quest.0065DA4214B7B303.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eAncient Remnant&r can be found within an &dOtherworld Dungeon&r.
quest.0065DA4214B7B303.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e远古遗魂&r可在&d异界地牢&r中找到。

quest.0065DA4214B7B303.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are found scattered throughout the &dVoid Chasm&r ring.
quest.0065DA4214B7B303.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该结构散布在&d虚空裂隙&r环周围。

quest.007CD364F96C2912.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aFree Runner&r boots provide little protection, but prevent all fall damage.
quest.007CD364F96C2912.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a自由助跑器&r只能提供一点点防御能力，但可以完全免疫摔落伤害。

quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 说是“交流”的话，或许有些牵强了。

quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[2].en_us: You will need the souls of specific mobs, and that means cosplaying as the Grim Reaper and swinging a &aScythe&r.
quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要特定生物的灵魂，这意味着你要扮演一名挥舞着&a镰刀&r的死神。

quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[4].en_us: Mobs will release their spirits when killed with the &aScythe&r, meaning you'll need to hunt down specific monsters for their souls.
quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 生物被&a镰刀&r杀死时会释放精魂，因此，你需要击杀特定的怪物来获取它们的灵魂。

quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[8].en_us: Zombies and Skeletons should have all of the souls you need for this craft.
quest.007F4A173D5CA51F.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 僵尸和骷髅拥有此任务所需的所有种类的灵魂。

quest.0089BFB911BD5E5B.quest_desc[0].en_us: While only being able to operate in a radius (1 block per &2scale module&r), the &eInterdiction Matrix&r is no less powerful for it.
quest.0089BFB911BD5E5B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然&e结界矩阵&r的能力只在一定范围内有效（每个&2尺寸模块&r增加一格半径），但它的威力依旧不容小觑。

quest.0089BFB911BD5E5B.quest_desc[2].en_us: When powered by &3Fortron&r and with a &aBiometric Identifier&r on its frequency, it can use installed &amodules&r to perform various key functions, such as: killing hostile mobs, denying block interaction without use of chunk claims or among team members, and warning the general public that they're getting too close to that nuclear mishap &l(not your fault)&r
quest.0089BFB911BD5E5B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 提供&3力场子&r和一台处于相同频率的&a生物识别器&r，结界矩阵就可以通过安装&a模块&r来实现各种实用功能，例如击杀敌对生物，在不使用区块声明或非同队成员的情况下禁止方块交互，并警告公众不要过于靠近&l（不是你的错）&r等等。

quest.009EE2933A83120B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6W.E.R.K&r has encountered a system error, perhaps &dThe Wyrmwright&r will be able to find traces of her brother &k&6Chaos&r.
quest.009EE2933A83120B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6知识库&r发生了一个系统错误，也许&d飞龙匠人&r能找到她的弟弟&k&6混沌&r的踪迹。

quest.009FE1E1B3017486.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cMob Slaughter Factory&r does more than just kill passive mobs for meat—it reduces them to &dPink Slime&r, a liquid that is crucial for progression in &eI.F&r.
quest.009FE1E1B3017486.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c生物屠宰厂&r不仅可以屠宰友好生物获取肉汤，还能把它们变成&d粉红黏液&r。你需要粉红黏液才能继续发展&e工业先锋&r。

quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eApotheosis&r overhauls the vanilla enchanting system with three new values, allowing for high-level enchants with upgradable progression. You will want to manage these values as you progress through upgrading your enchanting setup:
quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e神化&r模组大幅修改了原版的附魔系统，增加了三种新属性，玩家可以在升级过的附魔设施中进行更高阶的附魔。升级附魔设施时，你需要合理安排这三个属性的数值：

quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aEterna&r: The power of the enchanting table, capped based on the tier of your bookshelves. This stat determines the maximum level of enchants.
quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a位阶&r：这是附魔台的力量源泉，其最大值取决于你的书架等级。这个属性决定了附魔的最高等级。

quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[4].en_us: &cQuanta&r: The chaos inherent when enchanting at higher power. This determines the randomness of enchants.
quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &c量子化&r：这是进行高阶附魔时必然产生的混沌。这个属性决定了附魔的随机性。

quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[6].en_us: &dArcana&r: The overall quality and quantity of the enchantments. This determines the rarity of enchants, as well as how many enchants are applied per use.
quest.00A7C1FE54F86429.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &d阿卡那&r：这代表着魔咒的整体质量和数量。这个属性决定了魔咒的稀有度，以及单次附魔能够获得的魔咒数量。

quest.00A7DEFCF07BC63A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zRed Katar&r is the ultimate weapon from &6ProjectE&r.
quest.00A7DEFCF07BC63A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z红物质拳剑&r是&6等价交换&r模组的终极武器。

quest.00A7DEFCF07BC63A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Set a keybind to ProjectE's Extra Function and it will deal 25 damage to everything around you with each activation.
quest.00A7DEFCF07BC63A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 为等价交换的额外功能（Extra Function）设置一个快捷键以使用，每次使用时会对附近的任何生物造成25点伤害。

quest.00EF9BD860108718.quest_desc[0].en_us: You can convert your &aIron Furnace&r into a generator using the &aAugment: Generator&r!
quest.00EF9BD860108718.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 借助这个&a强化组件：发电机&r，你就可以把&a更多熔炉&r模组的熔炉变成发电机！

quest.00EF9BD860108718.quest_desc[2].en_us: By itself, this allows you to burn items like coal or wood to generate power depending on the tier of furnace you have. You can couple this generator with a &aBlasting Augment&r to allow you to burn metals like Iron or Diamond for even more power.
quest.00EF9BD860108718.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 安装该组件后，你就可以燃烧各种物品发电了，比如煤炭或者木头，具体能烧什么取决于该熔炉的种类。比如说，你可以给这个发电机安装&a强化组件：高炉&r，这样它就可以烧铁或者钻石之类的矿物，发更多的电了。

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Apotheosis&r has a new &bWorld Tier&r system that can be accessed using "CTRL + T" by default.
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6神化&r模组添加了一个全新的&b世界层级&r系统，默认可以通过“CTRL+T”查看。

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["You start at ", {"text": "Haven", "color": "#7E7E7E"}, " upon acquiring your first ", {"text": "Affix Item", "color": "#55FF55"}, ", and unlock more tiers as you advance in the mod."]
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["获得第一个", {"text": "词缀物品", "color": "#55FF55"}, "后·，你就会进入", {"text": "居所", "color": "#7E7E7E"}, "层级。随着模组进程的推进，你会解锁更多的层级。"]

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[4].en_us: Higher tiers increase the difficulty and rewards across all dimensions. These rewards can be checked in the Tiers menu ("CTRL + T").
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 随着层级升高，所有维度的难度和奖励都会增加，具体可在层级菜单（“CTRL+T”）中查看。

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[6].en_us: In order to progress your &bWorld Tier&r, you can check the &6Apotheosis&r advancements using "L" by default, and going to the tab with a skull to guide you through the progression.
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 要提升你的&b世界层级&r，你可以按“L”（默认按键），然后点进带有头颅的选项卡，即可查看&6神化&r模组的进度，它会指导你推进。

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[8].en_us: You can also check the next page on this quest for all of the requirements.
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你也可以在此任务的下一页中查看提升层级所需的条件。

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "居所", "color": "#7E7E7E"}, " - 获得第一个", {"text": "词缀", "color": "#55FFFF"}, "装备。"]

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[14].en_us: ["", {"text": "Frontier", "color": "#55FF55"}, " - Equip a full set of ", {"text": "Common", "color": "#7E7E7E"}, " or higher ", {"text": "Affix", "color": "#55FFFF"}, " gear."]
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "边境", "color": "#55FF55"}, " - 穿上一整套", {"text": "普通", "color": "#7E7E7E"}, "或更高级", {"text": "词缀", "color": "#55FFFF"}, "的装备。"]

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[16].en_us: ["", {"text": "Ascent", "color": "#5454FC"}, " - Equip a full set of ", {"text": "Uncommon", "color": "#55FF55"}, " or higher ", {"text": "Affix", "color": "#55FFFF"}, " gear and slay an ", {"text": "Apotheosis", "color": "#FFAA00"}, " boss monster."]
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "攀升", "color": "#5454FC"}, " - 穿上一整套", {"text": "罕见", "color": "#55FF55"}, "或更高级", {"text": "词缀", "color": "#55FFFF"}, "的装备，并击杀一个", {"text": "神化", "color": "#FFAA00"}, "Boss。"]

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[18].en_us: ["", {"text": "Summit", "color": "#B900B9"}, " - Equip a full set of ", {"text": "Rare", "color": "#5454FC"}, " or higher ", {"text": "Affix", "color": "#55FFFF"}, " gear and slay the Wither"]
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "高峰", "color": "#B900B9"}, " - 穿上一整套", {"text": "稀有", "color": "#5454FC"}, "或更高级", {"text": "词缀", "color": "#55FFFF"}, "的装备，并击杀凋灵。"]

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[20].en_us: ["", {"text": "Pinnacle", "color": "#EA6F14"}, " - Equip a full set of ", {"text": "Epic", "color": "#B900B9"}, " or higher ", {"text": "Affix", "color": "#55FFFF"}, " gear and slay the Chicken Jockey Boss"]
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[20].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "顶点", "color": "#EA6F14"}, " - 穿上一整套", {"text": "史诗", "color": "#B900B9"}, "或更高级", {"text": "词缀", "color": "#55FFFF"}, "的装备，并击杀末影鸡骑士。"]

quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[22].en_us: Changes for each tier can be checked in the &bWorld Tiers&r menu ("CTRL + T" by default).
quest.011DBD2652E49B97.quest_desc[22].zh_cn: 你可以在&b世界层级&r菜单（默认为“CTRL+T”）中查看每个层级的变化。

quest.012AEBFDB1F1512E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eJust Dire Things&r armor can be tiered up via &aSmithing Templates&r and accept more &2Upgrades&r as they rank up to armor better than netherite.
quest.012AEBFDB1F1512E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eJust Dire Things&r模组的盔甲可以使用&a模板&r来升阶，且盔甲的等阶越高，可以加装的&2升级&r就越多，最终可以打造出比下界合金更强大的盔甲。

quest.0138DA9E72BF9CE0.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass will lead you to the nearest &aHealing Spring&r.
quest.0138DA9E72BF9CE0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针会指向最近的&a治愈之泉&r。

quest.0171649B0F984DBB.quest_desc[0].en_us: This quest will set up a waypoint to the &dWyrmwright's &6Archive&r.

quest.0173ED2BED248CF6.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aMatter&r &eTransmitters&r and &aReceivers&r can be used to set up teleportation back and forth within the world.

quest.018B19721F4404FF.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Ender Pearls or Eyes of Ender.
quest.018B19721F4404FF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 消耗末影珍珠或末影之眼发电。

quest.0191028C1E2EAA31.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eMalum's &aScythes&r allow you to reap &bSpirits&r from your enemies.
quest.0191028C1E2EAA31.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e灵灾&r模组的&a镰刀&r可以收割敌人的&b精魂&r。

quest.0191028C1E2EAA31.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dEdge of Deliverance&r can be exceptional for early bosses with its critical enhancement passive effect and increased attack reach.
quest.0191028C1E2EAA31.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d挽魂锋镰&r有强力的被动效果加成以及更长的攻击距离，在对付游戏前期的boss时非常好用。

quest.019C7CBC9B62C803.quest_desc[0].en_us: Don't like the look of Drawers? Make &aFramed Drawers&r instead!
quest.019C7CBC9B62C803.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 不喜欢抽屉的样子？那就做个&a镶框抽屉&r吧！

quest.019C7CBC9B62C803.quest_desc[2].en_us: These drawers can be crafted together with other items to change the look of the drawer to your liking. Each slot in the crafting table corresponds to a specific texture on the drawer.
quest.019C7CBC9B62C803.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以把别的物品和这些抽屉合成以改变外观。每个合成槽都代表抽屉上的一块纹理。

quest.01D2CEAF59872C33.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aGem Cutting Table&r is used to upgrade &bGems&r.

quest.01D2CEAF59872C33.quest_desc[2].en_us: Upgrading a &bGem&r costs &aGem Dust&r, rarity materials, and a second &bGem&r of the same rarity. The material and dust cost of upgrading a &bGem&r increases with its rarity.
quest.01D2CEAF59872C33.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 升级&b宝石&r需要消耗&a宝石粉&r、对应稀有度的材料以及另一枚同稀有度的&b宝石&r。&b宝石&r的稀有度越高，升级消耗的材料就越多。

quest.01D2CEAF59872C33.quest_desc[4].en_us: The exact upgrade costs will be shown in the table's interface.
quest.01D2CEAF59872C33.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 具体的升级花费会在切割台的UI中显示。

quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dSupercritical Phase Shifter&r (&dSPS&r) is a large structure that uses as much power as you can give it to generate small amounts of &5Antimatter&r from large amounts of &bPolonium&r.
quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d超临界移相器&r（&dSPS&r）是一种大型结构，它会消耗你供给的全部能量，将大量的&b钋&r转化为少量&5反物质&r。

quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[2].en_us: This completely eliminates all possible &cNuclear Waste&r if that is a concern, though the energy used to process an amount of &bPolonium&r is greater than the energy made to create it, so additional power is required.
quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这完全消除了所有可能关于&c核废料&r顾虑，不过，处理一份&b钋&r所消耗的能量会大于其产生的能量，因此需要供给额外的能量才能持续运转。

quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[4].en_us: Simply feed chemical &bPolonium&r into one &dSPS Port&r, power into another attached to a &dSupercharged Coil&r on the inside, and one more &dSPS Port&r for extracting &5Antimatter&r.
quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 只需将化学品&b钋&r输入到一个&d超临界移相器端口&r，将电力输入到另一个与内部&d增压线圈&r相连的端口，最后再通过一个&d超临界移相器端口&r提取&5反物质&r即可。

quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[6].en_us: Each 1000mB of &5Antimatter&r can be turned into a single &5Antimatter Pellet&r.
quest.01DB719967817220.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 每1000mB的&5反物质&r可制成一个&5反物质球&r。

quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Timedoor Projector&r is a crude device that can open up timedoors for travel!
quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2时门投影仪&r是一个可以开启时门，用于快速旅行的简单设备！

quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[2].en_us: Sneak to place it on the ground then insert a &aLocation Card&r into it, or use a location card on the item while in your inventory.
quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 潜行时放置它，然后插入一张&a定位卡&r，或者在物品栏中拿着一张定位卡对它右击。

quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once a location card is inserted and you have enough &bChronon&r, you can open a portal door.
quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在正确插入定位卡，而且你有足够的&b时元&r后，就能够开启传送门了。

quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[6].en_us: This is done one of two ways: non-sneaking use from your hand, or when receiving a redstone signal in block mode.
quest.0219C9D8447C8936.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 有两种方式开启任意门：直接拿着它右击，或者在放置后，使用红石信号激活它。

quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eAE2&r has its own power unit called &bAE&r. By default, it does not accept power directly from other sources.
quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eAE2&r有自己的能量单位，叫做&bAE&r。AE2的设备默认不支持其他模组的能量。

quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[2].en_us: However, you can use an &aEnergy Acceptor&r to convert FE power into AE power for your network, which can be distributed out using &2Glass Cables&r.
quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 不过你也可以用&a能源接收器&r将FE变为AE能量，使用&2玻璃线缆&r可以仅传输能量。

quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[4].en_us: If you start running out of power as you add more machines to your network, it might help to create an energy buffer using &bEnergy Cells&r, which store power for future use.
quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 假如你的网络里头机器太多了，把能量都吸干了的话，加装一个缓存AE能量的&b能源元件&r也许是个不错的选择。

quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[6].en_us: You can also generate free power using the &dCrystal Resonance Generator&r.
quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &b水晶共振生成器&r可以为你免费产生AE能量。

quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[8].en_us: This generator extracts free energy from the vibrations of the crystals within it to generate around 20 AE/t. These vibrations limit your system to only have one of these per AE network.
quest.0224277CBEC1375E.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 这个共振发生器会吸收水晶的震动能量，功率约为20AE/t。不过由于共振的原因，每个AE网络只允许安装一个。

quest.02735F0443CA9727.quest_desc[0].en_us: These compasses point to locations of &3Vaults.

quest.02735F0443CA9727.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.02735F0443CA9727.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.02BC8FCDB2D94F0E.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.02BC8FCDB2D94F0E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.02BC8FCDB2D94F0E.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.02BC8FCDB2D94F0E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.02F6AC9E53029E0A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Combining a &bPrinted Circuit&r with &aPrinted Silicon&r and a piece of &cRedstone&r, you can craft a complete &dProcessor&r.
quest.02F6AC9E53029E0A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 将&b电路板&r、&a硅板&r和&c红石&r放在一起压印可以制得完整的&d处理器&r。

quest.02F6AC9E53029E0A.quest_desc[2].en_us: These &dProcessors&r are the main crafting components needed for most of the electronics you'll use, like &aTerminals&r, &eDisk Drives&r, and lots more.
quest.02F6AC9E53029E0A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些&d处理器&r就是制造AE2主要设备的重要元件，比如&a终端&r和&e驱动器&r之类的东西。

quest.02F6AC9E53029E0A.quest_desc[4].en_us: It's worth automating the production of these as soon as possible!
quest.02F6AC9E53029E0A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这三样物品的自动化非常重要，越早越好！

quest.0306C0D774144DAD.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.0306C0D774144DAD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.0306C0D774144DAD.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.0306C0D774144DAD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[0].en_us: &cReactor Heat Vents&r remove heat from the hottest neighboring component (&3Fuel Rods&r or &cHeat Pipes&r) and vent it out of the &dReactor&r.
quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c反应堆散热口&r会吸收最热的相邻组件（&3燃料棒&r或&c热量管道&r）的热量，并排出&d反应堆&r。

quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[2].en_us: The amount of heat removed is based on the temperature of the neighboring component. Hotter components will result in more heat removed.
quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 吸收热量的多少取决于该相邻组件的温度。相邻组件的温度越高，它吸收的热量就越多。

quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[4].en_us: &cReactor Heat Pipes&r take heat from &3Fuel Rods&r and spread it among neighboring &cHeat Vents&r.
quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &c反应堆热量管道&r会吸收&3燃料棒&r的热量，然后将热量传递至相邻的&c散热口&r中。

quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[6].en_us: The maximum transferred heat amount from a neighboring component is based on the temperature difference between them.
quest.030F1F8A4B0C1EBF.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 相邻组件间的最大热量转移量取决于两个组件之间的温差。

quest.033F3D2427ED6F40.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 允许更多类型的红石信号控制

quest.036047DE66198D10.quest_desc[0].en_us: If &aLeaves&r are dried out, they can be used to make stronger fibers.
quest.036047DE66198D10.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 烘干后的&a树叶&r可以制成更坚韧的纤维。

quest.036047DE66198D10.quest_desc[2].en_us: Make a &aCampfire&r and place the &aLeaves&r in it to dry them out. Once dry, you should be able to turn them into straw by breaking them with &aCrook&r.
quest.036047DE66198D10.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制造一个&a营火&r，把&a树叶&r放入烘干，烘干后，用&a钩子&r破坏它们，就可以获得草秆。

quest.036C11AC70835846.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aEnderic Lasers&r are primarily used to create &aFluxite&r, but can also be used to transfer RF wirelessly or mine blocks in the world.
quest.036C11AC70835846.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a末影激光器&r一般拿来制造&a辐水晶&r，不过它还有传输RF和挖掘方块的用途。

quest.036C11AC70835846.quest_desc[2].en_us: To link a machine or block to the &aEnderic Laser&r, use the &eTarget Designator&r by Sneak + Right-clicking the machine or block, then Sneak + Right-clicking the Enderic Laser to link them.
quest.036C11AC70835846.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果想把方块或机器链接到&a末影激光器&r上，首先拿着&e目标标识器&r潜行右击机器/方块，然后再潜行右击末影激光器即可。

quest.036C11AC70835846.quest_desc[4].en_us: &l&cWARNING!&r Removing a linked block without stopping the laser will mine all blocks within range of the laser's line of sight.
quest.036C11AC70835846.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &l&c警告！&r如果在未关闭激光的情况下就挖掉链接的方块，激光就会把激光线路上的方块全部破坏！

quest.03AC1C56F20BB662.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have some &dArcane Essence&r, there are a few spellbooks that you can craft for an upgrade!
quest.03AC1C56F20BB662.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在你有了一些&d奥术源质&r后，就可以制作几本法术书来升级！

quest.03BEFC2150D09E7A.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dWireless Grids&r allow remote access to your storage network when within range of the &3Wireless Transmitter&r.

quest.03BEFC2150D09E7A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each &dWireless Grid&r provides the same functionality as their corresponding &aGrids&r.

quest.03E48CD6E5DB806F.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Wyrmwright&r.
quest.03E48CD6E5DB806F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，寻找&d飞龙匠人的回响&r了。

quest.03E48CD6E5DB806F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with them to unlock the &dDraconic Energy&r upgrade for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.03E48CD6E5DB806F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与他合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&d神龙能量&r升级。

quest.03E48CD6E5DB806F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo wyrmwright&7.
quest.03E48CD6E5DB806F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo wyrmwright&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.04013A6813F80EF7.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you think the Simple Coal Generator is good, you should try out the &aSimple Fuel Generator&r.
quest.04013A6813F80EF7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你觉得初级煤炭发电器挺好用的，那你可以再试试这个&a初级燃液发电器&r。

quest.04013A6813F80EF7.quest_desc[2].en_us: Instead of burning coal, this burns the special &6Fuels&r from &6Just Dire Things&r, with the highest tier producing 4k RF/t.
quest.04013A6813F80EF7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它不是烧煤炭的，而是烧这些来自&6Just Dire Things&r模组的特殊&6燃料&r的，最高级的燃料产能速率可达4000RF/t。

quest.040795388568AB69.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dEnder Guardian&r is found within the &eRuined Citadel&r structure.
quest.040795388568AB69.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d末影守卫&r可在&e废弃堡垒&r结构内找到。

quest.040795388568AB69.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can find this structure in the &eEnd&r ring.
quest.040795388568AB69.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在&e末地&r环中找到这个结构。

quest.0415C8A3274EF9D1.quest_desc[0].en_us: You find yourself at the event horizon of a gigantic black hole. Explore the area and find &6Chaos&r.
quest.0415C8A3274EF9D1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你发现自己正处在一个巨型黑洞的事件视界。探索这片区域并找到&6混沌&r。

quest.0415C8A3274EF9D1.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with him to learn about the draconic species' most prized creation and acquire the &3Awakened Core Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.0415C8A3274EF9D1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与他合作，学习龙族最珍贵的造物，并为你的&6世界引擎&r安装&3觉醒核心升级&r。

quest.0428CA9172ACC5E3.quest_desc[0].en_us: This item works as a universal wireless terminal without the need for power.
quest.0428CA9172ACC5E3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此物品可以当作无线通用终端使用，但是它不需要能源。

quest.0448DC5884C8ED55.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Quartermaster&r.
quest.0448DC5884C8ED55.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多的&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，去寻找&d军需官的回响&r了。

quest.0448DC5884C8ED55.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to discover your first &3Major Upgrade&r.
quest.0448DC5884C8ED55.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，去探寻你的第一个&3主要升级&r。

quest.0448DC5884C8ED55.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo quartermaster&7.
quest.0448DC5884C8ED55.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo quartermaster&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.046FCE929A728A34.quest_desc[0].en_us: The wonders of &zInfinity&r, compressed into the form of a block.

quest.046FCE929A728A34.quest_desc[2].en_us: Head back to &zInfinity&r to finalize your &6World Engine&r.
quest.046FCE929A728A34.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 回到&z无尽&r身边，完成&6世界引擎&r的最终升级。

quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby to find the &dEcho of The Machinist&r.
quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，去寻找&d机械师的回响&r了。

quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dMachinist&r specialises in calibrated engineering and moving contraptions.
quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d机械师&r擅长设备校准和移动装置的制造。

quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[4].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock the &3Shadow Casing Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&3暗影机壳升级&r。

quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo machinist&7.
quest.0484D6030DF690BD.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo machinist&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.049DE43A1B31C38F.quest_desc[0].en_us: This chapter covers most of the basic ways to store your items!
quest.049DE43A1B31C38F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个章节会着重介绍大多数存储物品的办法！

quest.04ABB8DD43099429.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMagmator&r burns &cLava&r and other hot fluids to generate power over time.
quest.04ABB8DD43099429.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a岩浆发电机&r可以燃烧&c熔岩&r之类的热流体产生能量。

quest.04ABB8DD43099429.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is a great early generator if you have a good way of generating lava, but gets even better once you can automate &emore advanced fuels&r!
quest.04ABB8DD43099429.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在游戏前期，如果你有稳定的熔岩供应的话，用这个发电机来发电是个不错的选择。未来它还能变得更好用，因为那时候你就可以自动化生产&e更高级的燃料&r了！

quest.04E68DA90DC83B45.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.04E68DA90DC83B45.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.04E68DA90DC83B45.quest_desc[2].en_us: You will still need to set up and connect a rotational power source close to the &6World Engine&r.
quest.04E68DA90DC83B45.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你仍需在&6世界引擎&r附近搭建并接入一个旋转动力源。

quest.04E68DA90DC83B45.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.04E68DA90DC83B45.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.051AA9C595DC9B02.quest_desc[0].en_us: This quest will set up a waypoint to &dThe Catalyst's &6Archive&r.

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eMekanism &dFission Reactors&r take fissile fuel and coolant, and convert them into &6nuclear waste&r and &bhot coolant&r.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e通用机械&r的&d裂变反应堆&r会消耗裂变燃料和冷却剂，然后将它们转换为&6核废料&r和&b热冷却液&r。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[2].en_us: &dFission Reactors&r do not generate power by themselves. They can produce steam that can be pumped into a &6Turbine&r.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 虽然&d裂变反应堆&r本身不发电，但是它产生的蒸汽可以被泵入&6涡轮机&r中。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dReactor&r accepts two forms of coolants which can be piped directly into the multiblock via a port. &bWater Cooling&r is simpler but less effective, while &6Sodium Cooling&r is stronger but requires an additional multiblock.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d裂变反应堆&r可以使用两种冷却剂，冷却剂可以通过裂变反应堆端口输入。&b水冷&r更加简单，但是热交换效率较低；&6钠冷&r效率更强，但是需要额外的多方块结构才能用。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[6].en_us: Failing to provide coolant will not stop a running reactor, but will cause it to &coverheat&r, &ctake internal damage&r, and eventually &cexplode&r, releasing &cradioactive material&r. Failing to empty the waste will cause it to also &cleak out into the environment&r and accumulate as &eradiation&r.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 未能及时提供冷却剂不会导致正在运行的反应堆停机，但是会让其&c过热&r，导致&c内部受损&r，最终&c爆炸&r，释放&c放射性物质&r。未能排出的废料会&c泄漏到世界中&r并积累成为&e辐射&r。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[8].en_us: The smaller the build, the slower and fewer things can go wrong. Take your time and test it out.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 建造规模越小，出问题的概率就越低，但是速度也会更慢。花点时间自己琢磨一下吧。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[10].en_us: &7&oBuilding and operation are on the following pages.&r
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &7&o建造与操作详情见后续页面。&r

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[12].en_us: The smallest functioning &dFission Reactor&r is a 3x4x3 multiblock, which can scale up to 18x18x18. The edges of all &dReactors&r must be &aReactor Casings&r, but the faces can also include reactor glass, logic adapters, and/or ports.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 最小可运行的&d裂变反应堆&r是一个3x4x3的多方块结构，最大规模可以达到18x18x18。&d反应堆&r的12条边必须是&a反应堆外壳&r，而侧面可以是反应堆玻璃、逻辑适配器或反应堆端口。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[14].en_us: The &dReactor&r multiblock will form once the cuboid is fully built and at least one &2Fission Fuel Assembly&r is inside with a &aControl Rod Assembly&r on top.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 当多方块结构完全建成，且内部至少放置一个&2裂变燃料组件&r，顶部安装有一个&a控制棒组件&r时，&d反应堆&r的多方块结构将会自动形成。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[16].en_us: At least 4 &aFission Reactor Ports&r are needed to supply a &dFission Reactor&r: one for inputting &bWater&r, one for &2Fuel&r, one set to output &7Steam&r, and one set to output &cWaste&r. &dReactor Ports&r can be toggled by Sneak + Right-Clicking them with a &9Configurator&r.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: &d裂变反应堆&r至少需要4个&a裂变反应堆端口&r：一个用于输入&b水&r，一个用于输入&2燃料&r，一个用于输出&7蒸汽&r，以及一个用于输出&c废料&r。&d反应堆端口&r可以使用&9配置器&r潜行右击来切换模式。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[18].en_us: &dReactors&r can also accept &aFission Reactor Logic Adaptors&r for reading different information about its multiblock or for turning it on/off automatically.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: &d反应堆&r也可以直接接入&a裂变反应堆逻辑适配器&r，用于读取多方块结构的相关信息，也可实现自动开机或停机。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[20].en_us: &dReactors&r can burn fuel at a max rate of 1mB * (number of &3Fuel Assemblies&r) per tick, down to 0.01mB/tick.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[20].zh_cn: &d反应堆&r的燃烧速率最高可达1mB*（&3燃料组件&r数量）/tick，最低可降至0.01mB/tick。

quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[22].en_us: This rate also adjusts coolant demand, and the production of &7Steam&r and &cnuclear waste&r. Check the recipes and make sure your pipes can handle all these rates, as well as your coolant production.
quest.0533C0C07AE600FD.quest_desc[22].zh_cn: 速率会影响冷却剂的消耗，以及&7蒸汽&r和&c核废料&r的产出。请检查配方，并确保你管道的运输速率能够达到要求，同时冷却剂的供应充足。

quest.056492E163706EC5.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aDislocator&r can be used to store a teleport location by Sneak + Right-clicking with it in the world.
quest.056492E163706EC5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 潜行+右击可将你当前的位置（包括维度）存储到&a传送符咒&r。

quest.056492E163706EC5.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once stored, simply Right-click to teleport to that stored location, up to 32 times.
quest.056492E163706EC5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 存储位置后，手持符咒右击即可传送到此位置，最多使用32次。

quest.056492E163706EC5.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aUn-bound Dislocators&r can be set then placed onto a &aDislocator Pedestal&r to act as waystones to teleport you places. Using the pedestal doesn't use durability!
quest.056492E163706EC5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a未绑定的传送符咒（点对点）&r在使用后可放置到&a传送符咒基座&r上，之后基座可当作传送石碑使用。使用基座不会消耗耐久！

quest.056990503617C147.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dWyvern&r tools consume power instead of durability and can be customized via modules placed into their inventories.
quest.056990503617C147.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d双足飞龙&r工具使用电力代替耐久，可以通过安装模块来定制属性。

quest.056990503617C147.quest_desc[2].en_us: Their module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.
quest.056990503617C147.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.056990503617C147.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft this, you must have the &cAdvanced Machine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.056990503617C147.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成双足飞龙工具，你需要先进行&c高级机器方块&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[0].en_us: When a &dReactor's&r waste buffer overflows or a tube/machine holding radioactive chemicals is broken, a radiation source is spilled out into the world causing a &cnuclear accident&r.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 当&d反应堆&r的废料槽溢出，或装有放射性化学品的管道或装置被破坏时，辐射源会泄漏至环境中，引发&c核事故&r。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[2].en_us: Strong sources of &cradiation&r can linger in the world for several real-life hours. If irradiated, the only option available is to stop receiving radiation through &adistance&r, &aprotection&r, or both, and then let the radiation slowly fade.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 强烈的&c辐射源&r可以在游戏内存在数小时（现实时间）。如果受到辐射，唯一可行的选择是&a保持距离&r、&a防护措施&r或双管齐下，然后等待辐射慢慢消退。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aRadioactive Waste Barrels&r provide a safe place for regular and spent &cnuclear waste&r to slowly decay; multiple barrels are able to be used in parallel. This material &ccannot be destroyed&r through any other method. &bPolonium and plutonium&r do not decay in barrels, but can be stored. Comparators can read how full a &aWaste Barrel&r is.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a放射性废料桶&r为常规和废弃的&c核废料&r提供了一个安全的缓慢衰变场所；你可以同时使用多个废料桶。这种材料&c无法通过任何其他方法销毁&r。&b钋和钚&r不会在废料桶中衰变，但可以储存。比较器可以读取&a废料桶&r的满载程度。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[6].en_us: A full &6Hazmat Suit&r or equivalent upgrades are needed to protect you from radiation. These, however, do not cure radiation effects, and cannot be equipped to creatures, so be mindful where radioactive material is managed.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你需要一套完整的&6防化服&r或同等的升级装备才能保护自己免受辐射。然而，这并不能治愈辐射效果，也不能被生物所装备，所以在处理放射性物质时请务必小心谨慎。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[10].en_us: It is safer to treat &cnuclear accidents&r as a 'when' over an 'if'. Have precautions available and ready before producing radioactive products.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 将&c核事故&r看错“一定会发生”而不是“可能会发生”更为稳妥。在生产放射性产物之前，一定要做好充分的预防措施。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[12].en_us: Use whole amounts when processing nuclear waste, and let any excess decay in waste barrels.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 在处理核废料时，请使用正好够用的核废料，并让多余的废料在废料桶中自然衰变。

quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[14].en_us: Use logistics that transfer but don't hold the chemicals, such as &eApplied Energistics&r or &ePipez&r. The #1 cause of nuclear accidents among players is mistakenly broken piping that holds hazardous material, a &oDire&r situation.
quest.056C62BBBCEB1173.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 使用只传输不储存流体的运输方式，例如&e应用能源&r或&ePipez&r。发生核事故的大多原因，往往只是误拆了含有危险物质的管道，这局面堪称&o灾难性&r。

quest.059B456424293FF3.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the power of &dEther Gas&r, you can craft the final tier of machine frames!
quest.059B456424293FF3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 借由&d以太气体&r之力，你现在可以制作最高等级的机器框架了！

quest.05A6946A5AF26684.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you're looking for wireless redstone, &6Create&r has a simple &aRedstone Link&r that can connect up to any other link for wireless redstone. Using a &aCreate Wrench&r, you can toggle which link will transmit the redstone signal.
quest.05A6946A5AF26684.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你正在寻找无线红石，&6机械动力&r提供了一个简易的&a无线红石信号终端&r，可以连接到另一个信号终端实现无线红石。你可以用&a机械动力的扳手&r切换信号终端的模式，决定其是发送还是接收红石信号。

quest.05A6946A5AF26684.quest_desc[2].en_us: &6RFTools&r has something similar, but in two separate blocks.
quest.05A6946A5AF26684.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6RFTools&r也有类似的物品，但分成了两个独立的方块。

quest.05BB2A6101B519A0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Dimension Card&r grants you access to your network across dimensions at a hefty energy cost.

quest.05C3502C9F7BB7A3.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6MekaSuit&r can be crafted with some polonium and other high-end &eMekanism&r materials. These powered pieces of gear are very strong on their own, but can be vastly augmented with various &bModules&r from fortune to flight!
quest.05C3502C9F7BB7A3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作&6MekaSuit&r需要用到钋以及其他&e通用机械&r模组的高端材料。这种动力装甲本身就已非常强悍，但还能安装各种&b模块&r进一步强化，例如提供幸运效果和飞行功能！

quest.05C3502C9F7BB7A3.quest_desc[2].en_us: Simply place the crafted &bModule&r of choice in the similarly designed slot of the &aModification Station&r, and the piece of gear it applies to in the slot pointed to by the arrow.
quest.05C3502C9F7BB7A3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 只需将制作好的&b模块&r放入&a改造站&r中画有模块图标的槽位中，再把要改装的装备放入箭头所指的槽位中即可。

quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Sophisticated Backpacks&r provide a simple solution to your inventory problems! They can also be upgraded to hold even more items, and have tons of cool upgrades to help you in your adventures, like the &aCrafting Upgrade&r for a portable crafting table.
quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2精妙背包&r能轻松解决你的物品栏问题！它们可以升级，以便容纳更多物品，并且还有许多很酷炫的升级，可以在探险中提供帮助，比如可以随时随地使用工作台的&a合成升级&r。

quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can place these in a &eCurio Slot&r as well for easy access using a keybind. These can also be placed down in the world by Sneak + Right-clicking while it's in your main hand.
quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以把背包放到&e饰品栏&r，然后按快捷键就能打开。如果它在主手的话直接潜行右击就能放下。

quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["You can place these in a curio slot for easy access using the keybind ", { "keybind": "keybind.sophisticatedbackpacks.open_backpack", "color": "green" }, "."]
quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["你可以将其放在饰品栏，并使用快捷键轻松打开", { "keybind": "keybind.sophisticatedbackpacks.open_backpack", "color": "green" }, "。"]

quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: Backpacks do not connect to pipes or cables.
quest.05CEF45909A11F60.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：背包无法与管道或线缆相连。

quest.05F1EC4F14A449AD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aOre Laser Base&r from &bIndustrial Foregoing&r can be used to infinitely generate ores using &aLaser Drills&r.
quest.05F1EC4F14A449AD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b工业先锋&r的&a镭射钻基座&r，在使用&a镭射钻&r供能后可以用于无限产出矿物。

quest.05F1EC4F14A449AD.quest_desc[2].en_us: Within the UI, you can set the Y Lvl to determine what types of ores you want to find, as well as installing a &aColored Lens&r to allow the &aLaser Base&r to specialize in specific ore types.
quest.05F1EC4F14A449AD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在其UI中，你可以设置Y轴高度来决定你想要的矿物，同时安装&a镭射聚焦透镜&r可以使&a镭射钻基座&r专门寻找特定的矿物种类。

quest.05F1EC4F14A449AD.quest_desc[4].en_us: This machine becomes available with the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.05F1EC4F14A449AD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r后方可使用该机器。

quest.066342488E03F3B5.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bDiamonds&r make for great tools, but they tend to be brittle and shatter.
quest.066342488E03F3B5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b钻石&r能够制作绝佳的工具，但这些工具往往质地易碎，容易损坏。

quest.066342488E03F3B5.quest_desc[2].en_us: Using an &aAtomic Reconstructor&r, you can reinforce them to make them even stronger.
quest.066342488E03F3B5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 使用&a原子再构机&r可以加强其属性。

quest.066342488E03F3B5.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aReconstructor&r requires a special material to be crafted. The &2Geologist&r will know exactly where to find the crystal it needs.
quest.066342488E03F3B5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a原子再构机&r需要一种特殊材料来制作。&2地质学家&r知道哪里能找到这种水晶。

quest.066B47D2AB72355C.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon spawns at around x:512, z:512.

quest.06C9E9DBE25887D9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aLava Generator&r from &6Oritech&r generates RF by consuming lava. RF generation can be increased with &bAddons&r.
quest.06C9E9DBE25887D9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Oritech&r模组的&a熔岩发电机&r可消耗熔岩产生RF，加装&b插件&r可提升发电效率。

quest.06EC32E6140E68C1.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the power of &2Entro Crystals&r, you can create the fastest autocrafting setups using &dQuantum Autocrafting&r.
quest.06EC32E6140E68C1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 利用&2恩特罗水晶&r的力量，你就能搭建起最快的&d量子自动合成&r，也就是最快的自动化合成装置。

quest.06EC32E6140E68C1.quest_desc[2].en_us: The base crafting block is the &dQuantum Crafting Unit&r, which is needed for both the &6Quantum Crafter&r and the &6Quantum Computer Multiblock&r.
quest.06EC32E6140E68C1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 量子计算机的基础方块是&d量子合成单元&r，&6量子合成器&r和&6多方块量子计算机&r都需要它。

quest.07062B805D9238C0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The core device of the mod, the &aExperience Obelisk&r allows for lossless storage and fine manipulation of experience (XP) levels by converting it internally to and from a fluid called &bCognitium&r.
quest.07062B805D9238C0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 作为本模组的核心设备，&a经验方尖碑&r将经验等级与名为&b认知&r的流体相互转换，实现无损存储和对经验的精准调控。

quest.07062B805D9238C0.quest_desc[2].en_us: Other Cognition devices can be linked to this block with the &aStaff of Attunement&r, Cognition's "wrench," to enable or enhance their abilities. A &aMemory Tablet&r can be linked to remotely access an Obelisk in the general area. This link is per player.
quest.07062B805D9238C0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 其他认知设备可以通过这个模组的“扳手”——&a调试权杖&r连接到方尖碑，以启用或增强它们的能力。&a记忆石板&r链接到方尖碑后可实现远程访问，可供每名玩家使用。

quest.07062B805D9238C0.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oIt is also able to passively pick up XP orbs around it.
quest.07062B805D9238C0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o它还能够自动捡起周围的经验球。

quest.08000D28B577EF94.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.08000D28B577EF94.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.08145422E66D2B7D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dQuantum Entangloporter&r can transfer items, energy, gases, and liquids wirelessly.
quest.08145422E66D2B7D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d量子传送装置&r可以无线传输物品、能量、气体和流体。

quest.08145422E66D2B7D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once placed, you can right click to open up the interface. Inside, you can set specific frequencies, allowing you to link up to your other &dEntangloporters&r for wireless transmission.
quest.08145422E66D2B7D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 放下后，右击打开GUI。你可以在GUI里设定频率，频率设定后，将自动链接其他相同频率的&d量子传送装置&r，并开始无线传输。

quest.08145422E66D2B7D.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dEntangloporters&r have a buffer, so it can store a small amount of power, gases, etc. You'll want to set the sides up properly to determine what goes in and out of the block, especially if you are using these to transfer gases!
quest.08145422E66D2B7D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d量子传送装置&r内有缓存槽，可以储存少量能量或气体之类的东西。最好妥善设定它的输入面和输出面，在用它传输气体的时这点尤为重要！

quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Chickens will need a place to lay eggs and/or resources, which is what the &2Roost&r is for.
quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 小鸡需要一块地方来产蛋或资源，这就是&2鸡窝&r的作用。

quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[2].en_us: While chickens are in a &2Roost&r, they will need seeds matching their tier to produce resources. These tiered seeds are crafted using &bSouls&r.
quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 当小鸡位于&2鸡窝&r时，需要符合小鸡等级的饲料来生产资源。这些饲料可以用&b灵魂&r制作。

quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[4].en_us: The higher the Chicken's level, the more resources that are produced per seed.
quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 小鸡等级越高，每个饲料可产出的资源越多。

quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&f: You can rename your &2Roosts&r to keep things more organized, especially when using the &aRoost Collector&r.
quest.081EA35CCBDF793F.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&f：你可以重命名&2鸡舍&r使你的养鸡场更有条理，尤其是在使用&a鸡舍收集器（Roost Collector）&r时。

quest.08204AA5ACCC914E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aBackpacks&r can also be dyed! This is useful for color-coding your backpacks, or if you just want to look really cool with a black backpack on.
quest.08204AA5ACCC914E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a背包&r可以染色！这样一来，无论是用颜色来区分不同的背包，还是单纯想背着黑色背包耍酷，两者皆可。

quest.0826EF3E7B15B219.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Pink Items.
quest.0826EF3E7B15B219.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 消耗粉红色的物品发电。

quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[0].en_us: Within the Nether ring, you might run into an &cAncient Battleground&r.
quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在下界环中，你可能会碰到&c远古战场&r。

quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[2].en_us: Across the battlefield, you might see &cPiles of Armor Scraps&r. Mining these piles might seem tempting, but might disturb the &dAncient Knights&r that wore this armor.
quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在战场中，你可能会碰到&c散落的盔甲碎片&r。挖掘这些盔甲碎片也许十分诱人，但也可能会惊扰到&d远古骑士&r——这些盔甲的正主。

quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[4].en_us: Defeating one is necessary for progression, as these drop &cCinder Essence&r.
quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 为了推进游戏进度，你必须得击败一位远古骑士，因为它们会掉落&c灰烬源质&r。

quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[6].en_us: Also of note is &eHoglins&r of the crimson forests dropping the appropriately named &cHogskin&r, which is required for some improved spellbook crafts.
quest.08766B8721B4E541.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 同样值得一提的是，绯红森林中的&e疣猪兽&r会掉落所谓的&c疣猪皮&r。这种材料可以用来制作一些更强的法术书及相关物品。

quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the power of Teleportation Cores, you can create your own &dPortals&r using &6Mekanism&r to quickly travel around our bases, even across dimensions!
quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在&6通用机械&r模组中，你可以用传送核心的力量构建专属的&d传送门&r！不仅可以在基地周围快速移动，甚至可以跨维度传送！

quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[2].en_us: To build one, you'll need 1 &dTeleporter&r block and 9 &bTeleporter Frame&r blocks. Once built, you'll want to give the Teleporter block power, and then you can open it up and set a name for the frequency. Make sure to click the checkmark button when you are done naming it!
quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要想搭建传送门的话，你得先准备一个&d传送机&r和9个&b传送框架&r。建好后记得为传送机供电，然后打开UI给传送频率命名。命名完成后，别忘了点击确认按钮哦！

quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: To make these, it requires the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，需要先用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[6].en_us: All other Teleporters will now be able to see that frequency, and you can build another Teleporter and select the frequency to link them up.
quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 然后在其它传送器处就可以看到你设定好的频率，接着放置别的传送器，最后设定频率把它们挨个链接即可。

quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[10].en_us: The &dPortable Teleporter&r allows you to access all of your Teleporters, allowing for instant travel to any of them as long as it has power!
quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &d便携式传送器&r让你能够连接到所有的传送机，只要有能量提供，就能立即传送到任意一个传送点！

quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[12].en_us: By holding it in your hand and using it, you will see a list of your frequencies. You can then select one and click teleport!
quest.087D1FBAE8A425C0.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 右击它，就会显示你目前传送机的全部频率。选择并传送即可！

quest.091B8E814908DEDF.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAtomic Forge&r is a powerful machine capable of creating advanced computer chips, reinforcing deepslate, and even duplicating ores!
quest.091B8E814908DEDF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d原子锻造器&r是个强大的机器，可以合成一些高阶芯片、强化深板岩……甚至可以复制矿物！

quest.091B8E814908DEDF.quest_desc[2].en_us: It's a pretty big multiblock, requiring &b8 Machine Cores&r in total to build.
quest.091B8E814908DEDF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是个大型多方块结构，总共需要&b八个机器核心&r。

quest.091B8E814908DEDF.quest_desc[4].en_us: Energy pipes cannot connect directly to an &dAtomic Forge&r; it needs to be wirelessly powered by an &aEnderic Laser&r.
quest.091B8E814908DEDF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 能量管道无法直接连接到&d原子锻造器&r；需要用&a末影激光器&r来为机器供能。

quest.094A534C72917405.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon spawns in the lower parts of the &bOcean&r ring.
quest.094A534C72917405.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此地牢会生成在&b海洋&r环的下层。

quest.099481C1F0718B67.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &#FCD205Priest&r can be found in the &dTale of a Priest who knew too much!&r Gateway.
quest.099481C1F0718B67.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &#FCD205牧师&r可在&d一则传说——一位知道了太多的牧师&r传送门中找到。

quest.099594F0A383C280.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cAdvanced Machine Frame&r is the next tier upgrade for our machine frames.
quest.099594F0A383C280.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c高级机器框架&r是简易机器框架的升级版。

quest.099594F0A383C280.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine frame is used to make some of the most important machines, like the &dStasis Chamber&r and &3Ore Laser Base&r.
quest.099594F0A383C280.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种机器框架可以制造很多重要机器，比如&d冷凝室&r和&3镭射钻基座&r。

quest.09D15AF118F0C8D8.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have acquired all of the above &zcreative&r items, it's time for you to decide which system you want to give infinite power to.
quest.09D15AF118F0C8D8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你已经获得了以上所有的&z创造&r物品，是时候决定让哪个储存网络使用无限的力量了。

quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Tired of ugly cables dangling around your base?
quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 厌烦丑陋的电缆在你的基地周围乱晃吗？

quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eCable Facades&r (the mod) provides a one-size-fits-all solution to hiding all of your cables.
quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &eCable Facades&r模组提供了一种万能解决方案，可以隐藏你所有的电缆。

quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[4].en_us: To set up an empty &bFacade&r, place it in a crafting grid with the block you wish to change it to. This will "consume" the block, but this process can be reverted by placing the &bFacade&r back in a crafting grid and extracting the block.
quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将空的&b伪装方块&r与目标方块一起合成即可设置伪装。虽然合成时会“消耗”该方块，但你可以通过将&b伪装方块&r放回合成栏以拿回方块。

quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[6].en_us: Once set up, simply place the &bFacade&r over your ugly cables and voilà, your cables are gone!
quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 设置完成后，只需将&b伪装方块&r覆盖在杂乱的电缆上，电缆就消失无踪了！

quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[8].en_us: The &aFacade Wrench&r can be used to toggle facade transparency by Sneak + Right-clicking it.
quest.09DE55D4265E6E9D.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 使用&a伪装板扳手&r时，按住潜行键并右击即可切换伪装方块的透明状态。

quest.0A1243F0A9541645.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zInfinite Power Card&r can permanently power a force field.
quest.0A1243F0A9541645.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z无限能量卡&r可以永久地为力场子供能。

quest.0A2DB5AFC89E852F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCoke Oven&r is an early-game multiblock that converts regular coal into &3Coke Coal&r and &7Creosote Oil&r.
quest.0A2DB5AFC89E852F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a焦炉&r是游戏前期的多方块结构。能将煤炭转化为&3焦煤&r和&7杂酚油&r。

quest.0A2DB5AFC89E852F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &3Coke Coal&r is a more efficient fuel, while &aCreosote Oil&r will be used in many crafting recipes.
quest.0A2DB5AFC89E852F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &3焦煤&r是一种更加高效的燃料，而&a杂酚油&r可用于许多配方。

quest.0A2DB5AFC89E852F.quest_desc[4].en_us: To build this multiblock, make a 3x3x3 cube using &aCoke Bricks&r, then right click the middle block with the &bEngineer's Hammer&r to activate it.
quest.0A2DB5AFC89E852F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 要建造一座焦炉，你需要用&a焦炉砖&r摆成一个3x3x3的正方体，然后使用&b工程师锤&r右击任意一面中间的方块来完成这个多方块结构。

quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Within the lower parts of the &7Deepslate&r ring, you have a chance to run into the &dAncient City&r.
quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在&7深板岩&r环的下层，你有机会遇到&d远古城市&r。

quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Surely there is nothing bad down there. Just quietly sneak in and find a few of &dEcho Shards&r.
quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 那下面肯定没什么坏东西。悄悄溜进去，找几个&d回响碎片&r。

quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[4].en_us: You should see the &dEcho of The Enchanter&r after acquiring this shard.
quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 获得这种碎片后，去见见&d附魔师的回响&r吧。

quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: The &dEnchanter&r mentioned that the &dWayfinder&r can also offer you some that you can buy once you've completed some of their tasks.
quest.0A3C1CD48C85E17D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&d附魔师&r提到，在完成&d寻路者&r的一些任务后，你也可以在他的商店里找到一些回响碎片。

quest.0A6E103A6945D11E.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aFoundry&r is key for progression and specializes in creating all of the alloys needed to make &6Oritech&r machines.
quest.0A6E103A6945D11E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a铸造器&r是&6Oritech&r推动进度的重要机器，专门制作各种&6Oritech&r机器所需的合金。

quest.0A6E103A6945D11E.quest_desc[2].en_us: To build this multiblock, you'll need 3 &bMachine Cores&r total. Place the &aFoundry&r block first, then right click it to see where the Cores need to be placed. Once the cores are in place, right click again to finalize the machine!
quest.0A6E103A6945D11E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 搭建这个多方块机器一共需要3个&b机器核心&r。首先将&a铸造器&r放置，然后右击铸造器查看机器核心的位置。全部放好后右击机器即可！

quest.0A6E103A6945D11E.quest_desc[4].en_us: Note: Some of these alloys can also be crafted by hand or other modded machines, but doing so often consumes more resources.
quest.0A6E103A6945D11E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 注意：一些合金可以用其他模组的机器合成，甚至手搓都可以，不过代价是消耗更多资源。

quest.0A92084D7043133A.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bAddons&r are used to improve your Multiblock Machines depending on the type of Addon you choose to add.
quest.0A92084D7043133A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b插件&r可以提升你的Oritech多方块机器工作效率，提升的属性取决于使用的插件。

quest.0A92084D7043133A.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are attached to specific sides of your machines, or can be attached to a &aMachine Extender&r. Each Extender allows you to have more sides to attach more Addons!
quest.0A92084D7043133A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些插件需要装在机器的特定面上，或者装到&a机器扩展坞&r上。扩展坞安装得越多，可以安装插件的面也就越多！

quest.0A92084D7043133A.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can always check which sides of a machine can accept an Addon by checking the &bAddon GUI&r within the machine's interface.
quest.0A92084D7043133A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以打开机器界面中的&b插件GUI&r来确定机器的哪些面可以安装插件。

quest.0AA1977AC1B5E5A9.quest_desc[0].en_us: Anvils are all well and good for repairing mundane gear, but magical goods can be much more expensive or even impossible to repair in this manner. With a &aRepair Pylon&r, the &eSpirit Crucible&r is able to focus spirits and a repair material into a piece of gear, so long as it already has ties to &bcertain magics&r or is totally mundane.
quest.0AA1977AC1B5E5A9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 铁砧用来修复一般的装备非常合适，但用来修理魔法物品却会有非常昂贵的消耗，甚至可能无法修复。但只要有了&a修复基柱&r，你就可以用&e精魂坩埚&r来把精魂和修复材料集聚到装备上。无论是已经与&b特定种类的魔法&r相关联的装备，还是普通的装备，都可以修复。

quest.0AA1977AC1B5E5A9.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is also the only way to repair a &eFractured Impetus&r.
quest.0AA1977AC1B5E5A9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 此外，这也是唯一一种能够修复&e碎裂促符&r的方法。

quest.0AAA6858DAF43067.quest_desc[0].en_us: Cobblestone will only get you so far.
quest.0AAA6858DAF43067.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 圆石只能带你走到这一步了。

quest.0AAA6858DAF43067.quest_desc[2].en_us: Make a &aStone Hammer&r so that you can break Cobblestone down into a finer material. There has to be some minerals in it somewhere!
quest.0AAA6858DAF43067.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作一把&a石锤&r，这样就能把圆石砸碎成更精细的材料了。这里面肯定藏着矿物！

quest.0ABD10520EAB1C57.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aStorage Controllers&r allow you to connect and interact with several drawers at once. These are amazing for automating items going in and out of your drawer system!
quest.0ABD10520EAB1C57.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a存储控制器&r能连接大量抽屉并与其进行交互。对于要进进出出的自动化抽屉系统来说，这玩意简直是神器啊！

quest.0ABD10520EAB1C57.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once you've linked your drawers to the controller using the &3Linking Tool&r, you can double right click the controller to deposit all items from your inventory directly into the drawer network! This also means you can pipe in items into the controller as well.
quest.0ABD10520EAB1C57.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 将抽屉用&3链接工具&r链接到控制器后，只需双击控制器就可以将身上物品全部存入抽屉网络！意思就是你可以把外部输入直接通到控制器进行存储。

quest.0ABD10520EAB1C57.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aController Access Points&r can be used as extra controllers as long as it is linked to the main controller.
quest.0ABD10520EAB1C57.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a控制器扩展器&r在链接一个特定控制器后，就可以当做该抽屉控制器使用。

quest.0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2.quest_desc[0].en_us: Instead of picking through &7Dirt&r with a &2Crook&r, the &aCrude Brush&r can help you find smaller objects like &2Seeds&r to start a farm!
quest.0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 比起用&2钩子&r在&7泥土&r里翻找，用&a粗制刷子&r能找到更小的物品，比如&2种子&r，然后你就可以开辟农场了！

quest.0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2.quest_desc[2].en_us: Grass or &dDelightful Dirt&r can also be used to make a &aPassive Mob Farm&r that can be a good source of food and resources, especially &bLeather&r.
quest.0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 草地或&d祈福之土&r也可以用来建造&a友好生物农场&r，它能为你提供稳定的食物与资源，特别是&b皮革&r。

quest.0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dEcho of Guidance&r also sells a Gateway containing passive mobs.
quest.0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d指引者的回响&r也会出售一种包含友好生物的传送门。

quest.0AD2F3DB33241628.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eArs &aSpell Books&r are versatile tools that can create and cast spells.
quest.0AD2F3DB33241628.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e新生魔艺&r模组的&a法术书&r功能广泛，可以制造和施展法术。

quest.0AD2F3DB33241628.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eArs &2Tools&r become accessible after completing &dThe Magician's&r &3Source Upgrade&r. These magical tools can provide a vast amount of customization via spell-imbuement.
quest.0AD2F3DB33241628.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 完成&d魔法师&r的&3魔源升级&r之后，你才能使用&e新生魔艺&r的&2工具&r。这些魔法工具可以通过法术灌注来个性化。

quest.0ADBBF7BA99D2811.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eActually Additions' &aAll-In-One-Tools&r are handy additions to save you hotbar space, as they act as every tool at once!
quest.0ADBBF7BA99D2811.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e实用拓展&r模组的&a全能工具&r拥有所有种类工具的功能，可以大大节省你快捷栏的空间！

quest.0AFF8E28FC51B123.quest_desc[0].en_us: Need to swap two simple blocks with as little hassle as possible? Try the &cSwapper Wand&r!
quest.0AFF8E28FC51B123.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 想要轻松省事地交换两个普通方块吗？快来试试&c替换手杖&r吧！

quest.0AFF8E28FC51B123.quest_desc[2].en_us: Need to grab a block and place it somewhere else with as little hassle as possible? Try the Picker Wand!
quest.0AFF8E28FC51B123.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 想要轻松省事地将一个方块从一处搬到另一处吗？快来试试&c拾取手杖&r吧！

quest.0B02B72259362345.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.0B02B72259362345.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aModes&r and &2Modules&r instruct the &dProjector&r on how to function.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a模式&r和&2模块&r用来指示&d力场投影仪&r如何运行。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aShape Modes&r define the form &bForce Field Blocks&r will be placed in and &2Directional Modules&r &7(next quest)&r specify its placement in the world.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a各形状的模式&r决定&b力场方块&r放置的形状，而&2定向模块&r&7（下个任务）&r特化力场方块在世界中的放置方式。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[4].en_us: An &eInverter Module&r in the matrix slots will fill the &lentire&r projected volume with &bfield blocks&r instead of just creating an outline.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在矩阵槽放入&e反转模块&r将会用&b力场方块&r填充&l整个&r投射区域，而不是仅生成一个轮廓。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7&oMore mode details on the next pages.

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[8].en_us: &aCube Mode&r respects the directions of scale modules along an axis, and requires each of the three axes to be defined to form an enclosed field.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &a立方模式&r将尺寸模块视为对应轴方向的长度，需要三个拥有长度的坐标轴以形成一个封闭力场。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[10].en_us: &aSphere Mode&r treats every &2Scale module&r in the field slots as a single radius addition, allowing you to encase a vast area at the cost of reduced shape customization.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &a球体模式&r将力场槽内的每个&2尺寸模块&r视为增加一格半径，形状选择更少，但笼罩的区域更大。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[12].en_us: &aTube Mode&r is nearly identical to &aCube Mode&r, but has two of the resulting faces open.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: &a管状模式&r与&a立方模式&r几乎一致，但有两个面是空的。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[14].en_us: &aPyramid Mode&r forms a 4-sided pyramid with points along the horizontal axes, requiring all three axes to be defined, respecting Up/Down directions for height.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: &a椎体模式&r将生成一个四棱锥，以水平轴为端点，需要定义三个方向轴，将上下方向视为高度。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[16].en_us: &aCylinder Mode&r uses the horizontal axis as a radius, and the Up/Down axis as one total height.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: &a圆柱模式&r以水平轴作为半径，上下轴作为整体高度。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[18].en_us: &bCustom Mode&r can be used to set both opposing corners of an area. Sneak + Right-Clicking will set that field structure on any non-air blocks within that area. Sneak + Right-Clicking the air will clear the selection.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: &b自定义模式&r设置两个对角以确定选区。潜行右击以将力场形状设置为选区内所有非空气方块的形状，潜行右击空气将清除选区。

quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[20].en_us: &bThis mode&r ignores &2Scale Modules&r, and defaults its origin to the center of the selected area. A &dCamouflage Module&r will copy the selected blocks instead of its normal behavior.
quest.0B1E459D12D11A0D.quest_desc[20].zh_cn: &b此模式&r忽略&2尺寸模块&r，且默认以选区的中心为原点。安装&d伪装模块&r将显示原本选区内的方块，而非力场方块。

quest.0B25350118D515DF.quest_desc[0].en_us: The final upgrade for the &6World Engine&r requires the power of &zInfinity&r in block form.
quest.0B25350118D515DF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&r的最终升级需要方块形态的&z无尽&r之力。

quest.0B295CE75D367D59.quest_desc[0].en_us: Wood is important, especially in a world made of Stone. You need to make use of everything you can get!
quest.0B295CE75D367D59.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 木材很重要，尤其是在这个石头构成的世界里。你得充分利用能获取到的所有东西！

quest.0B295CE75D367D59.quest_desc[2].en_us: With your first pieces of Wood, make some &aWooden Shears&r to properly harvest those leaves as well!
quest.0B295CE75D367D59.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用你收集到的第一批木材制作几把&a木剪刀&r，这样就能收割那些树叶啦！

quest.0B65713A23351790.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWyvern Sword&r is a powered sword that allows for a ton of customization options.
quest.0B65713A23351790.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d双足飞龙剑&r是一把由能量驱动的剑，它具有多个自定义选项。

quest.0B65713A23351790.quest_desc[2].en_us: &6Draconic Evolution&r gear has its own interface that can store modular upgrades inside of each item.
quest.0B65713A23351790.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6龙之进化&r模组的装备都有一个可以安装升级模块的界面。

quest.0B65713A23351790.quest_desc[4].en_us: This allows you to upgrade any of the mod's items in many different ways using &dModules&r.
quest.0B65713A23351790.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以使用&d模块&r来个性化地升级本模组中的各种装备。

quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[0].en_us: While the main goal will be to upgrade the &bWorld Engine&r with the &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r, you'll need to upgrade how it handles power first.
quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然你的主要目标是用&c高级机器方块&r升级&b世界引擎&r，但在此之前，你需要先升级它的能量系统。

quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[2].en_us: Installing a single &cNitro Tier Ender Cell&r should allow it to handle more complex crafts related to the power of the &eEnd&r.
quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 为其安装一个&c末影单元（下界）&r，这样它就能处理与&e末地&r力量相关的更复杂的合成配方了。

quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[4].en_us: Of course, this will require at least one &dNether Star&r.
quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 当然，这至少需要一颗&d下界之星&r。

quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[6].en_us: Return to the &dEcho of The Catalyst&r so they may show you how to upgrade your &6World Engine&r.
quest.0B69B9E1209A9234.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 回到&d精械师的回响&r处，他会教你如何升级你的&6世界引擎&r。

quest.0B92679772DB0C68.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aShafts&r and &aCogwheels&r are the primary ways to transfer rotational force to your machines and contraptions.
quest.0B92679772DB0C68.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a传动轴&r和&a齿轮&r是将旋转力传递到你的机器与结构的主要方式。

quest.0B92679772DB0C68.quest_desc[2].en_us: Check the &aCogwheel&r &bPonder&r to see how they can also be used to increase/decrease &bRotation(s) Per Minute&r (&bRPM&r) within your system.
quest.0B92679772DB0C68.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 对着&a齿轮&r进行&b思索&r，了解它们如何应用于增加或减少动力网络中的&b每分钟转速&r（&bRPM&r）。

quest.0BAF0C06F01C4E80.quest_subtitle.en_us: Improves energy capacity and energy transfer rate
quest.0BAF0C06F01C4E80.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 提升储电能力，提高能量传输速率。

quest.0BE524ECA97A0E63.quest_desc[0].en_us: &cWARNING&r: Completing this quest will instantly skip all pack progression.
quest.0BE524ECA97A0E63.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c警告&r：完成此任务将立即跳过整合包的所有流程。

quest.0BE524ECA97A0E63.quest_desc[2].en_us: &oOnly use this if you know what you're doing. There is no undo button.
quest.0BE524ECA97A0E63.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &o仅在你清楚自己在做什么时使用。没有撤销按钮。

quest.0BEF15E1352A5F72.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have an experienced &dDimensionalist&r working for you, you'll run into a very valuable ore called &dRaw Replication&r.
quest.0BEF15E1352A5F72.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在有了经验丰富的&d维度学家&r为你所用后，你就能接触到一种被称作&d粗复制物质&r的珍贵矿物。

quest.0BEF15E1352A5F72.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is how you start &6Replication&r, which will allow you to break down items into &bMatter&r, which can be converted into other items that are made up of that same type of &bMatter&r.
quest.0BEF15E1352A5F72.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这就是开始&6Replication&r的方法，它能让你将物品分解为&b物质&r，而这些&b物质&r又可以被转化成由同种&b物质&r构成的其他物品。

quest.0BEF15E1352A5F72.quest_desc[4].en_us: Think Full Metal Alchemist level of Alchemy.
quest.0BEF15E1352A5F72.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 想想《钢之炼金术师》里的炼金术。

quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[0].en_us: To progress into more late-game &eCreate&r, you will need to craft different plates for different functions.
quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要进入更后期的游戏阶段的&e机械动力&r，你需要制作多种不同功能的金属板。

quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[2].en_us: &3Iron Plates&r are the most common type of plate used in most machines and items.
quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &3铁板&r是大多数机器和物品中最常用的金属板。

quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[4].en_us: &3Copper Plates&r are generally used for fluid-related components.
quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &3铜板&r通常用于流体相关部件。

quest.0BF770CB2B6312CF.quest_desc[6].en_us: &3Gold Plates&r are used for other miscellaneous recipes.

quest.0BFACB0AAEE7F4C2.quest_desc[0].en_us: Inventory management is pretty important, and that's what &dPocket Storage&r is for!
quest.0BFACB0AAEE7F4C2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 物品栏管理很重要，所以这个整合包添加了&d便携存储&r模组！

quest.0BFACB0AAEE7F4C2.quest_desc[2].en_us: These devices will automatically pick up items that you collect based on what is placed inside of them. This is perfect for keeping your inventory clear of cobblestone on your mining trips.
quest.0BFACB0AAEE7F4C2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个设备会自动拾取内部标记的物品，挖矿的时候用它存储挖到的圆石刚刚好。

quest.0BFACB0AAEE7F4C2.quest_desc[4].en_us: Note: These will automatically void excess items, meaning once you've collected the stack limit, those items will be voided. Upgrade the tier to store more at once!
quest.0BFACB0AAEE7F4C2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 注意：它会自动销毁过量物品。也就是说，到达存储上限后，收集的过量物品会直接销毁。升级可以扩大储存空间！

quest.0C0B04B6FEFD2928.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aImporters&r are used to input resources into your network, while &aExporters&r export items from your network.
quest.0C0B04B6FEFD2928.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a输入器&r用于将资源输入进你的存储网络中，而&a输出器&r用于将物品从存储网络中输出。

quest.0C0B04B6FEFD2928.quest_desc[2].en_us: &3Interfaces&r can input into and output from your network at the same time, functioning as an &aImporter&r and &2Exporter&r within the same blockspace.
quest.0C0B04B6FEFD2928.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &3接口&r能同时实现存储网络的输入与输出，在单个方块内视作&a输入器&r和&2输出器&r的结合体。

quest.0C5173F51D68317C.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the &5Umbral Spirit&r, you can craft a powerful weapon.
quest.0C5173F51D68317C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用&5幽影精魂&r，你可以合成一种强大的武器。

quest.0C5173F51D68317C.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Splintered World's&r special ability summons flying swords that home in towards your enemies.
quest.0C5173F51D68317C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6界幔残痕&r：其特殊能力可以召唤出数把飞剑，自动追踪并攻击你的敌人。

quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aRegulator Upgrade&r controls the amount of items imported/exported from your system.
quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a调节升级&r可控制进出你系统的物品数量。

quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[2].en_us: When used in an &aExporter&r, it will push items out of your system until the target inventory contains the configured quantity of items.
quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用于&a输出器&r时，它能持续向目标容器中输出网络中的物品，直到容器内的物品数量达到你所设定的值。

quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[4].en_us: When used in an &aImporter&r, it will keep the configured quantity of items in the target inventory and import all excess items into your storage network.
quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 用于&a输入器&r时，它将根据你所设定的值维持目标容器中的物品数量，并将超出部分输入到存储网络中。

quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[6].en_us: To set it up, Right-click to open the interface and place the item you want to configure in the right slot then type in the quantity of items you wish to configure.
quest.0C59F30673774398.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 右击以打开界面，并将你想设定的物品放在其右侧槽位，然后输入你要设定的物品数量即可。

quest.0C784115309E7C1C.quest_desc[0].en_us: To access your AE2 system wirelessly, you can make a &dWireless Access Point&r and a &dWireless Crafting Terminal&r.
quest.0C784115309E7C1C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要远程访问你的AE系统，你需要制作一个&d无线访问点&r和一个&d无线合成终端&r。

quest.0C784115309E7C1C.quest_desc[2].en_us: Installing &bWireless Boosters&r into the access point will extend the range but cost more energy to operate.
quest.0C784115309E7C1C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 向无线访问点内安装&b无线增幅卡&r可以扩大访问范围，但是会消耗更多的能量。

quest.0C784115309E7C1C.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dWireless Crafting Terminal&r allows you to link to a wireless access point in your network by placing it in the slot in its interface. Once linked, you can access all of your items and even craft on the go anywhere you have signal!
quest.0C784115309E7C1C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以用&d无线合成终端&r链接到你的AE网络无线访问点。把它放在无线访问点的槽位上就可以链接，链接完成后就可以用它访问你的物品，只要在信号范围内就可以随意合成！

quest.0CA6DA721A97542F.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are hundreds of items you can place in your &eCurio Slots&r which can be accessible by clicking this small button in your inventory:
quest.0CA6DA721A97542F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这里有数百种可以放在&e饰品栏位&r里的小物件。在物品栏中点击下方这个按钮就可以打开饰品栏：

quest.0CA6DA721A97542F.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can look up a specific slot item in JEI by typing in 'Slot: ' before the slot name, for example: &aSlot: Head&r or &aSlot: Feet&r.
quest.0CA6DA721A97542F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以在JEI中搜索特定栏位的饰品，只需在栏位名字前输入“栏位: ”即可。例如： &a栏位: Head&r、&a栏位: Feet&r。

quest.0CA75E81F6824B22.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you're into magic AND exploration, try out &eIron's Spells 'n Spellbooks&r. This is an amazing magic mod that adds a ton of spells for you to play with.
quest.0CA75E81F6824B22.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你喜欢法术，还喜欢探索，那你一定要试试&eIron's Spells 'n Spellbooks&r模组。这个精美的魔法模组添加了大量法术供你游玩。

quest.0CA75E81F6824B22.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can find a &aSpell Book&r as exploration loot, or you can start by making a &aFlimsy Journal&r or &aIronbound Tome&r to hold a few spells. We'll even provide a few starter &dSpell Scrolls&r for you!
quest.0CA75E81F6824B22.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在探险所得的战利品中找到&a法术书&r，同时你还可以制作&a初学者日志&r或&a铁箍书卷&r来保存一些法术。我们还给你准备了一些起步用的&d法术卷轴&r！

quest.0CA75E81F6824B22.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be cast as single-use items, or placed in your &aSpell Book&r to cast at-will with Mana.
quest.0CA75E81F6824B22.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这些卷轴可以作为一次性物品施放法术，也可以装进你的&a法术书&r里并消耗法力值来随意施放。

quest.0CE3C7A6DE787371.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.0CE3C7A6DE787371.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.0CE3C7A6DE787371.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.0CE3C7A6DE787371.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.0D159FD643581C18.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dMachinist&r mentioned a forgotten and potentially &cdangerous&r &3Vault&r that should contain the alloy needed to make the &6World Engine's &3Shadow Casing Upgrade&r.
quest.0D159FD643581C18.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d机械师&r提到了一处被遗忘且可能暗藏&c危险&r的&3宝库&r，里面应该藏有&6世界引擎&3暗影机壳升级&r所需的合金。

quest.0D159FD643581C18.quest_desc[2].en_us: Dig throughout the &3Stone&r and &3Deepslate&r rings to locate the &3Vault&r using the compass provided by the &dMachinist&r.
quest.0D159FD643581C18.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 跟着&d机械师&r给你的指南针，挖开层层叠叠的&3石头&r与&3深板岩&r环，去寻找那个&3宝库&r吧。

quest.0D38D67E3FD120CB.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["", {"text": "Chaotic", "color": "rainbow"}, " weapons are the final upgrades to ", {"text": "Draconic", "color": "gold", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "5388B67410670702" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Draconic Weapons Quest"}}, " weapons, with the most room for ", {"text": "Upgrade Modules", "color": "green"}, " and maximum customizability."]
quest.0D38D67E3FD120CB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "混沌", "color": "rainbow"}, "武器是", {"text": "神龙", "color": "gold", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "5388B67410670702" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往神龙武器任务"}}, "武器的最终升级版，可安装", {"text": "升级模块", "color": "green"}, "的数量最多，拥有最强的可定制性。"]

quest.0D38D67E3FD120CB.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also upgrade into or craft the &zChaotic Staff of Power&r, an All-In-One tool and weapon.
quest.0D38D67E3FD120CB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你还可以通过升级或直接合成的方式打造一根&z混沌之力权杖&r，它不仅是一把全能工具，还是一把武器。

quest.0D38D67E3FD120CB.quest_desc[4].en_us: Their module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.
quest.0D38D67E3FD120CB.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.0D57D3662EB40CE3.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aCapacitor Banks&r from &eEnderIO&r are used to store energy!
quest.0D57D3662EB40CE3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e末影接口&r模组的&a电容库&r是用来存储能量的！

quest.0D57D3662EB40CE3.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are easily configurable within the interface. You can also stack these together to make multiblock power banks.
quest.0D57D3662EB40CE3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在它的GUI中轻松调整各种设置。多个电容库可以堆放在一起，组成多方块电容库。

quest.0D864FD6A668D8C6.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Interfaces&r can input into and output from your network at the same time, functioning as an &aImporter&r and &2Exporter&r within the same blockspace.

quest.0DB5CBE2E76D2FD9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Pipez&r mod adds several useful pipes for transferring &bitems&r, &9fluids&r, &cpower&r, or &2gases&r. You can even use the &dUniversal Pipes&r to condense everything down into one pipe.
quest.0DB5CBE2E76D2FD9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Pipez&r模组添加了很多有用的管道，涵盖&b物品&r、&9流体&r、&c能量&r以及&2气体&r。你甚至可以用&d通用管道&r实现传输四合一。

quest.0DB5CBE2E76D2FD9.quest_desc[2].en_us: To set a pipe to extract, you'll need to Sneak + Right-click a &aPipe Wrench&r on the end of the pipe that is connected to the block you want to extract from. Once done, you can upgrade the pipe using a &bPipe Upgrade&r to make it faster, allow for filters, and more!
quest.0DB5CBE2E76D2FD9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要让连接到方块的管道开始抽取，你需要手持&a管道扳手&r潜行右击管道与方块的连接处。右击后，你还可以用&b管道升级&r来升级管道，让它们拥有更快的传输速度、物品过滤功能等等！

quest.0DB5CBE2E76D2FD9.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: &aPipes&r require the &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.0DB5CBE2E76D2FD9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成该模组的&a管道&r，需要先用&a机器方块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eXNET&r is a logistics mod that allows you to set up to 8 channel types (energy, item, fluid, gas, chemicals, and more) on a single connection network.
quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eXNET&r是一个物流模组，它允许你在一个网络中设定至多8种频道（能量、物品、流体、气体、化学品及其他）。

quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[2].en_us: Machines and storage devices can then be connected and managed all on a single network, taking up very little space and without the need for messy cables everywhere.
quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 接下来，你就可以在一个网络上统一连接机器以及存储设备，并进行管理。这只需要非常小的空间，不用把乱糟糟的线缆接得到处都是。

quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[4].en_us: To get started you’ll need some power (FE), a &aController&r and some &2Connectors&r.
quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 要想建立这种网络，你需要一些能量（FE单位），一个&a控制器&r以及一些&2连接器&r。

quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: The &aController&r requires the &aMachine Block&r and &cEnder Cell&r &3World Engine Upgrades&r to craft.
quest.0DF5D2B35FDEE536.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&a控制器&r，需要先用&a机器方块&r和&c末影单元&r进行&3世界引擎升级&r。

quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Controllers&r are used to increase the number of channels a network has. These aren't necessary to use in the early game, especially since you have 32 channels to work with by default. Networks without a &3Controller&r are considered &bAd-Hocs&r.
quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3ME控制器&r可以用来增加一个网络中的频道数量，这个东西在游戏初期并不是特别重要的东西，因为你初始网络自带36个频道。但是一个没有&3控制器&r的网络只能&b暂时拿来用用&r。

quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: &3Controllers&r require the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&3控制器&r，需要先用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &3Controller&r is considered the routing hub of your ME network. You cannot have 2 separate &3ME Controllers&r in the same network, but you can build a massive multiblock setup if you need the extra channels.
quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &3ME控制器&r是你的ME网络路由中心，一个网络内不允许存在两个互相独立的&3ME控制器&r。如果实在需要大量频道的话，你可以选择建造一个巨大的&3ME控制器&r多方块结构。

quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[6].en_us: A single &6Controller&r will provide &b128 Channels&r per face with the pack's settings. This makes it where if you add a controller, you will most likely never have to worry about channels.
quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 这个整合包开启了4倍频道设置，所以&6ME控制器&r一个面可以提供&b128个频道&r。只要你愿意堆叠控制器，根本不用担心频道问题。

quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[8].en_us: You can find more info and rules for building multiblock controllers in the &eAE2 Guide&r.
quest.0E06BDC6265EB7F7.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你可以在&eAE2教程&r中了解更多多方块控制器的介绍与搭建规则。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aReactor Fuel Rods&r are interior components that need to be supplied with &6Uranium&r or &dPlutonium&r &6Pellets&r from &aReactor Fuel Ports&r to generate heat.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a反应堆燃料棒&r是内部组件，需要&a反应堆燃料口&r提供&6铀&r或&d钚&r&6球&r来产生热量。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aFuel Port&r will be placed on the ceiling of the Reactor. This Port will need &aFuel Rods&r connecting it all the way to the bottom of the Reactor.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a燃料口&r需要放置在反应堆的顶面上，还需要用&a燃料棒&r将其与反应堆的底层相连。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[4].en_us: To create &6Uranium Pellets&r, you'll need access to the &6Atomic Forge&r to create &6Uranium Gems&r.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 生产&6铀球&r需要用到&6原子锻造器&r生产的&6铀石&r。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[6].en_us: When burning fuel, &aFuel Rods&r will generate neutron pulses that create a specific amount of energy, the more pulses a rod receives, the more energy it also creates. However, if a neighboring component is also a &aFuel Rod&r, it will also hit the neighboring component with a pulse.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 当燃烧燃料时，每个&a燃料棒&r会产生中子脉冲。每个脉冲默认生成固定能量。燃料棒接收到的脉冲越多，生成的能量也越多。 每个燃料棒默认发送和接收一个脉冲。然而，如果相邻组件也是&a燃料棒&r，则脉冲也会击中相邻的燃料棒。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[8].en_us: The amount of heat generated is based on the total pulses of a rod (internal + external pulses).
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 生成的热量基于燃料棒的总脉冲数（内部脉冲+外部脉冲）。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[10].en_us: A &aSingle Rod&r will generate 1 internal pulse, a &aDouble Rod&r 4, and a &aQuad Rod&r 12.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &a单燃料棒&r生成1个内部脉冲，&a双燃料棒&r生成4个，&a四燃料棒&r生成12个。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[12].en_us: &eNeutron Reflectors&r can be used to send a pulse back to its origin, acting as a similar rod type to its neighbor, increasing its efficiency.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: &e中子反射器&r可用于将脉冲反射回原点，类似于相邻的燃料棒类型，提高其效率。

quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[14].en_us: Each &aFuel Rod&r will consume a fixed amount of fuel from the &bReactor Fuel Ports&r above the stack. Each fuel pellet has a capacity, and each rod will use 1 capacity unit, a double rod uses 2, and a quad rod uses 4.
quest.0E0B4F549B42AF63.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 每个&a燃料棒&r将从上方的&b反应堆燃料口&r消耗固定数量的燃料。每个燃料球有不同的燃料容量。 每个单燃料棒消耗1个容量单元，双燃料棒消耗2个，四燃料棒消耗4个。

quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that we have some &aPrimogel Goo&r, we can use it to see how this mechanic works.
quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 现在你有了&a原初浆凝胶&r，是时候学学凝胶是怎么用的了。

quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[2].en_us: Start by placing down the &aPrimogel Goo&r somewhere in an open space, then activate it by giving it either &bSugar&r or &bRotten Flesh&r. You can now place &2Iron Blocks&r on any of its faces to start the conversion.
quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先把&a原初浆凝胶&r放在开阔的地方，之后使用&b糖&r或&b腐肉&r来激活它。然后把&2铁块&r放在凝胶的任意面上即可开始转换。

quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[6].en_us: You'll notice the &bGoo&r slowly starting to spread over, taking it completely over. Once the process is complete, you'll be left with &aRaw Ferricore Ore&r.
quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你会注意到&b凝胶&r已经开始缓缓蔓延，直至完全覆盖铁块。整个过程结束后，铁块就会变成&a粗核源铁矿簇&r了。

quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[8].en_us: &7&oSome Shaders will not properly display this effect, so you might want to disable them if you want to see the changes.
quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &7&o某些光影不会正确显示该效果，如果你想看到变化过程请禁用光影。

quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[10].en_us: Mining this ore will give you &aRaw Ferricore&r, which you can smelt down into &aFerricore Ingots&r.
quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 挖掘这种矿簇后掉落的&a粗核源铁&r能够烧制成&a核源铁锭&r！

quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[12].en_us: &eNote&r: Fortune does not work on these ores. You will typically get between 3 or 4 raw ores.
quest.0E107AC18FCFDB57.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: &e注意&r：时运不会作用于这些矿簇上。单个矿簇一般能掉落3到4个粗矿。

quest.0E610A03BB4007B6.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming some Mob Drops.
quest.0E610A03BB4007B6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 消耗某些怪物掉落物发电。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that the &6World Engine&r can handle some &dEnder&r crafts, you will need to get your hands on a &dDragon Egg&r without going to the &eEnd&r.
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 现在&6世界引擎&r已经能处理一些&d末影&r相关的配方了，你需要在不前往&e末地&r的情况下，获得一颗&d龙蛋&r。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Within the &eEnd&r ring, you'll be able to find a very special &3Vault&r with a dangerous fight inside. And maybe a Dragon Egg.
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&e末地&r环中，你能找到一座非常特别的&3宝库&r，其中的战斗非常难缠，但那里也许能找到龙蛋。
