quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[4].en_us: You will need to craft the &dMighty Ender Chicken Egg&r and use it in the &aDislocator Receptacle&r in the middle ring to summon the boss.
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要制作&d威猛末影鸡蛋&r，然后在环中央的&a移位收纳容器&r上使用它，即可召唤boss。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[6].en_us: This can be a very difficult fight if you are not prepared!
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果你未做好准备，那么此战将十分凶险。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[8].en_us: The &dMighty Ender Chicken&r spawns with a shield that needs to be broken before it can take damage. This can only be broken by being whacked by a &2Chicken Stick&r.
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &d威猛末影鸡&r出生时会附有一层护盾，你需要将其击破才能对本体造成伤害。你需要用&2鸡调试棒&r狠狠敲打它才行。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[10].en_us: This boss also has several different attacks, including a laser that will most likely kill you. Make sure to hide during this attack!
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 此Boss也拥有几种不同的攻击方式，包括一道几乎能秒杀你的镭射。面对此攻击时，请快速躲避！

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[12].en_us: Once you have your hands on a &dDragon Egg&r, the &6World Engine&r should be able to extract its essence into block form.
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 拿到&d龙蛋&r后，你可以用&6世界引擎&r将其精髓提取成方块形态。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[14].en_us: Return to the &dEcho of The Catalyst&r once again to find out how to upgrade your &6World Engine&r.
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 再次回到&d精械师的回响&r处，他会教你如何升级你的&6世界引擎&r。

quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[16].en_us: ["", {"text": "Note", "color": "yellow"}, ": It's worth setting up an ", {"text": "Extractor", "color": "green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "0EBA58B7FD2AF36D"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Extractor Quest"} }, " to get more ", {"text": "Dragon Eggs", "color": "light_purple"}, ", or you can redo the fight over and over." ]
quest.0E7AD6BCF9F8605F.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "注意", "color": "yellow"}, "：建议使用", {"text": "提取机", "color": "green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "0EBA58B7FD2AF36D"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到提取机任务"} }, "来获取更多的", {"text": "龙蛋", "color": "light_purple"}, "，你也可以反复击杀boss获取。" ]

quest.0EAEEF79436FDFA7.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.0EAEEF79436FDFA7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.0EAEEF79436FDFA7.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.0EAEEF79436FDFA7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.0EBA58B7FD2AF36D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aExtractor&r from &bXycraft&r is a staple for easily generating niche resources like &dDragon Eggs&r or &7Sky Stone Dust&r.
quest.0EBA58B7FD2AF36D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 来自&bXycraft&r的&a提取机&r是轻松获得稀有资源，如&d龙蛋&r或&7陨石粉&r的好办法。

quest.0EBA58B7FD2AF36D.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine becomes available with the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.0EBA58B7FD2AF36D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r后方可使用该机器。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've gathered a &2Spell Scroll&r, we can inscribe it into our spell tome using the &aInscription Table&r.
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 只要找到一卷&2法术卷轴&r，我们就可以通过&a法术抄写台&r来将它写入法术书中。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[2].en_us: In the interface of the table, you can insert the Spell Tome you wish to inscribe your spell scrolls into. You can then add a Spell Scroll to the empty slot on the left side underneath the tome, then click on the icon above it to inscribe the spell.
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在法术抄写台上，你可以随意选择你想要写入法术的法术书。随后，你要把法术卷轴放置在法术书下面的空白槽位上，然后点击抄写图标来完成法术抄写。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[4].en_us: Each spell tome can hold up to a different number of spells overall, with our starter spellbook only holding 5 or 6. It might be a good idea to upgrade that soon!
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 总的来说，每本法术书都有着不同的法术容量，而我们的入门级法术书只能容纳5到6个法术。尽快升级法术书绝对是个好主意！

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[6].en_us: You can also remove spells inscribed in the tome by selecting the spell in the interface, then clicking on the Spell Scroll on the right side to take it out.
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你也可以把写入法术书的法术再取回来。只要先选择一个法术，随后在右侧的槽位单击其法术卷轴即可将其取出。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[8].en_us: Spells can be cast by equipping your &aSpell Book&r in its curio slot.
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 把法术书装在&a法术书栏位&r，就可以施放魔法。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[10].en_us: Once equipped, you can open up the scroll wheel using the &bR&r keybind by default. Casting the selected spell can be done by pressing &bV&r.
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 把法术书装备后，你可以按默认的&bR&r键打开卷轴，&bV&r键施放选定的法术。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[12].en_us: These can all be changed in your keybinds. Try searching for &acategory:"Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - General"&r.
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 你可以在按键绑定中自行调整，直接按模组分类搜&a"Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - General"&r即可。

quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[14].en_us: There are also quick cast options!
quest.0EE0A8941A69703E.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 还有一些快速施法的方法！

quest.0EE35D6E57FAD973.quest_desc[0].en_us: One of the most useful items for any enchanting setup!
quest.0EE35D6E57FAD973.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这是附魔设施中最有用的物品之一！

quest.0EE35D6E57FAD973.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Enchantment Library&r acts as a storage for enchantments. With enough low level enchants, it can also create books of higher level enchants for you.
quest.0EE35D6E57FAD973.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6魔咒图书馆&r可以储存魔咒。存有足量的低等级魔咒时，它还可以将它们合并为更高等级的魔咒！

quest.0EE35D6E57FAD973.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：此物品为&z商店特供物品&r！

quest.0EFA11536D00E653.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Bio Fuel&r can be used as a great power source in the early game when pumped into a &aBio-Generator&r.
quest.0EFA11536D00E653.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2生物燃料&r是游戏前期不错的能量来源，&a生物能发电机&r可以利用它来发电。

quest.0EFA11536D00E653.quest_desc[2].en_us: Note: You can only extract power from it on the front face with the big square on it.
quest.0EFA11536D00E653.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 注意：你只能从那个有个大正方形的正面输出能量。

quest.0F1B7185D8F4CDE6.quest_desc[0].en_us: &7Dark Matter Tools&r are fast and unbreakable, and the dark matter &aPickaxe&r can switch modes from normal to 3-block-wide mining.

quest.0F1B7185D8F4CDE6.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eProjectE&r tools can be charged (default: "V") with EMC to empower powerful Area of Effect abilities when Right-Clicking each tool.

quest.0F3EDB9AE592016B.quest_subtitle.en_us: Improves energy capacity and energy transfer rate
quest.0F3EDB9AE592016B.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 提升储电能力，提高能量传输速率。

quest.0F48353EDD296510.quest_desc[0].en_us: Speak to &dThe Wyrmwright&r once you have crafted the &dResonant Void&r and they will show you how to install this &3World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.0F48353EDD296510.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作出&d共振虚空&r后，请与&d飞龙匠人&r交谈，他会教你如何安装这个&3世界引擎升级&r。

quest.0F7CB818AC0A9187.quest_desc[0].en_us: You gain access to &zTiny Chaos Fragments&r after facing off against the &zMighty Ender Chicken&r.
quest.0F7CB818AC0A9187.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在与&z威猛末影鸡&r战斗后，你便能用某种方法获取&z微小混沌碎片&r。

quest.0F7CB818AC0A9187.quest_desc[2].en_us: You will need to use a &aFluid Laser&r to extract &zMolten Chaos&r, which can be turned into &6Tiny Chaos Fragments&r.
quest.0F7CB818AC0A9187.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要使用&a流体镭射钻&r来提取&z熔融混沌&r，这样就能制作出&6微小混沌碎片&r了。

quest.0F7CB818AC0A9187.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["You can learn more about how to do this in the ", {"text": "Bringing Home The Chicken quest", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "4D7C7DE95E56C7B3"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Quest"}}, " in the T5 chapter."]
quest.0F7CB818AC0A9187.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["你可以查阅阶段5章节的 ", {"text": "把鸡带回家", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "4D7C7DE95E56C7B3"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Quest"}}, "任务，了解更多相关信息。"]

quest.0FD446B7912E00CB.quest_desc[0].en_us: It's time to combine each of the pieces together to create the &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r.
quest.0FD446B7912E00CB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 是时候将所有零件组装在一起，制作&c高级机器方块&r了。

quest.0FF5D73B3256F400.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.0FF5D73B3256F400.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.0FF5D73B3256F400.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.0FF5D73B3256F400.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.0FFC6CBB213B30AD.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Milk and Slimy Items.
quest.0FFC6CBB213B30AD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 消耗奶与黏糊糊的物品发电。

quest.101B8D9769D835AB.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.101B8D9769D835AB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.101B8D9769D835AB.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.101B8D9769D835AB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eRefined Storage 2&r (&eRS2&r) is an expandable digital storage network mod that can store items, fluids, and gasses.
quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e精致存储2&r（简称&eRS2&r）是一个可扩展数字化存储网络模组，能够存储物品、流体和气体。

quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["To get started with ", {"text": "RS2", "color": "yellow"}, " you'll need to get some ", { "text": "Certus Quartz", "color": "aqua", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "73EC5E7F2300B99D"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Certus Quartz Quest"}}, " to make ", {"text": "Quartz Enriched Iron", "color": "green"}, " and ", {"text": "Quartz Enriched Copper", "color": "dark_green"}, "."]
quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["开始发展", {"text": "RS2", "color": "yellow"}, "之前，你需要获取一些", { "text": "赛特斯石英", "color": "aqua", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "73EC5E7F2300B99D"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到赛特斯石英任务"}}, "来制作", {"text": "富石英铁", "color": "green"}, "和", {"text": "富石英铜", "color": "dark_green"}, "。"]

quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[4].en_us: Processors are used to craft most of the core components of your &eRS2&r network.
quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 处理器用于制作&eRS2&r网络中大部分核心组件。

quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[6].en_us: ["These can only be assembled inside a ", { "text": "Circuit Fabricator", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "663460DE8AF7E464" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Circuit Fabricator Quest"} }, "."]
quest.1069575C4B5BCE39.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: ["你只能在", { "text": "电路加工机", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "663460DE8AF7E464" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到电路加工机任务"} }, "组装它们。"]

quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[0].en_us: Throughout your adventures, you'll run into plenty of &dArcane&r loot.
quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你冒险的时候，也许会搜刮到很多&d奥术&r战利品。

quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[2].en_us: The most common item you'll find is &dArcane Essence&r. This can be used to create &dArcane Cloth&r, brew &bMana Potions&r, and more!
quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 最常见的战利品就是&d奥术源质&r，它可以用来制作&d奥术布匹&r、酿造&b魔力药水&r等等！

quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[4].en_us: You'll also find &aBlank Runestones&r, which can be used to craft &2Runestones&r that create some of the most powerful gear in the mod. &aNon-blank Runestones&r can also be found after killing wizards.
quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 也许你还会找到一些&a空白符文&r，用它可以合成各种&2符文&r。符文可以制造该模组最强大的装备。杀死巫师类敌怪后，你也有概率得到&a符文&r。

quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[6].en_us: &bMithril&r is a legendary metal not obtainable through usual methods in the void, or at least what passes for usual. Perhaps some magical source could provide it, some sort of gate...
quest.107C26E8BF309BC1.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &b秘银&r是一种传说中的金属，无法通在虚空中用常规手段获取，或者说，至少不是我们所认为的常规方式。或许需要借助某种魔法源泉，比如一扇传送门……

quest.10DEA5CE1800F935.quest_desc[0].en_us: &7&oSometimes things go wrong, and since Minecraft has no "Undo" button. We've added one for you.
quest.10DEA5CE1800F935.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &7&o意外是难免的，而MC没有“撤销”按钮，所以我们为你增加了一个。

quest.10DEA5CE1800F935.quest_desc[2].en_us: If you accidentally break your &6World Engine&r machine block, clicking this button will replace it for you.
quest.10DEA5CE1800F935.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你不小心破坏了你的&6世界引擎&r机器方块，点击此按钮将其替换。

quest.10DEA5CE1800F935.quest_desc[4].en_us: Keep in mind that this will wipe any of your existing settings and items inside the &6World Engine&r.
quest.10DEA5CE1800F935.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这会清除&6世界引擎&r中所有已调整的配置和已放置的物品，千万别忘了。

quest.1111B3ACEDDF5633.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you let a &zSmall Chaos Shard&r collide into &zAntimatter&r, you might destroy your world.
quest.1111B3ACEDDF5633.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 让&z小的混沌碎片&r与&z反物质&r相撞可能会摧毁整个世界。

quest.1111B3ACEDDF5633.quest_desc[2].en_us: Or a little totally harmless item version of the &zBlack Hole&r will plop down for you to pick up.
quest.1111B3ACEDDF5633.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 或者，也可能会出现一个无害的、物品形态的小&z黑洞&r。

quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["", {"text": "Draconic", "color": "gold"}, " tools are upgraded versions of ", {"text": "Wyvern", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "056990503617C147" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Wyvern Tools Quest"}}, " tools, with room for more ", {"text": "Upgrade Modules", "color": "green"}, " and better customizability."]
quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "神龙", "color": "gold"}, "工具是", {"text": "双足飞龙", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "056990503617C147" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往双足飞龙工具任务"}}, "工具的升级版，可安装更多的", {"text": "升级模块", "color": "green"}, "，具有更强的可定制性。"]

quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also craft the &6Draconic Staff of Power&r, an All-In-One tool and weapon.
quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你还可以打造一把集所有工具与武器于一体的终极装备：&6神龙之力权杖&r。

quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[4].en_us: Their module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.
quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, you must have the &cAdvanced Machine Block&r and the &dDraconic Energy&r &6World Engine Upgrades&r.
quest.11A35E8F97ACA240.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，你需要先进行&c高级机器方块&r与&d神龙能量&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.11BB3C62703E0B3E.quest_desc[0].en_us: Encasing spirits directly into a block is probably not the most ethical thing to do, but the &6World Engine&r can harness that power for more advanced crafts.
quest.11BB3C62703E0B3E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 直接将这些精魂囚禁在方块中可能不太人道，但是&6世界引擎&r可以利用它们的力量制作更强大的东西。

quest.11BB3C62703E0B3E.quest_desc[2].en_us: Bring this back to &dThe Infernal&r to learn how to install the &3Spirit Block Upgrade&r.
quest.11BB3C62703E0B3E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 带着这些东西回到&d炼狱使者&r处，学习如何安装&3精魂方块升级&r。

quest.11C58E38DE9488BE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMob Masher&r from &bMob Grinding Utils&r can automate the killing process in mob farms when given a redstone signal.
quest.11C58E38DE9488BE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 来自&b刷怪塔实用设备&r的&a怪物捣碎机&r在被给予红石信号后，可以用于刷怪塔的杀戮处理流程。

quest.11C58E38DE9488BE.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can also be upgraded to do more damage, drop more loot, or cause mobs to drop their heads!
quest.11C58E38DE9488BE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它可被升级以造成更多伤害，更多掉落物或者得到对应生物的头颅！

quest.11C58E38DE9488BE.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aNote&r: You will still need something to pick up the items as they drop into the world.
quest.11C58E38DE9488BE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a注意&r：你仍然需要收集起那些世界中的生物掉落物。

quest.11CC48D772573E73.quest_desc[0].en_us: &zInfinity Weapons&r deal an infinite amount of damage.
quest.11CC48D772573E73.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z无尽武器&r可以造成无限点伤害。

quest.11CC48D772573E73.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o基本上就是对怪物执行了“/kill”指令。

quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The advanced circuitry you need will require a specialized crystal called &dFluxite&r.
quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作高级电路需要一种叫&d辐水晶&r的特殊水晶。

quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[2].en_us: This crystal can only be created by beaming power directly into an &dAmethyst Crystal&r. To do this, you will need to create an &cEnderic Laser&r and a &bTarget Designator&r.
quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种水晶只能通过将能量直接射入&d紫水晶&r来制造。为此，你需要制作一个&c末影激光器&r和一个&b目标标识器&r。

quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once you've crafted the &cEnderic Laser&r, make sure to build it near a &dBudding Amethyst Block&r that can grow crystals.
quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 制作出&c末影激光器&r后，请将它放置在能生长水晶的&d紫水晶母岩&r附近。

quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[6].en_us: By Sneak + Right-clicking with the &bTarget Designator&r on an &dAmethyst Crystal&r, you can store the location into the Designator. Once stored, Sneak + Right-click on the &cEnderic Laser&r to designate where the laser should shoot.
quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 使用&b目标标识器&r潜行右击&d紫水晶&r，就可以把它的坐标储存在标识器中。储存完成后，再潜行右击&c末影激光器&r即可完成配置激光目标的操作。

quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[8].en_us: If done properly, the laser will fire and convert the crystal over into &dFluxite&r.
quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 如果操作正确，激光就会发射，将紫水晶转化为&d辐水晶&r。

quest.11F69E1E4FE4D5CD.quest_desc[10].en_us: Use this to craft the &dFlux Gate&r.

quest.12CB62610FEAADA0.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Dragon's Breath.

quest.131199313AE3F5E9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEnergized Smelter&r is essentially a powered furnace that can be upgraded!
quest.131199313AE3F5E9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a电力熔炼炉&r本质上是一种可升级的电动熔炉！

quest.133ECE7BDDC8C13D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that you've acquired <blank>, the &6Echo of Guidance&r mentioned further &dArchives&r that can be uncovered.

quest.133ECE7BDDC8C13D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Head back to the lobby to see what you can find!

quest.137039009E8EBA03.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6ProjectE&r has several very strong tools that can be made once you have your hands on enough EMC and a &cNetherite Smithing Template&r.
quest.137039009E8EBA03.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6等价交换&r模组有一些非常强大的工具，只要你有足够的EMC和一个&c下界合金锻造模板&r就能制作。

quest.137039009E8EBA03.quest_desc[2].en_us: These tools can be charged (default: "V") with EMC to empower powerful Area of Effect abilities when Right-Clicking each tool.
quest.137039009E8EBA03.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些工具可以用EMC充能（默认按键为V），右击可激活强大的范围功能。

quest.137039009E8EBA03.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, you must have the &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.137039009E8EBA03.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此工具，你需要先进行&a机器方块&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.137EC884018376A1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &cNetherite&r gear makes for some great armor once you have your hands on &aAncient Debris&r and a &cNetherite Smithing Template&r..
quest.137EC884018376A1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&a远古残骸&r和&c下界合金锻造模板&r之后，制造&c下界合金&r盔甲会是个不错的选择。

quest.137EC884018376A1.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["You may get ", {"text": "Ancient Debris", "color": "green"}, " early by going to the ", { "text": "Nether Dungeon", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "21A521011401074F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Nether Dungeon Quest"}}, ", which can spawn in the Deepslate Ring." ]
quest.137EC884018376A1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["想早早的获得", {"text": "远古残骸", "color": "green"}, "，你可以前往", { "text": "下界地牢", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "21A521011401074F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往寻找下界地牢的任务"}}, "，这种结构会在深板岩环区域生成。" ]

quest.13874944C284A510.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bOccultism&r offers generating infinite ores by binding spirits to mine for you in the demon realm.
quest.13874944C284A510.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b神秘学&r提供了一种无限生成矿石的办法：绑定魔灵为你在恶魔领域挖矿。

quest.13874944C284A510.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be done using a &dDimensional Mineshaft&r and a &dBound Miner Foliot&r.
quest.13874944C284A510.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用&d维度矿井&r和&d绑定的矿工魔精&r便可做到。

quest.13874944C284A510.quest_desc[4].en_us: Place the Miner Foliot into the &dDimensional Mineshaft&r and it will generate ores over time.
quest.13874944C284A510.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将矿工魔精放在&d维度矿井&r中，便会定期生成矿石。

quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Ars Nouveau&r allows you to perform &drituals&r to summon mobs, build floating islands, and much more!
quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6新生魔艺&r的某些&d仪式&r可以召唤怪物、制造浮空岛……用处超多！

quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make your first Ritual, you'll need to craft a &3Ritual Brazier&r and one of the many different types of &dRitual Tablets&r that you'd like to perform. Place the Brazier down and then use the tablet for the ritual you'd like, then right click again with an empty hand to perform the ritual.
quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要进行你的第一个仪式，你需要先合成一个&3仪式火盆&r，以及一块对应你心仪仪式的&d仪式石板&r（石板有多种类型）。先将火盆放置好，然后手持仪式石板对它使用，最后再空手右击火盆，即可启动仪式。

quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[4].en_us: Most rituals will need &dSource&r to activate, so make sure to have a jar nearby!
quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 很多仪式都需要&d魔源&r才能激活，所以在边上放个魔源罐吧！

quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[6].en_us: Rituals can also be &aaugmented&r using certain items to empower them. This is done by first using the &3Ritual Tablet&r on it first, then by using the items on the Brazier one at a time to fulfill the augment needs. Once finished, you can right click with an empty hand to activate the ritual.
quest.138CB008CE4C838B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果加入特定物品的话，仪式就会被&a增强&r。首先你要放入&3仪式石板&r，然后对着仪式火盆一个一个地置入所需物品，直到满足增强要求为止。最后空手右击火盆即可激活仪式。

quest.13C8B2286F5184C7.quest_desc[0].en_us: When charged, using the &3Teleport Staff&r will teleport you in the direction you are looking, up to 100 blocks away.
quest.13C8B2286F5184C7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用充能过的&3传送权杖&r会把你传送到光标处，最大传送距离为100格方块。

quest.13D1BC0C49543326.quest_desc[0].en_us: This quest will set up a waypoint to &dThe Ancient's &6Archive&r.

quest.13E0F74B9A1DAB58.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.13E0F74B9A1DAB58.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.13E0F74B9A1DAB58.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.13E0F74B9A1DAB58.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.13EC7C64DFBD1556.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aBasic Generator&r from &6Oritech&r is a starter generator that burns any type of furnace fuel to generate a small amount of power.
quest.13EC7C64DFBD1556.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Oritech&r模组的&a基础发电机&r是一种入门级的发电机，可以消耗熔炉燃料发电，但效率较低。

quest.13EC7C64DFBD1556.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can transfer the power out using &cEnergy Pipes&r from the mod, or any other type of energy cable works as well.
quest.13EC7C64DFBD1556.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以用各种模组中的&c能量线缆&r来输出能量。

quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aFluid Extractor&r is the first machine you'll want to make in the mod.
quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a流体提取机&r是发展工业先锋需要的第一台机器。

quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[2].en_us: These machines will pull &7Latex&r from any Wood Log placed in front of it. You'll need a lot of &7Latex&r, so it's good to make a few of these!
quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这台机器会从面前的原木中提取&7胶乳&r。你会需要很多胶乳，所以最好多做几台！

quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[4].en_us: These machines don't require power, but work &b3x faster&r when powered.
quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 它不消耗能量，但供能能将运行速度提升至&b三倍&r。

quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[6].en_us: Most logs will give an average amount, but &aAcacia logs&r and &aMangrove logs&r will give the most!
quest.13FD704C45145E23.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 多数原木的产量比较平平无奇，不过&a金合欢原木&r与&a红树原木&r的胶乳产量是最高的！

quest.13FE28AF74A357CD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aMechanical Belts&r can be used to create conveyor-like systems to transfer items and/or &bRotational Force&r.
quest.13FE28AF74A357CD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a传送带&r可用于搭建传送带装置，实现物品和&b旋转力&r的传输。

quest.13FE28AF74A357CD.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eCreate&r machines will automatically interact with items on &aBelts&r if they are able to.
quest.13FE28AF74A357CD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e机械动力&r的机器能够自动与&a传送带&r上的物品交互（当机器支持该功能时）。

quest.141CE17C25D2A53A.quest_desc[0].en_us: To make any of the upgrades for your backpack, you'll first need to craft an &aUpgrade Base&r.
quest.141CE17C25D2A53A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果想要合成背包升级，你得先做&a空白升级&r。

quest.141CE17C25D2A53A.quest_desc[2].en_us: There are a ton of useful upgrades you can make, like &aStack Upgrades&r to increase the slot stack limit for storing tons of items, or the &aFeeding Upgrade&r that can automatically feed you when you are hungry!
quest.141CE17C25D2A53A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以制作很多有用的升级，比如&a堆叠升级&r可以提升背包的单格物品最大数量，&a喂食升级&r可以让你吃东西！

quest.141CE17C25D2A53A.quest_desc[4].en_us: Make sure to check them all out!

quest.143E07D2565798AB.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eOritech&r is all about building &bMultiblock Machines&r, most of which require using &aMachine Cores&r. You can always check to see how many cores are needed by checking the tooltip of the machine.
quest.143E07D2565798AB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eOritech&r模组的主要机器为&b多方块机器&r，其中绝大多数的多方块机器都需要用上&a机器核心&r。记得查看机器的工具提示，其中标出了需要多少核心。

quest.143E07D2565798AB.quest_desc[2].en_us: There are 7 different tiers of &aMachine Cores&r, with each increasing the total number of &bAddons&r that can be attached to the machine multiblock.
quest.143E07D2565798AB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 总共有七个等级的&a机器核心&r，每提升一个等级，可安装的&b插件&r数量也会增加。

quest.143E07D2565798AB.quest_desc[4].en_us: For now, you can make either of the first 2 tiers to get you started!
quest.143E07D2565798AB.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以选择前两个阶段中的任意一个来进行起步！

quest.14537A63D3BDC09B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.14537A63D3BDC09B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.14537A63D3BDC09B.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.14537A63D3BDC09B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.1461682BD1978BA8.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCrusher&r is a &bHeavy Machine&r primarily used as a way to break down ores and metals into &bdust&r.
quest.1461682BD1978BA8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a粉碎机&r是一种&b重型机器&r，可将矿石和金属磨制成&b粉&r。

quest.1461682BD1978BA8.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can also be used to grind up enemies that are unfortunate enough to fall into it, outputting their relevant drops.
quest.1461682BD1978BA8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它还能碾碎不幸落入其中的敌对生物，输出它们的掉落物。

quest.1461682BD1978BA8.quest_desc[4].en_us: Make sure to check out the &bEngineer's Manual&r to help you build the multiblock!
quest.1461682BD1978BA8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 务必查看&b工程师手册&r来辅助搭建多方块结构！

quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[0].en_us: Believe it or not, cows really like Apples and.... clay? Put them together and what do you get?
quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 不管你信不信，牛真的喜欢苹果和粘土？把他们放在一起会得到什么呢？

quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[2].en_us: If you feed a cow a &aClapple&r, it will convert it into a random baby &bFluid Cow&r. Once fully grown, these can be milked to give a bucket of that fluid!
quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你喂给了牛&a黏土苹果&r。牛将会被转化为随机的幼年&b流体牛&r。一旦它们长大，他们可被挤出对应流体。

quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[4].en_us: Unlike regular cows, &bFluid Cows&r have a cooldown on how often they can be milked.
quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 不像平常的牛，&b流体牛&r被挤奶时有冷却时间。

quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[6].en_us: List of &bFluid Cows&r that can be made using the &aClapple&r ->
quest.150BB4679DD2B4B5.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 下列&b流体牛&r可被&a粘土苹果&r转化而来 ->

quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[0].en_us: To be able to use the &aWorker Token&r in an &2Unearther&r, you'll need a villager that has one of these 3 jobs:
quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 以下三种职业的&a劳工令牌&r可在&2发掘室&r中使用：

quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[2].en_us: - &aArcheologist&r: Can brush Dirt, Dust, Mud, and Sand. Uses a &aDecorative Pot&r for the workstation.
quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: - &a考古学家&r：可以刷泥土、尘土、泥巴和沙子。其工作站为&a饰纹陶罐&r。

quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[4].en_us: - &2Geologist&r: Can brush Gravel, Soul Sand, and Crushed Kivi. Uses a &2Salvaging Table&r for the workstation.
quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: - &2地质学家&r：可以刷沙砾、灵魂沙和粉碎磊岩。其工作站为&2回收台&r。

quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[6].en_us: - &dDimensionalist&r: Can brush Netherrack, End Stone, and Otherrock. Uses the &dResonanz Engineering Block&r for the workstation.
quest.1520491A7804E08E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: - &d维度学家&r：可以刷下界岩、末地石和异界岩。其工作站为&d共振工程块&r。

quest.159DE084D82C6A1C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Garden Cloche&r is a staple machine that can automate growing crops, as long as it has water, power, and a piece of soil inside.
quest.159DE084D82C6A1C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2园艺玻璃罩&r是一台强力机器，可用于自动生产作物。尽管它需要水，电力和一小块土。

quest.159DE084D82C6A1C.quest_desc[2].en_us: Different tiers of soil have different rates of growth!
quest.159DE084D82C6A1C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 不同等级的土有不同的种植速度！

quest.15B551FCA8790707.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.15B551FCA8790707.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.15DE76B303680F79.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWyrmwright&r knows a lot about dragons. At this point, you should have some &dDraconic Dust&r.
quest.15DE76B303680F79.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d飞龙匠人&r对龙族十分了解。此时，你手中应该已经有一些&d龙尘&r了。

quest.15DE76B303680F79.quest_desc[4].en_us: Return to the &dEcho of The Wyrmwright&r once you've made a few draconic items to find out how to install this &3Upgrade&r.
quest.15DE76B303680F79.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 制作出一些关于神龙的物品后，请回到&d飞龙匠人的回响&r处，他会教你如何安装这个&3升级&r。

quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eTempad&r is a teleportation mod that uses special temporary portals called timedoors to travel between locations.
quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e任意门&r是一个传送模组，你可以使用一种被称为“时门”的临时传送门，实现在不同的标记点之间传送。

quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[2].en_us: You've already gotten started with the &eTempad&r mod by making the &6Chronon Generator&r and &aChronon Cell&r.
quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 其实，你之前做出了&a时元电芯&r和&6时元发生器&r，已经算是入门了&e任意门&r模组。

quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aLocation Cards&r are the next step, and can be used to register location data for use in other devices such as the &2Timedoor Projector&r or &6Tempad&r.
quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 接下来要合成&a定位卡&r，它可用于导入传送点的数据，以便在&2时门投影仪&r和&6时域仪&r之类的设备中使用。

quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[6].en_us: These can be stored in a &aWallet&r to keep your inventory clean.
quest.165A1B6F56051FA6.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 可将位置卡存放在&a钱包&r内，节省物品栏空间。

quest.1666835CA3297C7D.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are 2 special &aArtisan Scrolls&r that will teach you how to craft &6Duality&r jewelry.
quest.1666835CA3297C7D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有2种特殊的&a工匠卷轴&r，能让你解锁如何制作&6双层种类&r珠宝。

quest.1666835CA3297C7D.quest_desc[2].en_us: This jewelry takes both the attributes from the &eMetal&r and the &dGem&r, and has a higher quality overall.
quest.1666835CA3297C7D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种珠宝同时拥有&e金属&r和&d宝石&r的属性，并且总体品质更高。

quest.1666835CA3297C7D.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Both of these recipes need the &dEnchanting&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.1666835CA3297C7D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：这两种配方都需要&6世界引擎&r&d附魔升级&r。

quest.166A223222AD76FC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zCreative Chance Pendant&r will allow you to set the luck of a &dChance Cube&r once placed into the Pendant.
quest.166A223222AD76FC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 佩戴&z创造机会吊坠&r即可让你设置&d机会方块&r的幸运值。

quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Fortron&r can be extracted from the buffer of a &aCoercion Deriver&r or any other &bFortron-based machines&r.
quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3力场子&r可以从&a能源转换器&r或其他由&b力场子驱动的机器&r中提取。

quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be done by using any method of fluid extracting from other mods.
quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 任何其他模组的流体提取方式都可以提取力场子。

quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oCheck the "Logistics" quest chapter for some fluid management options.
quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o前往“物流”任务章节寻找管理流体的方式。

quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7&oNote: to complete this quest, you'll need to pump a bucket's worth (1000mB) into an assigned &2Task Screen&r.
quest.166BA0D04A1686C7.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &7&o注意：要完成该任务，请向&2目标显示器&7提供足够一个桶（1000mB）的流体量。

quest.1680080BED98F027.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.1680080BED98F027.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've encoded some patterns using the &dPattern Encoding Terminal&r, you can place them into a &aPattern Provider&r. The &aProviders&r will try to complete the craft using whatever block it is attached to.
quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以选择把&dME样板终端&r上编码的样板，都塞进&a样板供应器&r。&a样板供应器&r会试图用周边方块完成样板的合成配方。

quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[2].en_us: For doing shaped and shapeless craft recipes that don't require machines, you can place the &aProvider&r next to a &3Molecular Assembler&r, which are just fancy autocrafters!
quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果配方不需要特定机器，则无论有序无序都可以放进&d分子装配室&r，&d分子装配室&r其实就是花哨点的自动合成器！

quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[4].en_us: For other autocrafting tasks that require some type of processing, you'd place the &aProvider&r facing the machine you want to craft in.
quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 但假如配方有额外处理需求的话，你可以把&a样板供应器&r直接放在机器边上。

quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[6].en_us: For example, you can set up autosmelting for recipes by placing a &2Furnace&r in front of the &aProvider&r, and then encoding the appropriate smelting recipes onto patterns to be placed into the &aProviders&r.
quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 比如：把&2熔炉&r放在&a供应器&r边上，之后只需要把写好的熔炼样板放入&a样板供应器&r即可自动进行熔炼配方。

quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[8].en_us: For more information about how to make the &aPattern Providers&r and &3Assemblers&r work faster, check out the AE2 Guide!
quest.16B60BCB8240F808.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 如果想知道怎么让&a样板&r供应器和&3分子装配室&r工作变快，请查阅AE2教程！

quest.16F7490FA5DE307C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMob Crusher&r from &bIndustrial Foregoing&r can easily crush mobs for you within your mob farm.
quest.16F7490FA5DE307C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b工业先锋&r的&a屠宰机&r可以轻松杀死你刷怪塔的生物。

quest.16F7490FA5DE307C.quest_desc[2].en_us: When powered, this machine will instantly kill any mob within its working area, automatically picking up the loot into its inventory.
quest.16F7490FA5DE307C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 当供能时，该机器会瞬间杀死其工作范围的任何生物，并自动拾取掉落物到机器的储存空间。

quest.16F7490FA5DE307C.quest_desc[4].en_us: The working area can be upgraded using addons, as well as how fast it activates.
quest.16F7490FA5DE307C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 其工作范围和运作速度可被插件升级。

quest.1770A460E1FD7CC8.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["", {"text": "Particle Accelerators", "color":"#FF55FF"}, " can be built in various ways, depending on their goals. A straight line of ", {"text": "Linear Motors", "color":"#55FF55"}, " can shoot particles at something, but higher speeds are more efficiently reached with a circular design. Very large rings might be needed to reach certain elements. Slow particles require ", {"text": "Guide Rings", "color": "#55FF55"}, " to be close together, so starting in a small ring and then ", {"text": "using redstone", "color":"#55FFFF", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "778A876616D4638E" } }, " to move to a larger ring often makes sense."]
quest.1770A460E1FD7CC8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "粒子加速器", "color":"#FF55FF"}, "可以根据目标以多种方式构建。",{"text": "直线型马达阵列", "color":"#55FF55"}, "可以将粒子射向某个目标，但更高效率的速度通常通过环形设计实现。非常大的环可能需要包含某些要素。慢速粒子需要", {"text": "导向环", "color": "#55FF55"}, "紧密排列，因此从小环开始", {"text": "使用红石", "color":"#55FFFF", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "778A876616D4638E" } }, " 然后再逐步升级，一般来说都是很有用的。"]

quest.1770A460E1FD7CC8.quest_desc[2].en_us: Multiple ring stages might be necessary for some cases.
quest.1770A460E1FD7CC8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 某些情况下可能需要设计多环结构。

quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the &aEcho Encoder&r, you can Sneak + Right-click to convert the Villager into a &2Token&r.
quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用&a回响编码器&r潜行右击村民，可将他变成&2劳工令牌&r。

quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[2].en_us: This &2Token&r encodes the &aVillager&r in time, allowing you to place it down when needed.
quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个&2令牌&r会及时对&a村民&r进行编码，让你能在需要时将其放置出来。

quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aEcho Encoder&r only has so many charges, and will need to be recharged by placing it back into the &6World Engine&r.
quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a回响编码器&r的电量是有限的，你需要将其放回&6世界引擎&r中充电。

quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &dEcho of Guidance&r should now guide your next steps.
quest.17AC5EBEBDC124E9.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 现在，&d指引者的回响&r应该会告诉你接下来该做什么了。

quest.17C23A586C708425.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have the &dPlutonium Pellets&r, you can craft the &6Neutron Collector&r.
quest.17C23A586C708425.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&d钚球&r，你就能制作&6中子态素收集器&r了。

quest.17C23A586C708425.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine will generate a &zNeutron Pile&r about every 6 minutes. It's worth making a few of these unless you want to wait a while.
quest.17C23A586C708425.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个机器大约每6分钟就会生成一小撮&z中子素尘埃&r。建议多造几台，除非你有耐心多等一会儿。

quest.17D5EB0E89BC10D7.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEndergenic&r generator setup is one of the most complicated energy generators that doesn't require a degree in nuclear physics.
quest.17D5EB0E89BC10D7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a末影能&r发电机是游戏里除核能以外最复杂的发电机。

quest.17D5EB0E89BC10D7.quest_desc[2].en_us: These generators extract power from &dender pearls&r by 'throwing' the pearls between each other (targeted via &eSmart Wrench&r) and canceling their teleportation effect, absorbing the stifled energy.
quest.17D5EB0E89BC10D7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种发电机会彼此“投掷”&d末影珍珠&r（这需要你用&e智能扳手&r设定投掷目标），并抑制其传送效果，从而将用于传送的能量提取出来。

quest.17D5EB0E89BC10D7.quest_desc[4].en_us: Continuing to hold onto a stifled pearl uses energy however and &aEndergenics&r enter a &3cool-down state&r after throwing a pearl, so proper timing using redstone is crucial to efficiency. The process isn't perfect, so sometimes pearls will shatter in the machines after being thrown.
quest.17D5EB0E89BC10D7.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 然而，持续抑制末影珍珠本身就需要能量，而且&a末影能发电机&r在投掷珍珠后还会进入&3冷却时间&r，所以，通过红石来合理设定触发时机，对于提升效率而言是非常重要的。这一过程注定不会完美，因此机器中总有一部分珍珠会在投掷后白白破碎。

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 很多烹饪配方中都需要用到&b奶&r。

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[2].en_us: That's why you should just shove a &6Cow in a Jar&r. When added to the &bKitchen Multiblock&r, this will provide recipes with Milk Buckets if they call for it.
quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 所以，做一个&6罐中牛&r是很有必要的。将其接入&b多方块厨房&r后，它就会为需要奶的配方提供奶。

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[4].en_us: But how do you get one? First, you need to make a &aMilk Jar&r. This can store milk by itself, but you'll want a renewable source of Milk for your kitchen.
quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 但怎么才能把牛塞进罐子里呢？首先，你需要做一个&a奶罐&r，它也可以储存奶，不过，你大概更想给你的厨房装一个无限奶源。

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[6].en_us: Next, you'll need to place the Milk Jar in a hole that's big enough where a Cow can fit in.
quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 然后，你需要把奶罐放在一个洞里，这个洞要大到能够容纳一头牛。

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[8].en_us: Lure a Cow into the hole where it is directly on top of the Milk Jar, then drop an Anvil into the hole. This will smoosh the Cow into the Jar!
quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 把一头牛吸引到洞里去，让它站在奶罐正上方，然后把一个铁砧砸进洞里，牛就进到罐子里了！

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[10].en_us: This will provide milk slowly overtime for your Kitchen.
quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 罐中牛会缓慢产出奶，供你的厨房使用。

quest.17DE59BAD714DE63.quest_desc[12].en_us: &eNote:&r This same thing can be done for Fluid Cows!

quest.188CEC9710C2F404.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aIron Chests&r mod adds basic metal upgrades to the standard chest.
quest.188CEC9710C2F404.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a更多箱子&r模组为普通的箱子添加了多种基础材料升级。

quest.188CEC9710C2F404.quest_desc[2].en_us: These can be easily crafted, or you might have gotten one from being bonked by a Loot Bee.
quest.188CEC9710C2F404.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 虽然这些很容易制作出来，但是当一只战利品蜜蜂撞到你后也可能获得一个。

quest.18A36EA79A9355C4.quest_desc[0].en_us: To upgrade to the &dWyvern Fusion Injectors&r, you will need at least 8 &dDraconium Injectors&r placed around the Core.
quest.18A36EA79A9355C4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要升级&d飞龙聚合注入器&r，你需要在核心附近放置至少8个&d聚合注入器&r。

quest.18A36EA79A9355C4.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can right-click each item the injectors need to craft the upgrade. Each injector will also need power.
quest.18A36EA79A9355C4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以手持所需物品右击注入器，来制作此升级。每个注入器都需要能量。

quest.18A36EA79A9355C4.quest_desc[4].en_us: With all items placed in the injectors, you can place the main item in the &aCore&r, and the craft should start once it has a redstone signal.
quest.18A36EA79A9355C4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将物品全部放置到注入器上后，你就可以把主要物品放入&a核心&r，并用红石信号启动合成。

quest.18AF36E1C2375101.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the latent magical powers of &7Deepslate&r, you should be able to craft a bookshelf that can grant even stronger enchants within your table.
quest.18AF36E1C2375101.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 利用&7深板岩&r的潜在魔力，你可以制作一种书架，这能用来提高附魔台的上限。

quest.18E10F15FD94258B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Before you can create the casings used in for the &6World Engine&r, you'll need to have acquired &cLava&r and &dObsidian&r.
quest.18E10F15FD94258B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在打造用于&6世界引擎&r的机壳之前，你得先获取&c熔岩&r和&d黑曜石&r。

quest.18E10F15FD94258B.quest_desc[2].en_us: If you haven't already, make sure you go speak to &6The Machinist&r to get an &bEntropy Manipulator&r to create lava.
quest.18E10F15FD94258B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你还不知道怎么获取，请去找&6机械师&r领取一个&b熵变机械臂&r，它可以帮你制造熔岩。

quest.18E10F15FD94258B.quest_desc[4].en_us: &dObsidian&r is a strong enough material to support the strength of basic casings, but you'll need to press it into &aPlates&r first.
quest.18E10F15FD94258B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d黑曜石&r足够坚硬，能够保证机壳的强度，但它需要被压成&a板&r才能使用。

quest.193690C049F4B4BB.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using a &2Hammer&r, you can also break down Dirt into Sand, and then into &aDust&r. These will provide different resources needed for progression.
quest.193690C049F4B4BB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你还可以接着用&2锤子&r敲泥土，得到沙子，沙子还能再敲成&a尘土&r。它们可以产出游戏所需的不同资源。

quest.193690C049F4B4BB.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &2Hammer&r can also smash down &aCompressed Blocks&r to speed things up!
quest.193690C049F4B4BB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &2锤子&r也能敲碎&a压缩方块&r，这样比一个一个敲快多了！

quest.19C7CC772EC56E7B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have some eggs, you can combine them with any color of the rainbow to create a &aDyed Chicken Eggs&r.
quest.19C7CC772EC56E7B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 一旦你有了一些蛋，你就可以将蛋与任何彩虹色合成以得到&a染色的鸡蛋&r。

quest.19C7CC772EC56E7B.quest_desc[2].en_us: When these eggs are thrown, there is a chance for it to hatch into a chicken of that color.
quest.19C7CC772EC56E7B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 当这些鸡蛋被投出时，有几率得到对应颜色的鸡。

quest.19C7CC772EC56E7B.quest_desc[4].en_us: While only considered a tier 1 chicken, these chickens are required for breeding for the higher tier chickens!
quest.19C7CC772EC56E7B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 虽然这只是1阶的鸡，但它们是繁育更高阶鸡所必需的！

quest.19C9BB7952E89BA7.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that you've shoved a &zBlack Hole&r into a container, head back to &6Radiance&r and learn how to set up the upgrade.
quest.19C9BB7952E89BA7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你已经将&z黑洞&r塞入容器中了，现在请回到&6辐光&r身边，学习如何安装此升级。

quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Psi&f is a Mod that brings an interesting concept to &2Minecraft&r, What if it was possible to &dProgram Magical Spells&r and imbue them into &cBullets&r?
quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Psi模组&f为&2Minecraft&r带来了一个有趣的想法——如果可以的话，&d编写魔法咒语&r并注入到&c子弹&r中会怎样？

quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_desc[2].en_us: - To start your Technomagic Journey, simply make a &6CAD Assembler&r and a &6Basic CAD Device&r of any kind, &bCAD&r stands for &b"&oCasting Assistant Device&r"&r.
quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: - 只需制作一个&6CAD装配器&r和一个任意类型的&6基础CAD设备&r，就可以开始你的科技魔法之旅。&bCAD&r指的是&b“&o术式辅助演算机（Casting Assistant Device）&r”&r。

quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_desc[5].en_us: &8&oAnd this Mod is made by Vazkii, which means.... It's &lNEAT&r!&r&r
quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: &8&o这个Mod是由Vazkii制作的，所以…它&l非常棒&r！&r&r

quest.1A2D8034C07D988B.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 一个受科技魔法动漫启发的模组！

quest.1A84E167BFF8C2E4.quest_desc[0].en_us: No dirt... no trees... no tools... But you've still got your fists.
quest.1A84E167BFF8C2E4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 没有泥土……没有树木……没有工具……但你还有拳头。

quest.1A84E167BFF8C2E4.quest_desc[2].en_us: Break some &aStone&r to get &2Pebbles&r that you can work with.
quest.1A84E167BFF8C2E4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 敲碎一些&a石头&r，得到&2石子&r，以备使用。

quest.1A84E167BFF8C2E4.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: This must be done with an empty hand!

quest.1A89ACDC528588D5.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bCelestigem&r is the next tier for armor from &6Just Dire Things&r.
quest.1A89ACDC528588D5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b苍穹晶&r盔甲是&6Just Dire Things&r模组下一等阶的盔甲。

quest.1A89ACDC528588D5.quest_desc[2].en_us: Instead of using durability, this armor uses &cenergy&r instead, and can have even more upgrades that can be installed.
quest.1A89ACDC528588D5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 苍穹晶盔甲不再消耗耐久，而是使用&c能量&r，并且可以加装更多的升级。

quest.1A89ACDC528588D5.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be made once you've made a trip out to the &dAncient City&r and made &dVoidshimmer Goo&r.
quest.1A89ACDC528588D5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 等你探索过&d远古城市&r，制作出&d虚空辉凝胶&r之后，就可以制作苍穹晶了。

quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[0].en_us: When setting up automation, pushing and pulling items into Drawers can get complicated. That's where the Storage Tools come in!
quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 建立自动化产线的时候，从抽屉中存入或取出物品会很麻烦，所以存储工具就派上用场了！

quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &3Configuration Tool&r is used to lock Drawers to only interact with certain items. This is super useful when you are constantly pulling or pushing items from Drawers!
quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &3配置工具&r是用来锁定抽屉存放物品种类的，如果你要从抽屉中一直存取同类物品的话，那么它就能派上用场了！

quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &ePro Tip&r: If you've connected Drawers to a &aStorage Controller&r, you can use the Configuration Tool on the Controller to lock all of the Drawers that are linked, all at once!
quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e专业提示&r：如果你把抽屉都连上了&a存储控制器&r，那么可以对存储控制器使用配置工具，这样一次就能锁定所有抽屉！

quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[6].en_us: You can also sneak-use the tool in the air to change modes. There are several modes that you can configure for drawers, like hiding the count amount or disabling the render of items on a Drawer to save FPS.
quest.1AA08B095A8B378F.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 潜行使用配置工具可以改变模式。配置工具有很多模式，比如隐藏物品存储数量，又或者为了节省FPS而隐藏抽屉物品显示。

quest.1ABA5F2ECAA6D9D2.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eMekanism&r offers some of the best logistics cables and pipes in the pack! These items can be upgraded in the world, and also have an internal buffer.
quest.1ABA5F2ECAA6D9D2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e通用机械&r提供的物流线缆和管道是这个整合包最好用的管线！已经放在地上的管线可以直接升级，而且它们都有自己的内部缓存。

quest.1ABA5F2ECAA6D9D2.quest_desc[2].en_us: To configure these pipes and cables, it is best to use the &dConfigurator&r. This is Mekanism's wrench, which also comes with several useful features.
quest.1ABA5F2ECAA6D9D2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 请使用&d配置器&r来配置管道和线缆。配置器就是通用机械的扳手，而且还有很多有用的功能。

quest.1B10A2DED0629D6B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Just like the same upgrade for backpacks, the &dVoid Upgrade&r is probably one of the most useful upgrades that you can install.
quest.1B10A2DED0629D6B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 和同名的背包升级一样，&d虚空升级&r应该是你能装的最有用的升级。

quest.1B10A2DED0629D6B.quest_desc[2].en_us: This allows you to void specific items that go into the chest, and comes with a filter that can do some pretty awesome stuff. You could even set the filter to void everything from a certain mod!
quest.1B10A2DED0629D6B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个升级可以销毁特定物品，而且还有个特别强大的过滤器，你甚至可以用它来把某个特定模组的东西全部销毁！

quest.1B20BEE2BE4476A7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eOritech's &aCybernetic Upgrades&r allow you to go full cyberpunk and install toggleable upgrades directly to your character.
quest.1B20BEE2BE4476A7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eOritech&a模组的&a赛博升级&r可以让你完全赛博朋克，直接在你的身体里安装各种可替换的升级。

quest.1B20BEE2BE4476A7.quest_desc[2].en_us: These upgrades may require certain research stations, and range from things like increasing your movement speed or attack damage to making your player permanently invisible, or granting you creative flight.
quest.1B20BEE2BE4476A7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 安装这些升级需要使用特定的研究站，可升级的选项包括但不限于增加移动速度和攻击伤害，或者让你永久隐形，甚至创造模式飞行。

quest.1B3B2B9697D7AEA6.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dEclipse Alloy&r tools are the final tier of tools from &6Just Dire Things&r.
quest.1B3B2B9697D7AEA6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d蚀空合金&r工具是&6Just Dire Things&r模组最高等阶的工具。

quest.1B3B2B9697D7AEA6.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are powered tools that can use the best upgrades from the mod.
quest.1B3B2B9697D7AEA6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些能量驱动的工具可以安装本模组中最强力的升级。

quest.1B3B2B9697D7AEA6.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be made once you've defeated the &dChicken Jockey&r and made &dShadowpulse Goo&r.
quest.1B3B2B9697D7AEA6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 等你击败&d威猛鸡骑士&r，制作出&d暗影脉凝胶&r之后，就可以制作蚀空合金了。

quest.1B8BB733ADF897FE.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eProductive Metalworks&r is used to smelt and forge alloys, and cast them into various different parts.
quest.1B8BB733ADF897FE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以利用&eProductive Metalworks&r模组冶炼合金并将其铸造成各种不同的零件。

quest.1B8BB733ADF897FE.quest_desc[2].en_us: Start by crafting some &cFire Clay&r and then smelting that into &4Fire Bricks&r. These will be used to build the structure of our &6Foundry&r.
quest.1B8BB733ADF897FE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先制作一些&c耐火粘土&r，然后将其冶炼成&4耐火砖块&r来搭建&6熔铸炉&r结构。

quest.1B8BB733ADF897FE.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &eBig Book of Metallurgy&r can show you how to set up a &6Foundry&r.
quest.1B8BB733ADF897FE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 阅读这本&e冶金学百科全书&r，你可以大概知晓如何建造一个合格的&6熔铸炉&r。

quest.1BC994881BC225ED.quest_desc[0].en_us: By combining magical spools with different materials and applying them to arcane armor in the &aWeaver's Workbench&r, the armor changes in appearance while keeping all of its defense and other benefits.
quest.1BC994881BC225ED.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以在&a织物工作台&r上把隐秘线轴与不同材料结合在一起，并把它们安置在奥术盔甲上。盔甲的外观会发生变化，但防御力和其他增益都会保留。

quest.1BC994881BC225ED.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &eAncient Weave&r converts the armor to an alternate version of itself, but all other weaves change the armor to one set look.
quest.1BC994881BC225ED.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e古代织物&r会把不同盔甲转化成不同独立的样式（注：实测都只有一套样式），而其他织物无论转化什么盔甲都是同一种样式。

quest.1BC994881BC225ED.quest_desc[4].en_us: &o&7Ex. a Soulhunter Robe and a Soulstained Chestplate will seem identical after a Cornered Weave is applied.&r
quest.1BC994881BC225ED.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &o&7举个例子，用了指挥官织物后，灵魂猎手长袍会和魂染钢胸甲长得一模一样。&r

quest.1BF77D602FFDF292.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dInfinity Range Booster&r grants you access to your network anywhere within the same dimension.
quest.1BF77D602FFDF292.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d无限范围增幅器&r可以让你在同维度的任何地方访问你的网络。

quest.1BF77D602FFDF292.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Dimension Card&r grants you access to your network across dimensions at a hefty energy cost.
quest.1BF77D602FFDF292.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6维度卡&r可以让你跨维度访问你的网络，但是需要消耗大量能量。

quest.1BFDE3507411C116.quest_desc[0].en_us: Your &6Foundry&r will need a &aController&r and a &2Tank&r to control the foundry and to store smelting liquids.
quest.1BFDE3507411C116.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你的&6熔铸炉需要一个&a控制器&r和一个&2储罐&r来控制熔铸炉和储存熔融的金属。

quest.1BFDE3507411C116.quest_desc[2].en_us: Of course, you'll also need your &6Foundry&r base resistant enough to withstand enough heat to smelt things down.
quest.1BFDE3507411C116.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 当然，你还需要一个足够耐热的储罐来存放能够熔化金属的高温液体。

quest.1BFDE3507411C116.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oThese can be dyed to match your base aesthetics.
quest.1BFDE3507411C116.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o你可以根据你的喜好进行染色。

quest.1C0024A48898FB90.quest_desc[0].en_us: With an &aAlchemical Impetus&r as a focus, &aSpirit Crucibles&r are able to channel spirits into a physical form such as dusts or gems that align with their aspects. This slowly uses up the Impetus's material, but it can be repaired or made anew.
quest.1C0024A48898FB90.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 只要以&a炼金促符&r作为核心材料，你就能用&a精魂坩埚&r来把精魂转化成其派别对应的物理形式，比如粉末或是宝石。这种转化会缓慢消耗促符的耐久度，不过你可以修复它，也可以重新制作。

quest.1C0024A48898FB90.quest_desc[2].en_us: Of note is &e'blazing quartz'&r which cannot otherwise be found in the void.
quest.1C0024A48898FB90.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 值得一提的是，空岛上是不会自然生成&e“烈焰石英”&r的。

quest.1C0024A48898FB90.quest_desc[4].en_us: Other types of Impetus also can be crafted, allowing the conversion of spirits into a wider variety of resources.
quest.1C0024A48898FB90.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还可以做出其他类型的促符，它们能把精魂转换成的资源种类会更加丰富。

quest.1C6508B8B2C94CAF.quest_desc[0].en_us: These power-consuming tools can be upgraded within a &aModification Table&r.
quest.1C6508B8B2C94CAF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这些由能量驱动的小工具可以在&a改装台&r上升级。

quest.1C6508B8B2C94CAF.quest_desc[2].en_us: Upgrades can be installed to lower its energy consumption, increase digging reach, or apply silk-touch or fortune.
quest.1C6508B8B2C94CAF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 安装升级可以降低能量消耗、增加挖掘范围，或是添加精准采集/时运效果。

quest.1CA7E96F42B75C2F.quest_desc[0].en_us: One of the first machines that you can make is the &aPowered Furnace&r!
quest.1CA7E96F42B75C2F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以制作的第一台机器就是&a电炉&r！

quest.1CA7E96F42B75C2F.quest_desc[2].en_us: To build this machine, place down the &aPowered Furnace&r block first, then place a &bMachine Core&r on top of it. Then you can Right-click it to build it.
quest.1CA7E96F42B75C2F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要搭建这台机器，首先需要先放下&a电炉&r，然后在它上方放置一个&b机器核心&r。最后右击整体便可搭建完成。

quest.1CA7E96F42B75C2F.quest_desc[4].en_us: This is a decent machine in the early game, but can be upgraded to be much faster using &bAddons&r.
quest.1CA7E96F42B75C2F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这台机器在游戏前期还算可以，但你也可以为它加装&b插件&r来大幅提升工作速度。

quest.1CC15C703CEC4190.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eImmersive Engineering&r (&eI.E&r) is a realism-inspired tech-mod with many fun and useful multiblocks.
quest.1CC15C703CEC4190.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e沉浸工程&r（又名&eIE&r）是取材于现实工业的科技模组，能为你带来许多有趣实用的多方块结构。

quest.1CC15C703CEC4190.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started, craft an &aEngineer's Hammer&r, which will be used throughout the mod for crafting recipes and activating multiblocks.
quest.1CC15C703CEC4190.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先制作一把&a工程师锤&r，本模组的许多合成配方，以及激活多方块结构都需要工程师锤。

quest.1CC15C703CEC4190.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aEngineer's Manual&r will be your best friend when showing you how to set up these multiblock machines.
quest.1CC15C703CEC4190.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a工程师手册&r可以为你展示如何搭建多方块结构，想必它会成为你的好伙伴。

quest.1CCD08A54B3F94C4.quest_desc[0].en_us: Most items in the pack won't have EMC values, but &dDark Matter&r and &cRed Matter&r can be used for more than EMC.
quest.1CCD08A54B3F94C4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 该整合包的大多数物品没有EMC值，但是&d暗物质&r和&c红物质&r有更多除EMC以外的用途。

quest.1CCD08A54B3F94C4.quest_desc[2].en_us: Either of these can be converted into a TON of &bMatter&r using the &aDisintegrator&r.
quest.1CCD08A54B3F94C4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这两者中的任意一种都可以使用&a分解器&r转换成大量的&b物质&r。

quest.1CFBFD1CE648772F.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you want to tap into your power storage wirelessly, you should pump your power into an &dEnder Cell&r.
quest.1CFBFD1CE648772F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想无线传输能量，试试把能量输入&d末影单元&r中。

quest.1CFBFD1CE648772F.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are used to store a massive amount of power into a &bfrequency&r, which can be accessed from any dimension using another Ender Cell or &6Ender Gate&r.
quest.1CFBFD1CE648772F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 末影单元能够将大量能量存储进一个&b频道&r中，你可以在任意维度中使用另一个末影单元或&6末影道门&r取用能量。

quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you get your hands on some &bInk&r, you can use this to craft new spell scrolls using the &aSpell Forge&r.
quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 搞到一些&b墨水&r后，就可以着手用&a卷轴撰写台&r制造新法术卷轴了。

quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[2].en_us: For each scroll, you'll need some &bInk&r, paper, and a specific item that determines the &bSpell school&r you wish to craft. You can use &eJEI&r to see all of the items for each school!
quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果想要撰写卷轴，你需要准备一些墨水、纸张、一个决定&6卷轴种类&r的特定物品。请查阅&eJEI&r了解卷轴的对应物品！

quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[4].en_us: The tier of &bInk&r used determines the level of the spell you can craft. Certain spells can only be crafted with higher inks.
quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 可合成法术的等级取决于&b墨水&r的等级，部分法术只能用高阶墨水撰写。

quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[6].en_us: Pro Tip: Trading with Piglins is an easy way to get &dCrying Obsidian&r, but there are other methods too!
quest.1CFD4CE2704F2ADE.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 专业提示：和猪灵交易可以很轻松地获得&d哭泣黑曜石&r，但也有其他方法！

quest.1D87C5E9D52341C4.quest_desc[0].en_us: To craft more advanced items in &eDraconic Evolution&r, you will need a special crafting setup called &dFusion Crafting&r.
quest.1D87C5E9D52341C4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要制作&e龙之进化&r更高级的物品，你需要一种被称作&d聚合注入&r的特殊合成装置。

quest.1D87C5E9D52341C4.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dFusion Crafting Core&r must be the middle of the setup, with &dDraconium Fusion Crafting Ejectors&r placed facing towards the Core 2 blocks apart.
quest.1D87C5E9D52341C4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d聚合核心&r必须位于装置中央，并在间隔2个方块处，面向核心放置&d聚合注入器&r。

quest.1D87C5E9D52341C4.quest_desc[4].en_us: The Core will also need a redstone signal to start.
quest.1D87C5E9D52341C4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要用红石信号启动核心。

quest.1D8B2D2B03DF3256.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dThe Wyrmwright&r says crafting the &2Chronon Resonator&r will allow them to find their brother's last known location, wherever that may be.
quest.1D8B2D2B03DF3256.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 据&d飞龙匠人&r所说，制作出&2时元谐振器&r后，就能找到他弟弟最后的已知点位，无论在哪。

quest.1DA78BAB2A6E2C82.quest_desc[0].en_us: For modded veterans, &eEnderIO&r held great memories due to its amazing pipes, called &dConduits&r.
quest.1DA78BAB2A6E2C82.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 对于模组老手，&e末影接口&r令人惊叹的管道给他们留下了诸多美好的回忆，这些管道被称为&d导管&r。

quest.1DA78BAB2A6E2C82.quest_desc[2].en_us: These &dConduits&r are highly configurable, and can even store multiple conduits in the same block space. If you don't like the look of the cables, you can also slap on a &2Facade&r to cover them up!
quest.1DA78BAB2A6E2C82.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些&d导管&r可以随心所欲配置，甚至一个方块空间内可以放置多个导管。如果你不喜欢这玩意的样子的话，就往上面贴个&2导管框架&r吧！

quest.1DA78BAB2A6E2C82.quest_desc[4].en_us: Configuring them is made easy using the &aYeta Wrench&r. If any pipe is hidden beneath a &2Facade&r, holding the wrench in your hand will uncover them for easy configuration.
quest.1DA78BAB2A6E2C82.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 调节这些管道需要&a耶塔扳手&r，如果你把管道放在了&2导管框架&r下，但是又想调整这个管道的话，手持扳手它们就会显现出来，以便于配置。

quest.1DC5DE6E9F0D0B2C.quest_desc[0].en_us: Spells can be cast by equipping your &aSpell Book&r in its curio slot.

quest.1DC5DE6E9F0D0B2C.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once equipped, you can open up the scroll wheel using the &bR&r keybind by default. Casting the selected spell can be done by pressing &bV&r.

quest.1DC5DE6E9F0D0B2C.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can all be changed in your keybinds. Try searching for &acategory:"Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - General"&r.

quest.1DC5DE6E9F0D0B2C.quest_desc[6].en_us: There are also quick cast options!

quest.1E061D2E5C560867.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cChesed Arena&r is a massive structure found in the &eEnd&r ring.
quest.1E061D2E5C560867.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c慈悲竞技场&r是生成于&e末地&r环中的大型结构。

quest.1E061D2E5C560867.quest_desc[2].en_us: This arena comes with its own boss fight!

quest.1E077BC4B8832C98.quest_desc[0].en_us: Found within the upper levels of the &bTwilight Forest&r ring, the vault of the &aYeti&r is the second Twilight boss to fight.
quest.1E077BC4B8832C98.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a雪怪&r宝库坐落于&b暮色森林&r环的上层，这是你要击败的第二个暮色Boss。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aBiometric Identifier&r is a requirement for making the &dForcefield&r and the &eInterdiction Matrix&r function on an individual level, such as being able to sneak to walk through field blocks.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a生物识别器&r为&d力场&r和&e结界矩阵&r提供了调整个体权限的功能，例如潜行穿过力场方块的权限。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Any player not sneaking inside a field block will take instantaneous &cinfinite damage&r.&r
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 任何在力场方块内没有潜行的玩家都将瞬间受到&c无穷大的伤害&r。&r

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[4].en_us: You will need an &bIdentification Card&r registered to yourself and one per any relevant players. These registered &bcards&r are placed into slots in the &aIdentifier&r machine.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要为自己注册一张&b身份卡&r，也要给你的朋友注册一张，这些注册过的&b身份卡&r需要放进&a生物识别器&r的对应槽位里。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[6].en_us: Other players can be registered by sneak + right-clicking them with the &bcard&r.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 手持&b身份卡&r潜行右击其他玩家即可对其进行注册。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[10].en_us: The first slot is for allowing/disallowing various "rights" to the &bcard's&r registered player.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 第一个槽位可以调整&b身份卡&r注册人的“权限”。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[12].en_us: The second slot will copy the rights of a &bcard&r in the first slot onto any &bcard&r placed into the second.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 第二个槽位用来复制第一个槽位中&b身份卡&r的权限并将其写入第二个槽位的&b身份卡&r中。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[14].en_us: The third slot grants all rights to the &bcard's&r registered player. The &aIdentifier&r will &lnot&r turn on without a card in this slot.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 第三个槽位将赋予&b身份卡&r注册人所有权限，&a生物识别器&r在该槽位没有身份卡时将&l不会&r运行。

quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[16].en_us: The remaining 9 slots will apply the defined rights to the relevant player when a &bcard&r is placed inside.
quest.1E2A91B73A752B3B.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 将&b身份卡&r放进其余九个槽位以定义对应玩家的权限。

quest.1E6014F4B7CBE373.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Batteries&r are an &dOptional Attachment&r to have in a &bCAD&r; they allow you to have a &bspare amount of Psi Energy ready&r to be discharged when your basic Psi Energy runs dry.
quest.1E6014F4B7CBE373.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6电池&r是&bCAD&r中的&d可选附件&r，可以在基础Psi能量耗尽时，提供&b额外的Psi能量&r。

quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eDE&r energy core is a tiered energy storage solution capable of storing a near-infinite quantity of power when fully upgraded.
quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e龙之进化&r的能量核心是一种分阶能量储存装置，升至满阶后，就能存储近乎无限的能量。

quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Its core components are the &aEnergy Core&r and the &2Energy Core Stabilizers&r, which can be placed in any direction up to 8 blocks away from the core.
quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 其核心部件是&a能量核心&r和&2能量核心稳定器&r，稳定器可以放置在核心的任意方位，至多距离8格方块。

quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[4].en_us: To insert or extract power from the Core, you'll need to place down an &bEnergy Pylon&r within 10 blocks of the core, then place a glass block under or above it.
quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 若要实现核心内能量的输入输出，你需要在核心10格范围内放置一台&b能量塔&r，并在其上方或下方放置一块玻璃。

quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[6].en_us: To upgrade the core, you'll need to surround the &aEnergy Core&r with more &dDraconium Blocks&r per tier. At tier 8, you'll also need to surround it with &6Awakened Draconium Blocks&r.
quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 若要升级核心，你需要在&a能量核心&r周围放置更多&d龙块&r以逐阶提升。升至8阶时，还需要在其周围放置&6觉醒龙块&r。

quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[8].en_us: The energy core has a build guide within its interface when you interact with it that can automatically place the blocks in their position from your inventory.
quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 能量核心的界面中内置了搭建指导功能，与其交互便能自动将你物品栏中的方块放置到相应位置。

quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[10].en_us: At tier 8, you will also need to upgrade your &2Stabilizers&r into a ring, requiring a total of 36 blocks (9 per ring).
quest.1E6E38DC6183463A.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 升至8阶时，你还需要把&2稳定器&r升级为环型结构，共需要36个（每个环9个）。

quest.1EEC74B18B1BFBB5.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aBatteries&r are a good way to store energy to move around. They can be charged with any wired or wireless charging method.
quest.1EEC74B18B1BFBB5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a电池&r是很好的便携式能量容器。各种充能方式都可以给它充能，无论是有线的还是无线的。

quest.1EEC74B18B1BFBB5.quest_desc[2].en_us: When holding them in hand, they can be sneak-right-clicked to put them into discharge mode, charging other items in your inventory.
quest.1EEC74B18B1BFBB5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持电池时，潜行右击可将其切换为放电模式，此模式下电池会为物品栏中的其他物品充能。

quest.1F0F37429F1177DF.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of Twilight&r.
quest.1F0F37429F1177DF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，去寻找&d暮光族裔的回响&r了。

quest.1F0F37429F1177DF.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with them to unlock the &3Twilight Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.1F0F37429F1177DF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与他合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&3暮色升级&r。

quest.1F0F37429F1177DF.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo twilight&7.
quest.1F0F37429F1177DF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo twilight&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Crafting the circuitry for the &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r will require more than just a steady hand.
quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为&c高级机器方块&r制作电路，仅凭一双巧手可远远不够。

quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[2].en_us: You'll need a machine that can be very precise for this. The &aAssembler&r should do the trick.
quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要一台高精密度的机器来制作它。&a装配器&r应该能胜任。

quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: To assemble this machine, you'll need 3 &aMachine Cores&r of any tier.
quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要组装这台机器，你需要3个任意等级的&a机器核心&r。

quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[6].en_us: [{"text": "", "color": "gray", "italic": true}, "If you wish to learn more about Oritech, check out the ", { "text": "Oritech Chapter", "color": "gray", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "1FD2F304ADC237D0"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Oritech Questline"} }, "."]
quest.1F1A15B6E079F31F.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: [{"text": "", "color": "gray", "italic": true}, "如果你想了解更多关于Oritech模组的信息，请参阅", { "text": "Oritech章节", "color": "gray", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "1FD2F304ADC237D0"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往Oritech任务章节"} }, "。"]

quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Cores&r are an &aessential part of your CAD&r, always try to make the best one you can, &athey're basically the CPU of your CAD&r.
quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6核心&r是&aCAD中的关键部分&r，尽可能制作最好的吧——&a它们本质上是CAD的CPU&r。

quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[2].en_us: Every &6CAD Core&r has a &d&lComplexity Value&r&r, which means &dhow many computations it is able to do&r.
quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个&6CAD核心&r都有一个&d&l复杂度&r&r，这代表&d它能够执行多少计算&r。

quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[3].en_us: &8&o(Selectors, Operators e etc can increase the Complexity of a Spell)&r&r
quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: &8&o（选择符、运算符等会增加术式的复杂度）&r&r

quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[5].en_us: Also, Every &6CAD Core&r has a &3&lProjection Value&r&r, which is simply the &3total number of non-debug tricks it can perform at once&r.
quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: 此外，每个&6CAD核心&r都有一个&3&l映射值&r&r，这就是&3它能一次执行的非调试启动式的总数&r。

quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[7].en_us: These &6Cores&r in particular can provide you with either:
quest.1F1C11D77667DEB4.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: 这些&6核心&r可以为你提供：

quest.1F66695405A4863D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dChroniton Star&r is filled with the power to alter time and space.
quest.1F66695405A4863D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d时空粒子之星&r蕴含着足以扭曲时空的力量。

quest.1F66695405A4863D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Using the &6World Engine&r, you should be able to drain this power to upgrade the &6World Engine&r itself by infusing its own power into &2Chroniton Glass&r.
quest.1F66695405A4863D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以利用&6世界引擎&r抽取这股力量，并将其注入&2时空粒子玻璃&r，进而升级&6世界引擎&r本身。

quest.1F66695405A4863D.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: The &dChroniton Star&r can be restored once you've upgraded the &6World Engine&r with the glass.
quest.1F66695405A4863D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：完成该&6世界引擎&r升级后，就能借助它复原&d时空粒子之星&r。

quest.1F9D3474C8A655A9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 欢迎来到&6指引者的档案室&r。

quest.1F9D3474C8A655A9.quest_desc[2].en_us: Speak with the &dEcho&r to begin your journey...
quest.1F9D3474C8A655A9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与&d回响&r交谈，开启你的旅程吧……

quest.1F9D3474C8A655A9.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&f: If you're playing with friends, complete this quest first and reach your home base &nbefore&r inviting others to your team.
quest.1F9D3474C8A655A9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&f：如果你是与朋友一起玩的，请先完成这个任务并到达你的基地，&n然后&r再邀请其他人加入你的队伍。

quest.1FE2B36C234A35C9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Apothecarist&r can be found in the &aTale of Life and Death&r Gateway.
quest.1FE2B36C234A35C9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2药剂师&r可在&a一则传说——生与死的传说&r传送门中找到。

quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eEnder Storage&r allows for cross-dimensional storage of items and fluids.
quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e末影存储&r可以实现跨维度存储流体和物品。

quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aEnder Chests&r link their inventories to others with matching color patterns. You can use any colored dye on the wool pads to change its color.
quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 相同颜色排列的&a末影箱子&r之间互通，用任意颜色的染料对着它的羊毛右击就可以改变颜色。

quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Crafting these requires the &bChroniton Glass&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，需要先用&b时空粒子玻璃&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[6].en_us: &aEnder Pouches&r allow you to remotely access an &aEnder Chest&r of the same color pattern. Right-clicking the pouch on any &aEnder Chest&r will change the pouch's color to match that of the chest.
quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a末影袋子&r可以让你远程访问相同颜色的&a末影箱子&r，对着目标箱子右击就可以将袋子颜色变为箱子颜色。

quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[8].en_us: &aEnder Tanks&r work in the same way as &aEnder Chests&r but store liquids instead of items.
quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &a末影蓄水槽和&a末影箱子&r一样，但是它储存的是液体。

quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[10].en_us: Using a &bDiamond&r on the latch of an &aEnder Chest&r will move it to a separate private network for the player that used the diamond. This is especially good for server use.
quest.1FEEBCA6D633B479.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 手持&b钻石&r右击&a末影箱子&r会将它转化为私人模式，这样就只有对它使用钻石的玩家能使用它了，服务器用这个挺舒适的。

quest.20168B6357665708.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.20168B6357665708.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.201BB935C9972574.quest_desc[0].en_us: Lesser Spell Slot Improvements can be crafted from a lot of &cHogskin&r and some &bArcane Cloth.&r
quest.201BB935C9972574.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 小型法术槽升级可以使用大量&c疣猪皮&r及少量&b奥术布匹&r来合成。

quest.201BB935C9972574.quest_desc[2].en_us: They can be repeatedly applied to any &aSpellbook&r via the &aArcane Anvil&r to grant up to a max of 12 spell slots, even for the Flimsy Journal!
quest.201BB935C9972574.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 通过&a奥术铁砧&r，你可以用这种材料反复为&a法术书&r进行扩容，最多可以扩容到12个法术槽，连初学者日志都能扩！

quest.206987FC6B1524F8.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAtomic Reconstructor&r is used to crystalize materials and is one of the main machines used in &eActually Additions&r.
quest.206987FC6B1524F8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a原子再构机&r是&e实用拓展&r的重要机器，一般拿来做晶体材料。

quest.206987FC6B1524F8.quest_desc[2].en_us: When provided with power, it will shoot a laser beam up to ten blocks away, or until the laser comes into contact with another block.
quest.206987FC6B1524F8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 给它供应足够的能量后，它就会射出一道长10格的激光，激光会被方块挡住。

quest.206987FC6B1524F8.quest_desc[4].en_us: It will crystalize any dropped items or blocks placed on either side of the laser.
quest.206987FC6B1524F8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这道激光会把路径上的掉落物或放置在激光两侧的方块全部晶体化。

quest.20D7DA6055C540FA.quest_desc[0].en_us: Most quests in the Bounty Board are repeatable and &arefresh every 24 hours&r!
quest.20D7DA6055C540FA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 悬赏板中的大多数任务都是可重复且&a每24小时刷新&r的！

quest.20D7DA6055C540FA.quest_desc[2].en_us: The clock task in each quest will show the cooldown once you've collected your rewards.
quest.20D7DA6055C540FA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个任务中的时钟将在你领取奖励后显示冷却时间。

quest.20F9CC6590B8990C.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Ars&r has many magical creatures that you can summon to help you with your everyday tasks. These can be controlled by using the &dDominion Wand&r!
quest.20F9CC6590B8990C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在&6新生魔艺&r中，你可以召唤许多魔法生物来帮助你完成日常任务，并能使用&d支配之杖&r来控制它们！

quest.20F9CC6590B8990C.quest_desc[2].en_us: To learn more about what each one does, make sure to refer to the &aTattered Tome&r guidebook.
quest.20F9CC6590B8990C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要了解更多关于每个生物的作用，请查阅&a残破的宝典&r指南书。

quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAlloy Smelter&r will be your most used machine in &eEnderIO&r as most Machines and Gizmos require some kind of Alloy produced here! oh and it can be upgraded with &bCapacitors&r.
quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a合金炉&r将是你&e末影接口&r旅途中最常用的机器，因为大多数机器和设备都需要用到它生产的合金！哦，它还可以用&b电容&r升级。

quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[2].en_us: In the &aAlloy Smelter's&r interface, you can configure it in many different ways to improve your automation. It allows for side input/output configuration, redstone configuration, and swapping between three modes:
quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&a合金炉&r的UI内，你可以按需进行自动化配置，比如侧面输入/输出、红石控制，以及切换以下三种工作模式：

quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eAlloy only mode&r: Only allows the Alloy Smelter to create alloys.
quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e仅合金配方&r：这个模式下合金炉只能处理合金配方。

quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eFurnace only mode&r: Treats the Alloy Smelter as a furnace
quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e仅熔炉配方&r：这个模式下合金炉就是个熔炉而已。

quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eAlloying and Smelting&r: This mode will do both alloying and smelting, which can be bad when automating as some items will be smelted before turning into alloys.
quest.210753664AB84703.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e合金和烧炼配方&r：这个模式下熔炼和合金配方不分离，等你要烧的物品变成合金就知道错了。

quest.212600F8D3C1E1EB.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you run &eBrine&r through another Thermal Evaporation Tower, it'll convert it into &6Liquid Lithium&r.
quest.212600F8D3C1E1EB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 把&e盐水&r再次输入进热力蒸馏塔，就会产出&6液态锂&r。

quest.212600F8D3C1E1EB.quest_desc[2].en_us: We can't do much with Liquid Lithium, so we'll need to convert it into a gas using a &aRotary Condensentrator&r.
quest.212600F8D3C1E1EB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 液态锂对你来说根本没啥用，所以需要&a回旋式气液转换机&r来把它变成气态锂。

quest.212600F8D3C1E1EB.quest_desc[4].en_us: To make the best power storage in &aMekanism&r, we'll need to convert Lithium into &6Lithium Dust&r using a &aChemical Crystallizer&r. The Crystallizer requires &dUltimate Control Circuits&r to craft!
quest.212600F8D3C1E1EB.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 想做出&a通用机械&r中的最强储能设备，你就需要使用&a化学结晶器&r将锂转化为&6锂粉&r。但是要制作化学结晶器，就得先做出&d终级控制电路&r！

quest.21322BAF061FE83F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Neutronium&r gives you a start to work with, but now we will need to activate it. The &zNeutron Activator&r is a multiblock machine that will be used for this purpose.
quest.21322BAF061FE83F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6中子素&r是你迈出的第一步，但现在我们还需要激活它。&z中子活化器&r是一种多方块机器，它便拥有此功能。

quest.21322BAF061FE83F.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine requires heat to simulate the power of the sun that is obviously missing in this stone world.
quest.21322BAF061FE83F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种机器需要用热量来模拟这个石头世界缺失的太阳能。

quest.21322BAF061FE83F.quest_desc[4].en_us: It can convert &eNuclear Waste&r into &dPolonium&r, and &eLithium&r into &aTritium&r when powered with a single &6Neutron Pile&r.
quest.21322BAF061FE83F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 只需要一撮&6中子素尘埃&r作为能源，它就能将&e核废料&r转变为&d钋&r，将&e锂&r转变为&a氚&r。

quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eBaubley Heart Crystals&r allows you to increase your maximum health by up to 80 hearts (160 health points). This can be done by placing up to 20 canisters of each tier inside the &aHeart Amulet&r.
quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e心之容器&r模组可以增加你的最大生命值，最多可增加80颗心（160点生命值），也就是至多可在&a心之项链&r中放入80个心之容器（每种心之容器各20个）。

quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[2].en_us: &cRed Hearts&r can drop when killing hostile mobs.
quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &c红心&r可以通过击杀敌对怪物获得。

quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eYellow Hearts&r are dropped by most bosses.
quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e黄心&r可以通过击杀大部分boss获得。

quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[6].en_us: &aGreen Hearts&r are dropped by the &dWarden&r and &cIgnis&r.
quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a绿心&r可以通过击杀&d监守者&r和&c焰魔&r获得。

quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[8].en_us: &9Blue Hearts&r are dropped by &zMighty Ender Chicken&r, &6Leviathan&r, &6Tyros&r, and &cMaledictus&r.
quest.213FE1D19D589513.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &9蓝心&r可以通过击杀&z威猛末影鸡&r、&6利维坦&r、&6提洛斯回响·原初受火者&r以及&c咒翼灵骸&r获得。

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMultiblock Printer&f and &aMultiblock Validator&f are two tools that can help you build new structures and validate broken multiblocks.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[2].en_us: The following pages will teach you how to use each item.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aMultiblock Printer&f supports only certain structures, which you can find in &eJEI&r by searching “&aMultiblock Printer&r” and checking for the "&aⓘ&f Compatible" tag.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[6].en_us: Once you've gatherered the required blocks and cleared enough space for the multiblock, place down the &bController&r and Right-click it with the &aMultiblock Printer&r.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[8].en_us: It will place blocks automatically using items from your inventory.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[10].en_us: If something blocks block placement or an item can’t be found in your inventory, the &aMultiblock Printer&f stops working and shows an error explaining the issue.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[12].en_us: The &aMultiblock Validator&f helps diagnose and maintain &eCustom Machinery&r multiblocks.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[14].en_us: Using it on a &bCustom Machinery Controller&r shows all &aInstalled Multiblock Modules&f.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[16].en_us: It can also re-align the World Engine automatically.

quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[18].en_us: You can also reset all multiblock cores. This action will &c&n&lNOT&r&c&n refund any lost items&r to errored cores, meaning any items in those cores will be effectively voided.

quest.214D210F200CD11F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dTime Twister&r records important events such as deaths or changing dimensions on a timeline. You can then teleport to the exact location of these timeline events, provided you have enough &bChronon&r.
quest.214D210F200CD11F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d时间扭曲器&r能够在时间线上记录重要的事件，比如死亡或者进/出维度。只要你有足够的&b时元&r，你就可以传送到时间线事件发生的准确位置。
