quest.214D210F200CD11F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Which events are recorded can be configured via the Time Twister's interface.
quest.214D210F200CD11F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 打开时间扭曲装置的界面，即可配置需要被记录的事件。

quest.215E7EB95A7C64A3.quest_desc[0].en_us: Every second matters, and that's why you should shove them in the &6Temporal Pouch&r.
quest.215E7EB95A7C64A3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 一寸光阴一寸金，你的时间非常值钱。所以你应该把时间装到&6时间之袋&r里。

quest.215E7EB95A7C64A3.quest_desc[2].en_us: This pouch stores time, as long as it is in your inventory. This time can be used to increase the ticks of pretty much anything by sneak-using the pouch on it.
quest.215E7EB95A7C64A3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 当这个袋子放在物品栏中时，可以储存时间。手持袋子右击方块可以加快其游戏刻流逝速度（与时间之瓶别无二致）。

quest.215E7EB95A7C64A3.quest_desc[4].en_us: If something is too slow, use some of your stored time to make it faster!
quest.215E7EB95A7C64A3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果你感觉有的东西太慢了，那就用一些你储存的时间让它变快！

quest.21A521011401074F.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon spawns in the &7Deepslate&r and &cNetherrack&r rings.
quest.21A521011401074F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此地牢会生成在&7深板岩&r与&c下界岩&r环中。

quest.21E1A72027DBF236.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.21E1A72027DBF236.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.21E1A72027DBF236.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.21E1A72027DBF236.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.22103051C3EE2BA0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSAG Mill&r crushes items into dusts, and can be used to increase ore yields.
quest.22103051C3EE2BA0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a半自磨机&r可以将物品磨成粉，它也能够实现矿石增产。

quest.22103051C3EE2BA0.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bGrinding Balls&r can be used to improve machine power usage, and item process output. There are many tiers of Grinding Balls, but you can always use &3Flint&r when just starting out.
quest.22103051C3EE2BA0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b磨珠&r能改善机器的用电效能以及物品产出。磨珠有很多等级，刚开始一般用&3燧石&r。

quest.226E5BD0BEB1BA75.quest_desc[0].en_us: These are unique shelves that provide certain bonuses like adding 100% &cQuanta&r, or removing &cQuanta&r and &5Arcana&r.
quest.226E5BD0BEB1BA75.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这些独特的书架能提供特定的效果，例如添加100%的&c量子化&r，或者降低&c量子化&r和&5阿卡那&r。

quest.22B83D03C6C3E61E.quest_subtitle.en_us: Improves operation speed, but reduces energy efficiency
quest.22B83D03C6C3E61E.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 提升运作速度，但是会降低能量使用效率。

quest.22B94BDDC08B3FA9.quest_desc[0].en_us: By reinforcing a &aBrass Casing&r with an &dObsidian Plate&r, you can create a casing strong enough to withstand the weight of a train.
quest.22B94BDDC08B3FA9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 用&d黑曜石板&r加固后的&a黄铜机壳&r足以承受列车的重量。

quest.22B94BDDC08B3FA9.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is a big step towards upgrading the &6World Engine&r!
quest.22B94BDDC08B3FA9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你离升级&6世界引擎&r又近了一大步！

quest.22B94BDDC08B3FA9.quest_desc[4].en_us: Head back to the &dMachinist&r to show them your progress.
quest.22B94BDDC08B3FA9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 回去找&d机械师&r，向他展示你的成果吧。

quest.231726AD865A945F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Mekanism&r offers simple energy storage using &aEnergy Cubes&r and &aEnergy Tablets&r. The Tablets are batteries for your inventory!
quest.231726AD865A945F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6通用机械&r提供了&a能量立方&r和&a能量板&r两种简易的能量存储方式，能量板就是一块便携式电池！

quest.231726AD865A945F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aEnergy Cubes&r can also charge items by placing them in the right slot of the interface.
quest.231726AD865A945F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a能量立方&rGUI右侧的槽位可以给物品充能。

quest.2341297707B00E93.quest_desc[0].en_us: The rest of the generators in this chapter are considered &aEnd Game Generators&r.
quest.2341297707B00E93.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本章中的其他发电机都属于&a游戏末期发电机&r。

quest.2341297707B00E93.quest_desc[2].en_us: These generators are customizable, and can generate some of the highest amounts of power in the pack.
quest.2341297707B00E93.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些发电机尺寸比较自由，它们是本整合包中产能的巅峰。

quest.2341297707B00E93.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Reactors from &6Oritech&r have been massively buffed.
quest.2341297707B00E93.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&6Oritech&r模组的反应堆被大大加强了。

quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Fusion Reactor&r is &eMekanism's&r final energy generator. Fueled by &aDeuterium&r and &2Tritium&r, or a mixture of both&r, it is capable of producing vast amounts of power and/or heat for relatively little upkeep. Both fuel components are produced using just water and energy!
quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6聚变反应堆&r是&e通用机械的&r发电的最终解决方案。它消耗&a氘&r和&2氚&r或两者的混合物作为燃料，能够以相对较低的维护成本去生产大量的电力或热能。两种燃料成分都只需水和能量即可轻松生产！

quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Fusion Reactor&r itself requires a (un)healthy amount of &bPost-Fission&r materials to create, both to justify this level of power and contain it.
quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6聚变反应堆&r需要大量的&b裂变产物&r来建造，既是为了支撑这种级别的能量输出，也是为了确保其安全稳定。

quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[6].en_us: To build the &6Fusion Reactor&r, place three 5x5 squares of building material that connect with each other at their mid points, replace the corners of the squares with &2Fusion Reactor Casing&r, and add four &2Casings&r around the midpoints.
quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 要建造&6聚变反应堆&r，先以任意一个点为中心，围绕这个点的x、y、z轴各搭建一个5x5的框架方块结构（参考潮涌核心的框架），然后用&2聚变反应堆框架&r替换这三个框架的四个角，并在这些框架的交点周围额外添加四个&2反应堆框架&r。

quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[8].en_us: Then, replace the top mid-point with the &6Fusion Reactor Controller&r, and all other remaining building blocks can be replaced with reactor glass, ports, or the laser focus matrix.
quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 然后，用&6聚变反应堆控制器&r替换顶部中心方块，其余所有的辅助建筑方块都需替换为强化玻璃、聚变反应堆端口，激光聚焦矩阵或其他反应堆方块。

quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[10].en_us: To start the &6Reactor&r, a small amount of &aD-T Fuel&r in a &eHohlraum&r will be needed inside the &2Controller&r, with fuel supplied to the &6Reactor&r. A disabled &bLaser Amplifier&r will then need to collect energy from other lasers before firing a single beam containing 400 million FE or more into the &3Laser Focus Matrix&r on the &6Reactor&r.
quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 如果要启动&6聚变反应堆&r，需要在&2聚变反应堆控制器&r内放入装有少量&a氘氚燃料&r的&e黑体辐射腔&r，并为&6反应堆&r持续输入燃料。然后，让一个关闭状态的&b激光增幅器&r从其他激光增幅器汇集能量，待激光增幅器收集到4亿FE以上的能量后，向&6反应堆&r上的&3激光聚焦矩阵&r启动激光增幅器从而发射一道能量极大的激光束。

quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[12].en_us: From here energy, steam, or heat can be extracted from a &aFusion Reactor Port&r set to output mode.
quest.24401E59D87AC23A.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 可以将&a聚变反应堆端口&r设置为输出模式，以从反应堆中提取能量、蒸汽或热量。

quest.24CE908ED60FD514.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aPulverizer&r is a simple machine that can be used to make Dusts and Biomass.
quest.24CE908ED60FD514.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a磨粉机&r是个很简单的机器，可以用于制造各种粉和生物质。

quest.24CE908ED60FD514.quest_desc[2].en_us: In the early game, this is also the best way to get &6Enderic Compounds&r.
quest.24CE908ED60FD514.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是前期获取&6末影化合物&r的最好方式。

quest.25023C87AA259688.quest_desc[0].en_us: While not offering much protection in the form of armor, holding down "Shift" while wearing a full set of this armor will turn you into a cardboard box small enough to avoid being detected by mobs.
quest.25023C87AA259688.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 尽管这身盔甲并不能提供多少防御力，但当你身着全套纸板盔甲时，按下“Shift”就可以把自己变成一个纸盒子，让怪物找不到你。

quest.2568C81FA7914FE2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Quantum Entangler&r will effectively multiply all &bQuantum Storage&r by 4.
quest.2568C81FA7914FE2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6量子数据纠缠器&r可以将所有&b量子合成存储器&r的内存翻四倍。

quest.2568C81FA7914FE2.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can only use 1 per multiblock structure.
quest.2568C81FA7914FE2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个多方块合成器只允许放一个量子计算机。

quest.25B9F4FD7CA67A0B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aDimensional Cells&r are energy storage blocks that are capable of sharing their storage with each other wirelessly via &aPowercell Card&r channels. There is a small amount of loss in this process based on the distance, improved by &binfusing&r the cell that's drawing the energy.
quest.25B9F4FD7CA67A0B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a维度能量单元&r是一种能量存储方块，它们可以通过&a维度标记卡&r的频道来无线传输能量。这种传输有一定的能量损耗，损耗随传输距离而增加，给能量单元&b注能&r可以降低损耗。

quest.25B9F4FD7CA67A0B.quest_desc[2].en_us: To insert or extract energy, configure a side of the cell using a &eSmart Wrench&r. Blue sides will allow energy into the cell, yellow will allow energy to be pushed out.
quest.25B9F4FD7CA67A0B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以用&e智能扳手&r配置能量单元的侧面以输入或输出能量，蓝色端口为输入，黄色端口为输出。

quest.25B9F4FD7CA67A0B.quest_desc[4].en_us: To configure a &aPowercell Card&r and create a &bwireless energy channel&r, simply place an unlinked card in the leftmost slot of an unlinked &aDimensional Cell&r. This will register a new channel on the card to transfer power over. To add cards to this channel, place an unlinked card in the slot to the right of it.
quest.25B9F4FD7CA67A0B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将未链接的&a维度标记卡&r放在未链接的&a维度能量单元&rGUI中最左侧的槽位，即可为该标记卡注册一个新的&b无线能量传输频道&r，用于能量传输。将其他未链接的标记卡放入右侧的那个槽位，即可将其添加到该频道。

quest.25C6F433BD3128C4.quest_desc[0].en_us: This ranged 6-shot revolver from &eImmersive Engineering&r can be loaded up with different types of bullets and addons.
quest.25C6F433BD3128C4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 来自&e沉浸工程&r模组的远程6发左轮手枪可以装载数种不同类型的子弹和配件。

quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The first step of &zAscension&r is to become godlike.
quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z飞升&r的第一步，便是做一套成神的装备。

quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[2].en_us: Equip yourself with the strongest weapon and armor known in this dimension.
quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 装备上这个维度最强的武器和盔甲。

quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[4].en_us: Prove yourself worthy of the power of &zcreative items&r.
quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 以证明你配得上这些&z创造物品&r的力量。

quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: All quests in this chapter must be completed using a &n&6Task Screen&r.
quest.25CCA572C4D5CEA0.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：本章节的所有任务必须使用&n&6目标显示器&r完成。

quest.2646D51DBAD8AD42.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bUnlocks&f: "Create Vault" Technically players can get there before
quest.2646D51DBAD8AD42.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &bUnlocks&f: "Create Vault" Technically players can get there before

quest.2682A911828C2D88.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eFramed Blocks&r allow you to create custom blocks and shapes that uses the texture of almost any other block in the pack!
quest.2682A911828C2D88.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e框架方块&r就是用来干这个的！有了它，你就可以搞出形状纹理五花八门的方块了！

quest.2682A911828C2D88.quest_desc[2].en_us: To do this, place down a framed block, and then use the block with the desired texture on the framed block to copy the texture over.
quest.2682A911828C2D88.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 先把框架方块放下来，然后手持某方块右击，这样它就会变成手中方块的纹理了。

quest.2682A911828C2D88.quest_desc[4].en_us: There are also some cool features for these blocks, like using &6Glowstone Dust&r on a framed block to make it glow!
quest.2682A911828C2D88.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这玩意还有些好玩的特性，比如说对它使用&6荧石粉&r，它就会发光！

quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The final tier of bookshelves is locked behind the infusion of &dDragon's Breath&r.
quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作终级的书架需要用到灌注&d龙息&r。

quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[2].en_us: To do this, you will need &a80&r &6Eterna&r, between &a15&r to &a30&r &cQuanta&r, and at least &a60&r &dArcana&r.
quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 想要进行龙息的灌注，你需要达到&a80&r的&6位阶&r、&a15&r到&a30&r的&c量子化&r，以及至少&a60&r的&d阿卡那&r。

quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[4].en_us: If you don't have enough &dArcana,&r you can use candles, which provide a small boost.
quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果&d阿卡那&r不太够，你可以多放点蜡烛，蜡烛可以提供少量的阿卡那。

quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: &dDragon's Breath&r can be obtained from the &dChicken Jockey&r fight.
quest.268CC540E5B605A9.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&d龙息&r可以在与&d威猛鸡骑士&r的战斗中获取。

quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eCustom Machinery&r has a built-in structure preview function that allows you to see where the blocks should be placed in the world.
quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eCustom Machinery&r模组内置结构预览系统，能让你查看方块应放置在世界中的位置。

quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[2].en_us: To access this feature, simply click the Recipe arrow inside of the UI, then click the structure block in JEI to see the block placements in the world.
quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 只需要点击界面中的配方箭头，然后在打开的JEI界面中点击结构方块，便能查看世界中的方块位置。

quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oThe next page contains screenshots to help guide you, and the final page contains a screenshot of the fully-built structure. ->
quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o下一页包含截图以作操作引导，最后一页则是完整的结构截图。->

quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[9].en_us: The final structure should look like the picture below, with vibrant quartz glass on all the three sides of the mysterious cube block.
quest.2690BF30D8119E77.quest_desc[9].zh_cn: 完整的结构应像下图所示，在神秘方块所在三面各有聚能石英玻璃。

quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[0].en_us: Most of &6Oritech's&r generators can accept the &aSteam Boiler Addon&r. This allows you to pump water into the addon, which will convert the power output of the generator into &bSteam.
quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 大部分&6Oritech&r模组的发电机都可以加装&a蒸汽锅炉插件&r。你可以将水泵入该插件，从而将机器产生的能量转化为&b蒸汽。

quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can then be pumped into a &aSteam Engine&r to generate RF. The energy produced is added with the energy produced from the base generator that is using the &aSteam Boiler Addon&r.
quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些蒸汽可输入&a蒸汽机&r中产生RF，产生的总能量相当于蒸汽机产生的能量与安装了&a蒸汽锅炉插件&r的机器产生的能量的和。

quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[4].en_us: A &aSteam Engine's&r speed varies based on the stored steam. More steam results in more pressure, making it operate faster. The speed is scaled linearly based on the tank's fill percentage, with a maximum multiplier of 10 when the tank is full.
quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a蒸汽机&r的工作速度取决于其内部储存的蒸汽量，蒸汽越多压力越大，工作的速度也就越快。工作速度与蒸汽储量（百分比）线性相关，满蒸汽时工作速度可达10倍。

quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[6].en_us: However, the &aSteam Engine's&r efficiency varies based on the speed. Higher efficiency results in more RF per steam unit produced. The machine's efficiency is highest when operating at around 700% speed. Anything lower or higher than that will result in a less ideal yield.
quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 不过呢，&a蒸汽机&r的效率也会受到工作速度的影响。效率高意味着每单位蒸汽可产生的RF更多。机器以约700%的速度运行时效率最高，高于或低于这个值能量产率都会下降。

quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[8].en_us: Energy can be extracted from the red machine slots, while Fluid ports are marked blue.
quest.269EE6FF35CA9857.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 机器上红色的槽位是能量端口，蓝色的是流体端口。

quest.26B74124E89189F7.quest_desc[0].en_us: The base shelf for the final tier of enchanting.
quest.26B74124E89189F7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这是最高等级附魔的基础书架。

quest.26B74124E89189F7.quest_desc[2].en_us: Besides being locked behind &dInfused Dragon's Breath&r, Endshelves are relatively cheap.
quest.26B74124E89189F7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 除掉&d灌注龙息&r，末地书架的造价还是很便宜的。

quest.26CE741ECA36BBC5.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eJust Dire Things&r tools can be tiered up via &aSmithing Templates&r and accept more &2Upgrades&r as they rank up to tools better than netherite.
quest.26CE741ECA36BBC5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eJust Dire Things&r模组的工具可以使用&a模板&r来升阶，且工具的等阶越高，可以加装的&2升级&r就越多，最终可以打造出比下界合金更强大的工具。

quest.26CE741ECA36BBC5.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bFerricore&r and &cBlazegold&r are the first two tiers of tools available.
quest.26CE741ECA36BBC5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b核源铁&r和&c烈焰金&r是最初阶的两种工具材料。

quest.26D7C5298D95C69A.quest_desc[0].en_us: When crafting &bJewelry&r, &aBanding Materials&r can be used by themselves to grant effects and/or stat increases.
quest.26D7C5298D95C69A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 仅使用&a环带材料&r制成的&b饰品&r也可以提供增益效果和/或数值加成。

quest.26D7C5298D95C69A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Their main use, however, is to multiply &aGem&r effects with their quality multiplier.
quest.26D7C5298D95C69A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 不过，这些材料的主要用途是放大&a宝石&r的效果，放大倍率由材料的品质效果加成决定。

quest.26D7C5298D95C69A.quest_desc[4].en_us: While most vanilla gems will work, you can also search for &ajewelry_metal&r in JEI for a list.
quest.26D7C5298D95C69A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 即使大多数原版宝石都能奏效，但你仍能在JEI中搜索&ajewelry_metal&r来查看可用列表。

quest.26F18323EB6EFCA0.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bSNAD&r blocks allow you to create farms of Cactus or Sugarcane easily. These can also be given a redstone signal to increase the growth rate of the crop.
quest.26F18323EB6EFCA0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b子沙&r方块很适合建造仙人掌或者甘蔗农场。给它输入红石信号还可以提高作物的生长速率。

quest.26F3ECD3CC9E7CDA.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r are a modern wonder of technology.
quest.26F3ECD3CC9E7CDA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c高级机器方块&r是现代科技的奇迹。

quest.26F3ECD3CC9E7CDA.quest_desc[2].en_us: Bring these back to &dThe Catalyst&r, and they'll show you how to install this &3World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.26F3ECD3CC9E7CDA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 带着这些东西回到&d精械师&r处，他会教你如何安装该&3世界引擎&r升级。

quest.2722C0E2E8993658.quest_desc[0].en_us: The centerpiece of a fully completed enchanting setup.
quest.2722C0E2E8993658.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这是完整的附魔设施的核心组件。

quest.2722C0E2E8993658.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dDraconic Endshelf&r provides no additional stats, but will boost your &aEterna&r by 20, allowing you to hit a max of &6100&r.
quest.2722C0E2E8993658.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d巨龙末地书架&r没有额外的属性，只提供20点&a位阶&r，借此你可以把位阶提升至上限&6100&r点了。

quest.2722C0E2E8993658.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dPearlescent Endshelf&r is the best general-purpose bookshelf, providing significant amounts of both &cQuanta&r and &dArcana&r.
quest.2722C0E2E8993658.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 通常来说，&d璀璨末地书架&r就是最好用的书架了，它可以大幅提升&c量子化&r和&d阿卡那&r。

quest.272E84656D0F133C.quest_desc[0].en_us: With a base and up to five logs on top to form a pole, totems can be attuned to a particular spirit symbol by using the spirit on the logs. Once an appropriate set of symbols is made, right clicking the base will activate the totem pole to invoke a &eSpirit Rite&r. Doing so again will deactivate the Rite.
quest.272E84656D0F133C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 将图腾基座放在底部，然后在基座上方放置至多五块图腾原木，使其形成一根柱子，你就可以用精魂来把它们变成特定的图腾柱了。只要全套图腾样式正确，你就可以右击基座来激活图腾柱，从而展开&e图腾仪式&r。再次右击基座可以停止仪式。

quest.272E84656D0F133C.quest_desc[2].en_us: These Rites have a wide variety of effects either on the world or those who stand in its area. While multiple Rites can be invoked on an area, two or more of the same Rite will cancel each other out.
quest.272E84656D0F133C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些仪式会为这个世界及附近区域的人带来各种各样的影响。虽然你可以在同一片区域内进行多个仪式，但是两个及以上的相同仪式会导致它们彼此抵消。

quest.272E84656D0F133C.quest_desc[4].en_us: A &aTotemic Staff&r will let you see what this area is, and can be used on an attuned log to make it glow without activation.
quest.272E84656D0F133C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a图腾法杖&r不仅能让你查看当前区域的类型信息，还能对一个已调谐的原木使用，使其在未激活的状态下也能发光。

quest.27439A8D79B21B73.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Ancient&r.
quest.27439A8D79B21B73.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，去寻找&d远古族裔的回响&r了。

quest.27439A8D79B21B73.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with them to learn the secrets of the &dDeep Dark&r to unlock the &3Euphonium Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.27439A8D79B21B73.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与他合作，探寻&d深暗之域&r的秘密，并为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&3低吟金属升级&r。

quest.27439A8D79B21B73.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo ancient&7.
quest.27439A8D79B21B73.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo ancient&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.275C5A38C3231690.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've acquired the ability to produce &dSource&r, you should return to the &dMagician&r to learn how to infuse it into the &6World Engine&r.
quest.275C5A38C3231690.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 当你掌握了制造&d魔源&r的方法后，请回到&d魔法师&r处，他会教你如何将魔源注入&6世界引擎&r。

quest.276D2B384F21AC10.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eJust Dire Things&r weapons can be tiered up via &aSmithing Templates&r and accept more &2Upgrades&r as they rank up to tools better than netherite.
quest.276D2B384F21AC10.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eJust Dire Things&r模组的武器可以使用&a模板&r来升阶，且武器的等阶越高，可以加装的&2升级&r就越多，最终可以打造出比下界合金更强大的武器。

quest.277181E358575312.quest_desc[0].en_us: Not everyone likes &c&mslaughtering innocent cows&r animal farms. You may slay the undead instead to acquire &aRotten Flesh&r, which can be cured into &bLeather&r in a &2Campfire&r.
quest.277181E358575312.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 并非每个人都喜欢在动物农场里&c&m屠杀无辜的奶牛&r，你也可以击杀亡灵来获取&a腐肉&r，然后用&2营火&r把腐肉加工成&b皮革&r。

quest.277181E358575312.quest_desc[2].en_us: It's probably a good idea to consider making a &2Backpack&r with some of this leather!
quest.277181E358575312.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用这些皮革做一个&2背包&r会是个不错的主意！

quest.283EA4E7BA93DA11.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEmpowerer&r will consume four surrounding items to empower your crystals.
quest.283EA4E7BA93DA11.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a充能台&r可以通过消耗周围的物品来给你的水晶充能。

quest.283EA4E7BA93DA11.quest_desc[2].en_us: You'll need to set up each &aDisplay Stand&r three blocks away (two block gap) on each side of the &aEmpowerer&r.
quest.283EA4E7BA93DA11.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要在&a充能台&r每一侧的第三个方块处（两个方块间隙）放置&a物品展示台&r 。

quest.283EA4E7BA93DA11.quest_desc[4].en_us: The position of items on the &aDisplay Stands&r do not matter, but you will need to power them.
quest.283EA4E7BA93DA11.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 物品在&a物品展示台&r上的位置不重要，你只需要给它们充能即可。

quest.28683BFE22FBCCFC.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you didn't know, you can burn logs into &7Charcoal&r in a furnace!
quest.28683BFE22FBCCFC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要是你之前不知道的话，现在告诉你，你可以在熔炉里把原木烧成&7木炭&r！

quest.28683BFE22FBCCFC.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be a good early source of fuel.
quest.28683BFE22FBCCFC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是游戏早期不错的燃料来源。

quest.28C1BB5C88F65CA0.quest_desc[0].en_us: With &dWyvern&r tier injectors, you should be able to create &6Awakened Draconium&r, but you'll need a &6Dragon Heart&r. Several &6Dragon Hearts&r actually.
quest.28C1BB5C88F65CA0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&d飞龙&r级别的注入器后，你就能制作&6觉醒龙锭&r了，但你还需要一颗&6龙之心&r——实际上是几颗。

quest.28C1BB5C88F65CA0.quest_desc[2].en_us: You're going to need a ton of &6Awakened Draconium&r, so this method isn't the best way to go about making it.
quest.28C1BB5C88F65CA0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 未来你会需要大量的&6觉醒龙锭&r，因此这种制作方法恐怕不是最好的。

quest.28E63B302DFCF6D9.quest_desc[0].en_us: Depending on your enchanting setup, you might need a little boost of &dArcana&r.
quest.28E63B302DFCF6D9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有时候你可能需要为你的附魔设施增加一些&d阿卡那&r。

quest.28E63B302DFCF6D9.quest_desc[2].en_us: Candles placed around the &dEnchanting Table&r work great for this!
quest.28E63B302DFCF6D9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&d附魔台&r附近摆上一些蜡烛就可以了！

quest.28F636FAA3397479.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aBasic Coal Generator&r from &6RFTools&r is a simple-to-use generator that burns furnace fuel items to generate power.
quest.28F636FAA3397479.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6RF工具&r模组的&a基础燃煤发电机&r是一种简单方便的发电机，它可以消耗熔炉燃料产能。

quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Create&r has a very unique way of storing items as well as doing autocrafting!
quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6机械动力&r有一种非常特殊的物品存储方式，并可以进行自动合成！

quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aItem Vaults&r can store a ton of items, but don't have an interface to see what is in it.
quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a物品保险库&r能存储大量物品，但没有可浏览其中内容的面板。

quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can use &aPackagers&r to wrap items up and ship them off to other storages to create an inventory sorting system!
quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以使用&a打包机&r来打包物品，并将其输送到其他存储装置，这样就实现了一个物品分类系统！

quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[6].en_us: &2Stock Links&r help connect items in a storage to your storage network.
quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &2仓储链接站&r可以将库存物品连接到你的存储网络中。

quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[8].en_us: Combine this with a &aStock Ticker&r, you can request items from those linked storages.
quest.294AB45D52BE342B.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 通过与&a仓储发报机&r配合使用，你就能从连接的存储装置中请求物品。

quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[0].en_us: To upgrade the &6World Engine&r, you'll need to make some basic machines for processing materials.
quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了升级&6世界引擎&r，你需要制造一些基础的机器来帮你加工材料。

quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[2].en_us: To do this, you'll need some basic circuitry and metallic alloys. A &aMetallurgic Infuser&r would be a great machine for this.
quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 为此，你会需要一些基础电路和金属合金。一台&a冶金灌注机&r将会是完成这个任务的绝佳机器。

quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[4].en_us: You will also need a very durable machine casing to house the components.
quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还需要一种结实耐用的外壳来容纳这些组件。

quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[6].en_us: ["", {"text": "Note", "color": "yellow"},  ": Take a look at the ", {"text": "Power Generation", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "391B65CD04A90459"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Power chapter"}}, " chapter if you want some more early power options."]
quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "注意", "color": "yellow"},  "：你可以查阅", {"text": "能源", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "391B65CD04A90459"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往能源章节"}}, "章节以了解更多游戏早期可用的发电方式。"]

quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[8].en_us: You should return to the &dQuartermaster&r once you have completed his task.
quest.2950D495BCF2D52D.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 完成&d军需官&r给你的任务后，请回去找他。

quest.2AB58696A843E9C2.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Fabricator&r.
quest.2AB58696A843E9C2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，去寻找&d构件师的回响&r了。

quest.2AB58696A843E9C2.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock the &cHeat Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.2AB58696A843E9C2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&c加热器升级&r。

quest.2AB58696A843E9C2.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo fabricator&7.
quest.2AB58696A843E9C2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo fabricator&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.2AD996C548EBF4A4.quest_desc[0].en_us: Your &6Foundry&r can also be used to extract matter from the following living entities:
quest.2AD996C548EBF4A4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你的&6熔铸炉&r还可以从以下生物中提取物质：

quest.2AD996C548EBF4A4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: - 村民/小市场商人：&2熔融绿宝石

quest.2B02D9425E19F560.quest_desc[0].en_us: Found something that doesn't work like it should?
quest.2B02D9425E19F560.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 发现某些东西无法正常运作？

quest.2B02D9425E19F560.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["We'd love to know so we can fix it! You can stop by to let us know on ", {"text": "Discord", "color": "aqua", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "open_url", "value": "https://discord.com/invite/X5UGvBs"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": ["Open the Discord invite"]} }, " or by making a bug report on ", {"text": "GitHub", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "open_url", "value": "https://github.com/FTBTeam/FTB-Modpack-Issues/issues"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": ["Open the GitHub link"]} }, "."]
quest.2B02D9425E19F560.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["我们很想知道，以便于修复它！您可以前往", {"text": "Discord", "color": "aqua", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "open_url", "value": "https://discord.com/invite/X5UGvBs"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": ["打开Discord邀请（需要科技）"]} }, "反馈给我们，或者前往", {"text": "GitHub", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "open_url", "value": "https://github.com/FTBTeam/FTB-Modpack-Issues/issues"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": ["打开GitHub链接"]} }, "反馈bug。"]

quest.2B21D8D19E0413AC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cDead King&r can be found in the &aCatacombs&r with the &3Stone&r and &7Deepslate&r layers.
quest.2B21D8D19E0413AC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c死者之王&r可在&a地下墓穴&r中的&3石头&r层和&7深板岩&r层中找到。

quest.2B2BB685DE246BCC.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Lava (and optionally redstone).
quest.2B2BB685DE246BCC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 消耗熔岩（可加入红石）发电。

quest.2B86CBB61E10051F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cPyromancer&r can be found in the &cTale of Ice and Fire&r Gateway.
quest.2B86CBB61E10051F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c炽焰术士&r可在&c一则传说——冰与火的传说&r传送门中找到。

quest.2BB6C51E445A1C95.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Entangled&r allows you to bind two blocks together, allowing you to interact with them as if they were the same block!
quest.2BB6C51E445A1C95.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6纠缠方块&r能让你将两个方块绑定在一起，让你像同一个方块一样与它们交互！

quest.2BB6C51E445A1C95.quest_desc[2].en_us: This allows you to transfer items, energy, fluids, and more instantly.
quest.2BB6C51E445A1C95.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 借助此功能，物品、能量、流体等资源都可瞬时传输。

quest.2BB6C51E445A1C95.quest_desc[4].en_us: &cImportant&r: It will be worth using this on the &6World Engine&r to give you more sides to interface with!
quest.2BB6C51E445A1C95.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &c重要信息&r：在&6世界引擎&r上非常值得使用它，它可以为你提供更多的可交互面！

quest.2BC86AF57781BE63.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSlice'N'Splice&r is used to convert mob heads into special machine parts.
quest.2BC86AF57781BE63.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a头颅装配器&r用于将生物头颅转换为特殊机器部件。

quest.2BC86AF57781BE63.quest_desc[2].en_us: It requires two tools in order to function: an &aAxe&r and &aShears&r. Each operation will take off one durability from each tool. The &aAxe&r must be at least iron, and some &aShears&r from other mods may work.
quest.2BC86AF57781BE63.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要让它工作，需要两种工具：&a斧&r和&a剪刀&r。每次工作都将消耗工具的1点耐久。&a斧&r必须至少为铁制，另外，一些其他模组的&a剪刀&r也能使用。

quest.2BFD68083AD1B894.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aConstructors&r can place resources from your network into the world as blocks or item entities.

quest.2BFD68083AD1B894.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each &eCable Tiers&r upgrade works faster than its previous tier and has more filter slots.

quest.2BFD68083AD1B894.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oCheck each item's tooltip for exact speeds.

quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dParticle Accelerators&r are quite complex! Because of this, each part is split into different quests to break down how they all work.
quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d粒子加速器&r的工作方式非常复杂！所以，接下来的任务会将它的工作原理拆开讲解。

quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[2].en_us: To create new items with this machine, you will need to collide items from two separate controllers.
quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 想要用它制作新物品的话，你需要让两个不同控制器中的物品发生碰撞。

quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dAccelerator Magnetic Field&r can be placed into the middle of the ring and linked to a &dParticle Accelerator&r to increase the amount of speed the ring can handle.
quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d粒子加速器磁场线圈&r可以被放置在加速环的中心，将其连接到&d粒子加速器&r后，就能在加速环可承载速度范围内加速粒子。

quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[6].en_us: You will need an &6Advanced Target Designator&r to link to your Accelerator.
quest.2C0C63951FDED180.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你需要使用&6粒子加速器磁场线圈&r来将其连接到你的粒子加速器。

quest.2C141655079AC173.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dWyvern&r weapons consume power instead of durability and can be customized via modules placed into their inventories.

quest.2C141655079AC173.quest_desc[2].en_us: Their module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.

quest.2C1649AE3DADD71D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eConstruction Sticks&r is a mod all about making the building process much faster.
quest.2C1649AE3DADD71D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e建筑棒&r是一个旨在加快建筑过程的模组。

quest.2C1649AE3DADD71D.quest_desc[2].en_us: While holding a &eConstruction Stick&r in your hand, you can extend blocks in any direction with just one click!
quest.2C1649AE3DADD71D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 只需手持&e建筑棒&r，点击一下，就可以在任意方向搭建多个方块。

quest.2C1649AE3DADD71D.quest_desc[4].en_us: There are also some cool upgrades that you can add to the &eSticks&r, like making it use power instead of durability.
quest.2C1649AE3DADD71D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还可以给它安装一些超酷的升级，例如让它消耗能量而非耐久度。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCoffee Maker&r is used to make a potion-like drink that provides several buffs when consumed.
quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a咖啡机&r可以制作像药水一样的饮料，喝下后可以获得很多Buff。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine requires power to work, and mixes water and &aCoffee Beans&r into an &aEmpty Cup&r to make a &aCoffee Cup&r.
quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这台机器需要能量才能正常工作，它可以将&a咖啡豆&r和水混合，最后倒入&a空杯子&r中做成&a一杯咖啡&r。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can add up to 8 items within the GUI to provide special buffs.
quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 最多可以在GUI中放入8个物品，来提供特殊的增益。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[6].en_us: Note: The small numbers on the GUI represent the order in which the items will be consumed, so make sure you have the correct order of buffs.
quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 注意：GUI中的小数字展示了制造咖啡时物品的消耗顺序，所以仔细规划增益的获得顺序。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[9].en_us: You can brew the following buffs:

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[11].zh_cn: 河豚：提供&9水下呼吸&r，最高2级。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[13].zh_cn: 岩浆膏：提供&6抗火&r，最高2级。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[15].zh_cn: 金胡萝卜：提供&e夜视&r，最高2级。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[17].zh_cn: 发酵蛛眼：提供&7隐身&r，最高2级。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[19].zh_cn: 恶魂之泪：提供&c生命恢复&r，最高3级。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[21].zh_cn: 烈焰粉：提供&d力量&r，最高4级。

quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[25].en_us: Milk Bottle/Bucket: Adds 1min to a buff, but reduce its level by 1.
quest.2C8099E185CA2B60.quest_desc[25].zh_cn: 牛奶瓶/桶：增益时间延长1分钟，效果等级降低1级。

quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["The ", {"text": "AE2-Replication Bridge", "color": "green"}, " connects your ", {"text": "ME Network", "color": "aqua"}, " with a ", { "text": "Replication Matter Network", "color": "yellow", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "0BEF15E1352A5F72"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Replication Chapter"}}, ", seamlessly integrating the two systems."]
quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: [{"text": "AE2-Replication桥接器", "color": "green"}, "可以将你的", {"text": "ME网络", "color": "aqua"}, "与", { "text": "物质复制网络", "color": "yellow", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "0BEF15E1352A5F72"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往Replication章节r"}}, "连接起来，实现两个系统的无缝集成。"]

quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[2].en_us: To link both systems, the &aAE2-Rep Bridge&r must be connected via cables to both systems. This will allow you to:
quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要连接两个系统，必须用线缆将&aAE2-Replication桥接器&r同时连接到两个系统上。这样你就可以：

quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[4].en_us: - View matter quantities using AE2 terminals.
quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: - 在AE2的终端上查看物质储量。

quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: - 通过AE2的自动合成功能下达复制任务。

quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[8].en_us: &7&oYou can check GuideME documentation for further setup information.
quest.2CA2995C290D13F5.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &7&o想了解更详细的搭建方法，可以去看看GuideME里的说明。

quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eModular Force Field System&r (&eMFFS&r for short) is a tech mod that adds force fields and other defensive measures to protect your base.
quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e模块化力场系统（Modular Force Field System, MFFS）&r是一个科技模组，添加了力场及其他防御手段来保护你的基地。

quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started, craft the &aCoercion Deriver&r.
quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要发展这个模组，先制作一个&a能源转换器&r。

quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oMFFS machines require a redstone signal to run by default, most of which can be inverted in the upper left corner of the interface.
quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o模块化力场系统的机器默认需要红石信号才会运行，你可以在大部分机器的界面左上角切换为需要红石信号关停机器。

quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eDerive Mode&r converts energy from other mods or dischargeable items in its inventory to generate &3Fortron&r.
quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e输入模式&r转换其他模组的能量或使用机器内物品中的能量来生成&3力场子&r。

quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[10].en_us: &eIntegrate Mode&r converts &3Fortron&r into energy at a slight loss.
quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &e输出模式&r以微小损耗将&3力场子&r转换为其他能量。

quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[12].en_us: Placing &2Lapis&r or &2Nether Quartz&r inside will triple the &aCoercion Deriver's&r conversion rate when consumed.
quest.2CA74676EAC1A040.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 你可以在机器内放入&2青金石&r或&2下界石英&r，&a能源转换器&r会消耗他们，并将转换速率提升至三倍。

quest.2CB37185A7FAF348.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eMFFS&r machines need to be part of a system in order to run. Machines on the same &bFrequency&r will become part of the same system.
quest.2CB37185A7FAF348.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e模块化力场系统&r的机器需要在系统中运行，处于相同&b频率&r的机器会进入同一个系统。

quest.2CB37185A7FAF348.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &bFrequency&r can be set in the interface, or via right clicking the block with a &aFrequency Card&r, which can copy a machine's &bFrequency&r when placed in the corresponding interface slot.
quest.2CB37185A7FAF348.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 机器的&b频率&r可以在界面设置，也可以通过将&a频率卡&r放在机器的对应槽位，复制该机器的&b频率&r，再手持频率卡右击其他方块来设置。

quest.2CB418AE76610E8F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aWrench&r can be used to rotate network devices or dismantle them when used while crouching.
quest.2CB418AE76610E8F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a扳手&r可以用来旋转网络设备的方向。如果在潜行状态下使用扳手，则可以快速地拆卸网络设备。

quest.2CB418AE76610E8F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Dismantling a network device retains all its current settings, upgrades, and patterns.
quest.2CB418AE76610E8F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 使用扳手拆卸网络设备会完整保留设备的配置、升级和样板。

quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[0].en_us: Hidden deep within netherrack, &dThe Infernal&r mentioned a buried &3Vault&r in the &cNether&r ring that is home to a very dangerous burning soul.
quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d炼狱使者&r提到了一座埋藏在&c下界&r环中的&3宝库&r，它深藏在下界岩中， 栖息着极其危险的炽热之魂。

quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &3Vault&r comes alive once the jukebox is activated with its favorite song.
quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&3宝库&r中使用唱片机播放它最喜欢的歌曲，它便会苏醒过来。

quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: This vault is dangerous. Come prepared for a fight!
quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：这个宝库非常危险。请做好万全的战斗准备！

quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[6].en_us: To unlock the &3Vault&r, you will need to complete the dance once activated by the music disc. You can kill the &cBlazes&r to increase your &cHeat&r, or you can do the dance by following the lightest colored floor tiles.
quest.2D110AB9A38178C5.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 使用唱片开启音乐后，你需要完成舞蹈来解锁此&3宝库&r。你可以击杀场地中的&c烈焰人&r来提升你的&c温度&r，也可以跟随地板里颜色最亮的方块尽情舞蹈。

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eDE &bEnergy Crystals&r can transfer RF power to linked blocks via an energy network with at least one &aI/O Crystal&r and one &2Wireless Crystal&r.
quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e龙之进化&r的&b能量水晶&r能够通过能量网络，将RF传输到连接的方块，至少需要一个&a端口水晶&r和一个&2无线水晶&r。

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[2].en_us: Shift + Right-click your Wireless Crystal to start linking it to other blocks by Right-clicking.
quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 潜行右击无线水晶，再右击其他方块便能设立连接。

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aRelays&r can only connect to other Network components, so they are only used to extend the range of your network.
quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a中继水晶&r只能与能量网络中的其他部件连接，所以它只用于扩展你的网络范围。

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7&oCheck the next page for transfer rates ->
quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &7&o下一页为各等级水晶的传输速率->

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[8].en_us: Each crystal tier can output a different amount of power per connection:
quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 不同等级的水晶在连接时输出的能量值也不同：

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[10].en_us: The &aBasic Tier&r can transfer up to 32,000 RF/t

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[12].en_us: The &dWyvern Tier&r can transfer up to 128,000 RF/t
quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: &d双足飞龙等级&r至多传输128,000 RF/t

quest.2D1B390B363E0F27.quest_desc[14].en_us: The &6Draconic Tier&r can transfer up to 256,000 RF/t

quest.2D20EDB447787183.quest_desc[0].en_us: While you can use &ebelts&r as an automatic sidewalk and &eweighted ejectors&r to fling yourself, there are more sophisticated methods of travel around the different sections of your base using the &6Create&r mod. Namely: &6Hypertubes&r!
quest.2D20EDB447787183.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然你可以使用&e传送带&r作为自动人行道，或者用&e弹射置物台&r把自己弹出去，但要想用&6机械动力&r模组在基地各个区域之间移动，还有更高级的方法。那就是：&6超级管道&r！

quest.2D20EDB447787183.quest_desc[2].en_us: Single or dual direction &bhypertube paths&r can be made by placing down &aHypertube Entrance Blocks&r, then clicking with some &aHyper&mlink&r&atube Blocks&r to extend out to a separate point. You can place down hypertube blocks to set up connection points for longer distances.
quest.2D20EDB447787183.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 先放置&a超级管道入口块&r，然后不断放置&a超级&m链接&r&a管道块&r延伸向另一个点，即可创建单向或双向的&b超级管道路径&r。

quest.2D20EDB447787183.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oAny resemblance to Ficsit technologies current or previous is coincidental.
quest.2D20EDB447787183.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o任何与幸福工厂当前或过往技术的相似之处均纯属巧合。

quest.2D95FEECCF48B088.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aDraconic Capacitors&r are portable batteries that can store and provide power to other items within your inventory.
quest.2D95FEECCF48B088.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a通量容器&r是一种便携式能量电池，可以存储能量，并为你物品栏中的物品充能。

quest.2D95FEECCF48B088.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Capacitors can also go in your Curio Slots.
quest.2D95FEECCF48B088.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：通量容器也能放在你的饰品栏中。

quest.2D95FEECCF48B088.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["At this point you will also gain access to ", { "text": "Wyvern Tools", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "056990503617C147"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Wyvern Tools Quest"}}, ", ", { "text": "Wyvern Weapons", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "0B65713A23351790"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Wyvern Weapons Quest"}}, ", and the ", {"text": "Wyvern Chestpiece", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2DF77DA2ED65FBAC"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Wyvern Chestpiece Quest"}}, "."]
quest.2D95FEECCF48B088.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["此时，你也可以制作", { "text": "双足飞龙工具", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "056990503617C147"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到双足飞龙工具任务"}}, "、", { "text": "双足飞龙武器", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "0B65713A23351790"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到双足飞龙武器任务"}}, "和", {"text": "双足飞龙护胸", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2DF77DA2ED65FBAC"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到双足飞龙护胸任务"}}, "。"]

quest.2DB9D91CFB15C210.quest_desc[0].en_us: Use the Infuser to make the circuitry needed for the &2Machine Frames&r.

quest.2DF77DA2ED65FBAC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWyvern Chestpiece&r is a powered piece of armor that allows for a ton of customization options.
quest.2DF77DA2ED65FBAC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d双足飞龙护胸&r是一件由能量驱动的盔甲，它具有多个自定义选项。

quest.2DF77DA2ED65FBAC.quest_desc[2].en_us: &6Draconic Evolution&r gear has its own interface that can store modular upgrades inside each piece of gear which can be accessed via a keybind (&eTool Modules&r).
quest.2DF77DA2ED65FBAC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6龙之进化&r模组的装备都有一个可以安装升级模块的界面，你可以使用快捷键打开（&e工具模块&r）。

quest.2DF77DA2ED65FBAC.quest_desc[4].en_us: This allows you to upgrade this chestpiece in many different ways using &aUpgrade Modules&r.
quest.2DF77DA2ED65FBAC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以使用&a升级模块&r来个性化地升级此胸甲。

quest.2E53319ED51DC7C8.quest_desc[0].en_us: You wouldn't believe it, but this dungeon spawns in the &eEnd&r ring.
quest.2E53319ED51DC7C8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 说出来你可能不信，此地牢会生成在&e末地&r环中。

quest.2E619195856B3B9F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aOre Generator&r from &bMekanism&r allows you to charge &cLasers&r with power, then direct them into the generator to create ores.
quest.2E619195856B3B9F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了来自&b通用机械&r的&a矿石生成器&r，你只需要给&c激光&r通电并对准生成器就能制造源源不断的矿物。

quest.2E619195856B3B9F.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine becomes available with the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.2E619195856B3B9F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r后方可使用该机器。

quest.2E9F9DD6660745B3.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMechanical Harvester&r from &bCreate&r can be attached to a spinning contraption to auto-harvest any crops it comes in contact with.
quest.2E9F9DD6660745B3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b机械动力&r的&a动力收割机&r可以被安置在旋转结构上，以自动收割它接触的任何作物。

quest.2E9F9DD6660745B3.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be a great option for those who like to use &bCreate&r!
quest.2E9F9DD6660745B3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这对于那些喜欢&b机械动力&r的人来说是一个极好选择！

quest.2EA7D8A9632F845F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.2EA7D8A9632F845F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.2EA7D8A9632F845F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.2EA7D8A9632F845F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.2ECAD5F752E445F1.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["", { "text": "Prometheum", "color": "#FCD205"}, " is an advanced material that can only be produced in an ", { "text": "Atomic Forge", "color":"#FF55FF"}, "." ]
quest.2ECAD5F752E445F1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", { "text": "钷", "color": "#FCD205"}, "是一种高级的材料，只能通过", { "text": "原子锻造器", "color":"#FF55FF"}, "制造。" ]

quest.2ECAD5F752E445F1.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["This powerful resource is essential for crafting ", {"text": "Prometheum Tools", "color":"#FCD205"}, " and the ", {"text": "Ultimate Machine Core", "color":"#FF55FF"}, "."]
quest.2ECAD5F752E445F1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["这是一种用于制造", {"text": "钷工具", "color":"#FCD205"}, "和", {"text": "终极机器核心", "color":"#FF55FF"}, "的强大材料。"]

quest.2EEE782146096F9C.quest_desc[0].en_us: Probably one of the best mods out there for builders, the &eBuilding Gadgets&r mod adds several new gadgets that are a must have to make building better!
quest.2EEE782146096F9C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e建筑小帮手&r大概是最适合建筑师的模组了。这些小帮手能大大提升你的建筑体验！

quest.2F15D918EF183051.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Stoneblock 4&r is a story-driven modpack with plenty of options to play and progress based on your playstyle.
quest.2F15D918EF183051.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6石头世界4&r是一个由故事推动的整合包。依据不同玩家的游玩风格，本整合包可提供多种多样的游玩和发展方式。

quest.2F15D918EF183051.quest_desc[2].en_us: This pack has tons of mods for all types of players. Mods may be gated with the storyline, so make sure to explore the different options for progression!
quest.2F15D918EF183051.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 本整合包为各类玩家提供了海量模组。部分模组会受到剧情发展的限制，所以请多多探索不同的发展路径！

quest.2F15D918EF183051.quest_desc[4].en_us: For those who want a challenge, the final challenge of the pack is completing the &dWorld Engine&r. Do you think you have what it takes?
quest.2F15D918EF183051.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 对于那些渴望挑战的人来说，本整合包的最终挑战是复原&d世界引擎&r。你觉得你有这个能力吗？

quest.2F2DC018DD6A2A23.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aGems&r are the part of most &bJewelry&r that grants effects or attributes.
quest.2F2DC018DD6A2A23.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 大多数&b珠宝饰品&r的效果加成和属性都来自其所镶嵌的&a宝石&r 。

quest.2F2DC018DD6A2A23.quest_desc[2].en_us: Different pieces of &bJewelry&r are affected by &aGems&r in different ways, so be sure to check each piece carefully before crafting.
quest.2F2DC018DD6A2A23.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 同样的&a宝石&r镶嵌在不同的&b饰品&r上会赋予其不相同的属性与增益，因此在合成时还请仔细查看。

quest.2F2DC018DD6A2A23.quest_desc[4].en_us: While most vanilla gems will work, you can also search for &ajewelry_gem&r in JEI for a list.
quest.2F2DC018DD6A2A23.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 即使大多数原版宝石都能奏效，但你仍能在JEI中搜索&a#jewelry_gem&r来查看可用列表。

quest.2F8BB4724991B7C4.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you want to replicate an item based on stored matter, you will first need to learn how to make it using the &aIdentification Chamber&r.
quest.2F8BB4724991B7C4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想要基于储存的物质来复制物品，你首先需要使用&a鉴定室&r以了解如何制造它。

quest.2F8BB4724991B7C4.quest_desc[2].en_us: The chamber will need a &dMemory Chip&r to remember how to make the item. Each chip can save up to 16 items.
quest.2F8BB4724991B7C4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 鉴定室需要&d存储芯片&r去记忆如何制作该物品。每个芯片可以保存16个物品。

quest.2F8BB4724991B7C4.quest_desc[4].en_us: By placing a &aChip Storage&r on top of the &aIdentification Chamber&r, it will automatically push the chips into the storage when full.
quest.2F8BB4724991B7C4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将一个&a芯片存储器&r放置在&a鉴定室&r的顶部，当芯片存满后，它会自动将芯片输入到该存储器中。

quest.2F9F60F308C42FB0.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now with your &bPsimetal CAD&r and probably a few &aAttachments&r, it is time to make another simple, yet complex spell called
quest.2F9F60F308C42FB0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你现在有了&bPsi金属CAD&r，可能还安装了一些&a附件&r。那么是时候制作另一个简单而又复杂的术式了，它叫做

quest.2F9F60F308C42FB0.quest_desc[4].en_us: Just like you've done before to make &bPsimetal&r, simply place this trick in the Grid then copy it into a &eBullet&r.
quest.2F9F60F308C42FB0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 就像你之前做&bPsi金属&r的那样，只需将这个启动式放入网格中，然后复制到&e子弹&r中。

quest.2F9F60F308C42FB0.quest_desc[6].en_us: After doing so, you should be able to convert &bDiamonds&r into &6Psi Gems&r!
quest.2F9F60F308C42FB0.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 这样做之后，你应该能就够将&b钻石&r转化为&6Psi宝石&r了！

quest.2FF6307E57E005C8.quest_subtitle.en_us: requires IE crusher, only used in IE

quest.2FFA4CF8C062AD5E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aImport&r and &aExport Buses&r will allow you to pipe items into and out of your system and any other connected inventories.
quest.2FFA4CF8C062AD5E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以用&a输入总线&r和&a输出总线&r，将AE网络内的物品输出至外部，或者将外部存储的物品输入AE网络。

quest.2FFA4CF8C062AD5E.quest_desc[2].en_us: This, along with interfaces and pattern providers, will allow you to fully automate your entire base!
quest.2FFA4CF8C062AD5E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 有了它们，再配合接口和样板供应器，你就能将整个基地完全自动化！

quest.2FFA4CF8C062AD5E.quest_desc[4].en_us: These devices can be upgraded with &aCards&r to be redstone sensitive, accept NBT specific items or not (Fuzzy), or to increase speed and capacity with &eAcceleration&r and &eCapacity Cards&r.
quest.2FFA4CF8C062AD5E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 上述的设备可以加装各种&a卡&r，比如能让它受红石控制的卡，只允许特定NBT物品输入（或者模糊）的卡，提升速度的&e加速卡&r，以及提升样板存储容量的&e容量卡&r。

quest.304B25BADD64077D.quest_desc[0].en_us: You can increase the overall storage size of a backpack by upgrading it to the next tier!
quest.304B25BADD64077D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 升级你的背包，扩大存储空间！

quest.304B25BADD64077D.quest_desc[2].en_us: From the basic backpack, you can upgrade to either &aCopper&r or &aIron&r. Upgrading to Copper first allows you to save iron, as you only need 4 Iron Ingots to upgrade from Copper.
quest.304B25BADD64077D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以把基础背包升级到&a铜&r或&a铁&r等级。建议你先升级到铜，因为从铜升级只需要4个铁，能节约一点。

quest.304B25BADD64077D.quest_desc[4].en_us: Each tier also allows for more &aUpgrade Slots&r!
quest.304B25BADD64077D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 升级后的背包有更多的&a升级槽位&r！

quest.30689B890F5E7A03.quest_desc[0].en_us: The basics of infusing magic into your items starts with an &dEnchanting Table&r.
quest.30689B890F5E7A03.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d附魔台&r是为物品注入魔法的基础。

quest.30689B890F5E7A03.quest_desc[2].en_us: This table will draw in the latent magical energies of bookshelves around them. Basic bookshelves will only get you so far!
quest.30689B890F5E7A03.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 附魔台会吸收周围书架中潜在的魔法能量。普通书架的作用是有限的！

quest.30689B890F5E7A03.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: You'll need either &aInfused Hellshelves&r or &aInfused Seashelves&r to reach the required &bEterna&r levels for progression!
quest.30689B890F5E7A03.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：你需要&a灌注下界书架&r或&a灌注海洋书架&r才能达到进一步发展所需的&b位阶&r等级！

quest.308D9819EA67D3F0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The generators in this row are considered &aEarly Game Generators&r!
quest.308D9819EA67D3F0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这一排的发电机属于&a游戏前期发电机&r！

quest.308D9819EA67D3F0.quest_desc[2].en_us: These generators are fairly easy to make and can scale well as you create your power network.
quest.308D9819EA67D3F0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些发电机很容易制造，而且可以成规模地使用，很能适应能量网络的构建。

quest.30902357747A64F1.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the &2Yeti&r defeated, you will have access to 2 new vaults to find.
quest.30902357747A64F1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 击败&2雪怪首领&r后，将解锁2个新的宝库供你探寻。

quest.30902357747A64F1.quest_desc[2].en_us: Found within the upper levels of the &bTwilight Forest&r ring, you can run into a vault of the &aSnow Queen's Castle&r.
quest.30902357747A64F1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a冰雪女王宫殿&r宝库可在&b暮色森林&r环的上层找到。

quest.309D995CCCDB3AEE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWyrmwright&r has provided you with a &aChronon Battery&r infused with draconic powers, allowing this tool to access &zThe Fractured Void&r. This location is now also bound to your &2Action Pad&r.
quest.309D995CCCDB3AEE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d飞龙匠人&r已经把注入神龙之力的&a时元电池&r给你了，你可以借助它进入&z破碎虚空&r。传送点位同样已经绑定到你的&2操作板&r中。

quest.30EE07811728D901.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6World Engine&r is almost to full functionality. The final step would be to create the ultimate metal.
quest.30EE07811728D901.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&r的功能即将完全复原。最后一步是制造终极金属。

quest.30EE07811728D901.quest_desc[2].en_us: It's time to create the &zInfinity Ingot&r.
quest.30EE07811728D901.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 是时候制造&z无尽之锭&r了。

quest.30F922372D95D407.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eBonsai Pots&r make tree farming a breeze!
quest.30F922372D95D407.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e盆栽盆&r，让种树变得轻而易举！

quest.30F922372D95D407.quest_desc[2].en_us: Place in a piece of dirt, a sapling, and an axe to create a mini tree farm in a single block.
quest.30F922372D95D407.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 放入一块泥土、一棵树苗和一把斧头，就能在一格空间内打造出一个迷你树场。

quest.30F922372D95D407.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can get some clay by brushing sand.

quest.310F815C02B2CAF8.quest_desc[0].en_us: This quest will set up a waypoint to the &dTwilight's &6Archive&r.

quest.31705AD5BE50E2CB.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aPressurized Reaction Chamber&r is an advanced machine that combines 1 liquid, 1 gas, and 1 item to produce a new item, and sometimes a gas byproduct.
quest.31705AD5BE50E2CB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a加压反应室&r是台高级机器，它可以将一份流体、一份气体和一份物品进行组合，产生一个新物品；也偶尔有气体作为副产物。

quest.31705AD5BE50E2CB.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is used to make &6Ethene&r, &6HDPE Pellets&r, and more!
quest.31705AD5BE50E2CB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该机器可以制作&6乙烯&r、&6高密度聚乙烯丸&r等材料！

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Industrial Turbines&r are vertical multiblock structures that turn &7Steam&r into energy, and optionally back into &bWater&r using &9Saturating Condensers&r. Be careful if a turbine is full of energy, as it will stop or dump steam.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3工业涡轮&r是垂直的多方块结构，它能将&7蒸汽&r转化为能量，并可以使用&9饱和冷凝器&r将其变回&b水&r。注意，如果涡轮储存的能量已满，它将开始储存蒸汽并停止工作。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[2].en_us: The minimum size for this multiblock is a 5x5x5 structure, but adding just one layer to the height (5x6x5) &6quadruples&r its power production capacity. So, this quest will treat these dimensions (5x6x5) as the minimum. The largest size of turbine is a 17x18x17, as turbine widths need to be odd for the spinning blades.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 多方块结构的最小尺寸是5x5x5，但只需在高度上增加一层（5x6x5）发电能力将翻四倍。因此，本任务将以此尺寸（5x6x5）作为最低标准。工业涡轮的最大尺寸为17x18x17，底部的宽度需要是奇数才能使涡轮叶片正常工作。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[4].en_us: While &3Industrial Turbines&r are more complex than &dFission Reactors&r, they can handle plenty of &7Steam&r flow.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 虽然&3工业涡轮&r比&d裂变反应堆&r更复杂，但是它能处理大量的&7蒸汽&r。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[6].en_us: The multiblock needs a frame of &aTurbine Casings&r, with the bottom face filled with &aStructural Glass&r or more &aCasings&r.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 该多方块结构需要由&a涡轮外壳&r构成框架，底面则需要填满&a结构玻璃&r或&a涡轮外壳&r。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[8].en_us: &bTurbine Rotors&r are stacked on the center block at the bottom, with two &3Turbine Blades&r applied to each.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &b涡轮转子&r需要堆叠在底部中心方块上，每个转子都可以安装上两个&3涡轮叶片&r。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[10].en_us: Only &aStructural Glass&r, &3Turbine Valves&r, and &aCasings&r can fill in the faces up to the top of the rotors.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 只有用&a结构玻璃&r、&3涡轮阀门&r和&a涡轮外壳&r填满转子顶面才有用。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[14].en_us: The &3Rotational Complex&r goes above the rotors, and surrounded by &2Pressure Dispersers&r to close off the multiblock's bottom section.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: &3复杂旋钮装置&r放置在转子上方，并在其周围环绕放置&2分压元件&r，这样多方块结构的底部区域就搭建完毕。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[16].en_us: &dElectromagnetic Coils&r go above the complex, at least one must touch it, and all must be connected if using more than one.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 将&d电磁线圈&r紧挨着放置在复杂旋钮装置上方，如果使用多个&d电磁线圈&r，则所有线圈都必须连在一起。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[18].en_us: &3Saturating Condensers&r can then fill in the remaining space depending on how much water needs to be recycled.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: 你可以按照你的水循环需求向涡轮中填充&3饱和冷凝器&r。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[22].en_us: The remaining empty spaces can now be filled with &aGlass&r, &aCasings&r, or &2Turbine Vents&r. The multiblock only needs 1 &2Vent&r to form, but they help with &7Steam&r flow so the more the better.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[22].zh_cn: 剩余的位置可以用&a结构玻璃&r、&a涡轮外壳&r或&2涡轮排气口&r填充。该多方块结构只需1个&2排气口&r就能正常工作，但是，它们有助于&7蒸汽&r流动，所以多多益善。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[24].en_us: Once formed, the multiblock can be interacted with to check its current rates and status. The &eStats Menu&r can list what parts of the build are limiting the &7Steam&r flow and production rates.
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[24].zh_cn: 多方块结构建成后就可以与其交互来查看当前的速率和状态。&e统计菜单&r可列出当前结构中限制&7蒸汽&r的流量与生产效率的地方。

quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[26].en_us: &dFission Reactor &aSteam Ports&r can export into &aTurbine Valves&r, and &2Turbine Vents&r can export &bWater&r into the &dReactor&r input ports, allowing for a cycle with zero pipes!
quest.31C83D9253FFF685.quest_desc[26].zh_cn: &d裂变反应堆&r的&a蒸汽端口&r可以将蒸汽转移到&a涡轮阀门&r中，而&2涡轮排气口&r可以将&b水&r排出到&d反应堆&r的输入端口，从而做到无管道的循环！

quest.31CCB73669788855.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.31CCB73669788855.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.31F2DAA7A3EA9970.quest_desc[0].en_us: These Drawer Generators can be extremely helpful for generating water, lava, and obsidian.
quest.31F2DAA7A3EA9970.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 需要水、熔岩、黑曜石时这些抽屉生成器能提供很大帮助。

quest.31F2DAA7A3EA9970.quest_desc[2].en_us: These items are only available through the shop.
quest.31F2DAA7A3EA9970.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些物品只能通过商店获取。

quest.31FD89FA8B730048.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aSpeed Upgrades&r increase the speed at which a network device operates.
quest.31FD89FA8B730048.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a速度升级&r可提高网络设备的工作速度。

quest.31FD89FA8B730048.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aStack Upgrades&r increase the amount of items the network device can move at once.
quest.31FD89FA8B730048.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a堆叠升级&r可以增加网络设备单次移动的物品数量。

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the &aSimple Reforging Table&r, you can now reforge an item with brand new affixes.
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a简易重铸台&r可以为物品附上全新的词缀。

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Reforging is not limited to items that already have &bAffixes&r, and can be performed with any valid item, any number of times.
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 重铸不仅限于已经有&b词缀&r的物品，任何有效物品都可以进行无限次数的重铸。

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aSimple Reforging Table&r allows you to reforge items up to &9Rare&r rarity. You'll need to upgrade this table if you wish to reforge higher rarity items.
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a简易重铸台&r最高可以重铸&9稀有&r等级的物品。如果你想重铸更高等级的物品，则需要升级重铸台。

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[6].en_us: Reforging Tables have three input slots:

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[8].en_us: - The center slot holds the item you wish to reforge;
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: —中间的槽位放你想要重铸的物品；

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[10].en_us: - The top-left slot holds the rarity materials for the rarity you would like to reforge with;
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: —左上角的槽位放对应稀有度的材料；

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[12].en_us: - The bottom-right slot holds &aSigils of Rebirth&r, which are used as fuel during reforging.
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: —右下角的槽位存放&a新生符石&r，它是重铸过程中的耗材。

quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[14].en_us: There is a base cost of experience, sigils, and materials for reforges of each rarity, which can be doubled or tripled if choosing the other two options.
quest.3208AF90091D1B6B.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 重铸会消耗一定的经验、新生符石和重铸等级对应的材料，如果选择较高级的两个重铸选项，则消耗的数量会增长至两倍甚至三倍。

quest.322B81D896CBDF16.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dParticle Acceleration&r is a very complex subject, but it must be done.
quest.322B81D896CBDF16.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d粒子加速器&r的制作非常复杂，但必须要完成。

quest.322B81D896CBDF16.quest_desc[2].en_us: You will need to first create &ePlutonium Dust&r, and use that to create &dPlutonium Pellets&r.
quest.322B81D896CBDF16.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先，你需要制作&e钚粉&r，并使用它制造&d钚球&r。

quest.322B81D896CBDF16.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["", {"text": "Note", "color": "yellow"},  ": Take a look at the ", {"text": "Particle Acceleration", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2C0C63951FDED180"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Particle Acceleration Quest"}}, " quest if you want to learn more."]
quest.322B81D896CBDF16.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "注意", "color": "yellow"},  "：如果你想了解更多信息，请查阅", {"text": "粒子加速器", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2C0C63951FDED180"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到粒子加速任务"}}, "任务。"]

quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aReactors&r are where generating power starts to get serious!
quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a反应堆&r才是真正的发电大户！

quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[2].en_us: These will burn up &6Uraninite&r using &bCoal&r and &cRedstone&r to generate a ton of power.
quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 反应堆使用&6晶质铀矿&r作为燃料，同时消耗&b煤炭&r与&c红石&r，产生大量能量。

quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eReactors will not accept water in this pack!
quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e在这个整合包中，你无法向反应堆中输入水！

quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[6].en_us: To build one, you'll need &a36 Reactor Blocks&r in your inventory. Right clicking to place it down will automatically build out the 3x4x3 structure if it has room.
quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 要建造反应堆，你的物品栏中需要有&a36个反应堆方块&r，右击放下它时，如果有足够的空间，这个3x4x3的多方块结构就会自动搭建出来。

quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[8].en_us: &aNote&r: &6Uraninite&r is made in the &aEnergizing Orb&r, which requires the &cHeat&r &6World Engine&r upgrade.
quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e注意&r：制造&6晶质铀矿&r需要用到&a充能台&r，而制造&a充能台&r需要&6世界引擎&r&c加热器&r升级。

quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[10].en_us: Water is not a good enough coolant. You can see which coolants you can use by hitting &aU&r on a reactor block in JEI.
quest.323A230EB571C4CA.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 水并不适合用作冷却剂。你可以对JEI中的反应堆方块按&aU&r查看可用的冷却剂。

quest.325826C9B71AD7E1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aBrass&r is an easy and malleable alloy to work with, and can be used to create some basic casings.
quest.325826C9B71AD7E1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a黄铜&r是一种延展性良好、易于加工的合金，可用于制造一些基础的机壳。

quest.325826C9B71AD7E1.quest_desc[2].en_us: You'll need to combine these with &dObsidian Plates&r to create a stronger foundation.
quest.325826C9B71AD7E1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要给这些基础机壳装上&d黑曜石板&r，以提升其强度。

quest.325D35004FF683C2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Quantum Computer&r will be your ultimate autocrafting multiblock, capable of crafting an unlimited amount of crafting tasks at the same time, as long as it has the crafting storage for it.
quest.325D35004FF683C2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6量子计算机&r是最强大的多方块自动合成器，如果存储条件允许的话，它一次可以执行巨量任务！

quest.325D35004FF683C2.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Quantum Computer Core&r is the core of this multiblock, and acts as &b8 Co-Processors&r and &b256M of storage&r all on its own.
quest.325D35004FF683C2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6量子计算机核心&r是这个多方块的重要组件，它相当于&b八核并行处理器&r，并且内置&b256M&r存储缓存。

quest.325D35004FF683C2.quest_desc[4].en_us: It can be used for autocrafting by itself, but using it within the &6Quantum Computer&r multiblock will extend its processing power even further.
quest.325D35004FF683C2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 它本身就可以直接拿来自动合成，但如果搭建成多方块的话处理能力会更强。

quest.32653261B16850B3.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once both the &aSnow Queen&r and the &2Hydra&r have been defeated, there is one final vault that unlocks.
quest.32653261B16850B3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 击败&a冰雪女王&r和&2九头蛇&r后，最终的宝库将会解锁。

quest.32653261B16850B3.quest_desc[2].en_us: The vault of the &dKnight Phantoms&r will be your final puzzle and fight within the &bTwilight Forest&r ring.
quest.32653261B16850B3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你的最后一道难关是&d幻影骑士&r宝库，它同样位于&b暮色森林&r环中。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Psimetal Exosuit &fis a suit of armor allowing you to seamlessly integrate &bSpell-casting &finto your everyday adventuring!
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Psi金属装甲&f是一套可以让你无缝地将&b术式施放&f融入日常冒险的盔甲！

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bThe suits' Spells &fare cast with your &6CAD &fas a focus, so the usual &dCAD limits &fapply.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b套装的术式&f将以你的&6CAD&f进行施放，因此常规的&dCAD限制&f也适用于这种情况。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[4].en_us: Each piece of the &6Psimetal Exosuit &fcan be loaded with &bup to three Spell Bullets &fin a &6CAD Assembler&f, though sadly, some variants don't play well with the suit.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 每一件&6Psi金属装甲&f都可以在&6CAD装配器&f中装载&b最多三个术式子弹&f。只可惜，一些变体与这套装备不太适配。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[6].en_us: &fA suit piece remembers the number of times it's successfully cast a &bSpell&f; this count can be accessed from &e&lSelector: Success Counter&r&f.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &f套装的单件会记住它成功施放&b术式&f的次数，这个计数可以从&e&l选择符：成功次数&r&f中访问。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[10].en_us: &fTo select which &bSpell &fto use for a &6suit piece&r, craft an &d&lExosuit Controller&r&f,
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 制作一个&d&l套装控制器&r&f&f来选择用于&6套装单件&r的&b术式&f，

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[12].en_us: &fTo use the &dController&f, hold it and press the &bPsi master keybind&r &8(Default Key: c)&r.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: &f要使用&d控制器&f，请拿着它并按下&bPsi的主要快捷键&r&8（默认按键：c）&r。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[14].en_us: You can use the &2right and left-mouse buttons to cycle&r through &6suit pieces&r.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 你可以用&2鼠标左右键来切换&r&6套装单件&r。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[16].en_us: Once you've selected the &6suit piece&r you want to configure, choose one of the &bSpell Bullets&f that's displayed the same way you would with your &6CAD&f.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 选好了你想要配置的&6套装单件&r后，再选择一个界面中显示的&b术式子弹&f——与使用&6CAD&f的方式相同。

quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[18].en_us: &fSelecting the empty &cfourth slot&r disables that suit piece completely — &nno Spells will be cast even if its activation criteria are met&r.
quest.32ACE9E47B8A6C87.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: &f选择空白的&c第四个槽位&r将完全禁用该套装单件——&n即使满足其激活条件，也不会施放任何术式&r。

quest.32C6E1FD67863F50.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAlchemist Cauldron&r is an upgrade to your regular old brewing stand.
quest.32C6E1FD67863F50.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d炼金锅&r算是升级了你那普通又老旧的酿造台。

quest.32C6E1FD67863F50.quest_desc[2].en_us: This Cauldron can be used to brew potions, and is also used to break down &bSpell Scrolls&r for a chance to recycle the &bInk&r used to create it.
quest.32C6E1FD67863F50.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它可以用来酿造药水，而且还能分解&b法术卷轴&r，有概率回收撰写该卷轴的&b墨水&r。

quest.32C6E1FD67863F50.quest_desc[4].en_us: This is also the main way to regularly obtain &cBlood Vials&r. Just supply a body inside of the Cauldron!
quest.32C6E1FD67863F50.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 而且这个锅是获取&c猩红精华瓶&r的主要手段，把生物丢进这个锅里头就行！

quest.3334E05101A7297F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aReaction Chamber&r is a very fast machine that can produce many of the common &eAE2&r materials at the cost of large amounts of power.
quest.3334E05101A7297F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a反应仓&r是个处理速度非常快的机器，可以产生大部分&eAE2&r的材料，只不过耗能可能大了一点。

quest.3334E05101A7297F.quest_desc[2].en_us: It's important to make sure you have adequate power buffers as the crafts will not start without enough available power. You can export water or lava into these to process the recipes that require them.
quest.3334E05101A7297F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 请务必确保你有充足的能量缓存，因为如果没有足够的可用能量，合成便无法开始。你也可以将水或熔岩输入其中，以处理那些需要用到对应流体的配方。

quest.3334E05101A7297F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: The &aReaction Chamber&r requires both the &dME Quantum Ring&r and &cAdvanced Machine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrades&r to craft.
quest.3334E05101A7297F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&a反应仓&r需要先用&dME量子环&r和&c高级机器方块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &cNuclear Waste&r can be safely dumped into &aRadioactive Waste Barrels&r to slowly decay, but a &dReactor&r produces a lot of waste from which we can still extract some new useful products.
quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c核废料&r可以存放于&a放射性废料桶&r中安全并地缓慢衰变，但&d反应堆&r会产生大量的废料，可以尝试从中提取出一些有用的新资源。

quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Centrifuging radioactive waste will create &3Plutonium&r, while further radiating it with a &6Neutron Activator&r will produce &9Polonium&r, both processes heavily reducing the amount of radioactive chemicals.
quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 将放射性废料进行离心处理则会产生&3钚&r，使用&6中子活化器&r对其继续辐照则会产生&9钋&r，这两个步骤都能大大减少放射性废料的量。

quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[4].en_us: These chemicals can be further converted into &2Pellets&r, removing any final few chemical impurities that will still ultimately need to decay.
quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这些化学品可以进一步转化成为&2靶丸&r，去除最后残留的少量杂质，这些杂质仍需通过衰变消除。

quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[6].en_us: These &2Pellets&r are used in crafting high tier gear, as well as the ultimate power generator from the mod: the &dFusion Reactor&r.
quest.333E8FBE15AE980D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 这些&2靶丸&r可以用于制作更高一级的机器，包括该模组发电的终极方案：&d聚变反应堆&r。

quest.333F134987890582.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &3Crystal Assembler&r is used to craft many of the complex items from &bExtendedAE&r.
quest.333F134987890582.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3水晶装配室&r可以制作&bExtendedAE&r模组中的高阶物品。

quest.333F134987890582.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can also be used to craft 4 &2Processors&r at once!
quest.333F134987890582.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它可以一次制造四个&2处理器&r！

quest.3371E3F69A27D1E5.quest_desc[0].en_us: There seems to have been an error locating the final &dEchoes&r.
quest.3371E3F69A27D1E5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 定位最终的&d回响&r时似乎出现了错误。

quest.3371E3F69A27D1E5.quest_desc[2].en_us: The system seems to refer to them differently to the ones you've met thus far.
quest.3371E3F69A27D1E5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 系统对他们的称呼似乎与你之前遇到的回响不同。

quest.3371E3F69A27D1E5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 也许&d飞龙匠人&r知道点什么……

quest.3382AC7FEFE0B76E.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["You may get ", {"text": "Ancient Debris", "color": "green"}, " early by going to the ", { "text": "Nether Dungeon", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "21A521011401074F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Nether Dungeon Quest"}}, ", which can spawn in the Deepslate Ring." ]
quest.3382AC7FEFE0B76E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["想早早的获得", {"text": "远古残骸", "color": "green"}, "，你可以前往", { "text": "下界地牢", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "21A521011401074F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往寻找下界地牢的任务"}}, "，这种结构会在深板岩环区域生成。" ]

quest.33A9FF901E2D7725.quest_desc[0].en_us: To make most machines in the mod, we'll need &2Steel Casings&r!
quest.33A9FF901E2D7725.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你需要&2钢制机壳&r才能制作该模组的机器！

quest.33A9FF901E2D7725.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: Most machines have an internal push/pull limit, which can be bypassed by pipes. If you wish to speed up your production, make sure to utilize pipes.
quest.33A9FF901E2D7725.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：多数机器都有内部的输入/输出上限，但是这个上限可以通过管道来无视。因此，如果希望加快生产效率，请善用管道。

quest.33E4C81B762892B2.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eOritech&r is a tech mod centered around customizable multiblock machines that will change the way you use tech mods!
quest.33E4C81B762892B2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eOritech&r是个科技模组，聚焦于可定制的多方块机器，它将为你开启科技模组的全新篇章！

quest.33E4C81B762892B2.quest_desc[2].en_us: From basic ore processing to setting up &dParticle Accelerators&r, this mod has it all.
quest.33E4C81B762892B2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个模组下至基础矿物处理，上至搭建&d粒子加速器&r，它都能实现！

quest.33E4C81B762892B2.quest_desc[4].en_us: To get started, you'll need some &aRaw Nickel&r as this is the main crafting material for the mod.
quest.33E4C81B762892B2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 首先，你需要点&a粗镍&r，这是这个模组的重要合成材料。

quest.33EDFB2DC1BEA7F0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &3Autocrafting Monitor&r allows you to see the status of all active crafting requests.
quest.33EDFB2DC1BEA7F0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3自动合成监控器&r可查看所有正在进行的自动合成任务的状态。

quest.340D7F25B5EB0D33.quest_desc[0].en_us: The next tier of Goo is called &dVoidshimmer Goo&r, and allows you to convert &bDiamond Blocks&r into &bCelestigems&r.
quest.340D7F25B5EB0D33.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 下一阶的凝胶叫&d虚空辉凝胶&r，它可以将&b钻石块&r转化为&d苍穹晶块&r。

quest.340D7F25B5EB0D33.quest_desc[2].en_us: To activate it, you'll need to feed it either Sculk, Chorus Fruit, or an Ender Pearl.
quest.340D7F25B5EB0D33.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要激活它，你可以给它喂末影珍珠、紫颂果、幽匿块或幽匿催发体。

quest.340D7F25B5EB0D33.quest_desc[4].en_us: Just like previous tiers, this Goo can also produce the previous resources, and at a faster rate.
quest.340D7F25B5EB0D33.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这种凝胶可以生产上一阶的物品，且速度更快。

quest.3435641A78B90D97.quest_desc[0].en_us: A &bDisintegration Module&r can be used on its own to break any existing blocks where the field would generate and drop them into the world as items. When a &bCollection Module&r is also present, the &dprojector&r can place those items into an adjacent chest or other inventory.
quest.3435641A78B90D97.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b分解模块&r能够破坏位于力场生成位置的方块并留下掉落物。在同时安装&b收集模块&r的情况下，&d力场投影仪&r可以把掉落物放进相邻的箱子或其他容器内。

quest.3435641A78B90D97.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bStabilization Modules&r will cause a &dprojector&r to take block items from an adjacent chest/inventory and replace the field with said blocks.
quest.3435641A78B90D97.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b固化模块&r让&d力场投影仪&r能够用相邻箱子或容器中的方块构建力场。

quest.3435641A78B90D97.quest_desc[4].en_us: &bSponge Modules&r affect the &lentire&r space enclosed by a mode's field, evaporating all fluids present within.
quest.3435641A78B90D97.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b海绵模块&r可以影响&l整个&r力场笼罩的区域，蒸发其中所有的流体。

quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Roost Feeder&r and &aRoost Collector&r can deliver seeds and pick up items from any nearby Roost up to 30 blocks away. This range can be configured inside the interface by clicking the '+' and '-' buttons.
quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2喂食器（Roost Feeder）&r和&a鸡舍收集器（Roost Collector）&r能向周围至多30格范围的鸡舍传输种子并收集其产物。你可以在它们的界面中点击‘+’和‘-’按钮配置范围。

quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &2Roost Feeder&r allows you to filter which seeds can be fed to which roost by dragging a seed item from your inventory or JEI to the right-side filter slot of each roost within the &2Feeder's&r interface.
quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &2喂食器（Roost Feeder）&r界面右侧是每个鸡舍的过滤槽，你可以将物品栏或JEI中的鸡饲料拖拽过去，以单独设置鸡饲料的去向。

quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[4].en_us: For either block to function, you must also select a Roost to collect resources from by clicking the `[ ]` on the left to show `[x]`.
quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 而收集器则需你在界面中逐个选中要收集产物的鸡舍，使其名称前面的`[ ]`变为`[x]`。

quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&f: Renaming your &2Roosts&r will display their name on these interfaces.
quest.34A2BA2C754CE27A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&f：被重命名的&2鸡舍&r会在界面中显示其名字。

quest.34C8824842867F5D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zMighty Ender Chicken&r has a home on both the North and South parts of the map, specifically in &eEnd&r ring. Rumor has it, the chicken has an impenetrable shield. Perhaps a &bChicken Stick&r might help with that...
quest.34C8824842867F5D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z威猛末影鸡&r的栖息地分布在地图的北部与南部区域，具体位于&e末地&r环中。传闻中，这只鸡拥有一面无法穿透的护盾。也许一根&b鸡调试棒&r会有帮助……

quest.34D191F76AA69707.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eFlux Networks&r is the ultimate wireless power solution!
quest.34D191F76AA69707.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e通量网络&r是无线能源方面最强的模组！

quest.34D191F76AA69707.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aFlux Dust&r is the main crafting material for crafting all blocks within the mod.
quest.34D191F76AA69707.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a通量粉尘&r是本模组中方块的主要合成材料。

quest.34D191F76AA69707.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: &eFlux Dust&r requires the &aMachine Block&r and &cEnder Cell&r &6World Engine Upgrades&r to craft.
quest.34D191F76AA69707.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：制作&e通量粉尘&r需要用到&a机器方块&r和&c末影单元&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[0].en_us: This &aNovice Spellbook&r allows you to cast &aTier 1 Spells&r! It also comes with some basic spell knowledge (called &bGlyphs&r) already learned to help you craft your first spell.
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以用&a初学者法术书&r施放&a一阶法术&r！之后你需要先学习基础法术知识（&b魔符&r）再构建法术！

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make new spells, you'll need to create &bGlyphs&r using the &2Scribe's Table&r.
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要使用&2抄写台&r来创造&b魔符&r，构建新的法术。

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once crafted, you can place this down to research and craft new &bGlyphs&r, which are the base for spell crafting, as they teach you new parts for your &dSpells&r.
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 把这个桌子合成出来，然后把它放下来，用它研究并合成新的&b魔符&r。魔符是合成法术的基础物资，它可以让你学到更多的&d法术&r。

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[6].en_us: Let's learn how to craft a &bGlyph&r!
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 那么就来学学怎么合成&b魔符&r吧！

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[8].en_us: &bGlyphs&r are also tiered. With a &aNovice Spell Book&r, you'll only be able to cast &aTier 1 Glyphs&r. To cast higher tier spells, you'll need to upgrade your Spell Book.
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 注意，&b魔符&r也是分等级的。如果你手头的法术书是&a初学者法术书&r的话，你就只能用它施放&a一阶魔符&r。要想施放高阶魔符，就需要升级你的法术书。

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[10].en_us: To craft a &bGlyph&r, you'll need to right click on the Scribe's Table with your Spell Book in hand. This will open up the &bGlyph&r menu!
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 想要合成&b魔符&r？首先手持法术书右击抄写台，这样就能打开&b魔符&r面板！

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[13].en_us: This will show you every &bGlyph&r you can make, including those you have already learned. On the right side, you can filter them by tier, or search for a specific one.
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[13].zh_cn: 界面中会显示你目前可以制造的全部&b魔符&r，其中也包括你已经学到过的那些。你可以在右边以等级来筛选搜索结果，或者直接搜索特定&b魔符&r。

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[15].en_us: For our first &bGlyph&r, let's make &aAmplify&r! Search for it, then click it to see what items you need at the bottom, then click the "Select" button.
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[15].zh_cn: 如果硬要说先做哪一个&b魔符&r的话，就做&a魔符：强化&r吧！首先搜索它，然后点击其图标查看你所需要的材料，最后点“选择”即可。

quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[17].en_us: Now you can close out of the menu and right click the table with the required items, and watch the magic happen!
quest.34EC72BBCD9F197F.quest_desc[17].zh_cn: 然后退出界面，手持所需物品右击你的抄写台，见证魔法的时刻！

quest.3506242698EDF435.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aStack Upgrades&r multiply the stack size of each slot in a backpack. These are super useful for storing tons of the same types of items!
quest.3506242698EDF435.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a堆叠升级&r能使单个槽位的物品堆叠数量翻倍。存储大量同类物品时非常有用！
