quest.3506242698EDF435.quest_desc[2].en_us: When combined with other upgrades like &aTank&r or &aBattery&r upgrades, these also increase the overall storage limit of those upgrades as well.
quest.3506242698EDF435.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你的背包同时还加装了&a储罐升级&r、&a电池升级&r的话，堆叠升级也能增加它们的存储容量。

quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[0].en_us: To push your &6Eterna&r even higher, you will need to create and infuse &3Deepshelves&r.
quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了进一步提高&6位阶&r，你需要制作并灌注&3深暗书架&r。

quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[2].en_us: These shelves can push your &6Eterna&r to a max of &a75&r.
quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它们可以将你的&6位阶&r增加到至多&a75&r。

quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also use a &zDeepshelf of Arcane Treasures&r to allow your enchanting table to enchant &zTreasure Enchantments&r.
quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还可以放一个&z奥术宝藏深暗书架&r，这样你的附魔台就能附魔出&z宝藏魔咒&r了。

quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: Deepshelves can be used for a &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.353F6C94B5D5FF0B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：深暗书架也可用于&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.355C3ACB16CC2DE9.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Quantum Computer Accelerators&r add &b8 Co-Processors&r each to the multiblock.
quest.355C3ACB16CC2DE9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 每个&6量子计算机加速器&r在多方块结构内相当于一个&b八核并行处理器&r。

quest.355C3ACB16CC2DE9.quest_desc[2].en_us: It's nice to have many of these inside of the multiblock structure.
quest.355C3ACB16CC2DE9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在多方块结构里多装一些会是一个不错的选择。

quest.35791C02AC048594.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aChronon Cell&r allows you to store the power of time, called &bChronon&r.
quest.35791C02AC048594.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a时元电芯&r可储存名为&b时元&r的时间之力。

quest.35791C02AC048594.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &2Chronon Generator&r will slowly generate &bChronon&r for the &aCell&r, which enables teleportation to your base using /home.
quest.35791C02AC048594.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &2时元发生器&r会缓缓为&a电芯&r生成&b时元&r，如此一来，你就能用/home指令传送回你的基地了。

quest.35791C02AC048594.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also use the &aCell&r to teleport to the &6World Engine&r by Sneak + Right-clicking with it in your hand.
quest.35791C02AC048594.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 手持&a电芯&r潜行右击还可以将你传送到&6世界引擎&r处。

quest.35E8F57E93106BFE.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aPatterns&r are used to store crafting or processing recipes. This can be done inside the &3Pattern Grid&r, which can hold up to a stack of &aPatterns&r at once.
quest.35E8F57E93106BFE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a样板&r能存储合成或处理等配方。可以在&3样板终端&r内进行编码，该终端一次最多可容纳一组&a样板&r。

quest.35E8F57E93106BFE.quest_desc[2].en_us: To set up a recipe, first select the mode from the right-most interface. Then, search up the item you wish to craft in JEI and click the '+' icon next to its recipe. This will automatically set up the &aPattern&r, but you can still do it manually if you wish.
quest.35E8F57E93106BFE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 设置配方：先在界面最右侧选择模式，然后在JEI中搜索你想要合成的物品，点击其配方旁边的“+”图标，即可自动设置&a样板&r的配方。不过你也可以手动设置，如果你愿意的话。

quest.35E8F57E93106BFE.quest_desc[4].en_us: Resources capable of being autocrafted will have a yellow backdrop when viewed on a grid.
quest.35E8F57E93106BFE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在终端界面中，支持自动合成的东西会带有一个黄色的背景。

quest.36DD75256D280C4A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Machines can be upgraded by installing &aAddons&r.
quest.36DD75256D280C4A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 该模组的机器可以加装&a插件&r来升级！

quest.36DD75256D280C4A.quest_desc[2].en_us: There are different types of addons, most just increasing the speed or efficiency of the machine.
quest.36DD75256D280C4A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 插件有许多种类，大体上是提高机器的工作速度与效率。

quest.36DD75256D280C4A.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aRange Upgrades&r will increase the effective range of certain machines, like &aMob Crushers&r.
quest.36DD75256D280C4A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a范围升级&r能增加个别机器的工作范围，例如&a生物粉碎机&r。

quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[0].en_us: The final tier of Goo is called &5Shadowpulse Goo&r.
quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &5暗影脉凝胶&r是最高阶的凝胶。

quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[2].en_us: This Goo can convert &6Netherite Blocks&r into &5Eclipse Alloy Ore&r.
quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种凝胶可以将&6下界合金块&r转化为&5蚀空合金矿簇&r。

quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[4].en_us: To activate it, you'll need to feed it either Ender Pearls or Chorus Fruit.
quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 要激活它，你可以给它喂末影珍珠、紫颂果、幽匿块或幽匿催发体。

quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[6].en_us: Just like previous tiers, this can also convert all previous ingot blocks at an increased rate.
quest.36E0D875AA8E2F66.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 与先前的凝胶一样，它转化较低级别金属的速度更快。

quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSuperheating Element&r is perfect for the core of a heater.
quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a过热元件&r非常适合用作加热器的核心。

quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[2].en_us: While it may seem like you have 2 options for the type of heater you choose to make, the &cFuelwood Heater&r can only produce heat via coal or wood, rendering it insufficient to heat your &6World Engine&r.
quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作加热器时，虽然看上去有两种选择，但&c固体燃料加热器&r只能通过煤或木材产热，这无法为你的&6世界引擎&r提供充足的热量。

quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &cResistive Heater&r, however, specializes in converting power directly into heat. It allows for fine-tuning how much power is converted, and generates significantly more heat.
quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 而&c电阻型加热器&r能直接将电能转化为热能，还能精细调节转化的功率，产生的热量也多得多。

quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: 2k FE/t is ideal for hitting around 350°C.
quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：达到约350°C的理想能量功率为2K FE/t。

quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[8].en_us: To power the heater, you can either bring some generators or energy cubes down, or use &dSpectre Coils&r for wireless power transfer.
quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 要为加热装置供能，你可以放置一些发电机或能量立方，也可以使用&d通灵线圈（Spectre Coil）&r实现无线能量传输。

quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[10].en_us: Most crafts will require around &c350°C&r to work, and you will need to maintain that temperature during the craft for it to complete.
quest.370B05FC62884456.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 大多数配方需要约&c350°C&r，并且合成时需要维持该温度才能完成制作。

quest.37104662F0BDDE66.quest_desc[0].en_us: To get started with &eDigital Storage&r with either &6Applied Energistics 2&r or &6Refined Storage 2&r, you'll want to first craft a &aFlawless Budding Certus Block&r using the &6World Engine&r. This requires the &aMachine Block&r upgrade.
quest.37104662F0BDDE66.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如要使用&6应用能源2&r或&6精致存储2&r搭建&e数字化存储&r，你需要先使用&6世界引擎&r制作一个&a无暇的赛特斯石英母岩&r，其配方需要&a机器方块&r升级。

quest.37104662F0BDDE66.quest_desc[2].en_us: &o&7Yes, the reward is for decoration. This is not a bug.
quest.37104662F0BDDE66.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &o&7没错，这个奖励就是个装饰品，不是bug。

quest.371D1FEFBD49CCFF.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bCelestigem&r is the next tier for weapons from &6Just Dire Things&r.
quest.371D1FEFBD49CCFF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b苍穹晶&r武器是&6Just Dire Things&r模组下一等阶的武器。

quest.371D1FEFBD49CCFF.quest_desc[2].en_us: Instead of using durability, these weapons use &cenergy&r instead, and can have even more upgrades that can be installed.
quest.371D1FEFBD49CCFF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 苍穹晶武器不再消耗耐久，而是使用&c能量&r，并且可以加装更多的升级。

quest.371D1FEFBD49CCFF.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be made once you've made a trip out to the &dAncient City&r and made &dVoidshimmer Goo&r.
quest.371D1FEFBD49CCFF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 等你探索过&d远古城市&r，制作出&d虚空辉凝胶&r之后，就可以制作苍穹晶了。

quest.37499343396BC372.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.37499343396BC372.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.376227602F2E3DA4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &zTime Crystals&r are advanced materials that bend reality itself when inside your inventory.
quest.376227602F2E3DA4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z时间水晶&r是一种高级材料，处于物品栏时将扭曲现实本身。

quest.376227602F2E3DA4.quest_desc[2].en_us: These crystals are made in the &6World Engine&r, which requires the &dResonant Void&r and &cAdvanced Machine Block&r upgrades.
quest.376227602F2E3DA4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些水晶由&6世界引擎&r制造，需要&d共振虚空&r与&c高级机器方块&r升级后才能生产。

quest.37F99696A47264FD.quest_desc[0].en_us: This chapter is all about teaching you some of the different ways to craft, enhance, and enchant any gear you might need on your adventures!
quest.37F99696A47264FD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本章节旨在教你一些打造、强化、附魔装备的方式，以备探险使用！

quest.38124EBC1E14AB38.quest_desc[0].en_us: This tormented soul holds the secret to another &6World Engine&r upgrade.
quest.38124EBC1E14AB38.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个饱受折磨的灵魂掌握着另一个&6世界引擎&r升级的秘密。

quest.38124EBC1E14AB38.quest_desc[2].en_us: Slay the guardian of the &3Vault&r to acquire Ignitium ingots.
quest.38124EBC1E14AB38.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 击杀&3宝库&r的守卫者以获得腾炎锭。

quest.3819423319D1A414.quest_desc[0].en_us: With a few more &6World Engine&r upgrades unlocked, the &dEcho of Guidance&r will have more for you to discover.
quest.3819423319D1A414.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多的&6世界引擎&r升级被解锁，&d指引者的回响&r将为你带来更多可探索的内容。

quest.3819423319D1A414.quest_desc[2].en_us: After your chat, more &6Archives&r will be unlocked!
quest.3819423319D1A414.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 完成对话后，即可解锁更多&6档案&r！

quest.381B55C984A8BD33.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Scale Modules&r add one block along the specified axis, which is mirrored in some &aModes&r and directional in others.
quest.381B55C984A8BD33.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 每个&2尺寸模块&r都会在指定方向轴上增加一格长度，在某些&a模式&r下会增加两端长度，也可能只增加一端。

quest.381B55C984A8BD33.quest_desc[2].en_us: &2Translation Modules&r shift the origin of the projection by one block per module in the specified direction relative to the &dProjector&r, starting at itself.
quest.381B55C984A8BD33.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个&2移动模块&r都会把&d力场投影仪&r的投影原点以自身为中心向指定方向偏移一格。

quest.381B55C984A8BD33.quest_desc[4].en_us: &2Rotation Modules&r will rotate the projected area by 2° per module in the specified direction.
quest.381B55C984A8BD33.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 每个&2旋转模块&r都会将投影区域朝指定方向旋转2°。

quest.383DAD591823C746.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.383DAD591823C746.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.383DAD591823C746.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.383DAD591823C746.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dTesseract&r is a block that can wirelessly transfer energy, items, and fluids.
quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d超立方体&r是一个可以无线传输物品、流体和能量的方块。

quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can all be done using networks that can be configured to be private or public.
quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 只需创建一个网络，即可进行无线传输，还能将网络设置为私有或公共。

quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[4].en_us: It also has a new crafting recipe just like the old days!
quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 该模组还为超立方体新增了经典的老合成配方！

quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft the frame, it requires the &aMachine Block&r and &cEnder Cell&r &3World Engine Upgrades&r.
quest.387FB75C400B5D34.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成超立方体框架，需要先用&a机器方块&r和&c末影单元&r进行&3世界引擎升级&r。

quest.38869642A2E6F8B6.quest_desc[0].en_us: When it comes to logistics, &eModular Routers&r can do it all. This mod comes with tons of useful features, like &aAuto-Clicking&r, &aBlock Breaking&r, and more!
quest.38869642A2E6F8B6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 说到物流，&e模块化路由器&r可以解决你的一切问题，这个模组可以实现&a自动点击&r，&a自动方块破坏&r，还有很多别的功能！

quest.38869642A2E6F8B6.quest_desc[2].en_us: All of these features are done within the main block, the &dModular Router&r. To give it a function, it needs a &aModule&r to tell it what to do. These Modules can be configured and upgraded using &aAugments&r.
quest.38869642A2E6F8B6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 上述所有不可思议的功能都是靠主方块完成的，即&d模块化路由器&r。你首先要给路由器安装&a模块&r来“告诉”路由器应该干什么，这样它才能正常运转。模块可以用&a拓展&r来改装和升级。

quest.38869642A2E6F8B6.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: &aModular Routers&r require the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.38869642A2E6F8B6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&a模块化路由器&r需要&b力场子灌注块&r&6世界引擎升级&r才能制作。

quest.38E2176886386133.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAlloy Kiln&r is an early-game multiblock used to make alloys like: constantan, invar, electrum, and bronze.
quest.38E2176886386133.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a合金窑&r是一个游戏早期的多方块结构，能够制作合金，如：康铜、殷钢、琥珀金和青铜。

quest.38E2176886386133.quest_desc[2].en_us: To build this, build a 2x2x2 cube out of &aKiln Bricks&r, then right click on a face with the &aEngineer's Hammer&r.
quest.38E2176886386133.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要建造合金窑，你需要用&a窑砖&r搭建一个2x2x2大小的正方体，然后用&a工程师锤&r右击以建成合金窑！

quest.3900E67C8B833980.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aArtisan Scrolls&r can be found as loot or from buying them from &zShops&r.
quest.3900E67C8B833980.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a工匠卷轴&r可以在战利品中获得，也可以在&z商店&r中购买。

quest.3900E67C8B833980.quest_desc[2].en_us: To learn a &bJewel&r blueprint simply right-click with an &aArtisan Scroll&r in hand.
quest.3900E67C8B833980.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持&a工匠卷轴&r时，右击即可学习对应的&b珠宝饰品&r的制作方法。

quest.3917A0EC517F70E6.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.3917A0EC517F70E6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.3917A0EC517F70E6.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.3917A0EC517F70E6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.39751E377C0F22EE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aReplication Terminal&r allows you to request items to be replicated.
quest.39751E377C0F22EE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a复制终端&r允许你请求被复制的物品。

quest.39751E377C0F22EE.quest_desc[2].en_us: The Terminal will show you the items you have stored on &dMemory Chips&r within your network, as well as the total amount of matter stored in &aMatter Tanks&r on the right side.
quest.39751E377C0F22EE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 终端将会显示你在网络中&d存储芯片&r储存的物品，同时也会在右侧显示&a物质储罐&r中储存的物质总量。

quest.39758AAD01EEB3C8.quest_desc[0].en_us: Depending on the route you take for shelves, you might need some extra &cQuanta&r to hit infusion levels.
quest.39758AAD01EEB3C8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在布置书架的过程中，为了达成灌注的要求，你可能会想增加一点&c量子化&r。

quest.39758AAD01EEB3C8.quest_desc[2].en_us: &cSkulls&r work great and provide a &a+5&r boost to &cQuanta&r!
quest.39758AAD01EEB3C8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以放点&c头颅&r，每个&c头颅&r可提供&a5点&r的&c量子化&r！

quest.39A6CE8A1D5B2D8F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSimple Coal Generator&r from &6Just Dire Things&r can burn regular burnable items like coal or wood, but it can also burn the different tiers of coal from the mod itself, like &aPrimal Coal&r!
quest.39A6CE8A1D5B2D8F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 来自&6Just Dire Things&r模组的&a初级煤炭发电器&r可以燃烧可燃物品发电，例如煤炭或者木头等等。除了这些常见的物品，它还可以用该模组加入的不同等级的煤炭来发电，比如&a原初煤炭&r！

quest.39A6CE8A1D5B2D8F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Using these special coals will produce more power, with the higher tiers producing up to 960 RF/t.
quest.39A6CE8A1D5B2D8F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些特殊的煤炭产生的电能更多，最高可达960RF/t。

quest.39A6CE8A1D5B2D8F.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aPocket Generator&r will do the same thing, but in your inventory to charge your items.
quest.39A6CE8A1D5B2D8F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a便携发电器&r的工作方式与之相同，只不过它是放在你物品栏中，给你的物品充电的。

quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[0].en_us: While equipping yourself with all sorts of &bcurios and baubles&r is a common enough practice, certain choices are shunned. &aBrooches&r allow a few tweaks to this, exchanging one option for another. Among these options are the allowance for new &bRune slots&r.
quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 往自己身上装各种各样的&b饰品和其他小玩意&r是非常常见的做法，然而你不得不对一部分选择进行取舍。&a胸针&r能够改变这种情况，它们使玩家能够牺牲一部分饰品栏从而换来其他种类的饰品栏，这其中就包括&b符文栏&r。

quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Runes are made by inserting the base material into a &aRunic Workbench&r, then applying the amount and type of spirits required.
quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 只要将基础材料放进&a符文工作台&r，然后加入特定种类的数量的精魂，你就能造出符文。

quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[4].en_us: Runes provide a wide variety of potent effects: some applying a personal form of &bSpirit Rites&r as performed by &eTotems&r, others providing noticeable stat buffs, and still more that have their own unique traits.
quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 符文有着非常多的强力效果：有些能够对佩戴者单独作用，效果等同于由&e图腾&r展开的&b精魂仪式&r；有些能够带来非常显著的属性效果提升；还有些有着自己独特的能力。

quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[5].en_us: As typical, consult your &eEncyclopedia&r for more information.
quest.39ED88D2EF2F617B.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: 和之前一样，你可以查阅&e奥术全典&r来获悉更多信息。

quest.39F10D110D7E77B7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &cNetherite&r tools are great to use once you have your hands on  some &aAncient Debris&r and a &cNetherite Smithing Template&r.
quest.39F10D110D7E77B7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&a远古残骸&r和&c下界合金锻造模板&r之后，制造&c下界合金&r工具会是个不错的选择。

quest.39F10D110D7E77B7.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["You may get ", {"text": "Ancient Debris", "color": "green"}, " early by going to the ", { "text": "Nether Dungeon", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "21A521011401074F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Nether Dungeon Quest"}}, ", which can spawn in the Deepslate Ring."]
quest.39F10D110D7E77B7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["想早早的获得", {"text": "远古残骸", "color": "green"}, "，你可以前往", { "text": "下界地牢", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "21A521011401074F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往寻找下界地牢的任务"}}, "，这种结构会在深板岩环区域生成。"]

quest.39F6026AB205841A.quest_desc[0].en_us: While the pack contains &eFTB Ultimine&r, it does not work on &aStone&r!
quest.39F6026AB205841A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然该整合包包含&eFTB Ultimine&r模组，但它不能连锁挖掘&a石头&r！

quest.39F6026AB205841A.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["Ultimine can be toggled with the keybind ", { "keybind": "key.ftbultimine", "color": "green" }, "."]

quest.39F6026AB205841A.quest_desc[4].en_us: It also requires a tool in your hand to work.
quest.39F6026AB205841A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 同时需要手持工具才能生效。

quest.3A1424B69AD511BD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eActually Additions &aDrill&r consumes power to function and can be upgraded with several different augments.
quest.3A1424B69AD511BD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e实用拓展&r的&a手钻&r消耗能量来工作，且拥有许多可以增强其功能的升级组件。

quest.3A1424B69AD511BD.quest_desc[2].en_us: A fully-charged drill is available from the &dMachinist's&r shop.
quest.3A1424B69AD511BD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 可以在&d机械师的&r商店中买到充满电的手钻。

quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Workstation&r serves as an in-world &eTempad&r device.
quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6工作站&r可以看作是可以放置在世界中使用的&e时域仪&r。

quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[2].en_us: You must dock a &6Tempad&r on it for it to function, granting the Workstation its functionalities as well as the &dTime Twister's&r timeline ability if installed.
quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要使用它，你需要把&6时域仪&r放在它上面。如果安装了&d时间扭曲器&r功能，那在工作站中也一样可用。

quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[4].en_us: It comes with more options and more configurations such as keeping the timedoor open longer, as well the ability to install optional upgrades on your tempad.
quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 它提供更多的选项和配置，例如可以延长时门的持续时间，还可以在时门上安装可选的升级。

quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &dPlayer Teleport Upgrade&r allows your &6Tempad&r to discover players equipped with an active &aLocation Broadcaster&r or &dScreening Device&r.
quest.3A43CCB33A024711.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &d玩家传送升级&r能够让你的&6时域仪&r探测到带有激活的&a定位广播器&r或&d筛选装置&r的玩家。

quest.3A53BB7A6B708966.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you hit &a45&r &6Eterna&r, you will be able to infuse shelves!
quest.3A53BB7A6B708966.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 当你的&6位阶&r达到&a45&r之后，你就可以制作灌注书架了！

quest.3A53BB7A6B708966.quest_desc[2].en_us: Making &cInfused Hellshelves&r requires at least &a30&r &cQuanta&r, while &bInfused Seashelves&r require &a15&r &cQuanta&r and &a10&r &dArcana&r.
quest.3A53BB7A6B708966.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作&c灌注下界书架&r需要&c量子化&r达到&a30&r及以上，制作&b灌注海洋书架&r需要至少&a15&r的&c量子化&r和&a10&r的&d阿卡那&r。

quest.3A53BB7A6B708966.quest_desc[4].en_us: Using &dInfused Bookshelves&r, you'll be able to hit a max of &a60&r &6Eterna&r for the next upgrade.
quest.3A53BB7A6B708966.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 有了&d灌注书架&r，你就可以将附魔台的&6位阶&r提升到&a60&r，然后进行下一次升级。

quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dQuantum Network Bridge&r allows you to connect machines and storages far from your base to your AE2 network, allowing you to automate from afar.
quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d量子桥&r可以将远离基地的机器和存储连接到你的AE网络，从而实现远程自动化。

quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is how you can automate the &6World Engine&r!
quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这提供了自动化&6世界引擎&r的方法！

quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[4].en_us: To make this, you'll need to build 2 identical multiblock structures: one connected to your main network, and one connected to the new place you want to build in.
quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你必须搭建两个重要的多方块结构才能构建量子桥：一个连通主网，另一个连接到想延伸网络的地方。

quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[6].en_us: Each multiblock will consist of &b8 Quantum Rings&r with an &6ME Quantum Link Chamber&r in the center. To connect the two, you'll need to craft and use a &dQuantum Entangled Singularity&r on each of the Link Chambers to connect them.
quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 每个多方块结构都必须有&b八个量子环&r，中间需要摆放&6ME量子链接仓&r。你需要制造出&d量子纠缠奇点&r并安装在链接仓，这样才能把两个环连接起来。

quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[8].en_us: The Quantum Ring only allows 128 channels total from it, no matter which face you connect to. You can also only connect to the 4 Quantum Rings that are adjacent to the Link Chamber, as the corners do not connect.
quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 无论你连接到哪个面，每个量子环都只能提供总计128个频道。此外，你只能连接到与链接仓相邻的4个量子环，因为角落位置的方块无法与之相连。

quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[10].en_us: &eNote&r: Both sides will need to be chunk loaded to work.
quest.3A59D1773EBD3B8A.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &e注意&r：两端的都需要被加载才能正常工作。

quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[0].en_us: To get to the next upgrade, you want to get your &6Eterna&r to &a45&r. This can be done with upgraded shelves.
quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在进行下一次升级之前，你需要先把&6位阶&r提升到&a45&r。用这些升级版书架就行。

quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &cHellshelf&r is easier to craft, and focuses on boosting &cQuanta&r.
quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &c下界书架&r造起来比较简单，主要用于提升&c量子化&r。

quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[4].en_us: &bSeashelves&r will require some fishing to get started, but instead builds up your &dArcana&r values instead.
quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b海洋书架&r则需要一些渔获作为材料，但是能够提升&d阿卡那&r。

quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[6].en_us: &dSpirit Attuned Crystals&r from &6Occultism&r also work great for hitting the 45 mark.
quest.3A7774F5F0FD174E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &6神秘学&r模组的&d魔灵同调水晶&r也能够帮你提升位阶。

quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Infusing a spirit into anything is not usually... &owelcomed&r, one could say.
quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这么说吧，把精魂灌注到任何东西里都不太……&o受欢迎&r。

quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["To start this process, you'll need a ", {"text": "Spirit Altar", "color": "green"}, " to commune with spirits. You can find ", {"text": "Runewood Trees", "color": "dark_green"}, " within the ", { "text": "Arcane Grove", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "066B47D2AB72355C" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Arcane Grove Quest"}}, " just be ready to put up a fight."]
quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["要开启这个仪式，你需要使用", {"text": "精魂祭坛", "color": "green"}, "与精魂交流。你可以在", { "text": "奥术林地", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "066B47D2AB72355C" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往奥术林地任务"}}, "中找到", {"text": "符文树", "color": "dark_green"}, "，准备好投身战斗吧。"]

quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once you've harvested some of the &2Runewood&r, you will need a single piece of &dRefined Soulstone&r to create the altar.
quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 有了&2符文木&r，你还需要一块&d精制灵魂石&r来建造祭坛。

quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[6].en_us: ["This requires either throwing raw ores into the ", {"text": "Weeping Well", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "754ADB22C6B8041F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Weeping Well Quest"}}, " structure, or ", {"text": "The Magician", "color": "light_purple"}, " can help you out for the right price."]
quest.3AB006907366227A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: ["要获取灵魂石，要么将任意粗矿扔进", {"text": "哭泣之井", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "754ADB22C6B8041F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往哭泣之井任务"}}, "，要么去找", {"text": "魔法师", "color": "light_purple"}, "，只要价钱合适，他就能帮你解决这个问题。"]

quest.3AC24F0B92156F55.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAssembler&r features a 2x2 crafting grid and will automatically assemble items as long as it has energy, items in the input slots, and space for the finished product in the output slot.
quest.3AC24F0B92156F55.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d装配器&r有一个2x2合成栏，一有能量就会自动合成物品。将原材料放入输入槽，并且输出槽位没有满，则会把合成的物品自动放入输出槽。

quest.3AC24F0B92156F55.quest_desc[2].en_us: Some machine components can be crafted without an &aAssembler&r, but doing so consumes more resources.
quest.3AC24F0B92156F55.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 有些机器组件虽然可以不用&a装配器&r制作，但代价就是会消耗更多资源。

quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eSophisticated Storage&r allows you to create and upgrade your chests, barrels, and more!
quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e精妙存储&r可以给你的箱子、桶之类的存储方块升级！

quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[2].en_us: These &aStorages&r can hold even more items, hold fluids, or even automate certain tasks like smelting down ores.
quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些&a存储方块&r可以装下更多物品，储存更多流体，甚至还可以自动进行熔炼等任务。

quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[4].en_us: To start out, you can convert a regular chest or barrel into a &aSophisticated Chest&r or &aSophisticated Barrel&r by using &aBasic To Copper Tier Upgrade&r on it.
quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 想入门，你得先对原版箱子和桶用&a基础->铜升级&r转化为&a精妙存储&r的箱子或者&a精妙存储&r的桶才行。

quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: The &aBasic To Copper Tier Upgrade&r can only be acquired by purchasing it from the shop. Storage Tier Upgrades past copper can be crafted.
quest.3ACF3359B3B59A05.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&a基础->铜升级&r只能从商店购买。铜之后的存储升级就可以制作了。

quest.3B2B26B1AD947CC5.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aLarge Energy Storage&r holds a base value of 20M RF which can be upgraded with &bAddons&r.
quest.3B2B26B1AD947CC5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a大型能量存储&r的基础容量为20M RF，可用&b插件&r升级。

quest.3B2B26B1AD947CC5.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aLarge Energy Storage&r accepts energy from all green ports but can only output through the single red port. A redstone signal will disable all energy output.
quest.3B2B26B1AD947CC5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a大型能量存储&r的任意绿色端口都可以输入能量，但仅有一个红色端口可以输出能量。有红石信号时，它不会输出能量。

quest.3B33C4D5A2D400D4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bSky Stone&r can be obtained from the &dFluix Researcher&r villager through trading, from a friendly &eWandering Trader&r, or by smelting some &bsky stone dust&r.
quest.3B33C4D5A2D400D4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b陨石&r可以通过与&d福鲁伊克斯研究员&r村民交易、从友好的&e流浪商人&r处购买，或是通过烧炼&b陨石粉&r来获得。

quest.3B33C4D5A2D400D4.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also find blocks in the &aTelepad&r structures for each ring. The &dVoid Ring&r also has &bSky Stone&r blocks in the lower section.
quest.3B33C4D5A2D400D4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你也可以在各种环的&a传送&r结构找到这种方块。&d虚空环&r的较低处也可以找到&b陨石&r。

quest.3B9DB4204A7CC6CD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Timedoor Marker&r is placed on the ground to mark a specific location in the world.
quest.3B9DB4204A7CC6CD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2时门标记&r可以放置在地上作为一种特殊的标记点。

quest.3B9DB4204A7CC6CD.quest_desc[2].en_us: Right-clicking it opens an interface that allows you to configure its display name, color, and access settings.
quest.3B9DB4204A7CC6CD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 右击它可以打开界面，在这里你可以配置它的显示名称、颜色以及访问控制设置。

quest.3B9DB4204A7CC6CD.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &6Chronomark&r is an upgraded version which allows for more customization options.
quest.3B9DB4204A7CC6CD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &6时标基座&r是标记的升级版，可以进行更多自定义配置。

quest.3B9E10A560C565CC.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aTeleporters&r from the &6Simple Teleporters&r can be used to set up quick teleport pads within the world.
quest.3B9E10A560C565CC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 来自&6简易传送器&r模组的&a传送器&r可用于在世界中快速传送。

quest.3B9E10A560C565CC.quest_desc[2].en_us: &dEnder Shards&r can be Sneak + Right-clicked on a &aTeleporter&r to store its location data, then you can install the Shard into another &aTeleporter&r.
quest.3B9E10A560C565CC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持&d末影碎片&r，对着&a传送器&r潜行+右击，即可存储当前的位置数据，然后你可以将存有数据的末影碎片插入另一&a传送器&r中，将其激活。

quest.3B9E10A560C565CC.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once done, you can Sneak on top of the &aTeleporter&r to teleport!
quest.3B9E10A560C565CC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在已激活的&a传送器&r上潜行，即可进行传送！

quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Within the dark, empty spaces, it sounds like creatures have begun to crawl up from the depths of the stone.
quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 黑暗而空旷的洞穴中传来响声，似乎有什么生物正从岩石的深处爬出来。

quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[2].en_us: With some luck, you might be able to find a deceased &aVillager&r stirring up.
quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你的运气不错，也许能遇见已故的&a村民&r。

quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[4].en_us: Create an empty dark room to allow for a &aZombie Villager&r to spawn, and use the &2Healing Springs&r to bring them back to life.
quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 建一个空旷黑暗的房间，等待里面刷新出&a僵尸村民&r，然后用&2治愈之泉&r复活他。

quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&f: Make sure not to build the room too close to the &aHealing Spring&r as mobs won't spawn there! Look for the &bBiome Name&r under your minimap or using 'F3' to check.
quest.3BD07A9C3A6ED05A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&f：不要紧挨着&a治愈之泉&r造刷怪房，治愈之泉附近不会刷怪！你可以用F3或者在小地图下方查看当前的&b生物群系&r。

quest.3BFF8EFB5E7186A4.quest_desc[0].en_us: The inside of the &6Quantum Computer&r multiblock can be customized using a mix of different blocks, including extra &bQuantum Storage&r.
quest.3BFF8EFB5E7186A4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 多方块&6量子计算机&r内部可以用不同方块填充，包括更多的&b量子计算机合成存储器&r。

quest.3BFF8EFB5E7186A4.quest_desc[2].en_us: &6Quantum Computer Storage&r blocks effectively increase the number of concurrent tasks the multiblock can handle at once.
quest.3BFF8EFB5E7186A4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6量子计算机储存方块&r可以高效提升一次可执行的线程。

quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aThermoelectric Generator&r uses the temperature differential between the blocks on either side of it to generate &aLV&r power.
quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a热传导发电机&r可利用其两侧方块的温差产生&a低压&r能量。

quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[2].en_us: This means that you need to place one cold block/fluid and one hot block/fluid on opposite sides of the block to generate power.
quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 也就是说，你需要在发电机的两侧分别放置高温和低温的方块/流体。

quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can check the &aEngineer's Manual&r or JEI for a list of compatible blocks.
quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以在&a工程师手册&r或JEI中查看可用于发电的方块列表。

quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: This is a store only item.
quest.3CADD463CFC2FE32.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：此物品只能从商店中购买。

quest.3CD3CA5B619F5698.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aFortune&r and &aSilk Touch&r upgrades can be used in &aDestructors&r to apply their enchantment to the mined block.
quest.3CD3CA5B619F5698.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a时运&r和&a精准采集&r升级可以安装在&a破坏面板&r中，这样它破坏方块时就会有这种魔咒的效果了。

quest.3CE848B7CB98859F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dDeployers&r are used to mimic player interactions and process item recipes.
quest.3CE848B7CB98859F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d机械手&r用于模拟玩家交互和处理物品配方。

quest.3CE848B7CB98859F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &dDeployers&r can milk cows, shear sheep, create farmland, attack monsters, and much more.
quest.3CE848B7CB98859F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d机械手&r可以挤牛奶、剪羊毛、开垦农田、攻击怪物，还有更多功能。

quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eCustom Machinery&r has a built-in structure preview function that allows you to see where the blocks should be placed in the world.
quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eCustom Machinery&r模组内置结构预览系统，能让你查看方块应放置在世界中的位置。

quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[2].en_us: To access this feature, simply click the Recipe arrow inside of the UI, then click the structure block in JEI to see the block placements in the world.
quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 只需要点击界面中的配方箭头，然后在打开的JEI界面中点击结构方块，便能查看世界中的方块位置。

quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oThe next page contains screenshots to help guide you, and the final page contains a screenshot of the fully-built structure. ->
quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o下一页包含截图以作操作引导，最后一页则是完整的结构截图。->

quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[10].en_us: The final structure should look like the picture below, with 2 Whisperglass on each of the four walls, the Reactor Reflector one up from the bottom-middle block, the Reactor Vent on top of that and the Empowered Void Block on the top-middle block.
quest.3CFC372F57CF6B82.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 完整的结构应像下图所示，四面的墙上各有两个轻语玻璃，底部中心的方块上方一格处为反应堆反射器，其上方为反应堆散热口，顶部中心的方块则是充能煤晶块。

quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[0].en_us: In &6Stoneblock 4&r, the world is generated in rings!
quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在&6石头世界4&r整合包中，整个世界都是按环生成的！

quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[2].en_us: You spawn into a pre-generated stone ring that extends out about 712 blocks. Each subsequent ring only extends out 512 blocks.
quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你会生成在一个预先生成的石头环中，该环会向外延伸约712格。此后的每种环将仅向外延伸512格。

quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[4].en_us: The rings are in this order:
quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 由内到外，各环按照此顺序排列：

quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[12].en_us: 7. &zVoid Chasms&r (Otherrock, with Skystone in the upper layer)
quest.3CFDFD0BA7D30118.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 7. &z虚空裂隙环&r（异界岩，顶层部分为陨石）

quest.3CFDFFDCDC306A83.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are several extra items that you can craft to upgrade your &aKitchen Multiblock&r!
quest.3CFDFFDCDC306A83.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这里还有一些附件可以升级你的&a多方块厨房&r！

quest.3CFDFFDCDC306A83.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aRacks&r will add tools to be used for your multiblock.
quest.3CFDFFDCDC306A83.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a架子&r可以为多方块厨房提供所需的工具。

quest.3CFDFFDCDC306A83.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also store fruits in the &aFruit Basket&r.
quest.3CFDFFDCDC306A83.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你也可以把水果储存在&a水果篮&r里。

quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zSlowmelter 9000&r is a basic machine that melts items. The speed will shock you.
quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z慢速熔化炉&r是一台用于熔融物品的基础机器，为它的速度而战栗吧。

quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can create molten metals and alloys using power. If you attach a &aFoundry Tap&r from &6Productive Metalworks&r to the side of it, you can pour the metal out onto a &aCasting Table&r or &aCasting Basin&r as well.
quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 熔化炉消耗能量将金属或合金熔融成液态，给它的侧面加一个&6Productive Metalworks&r模组的&a熔铸炉浇注口&r，就可以将熔融物倒入&a铸件台&r或&a铸造盆&r。

quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once you have the appropriate &aCast&r, you can use this to make plates, ingots, and more!
quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 拥有对应的&a铸模&r之后，你就可以用这台机器来制作金属板、金属锭等许多东西了！

quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: This can only hold one type of fluid at a time.
quest.3D0CD724F9302BDD.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：本机器只能同时容纳一种流体。

quest.3D0CE267A8FD95CD.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the &2Yeti&r defeated, you will have access to 2 new vaults to find.
quest.3D0CE267A8FD95CD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 击败&2雪怪首领&r后，将解锁2个新的宝库供你探寻。

quest.3D0CE267A8FD95CD.quest_desc[2].en_us: Found within the lower levels of the &bTwilight Forest&r ring, you can find the &aHydra's Lair Vault&r.
quest.3D0CE267A8FD95CD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a九头蛇巢穴宝库&r可在&b暮色森林&r环的下层找到。

quest.3D0CE267A8FD95CD.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: The &cHydra&r failed to make rent, and new tenants have taken its place.
quest.3D0CE267A8FD95CD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&c九头蛇&r未按时交租，所以地方让给别的租户了。

quest.3D0DC34C36A173F5.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eOritech's &2Exo Suit&r provides very useful effects for exploring the world, but provide no protection against the dangers of leaving your home.
quest.3D0DC34C36A173F5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eOritech&r模组的&2外骨骼装甲&r可提供许多增益效果，在探索世界时十分有用。但当你在外遇到危险时，它提供不了任何保护。

quest.3D220672224EDBD7.quest_desc[0].en_us: All &6CAD Devices&r have a space for a &cC&r&2o&r&9l&r&do&r&er&r &bAttachment&r, purely cosmetic but can surely make them look cooler!
quest.3D220672224EDBD7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在所有&6CAD设备&r上都有一个空位，可用于安装&c五&r&2颜&r&9六&r&d色&r&e的&r&b色彩附件&r。虽然纯粹是装饰，但肯定能让它们看起来更酷！

quest.3D220672224EDBD7.quest_subtitle.en_us: Time to turn your CAD into a Gamer CAD.
quest.3D220672224EDBD7.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 是时候把你的CAD变成游戏玩家CAD了。

quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[0].en_us: If we want to play with &cDemons&r, we'll need a way to summon them with rituals. To do this, we need &aChalk&r.
quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要想和&c魔鬼&r玩耍，需要通过仪式召唤它们。为此，我们需要&a粉笔&r。

quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aChalk&r is used to draw glyphs for your &bRituals&r. You will come across many different colored &aChalks&r as you progress through &eOccultism&r.
quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a粉笔&r用于画出&b仪式&r所需的图案。随着你推进&e神秘学&r，你将遇到各种不同颜色的&a粉笔&r。

quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[4].en_us: By combining &aOtherworld Ashes&r and &aBurnt Otherstone&r, you can craft an &7Impure White Chalk&r, which can be thrown into &aSpirit Fire&r to purify it into &aWhite Chalk&r.
quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 把&a异界灰烬&r和&a煅烧异界石&r混合，就能够制作出&7含杂白色粉笔&r，可以通过将其扔入&a灵火&r中除杂得到&a白色粉笔&r。

quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[6].en_us: Chalk is pretty hard to scrub off of the ground. You can use a &aChalk Brush&r to get rid of any misplaced glyphs.
quest.3D239E5AD486D419.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 画在地上的粉笔痕迹没法轻易擦除。你需要使用&a粉笔擦&r来擦去绘制错误的图案。

quest.3D767C3E2F0DE320.quest_desc[0].en_us: The structure of the &6Quantum Computer&r multiblock can range from a 3x3x3 to a 7x7x7 square.
quest.3D767C3E2F0DE320.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6量子计算机&r多方块结构是大小在3×3×3和7×7×7之间的正方体。

quest.3D767C3E2F0DE320.quest_desc[2].en_us: The minimum must contain at least a &6Quantum Computer Core&r, and all edges and sides of the cube must be &dQuantum Structure Blocks&r.
quest.3D767C3E2F0DE320.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 最小的量子计算机必须有至少一个&6量子计算机核心&r，框架和六个面必须全都是&d量子结构方块&r。

quest.3D767C3E2F0DE320.quest_desc[4].en_us: &dQuantum Crafting Units&r can be used to fill in empty spaces within the multiblock, but do not serve a purpose otherwise when placed inside.
quest.3D767C3E2F0DE320.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 多方块内部空格可以用&d量子合成单元&r填充，除此之外没别的用处。

quest.3DCD6DC36B31EEF4.quest_desc[0].en_us: With these &3World Engine Upgrades&r installed, you feel as though you are finally starting to master the &6World Engine&r.
quest.3DCD6DC36B31EEF4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 安装完这些&3世界引擎升级&r后，你终于感受到自己开始掌握&6世界引擎&r的力量了。

quest.3DCD6DC36B31EEF4.quest_desc[2].en_us: Head back to the &dEcho of Guidance&r to see what comes next and unlock even more &6Archives&r!
quest.3DCD6DC36B31EEF4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 回去找&d指引者的回响&r，查看后续任务，解锁更多&6档案&r！

quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAction Pad&r is a marvel of the ages. It can route many of your commonly used commands, such has home, spawn and world engine teleportation through this device.
quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d操作板&r堪称时代的奇迹。它可以执行许多常用的指令，例如home、spawn，也能使用此设备传送到世界引擎。

quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["You can open the menu by using the item or with the keybind ", { "keybind": "ftbpackcompanion.key.open_action_pad", "color": "green" }, "."]
quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["手持此物品右击或按快捷键", { "keybind": "ftbpackcompanion.key.open_action_pad", "color": "green" }, "来打开它的菜单。"]

quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[4].en_us: Many other teleportation options will appear as you meet the various &dEchoes&r and progress through the pack.
quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 随着游戏的推进，你见到的&d回响&r越来越多，操作板中的传送选项也会越来越多。

quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[6].en_us: If you ever lose your device, you can claim a replacement in the questbook emergency items tab.
quest.3DF42A6D832C0492.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果你不小心把它弄丢了，你可以在任务书的应急物品中再领取一个。

quest.3E1DB27DAB197F6B.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Wayfinder&r.
quest.3E1DB27DAB197F6B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，寻找&d寻路者的回响&r了。

quest.3E1DB27DAB197F6B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Help this &dEcho&r to unlock the &aChroniton Glass&r upgrade for your &bWorld Engine&r.
quest.3E1DB27DAB197F6B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 帮助这个&d回响&r解锁&b世界引擎&r的&a时空粒子玻璃&r升级。

quest.3E1DB27DAB197F6B.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo wayfinder&7.
quest.3E1DB27DAB197F6B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo wayfinder&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[0].en_us: For our first &bRitual&r, we're going to summon a &7Foliot Crusher&r using the &bAviar's Circle Pentacle&r.
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 首次&b仪式&r我们将使用&b阿维亚之环&r来召唤&7魔精碎矿者&r。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[2].en_us: The easiest way to do this is to navigate to the &bPentacles&r tab in your guidebook, then find &bAviar's Circle&r. On the right side, you should see a render of it with an &beye icon&r in the bottom right.
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以打开魔精全典找到&b五芒星&r章节，随后点开&b阿维亚之环&r。在页面右边将显示此五芒星的示意图，下方还带有&b小眼睛&r图标。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[4].en_us: Clicking this will allow you to place a &bhologram&r to help you create the pentacle!
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 点击小眼睛能够在世界中放置&b全息图&r，方便你快速绘制五芒星！

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[6].en_us: Once you've drawn and completed the layout of the &bPentacle&r, you can place down 4 &aSacrificial Bowls&r anywhere within 8 blocks of the &2Golden Sacrificial Bowl&r.
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 画完&b五芒星&r之后，在&2黄金献祭之碗&r的八格范围内放下四个&a献祭之碗&r。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[8].en_us: You might notice that most &bPentacles&r have the perfect spot for these!
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你可能会注意到大多数&b五芒星&r为献祭之碗预留了绝佳点位！

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[10].en_us: Next, you'll place down the items needed in the &aSacrificial Bowls&r, then place in the &aBook of Binding: Foliot (Bound)&r into the center &6Golden Sacrificial Bowl&r.
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 接下来，在&a献祭之碗&r中放入所需的物品，随后把&a绑定之书：魔精（已绑定）&r放入中间的&6黄金献祭之碗&r。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[12].en_us: Once all items are in place, you can right click the Golden Sacrificial Bowl and start the ritual!
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 所有物品就位后，右击黄金献祭之碗就可以开始仪式了！

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[14].en_us: The items inside the bowls will be consumed until there are none left, at which point the &7Foliot Crusher&r will appear next to the &aGolden Sacrificial Bowl&r.
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 献祭之碗里的物品将会逐个消耗，消耗完毕后&a黄金献祭之碗&r的位置将会出现&7魔精碎矿者&r。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[16].en_us: Like all other &bCrushers&r, the &7Foliot Crusher&r will grind down items into dust, providing 2x the output.
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 就像其它&b碎矿者们&r一样，&7魔精碎矿者&r能将矿石磨成矿粉，提供两倍的矿物产出。

quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[18].en_us: The Crusher is also needed to create the next color of Chalk we'll need!
quest.3E2C26828FF869F3.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: 我们也需要它来帮忙制作下一种颜色的粉笔！

quest.3E3A7F72F835E497.quest_desc[0].en_us: To encourage exploring a variety of food, foods in this pack will grant you &6extra health&r the more you try!
quest.3E3A7F72F835E497.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了鼓励你多尝试各种各样的食物，在本整合包中，品尝新食物时有概率获得&6额外生命值&r！

quest.3E3A7F72F835E497.quest_desc[2].en_us: To keep up with what foods you’ve eaten and your next culinary threshold, you can always look in the &aFood Book&r.
quest.3E3A7F72F835E497.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&a食物清单&r中，你可以查看自己已食用过的食物，以便于制定之后的烹饪计划。

quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: Oritech模组的&#fcd205钷&r工具十分强力，而且不会损坏。

quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &#fcd205Pickaxe&r has a regular, single-block mode with built-in silk touch, and an area mode that mines a 3x3 area.
quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &#fcd205钷镐&r有两种模式，其中一种为单方块精准采集，另一种为3x3范围挖掘。

quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &#fcd205Battleaxe&r instantly breaks trees and deals a LOT of damage.
quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &#fcd205钷战斧&r能造成大量伤害，还能瞬间砍树。

quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, you will need the &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.3E50C85AFC627BDC.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，你需要先进行&a机器方块&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.quest_desc[0].en_us: And now at the &aTop of Progression&r, you should be able to execute the &6&lTrick: Ebony or Ivory&r&r at &dThe End&r to obtain either &6Ivory or Ebony Substance&r.
quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你现在到了&a最高进度&r，应该能够在&d末地&r执行&6&l启动式：阴阳变化&r&r，获得&6象牙白物质或乌金色物质&r了。

quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.quest_desc[2].en_us: With those you will gain access to the &6Best CAD Devices Craftable in the Mod&r, the stats may vary a tiny amount, so choose the one you prefer.
quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 有了那些材料，你就可以获得&6模组中可制作的最佳CAD设备&r了。属性可能会有微小的变化，所以请选择你最喜欢的那个。

quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.quest_desc[4].en_us: ► Also a good thing to point out is that this &6Trick&r allows you to do all the previous convertions as well. Just don't try to make them in &dThe End&r.
quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ► 此外还有一个值得指出的点是，这个&6启动式&r也可以让你进行之前的所有转化，只是不需要在&d末地&r进行。

quest.3E72FB579DF147FE.title.en_us: The Best CADs Accessible in Survival

quest.3E7E07DB49639EA5.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the Infuser and some &cRedstone&r, we can start by making the basic &aAlloys&r and &aCircuits&r! You can even combine them together to make &cAdvanced Control Circuits&r for more advanced machines.
quest.3E7E07DB49639EA5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用冶金灌注机，对原材料灌注&c红石&r以制作基础的&a灌注合金&r和&a基础控制电路&r，再把所有产物组合起来就可以做出&c高级控制电路&r，这种电路可以用来制造更高级的机器。

quest.3E7E07DB49639EA5.quest_desc[2].en_us: These will be used to create most of the items in &eMekanism&r.
quest.3E7E07DB49639EA5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e通用机械&r中的绝大多数物品的制作都需要用到它们。

quest.3E89531AEC1CF0DA.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've crafted all the required &aMachine Blocks&r, you should return to the &dQuartermaster&r to learn where they should go in the &6World Engine&r.
quest.3E89531AEC1CF0DA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作好所需的全部&a机器方块&r后，请回到&d军需官&r处，他会告诉你这些方块需要安装在&6世界引擎&r的什么位置上。

quest.3EB56937CCDFCB2A.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bCasts&r are used to shape your metals for tools, weapons and armor, or ingots and other forms. They are created by pouring &3Molten Steel&r onto an item of similar shape.
quest.3EB56937CCDFCB2A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b铸模&r能够将熔融金属塑形成工具、武器、盔甲、金属锭或是其他部件。将&3熔融钢&r浇注到板上就能得到板的铸模，以此类推。

quest.3EB56937CCDFCB2A.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can select which fluid gets poured out by selecting it within the &aController&r, then simply click a drain with the &2Casting Basin&r below to get out your material.
quest.3EB56937CCDFCB2A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&a熔铸炉控制器&r内选择你想用的熔融金属，然后右击放置在铸件台或铸造盆上方的&2熔铸炉浇注口&r即可使其流出。

quest.3EB56937CCDFCB2A.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oThis process can be automated with redstone.
quest.3EB56937CCDFCB2A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o这个过程可以用红石实现自动化。

quest.3F5480E01ABA887B.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAutocrafter&r accepts up to 9 configured recipe &aPatterns&r and 4 &aSpeed Upgrades&r.
quest.3F5480E01ABA887B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a自动合成仓&r最多可安装9个已配置配方的&a样板&r和4个&a速度升级&r。

quest.3F5480E01ABA887B.quest_desc[2].en_us: If the &aAutocrafter&r is pointing at a machine or chest, it will attempt to push the process' recipe items into that block, otherwise it will attempt to perform a crafting recipe.
quest.3F5480E01ABA887B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果&a自动合成仓&r的输出面指向某个机器或容器，它会尝试将处理配方所需的材料放入其中；否则，它会尝试执行工作台配方。

quest.3F5480E01ABA887B.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oAutocrafters will place down facing the block you are looking at.
quest.3F5480E01ABA887B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o放置自动合成仓时，它的输出面会朝向你所看向的方块。

quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Oritech Reactors&r are a great way to generate large amounts of power!
quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Oritech反应堆&r是生成大量能量的绝佳方式！

quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[2].en_us: The Reactor is a large custom multiblock made up of many different parts, with the &6Nuclear Reactor Control Panel&r being the main interface block.
quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 反应堆是一个由许多不同部分组成的大型自定义多方块结构，&6核反应堆控制面板&r是它的主要交互界面。

quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[4].en_us: This interface shows the current status of the reactor, along with the temperatures of the components and statistics. It also only shows the first layer of the interior.
quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这个界面显示了当前反应堆的状态、组件的温度和统计数据。它仅显示内部的第一层。

quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[6].en_us: &6Reactors&r generate power by consuming Uranium or Plutonium Pellets, and the amount of power is based on the number of &aReactor Rods&r and &bNeutron Reflectors&r next to the rods.
quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &6反应堆&r的燃料是铀球或钚球，产电量由&a反应堆棒&r和相邻的&b中子反射器&r的数量决定。

quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[8].en_us: &cIt is important to keep Reactors sufficiently cooled!&r Reactors like to make big holes.
quest.3F75F781DE5123F4.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &c保持反应堆充分冷却非常重要！&r反应堆喜欢炸个大坑。

quest.3F81256B4E65076F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The magical properties from the tree's logs can draw in the magical essence left behind in the world.
quest.3F81256B4E65076F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这些木材所具备的魔法特性能够汇聚留存于世间的魔法精华。

quest.3F81256B4E65076F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Craft the &aImbuement Chamber&r and convert &aLapis&r into a &dSource Gem&r.
quest.3F81256B4E65076F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作&a灌注室&r，并用它将&a青金石&r转化为&d魔源宝石&r。

quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWayfinder&r knows everything there is to know about traversing this world.
quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d寻路者&r通晓穿行于此世间的一切知识。

quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[2].en_us: He mentioned a secret power hidden within a &3Vault&r encased in the &3Deepslate&r ring.
quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 他提到，在&3深板岩&r环中有座&3宝库&r，那里隐藏着一种神秘力量。

quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: It might be worth making an &aExplorer's Compass&r to help locate the &3Vault&r!
quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：制作一个&a探险家指南针&r可以帮助你寻找&3宝库&r！

quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[6].en_us: If you manage to find your way through this &3Vault's&r puzzles, the &dChroniton Star&r should be yours for the taking.
quest.3FA9D6A475E4D1C6.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果你成功破解了这个&3宝库&r的谜题，那么&d时空粒子之星&r就可以任你取用。

quest.3FD6F10BE6F06FFF.quest_desc[0].en_us: Each &dAssembler Matrix Craft Core&r can run up to 8 crafting jobs simultaneously.
quest.3FD6F10BE6F06FFF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 每个&d装配矩阵合成核心&r都能让矩阵同时处理最多8个合成任务。

quest.3FE863C60B2D2719.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dDisenchanter&r from &6Draconic Evolution&r can be used to strip enchantments off an item at the cost of experience and some durability damage to the item.
quest.3FE863C60B2D2719.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6龙之进化&r模组的&d祛魔台&r可以将物品上的魔咒拆出来，这个过程会消耗经验和物品的耐久。

quest.3FE863C60B2D2719.quest_desc[2].en_us: The damage can be reduced by placing bookshelves around the &dDisenchanter&r, similar to a regular enchanting setup.
quest.3FE863C60B2D2719.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在&d祛魔台&r附近放书架（类似附魔台的摆法）可以减少祛魔过程对物品耐久的损耗。

quest.3FE99AE10B0737BB.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aBasic Bin&r stores a lot of a single item type. It can also generate cobble with a &aStone Generator&r upgrade installed.
quest.3FE99AE10B0737BB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: The &aBasic Bin&r stores a lot of a single item type. It can also generate cobble with a &aStone Generator&r upgrade installed.

quest.3FE99AE10B0737BB.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &#5EFCB6Basic Fluid Tank&r can store 32 buckets of a single type of fluid, but also works as a bucket.
quest.3FE99AE10B0737BB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &#5EFCB6基础流体储罐&r可以存储32桶单一种类的流体，并且可以被当作桶使用。

quest.3FE99AE10B0737BB.quest_desc[4].en_us: While holding this in your hand and sneaking, you can change the mode to &aBucket&r by scrolling your mouse wheel. This will allow you to scoop up multiple buckets worth of fluids like water or lava.
quest.3FE99AE10B0737BB.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 潜行的时候手持储罐，可以用鼠标滚轮把模式调整为&a桶&r，这样就可以装起多桶流体（比如水或熔岩）。

quest.400EF0F598308431.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that we have &7Latex&r, we can make the &aLatex Processing Unit&r.
quest.400EF0F598308431.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 现在你有了&7胶乳&r，做个&a胶乳加工机&r吧。

quest.400EF0F598308431.quest_desc[2].en_us: When powered, this machine takes in fluid latex and converts it into dry rubber, which can be smelted to get &aPlastic&r.
quest.400EF0F598308431.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这台机器将胶乳流体处理为干橡胶，干橡胶可以熔炼成&a塑料片&r。

quest.400EF0F598308431.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can use generators from other mods for this.
quest.400EF0F598308431.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以选择用其他模组的发电机给它供能。

quest.400FD8861E907DDA.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aDisk Interface&r transfers items between the storage network and provided &bStorage Disks&r.
quest.400FD8861E907DDA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a磁盘接口&r可以在存储网络和&b存储磁盘&r之间传输物品。

quest.400FD8861E907DDA.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bStorage Disks&r can alternatively be upgraded directly into the next tier by combining the upgraded part with the existing disk in a crafting grid, returning your old disk in the process while keeping all of your items.
quest.400FD8861E907DDA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b存储磁盘&r可以直接在合成格中升级，只需将更高级的存储组件与现有磁盘合成。此过程会返还旧的磁盘，并保留其中的所有物品。

quest.400FD8861E907DDA.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eCable Tiers &aDisk Interfaces&r upgrade the speed at which items are transferred and have more filter slots.
quest.400FD8861E907DDA.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e多级线缆&r模组的&a磁盘接口&r提供了更高的物品传输速率和更多的过滤槽位。

quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dWarp Scrolls&r from &6Ars Nouveau&r have two different uses.
quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6新生魔艺&r的&d折跃卷轴&r有两种不同的用法。

quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[2].en_us: When Sneak + Right-clicked, the scroll will store your location data for future use. The scroll can used to teleport you back to that spot, consuming the scroll.
quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 潜行+右击后，卷轴就会存储你当前的位置数据。之后当你使用卷轴时，就会传送回该位置，并消耗掉卷轴。

quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[4].en_us: Instead, you can create a portal frame out of &aSourcestone&r and throw the scroll in to create a one-way portal!
quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 又或者，你可以使用&a魔源石&r搭建一个传送门框架，把绑定好的卷轴扔进去，就可以创建一个单向的传送门了！（译注：需要魔源）

quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: &aWarp Scrolls&r require the &bTwilight Forest&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&a折跃卷轴&r，需要先进行&b暮色森林&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[8].en_us: &dStabilized Warp Scrolls&r can also be used to store your location, then when used on a block, it opens up a temporary portal for you.
quest.4032C8BD158D1776.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &d稳定化折跃卷轴&r也可用于存储你当前的位置，之后对着方块使用，卷轴就会创造一个临时传送门。

quest.4080C053E58A8B55.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Baubley Heart Canisters'&r weapons add +1 base damage for each &bHeart Canister&r inserted into them, for up to +96 base damage.
quest.4080C053E58A8B55.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6心之容器&r模组的武器所造成的基础伤害会随其内部装填的&b心容器&r数量的增加而增加，最多可以增加96点。

quest.4080C053E58A8B55.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, you will need the &dSpirit&r and &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrades&r.
quest.4080C053E58A8B55.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，你需要先进行&d精魂&r和&a机器方块&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.4080C053E58A8B55.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oHearts must be inserted via their interfaces.
quest.4080C053E58A8B55.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o心容器需要在武器的UI里装填。

quest.4094F70F627F492C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6World Engine&r can actually use the &zBlack Hole&r as an upgrade, but will need a container for it.
quest.4094F70F627F492C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&r能借助&z黑洞&r升阶，但需要先为黑洞准备一个容器。

quest.40DCA09032568A0F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aRelays&r can be used to create new branches of your network or switch on/off sections of your storage network.
quest.40DCA09032568A0F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a中继器&r可用于创建独立的网络分支，或接通/断开存储网络的某部分。

quest.40DCA09032568A0F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aDetectors&r emit a configurable redstone signal depending on how much of a resource is in your network.
quest.40DCA09032568A0F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a检测器&r可检测网络中某种资源的数量，并依此发出不同强度的红石信号。

quest.40DCA09032568A0F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aStorage Monitors&r can be configured to display how much of a certain resource is stored in your storage network. You can also pull items directly from this monitor by clicking on it.
quest.40DCA09032568A0F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a存储监控器&r可显示存储网络中某种资源的实时储量。你也可以点击其中物品将其直接提取出来。

quest.40DDD27BA5E191FA.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.40DDD27BA5E191FA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库。

quest.40DDD27BA5E191FA.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.40DDD27BA5E191FA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.4101E75F69C9909F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dQuantum Item Orchestration&r (&dQIO&r) system is &eMekanism's&r wireless, power-free, and expandable digital storage solution.
quest.4101E75F69C9909F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d量子物品编排&r（&dQIO&r）系统是&e通用机械&r的无线、无需电力且可扩展的数字存储解决方案

quest.4101E75F69C9909F.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dQIO&r operates on frequencies similar to teleporters and machine security, so items can be accessed from any &aQIO Dashboard&r that's connected to the frequency of a &2QIO Drive Array&r.
quest.4101E75F69C9909F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &dQIO系统&r的运行频率与传送器和机器安全系统相近，因此只要&aQIO仪表板&r连接到&2QIO驱动器阵列&r的频率，就可以从任何地方访问物品。

quest.4101E75F69C9909F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eApplied Mekanistics&r allows a &aME System&r to access a &dQIO&r storage by placing a &aDashboard&r onto an &2AE2 Storage Bus&r and setting the desired frequency.
quest.4101E75F69C9909F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e应用能源&r允许&aME系统&r通过将&a仪表盘&r放置在&2AE2存储总线&r上并设置所需的频率来访问&dQIO&r存储。

quest.4111541EAEF0E4FC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dQuantum&r armor provides netherite-tier protection, with the ability to be upgraded with a variety of &bModules&r via a keybind.
quest.4111541EAEF0E4FC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d量子&r盔甲的防御力与下界合金盔甲相当，但它还可以安装各种&b模块&r进行升级。

quest.4111541EAEF0E4FC.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &eOpen Quantum Armor Configuration&r key isn't bound by default.
quest.4111541EAEF0E4FC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 默认情况下，&e打开量子装甲配置&r未绑定按键。

quest.4119A43052DB5E3E.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eRelics&r mod adds 25 new and unique items, each with the ability to level up and grant unique abilities for those who wish to use them!
quest.4119A43052DB5E3E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e遗物&r模组添加了25个新奇而独特的饰品，这些饰品每一个都可以升级，并为使用者提供独特的能力！

quest.4119A43052DB5E3E.quest_desc[2].en_us: These can be found in loot, but can also be bought from the shop!
quest.4119A43052DB5E3E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在战利品中获得饰品，不过在商店里也能买到！

quest.4126A470077923D2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCardboard Box&r is a super useful item that can be used to move block entities like chests, spawners, and more!
quest.4126A470077923D2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a纸箱&r非常有用，它可以移动方块实体，比如箱子、刷怪笼和其他方块！

quest.4126A470077923D2.quest_desc[2].en_us: Using a box on a block will cover it, allowing you to break and pick it up as an item. Placing this item down and then sneak-right clicking on it will remove the box.
quest.4126A470077923D2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 对方块使用纸箱会将它打包，这样你就可以把它当做物品破坏。放下物品再潜行右击，纸箱就会被移除。

quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've gathered some materials from the &cNether&r ring, you can upgrade to the next tier of Goo.
quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以用&c下界&r环获取的材料升级凝胶。

quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[2].en_us: &cBlazebloom Goo&r will allow you to create a new tier of metal call &6Blazegold&r by converting &eBlocks of Gold&r, just like we did with Iron.
quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &c烈焰蕾凝胶&r可以将&e金块&r转化为全新金属：&6烈焰金&r。转化步骤和之前你转化铁的步骤一样。

quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[4].en_us: To activate it, you'll need to feed it either Nether Wart or Blaze Powder.
quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要使用下界疣或烈焰粉才能激活它。

quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[6].en_us: It also retains the ability to create &aFerricore Ore&r, so no need to make another Primogel Goo just for Iron. Not only that, it converts Iron faster than Primogel!
quest.417573A657CAED05.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 它同样保留了转化&a核源铁矿&r的能力，所以没必要再做一团凝胶。而且这个凝胶转化速度比原本的更快！

quest.4194852B70E0ECEB.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dEcho of Guidance&r has directed you to create your first home.
quest.4194852B70E0ECEB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d指引者的回响&r已经指导你创建了你的第一个家园。

quest.4194852B70E0ECEB.quest_desc[2].en_us: Head out of the &6Archive&r and enter through the giant portal to make your place in this world!
quest.4194852B70E0ECEB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 离开&6档案室&r，穿过那道巨型传送门，去开天辟地吧！

quest.4194F3C176E50B7B.quest_desc[1].en_us: &7A strike to weaken, a strike to fell
quest.4194F3C176E50B7B.quest_desc[1].zh_cn: &7只为动摇敌人，只为杀死敌人

quest.4194F3C176E50B7B.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7The random blows of life, each end aiding the downfall of another
quest.4194F3C176E50B7B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7给生灵带来无法预料的重击，每一条生命的亡语都是下一条生命的丧钟

quest.4194F3C176E50B7B.quest_desc[7].en_us: &7Struggle made manifest, every smite further and further smothering the soul
quest.4194F3C176E50B7B.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: &7敌人无法掩饰地挣扎，你的每一击都在逐渐扼杀他们的灵魂

quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[0].en_us: With soulstone embedded in the blade, a &aCrude Scythe&r is able to tear through both body and soul when slaying creatures, causing Spirit to form and be drawn to the slayer.
quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a粗制镰刀&r的刀刃里镶嵌了灵魂石，这使它能在杀死生物的同时撕碎它们的身体和灵魂，并给玩家带来精魂。

quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7Scythes also can accept unique enchantments that may drastically improve or alter its uses, such as collecting more spirits or providing a small aerial boost.
quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7此外，镰刀可以获得独特的附魔，这些附魔有可能大大增强甚至直接改变它的能力，比如能够收集更多的精魂或是使你能够在小范围内进行跃击。

quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[4].en_us: These spirits can be used in the &aSpirit Altar&r. This Altar is a place to channel spirit aspects and other infusion resources into a focal item.
quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以在&a精魂祭坛&r中使用这些精魂。这个祭坛可以把精魂特质以及其他魔导材料灌注到核心物品里。

quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[6].en_us: The Altar itself serves to hold this focus and anchor the spirits used on it, while any other focus materials must be placed on &epedestals&r within 4 blocks of the Altar. Once all materials and spirits are in place, the crafting begins automatically.
quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 祭坛本体是用来放置核心材料和锚定灵魂的，而其他聚焦材料必须放在祭坛周围四格以内的&e物品基座&r上。只要材料和魂魄就位，合成就会自动开始。

quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[8].en_us: While the crafting process can be slow, up to four &eRunewood Obelisks&r placed in this range will speed it up.
quest.41C439295D5558C2.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 合成的过程有可能非常慢，而将至多四个&e符文木方尖碑&r放置在附近可以使其加速。

quest.41ED404574094D5B.quest_desc[0].en_us: For the next step, you'll want to craft a &dDislocator&r and bind it directly on top of the &aStasis Chamber&r. Once you have the setup ready to go, head to the arena and right-click the &dDislocator&r into the &aReceptacle&r.
quest.41ED404574094D5B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 下一步，你需要制作一个&d传送符咒&r，并将它绑定到&a冷凝室&r正上方。准备好这套设施后，前往竞技场，手持&d传送符咒&r右击&a传送符咒收纳器&r将其放入。

quest.41ED404574094D5B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Hopefully the chicken will fall right into your trap.
quest.41ED404574094D5B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 希望这只鸡能精准落入你的陷阱。

quest.41ED404574094D5B.quest_desc[4].en_us: Milking the &zMighty Ender Chicken&r will give you &zMolten Chaos&r which can be used to make &6Tiny Chaos Shards&r.
quest.41ED404574094D5B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 从&z威猛末影鸡&r身上挤出能制作&6微小混沌碎片&r的&z熔融混沌&r。

quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Ars&r has several options for magical gear.
quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6新生魔艺&r中有多种魔法装备可供选择。

quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make these magical sets, you will need to find &aMagebloom Seeds&r from chests in the &dArcane Grove&r to get started. This will grow into &aMagebloom&r, which can be used to craft all types of gear, and even &dSpell Parchments&r!
quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要制作这些魔法套装，你需要先从&d奥术林地&r中的宝箱中找到&a法师之花种子&r。这个种子可以生长成&a法师之花&r，可以用来制作各种装备，以及&d法术羊皮纸&r！

quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[4].en_us: Gear can be altered in the &aAlteration Table&r to install upgrades in the form of &dThreads&r.
quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这些装备可以在“&a改衣台&r”中进行修改并安装“&d纤维&r”升级。

quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[6].en_us: Threads can be crafted and then inscribed onto armor using the &3Alteration Table&r. To use it, place the armor you'd like to alter onto the stand on the table. The tablet on the table will then show you the available Thread Slots it has, and you can right click a Thread on the tablet to add it to the armor. Now you can just remove your armor!
quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 合成纤维后可以在&3改衣台&r上将其缝到盔甲上。首先把想要裁改的盔甲放在改衣台上，然后改衣台就会显示它的可用纤维槽。手持纤维右击即可将其缝制到盔甲上，最后把盔甲拿下来就行！

quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[8].en_us: If you want to remove a thread, place the armor onto the table and interact with the display with an empty hand.
quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 如果你想移除纤维的话，把盔甲放在上面空手右击即可。

quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[10].en_us: If you want to upgrade the tier of your mage gear for more thread slots, you can use the &dEnchantment Apparatus&r.
quest.41F048EAE6949163.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 如果你想升级法师盔甲，以让它有更多纤维槽的话，请使用&d附魔装置&r。

quest.427682661459BB4F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &cQuanta&r adds randomness to your enchanting rolls, and at max chaos, you will end up with either +100% or -100% power.
quest.427682661459BB4F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c量子化&r给你的附魔增添了不确定性，量子化满的时候，附魔等级会在+100%和-100%之间随机抽取。

quest.427682661459BB4F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eStabilization&r cancels out the negative effects, meaning you get all the upside, and none of the downside.
quest.427682661459BB4F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e量子稳定&r会剔除掉负面的部分，这样你的附魔等级就只增不减了。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[0].en_us: Our new friend should make it easy for us to make &eCrushed Endstone&r, but before we continue, it's important to understand more about &bRituals&r and &bPentacles&r!
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 我们的新朋友能帮助我们轻松获得&e粉碎末地石&r，但在开始下一步之前，有必要进一步了解一下&b仪式&r和&b五芒星&r！

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[2].en_us: In short, a &bPentacle&r is a formation of glyphs, bowls, and stabilizers placed around the &aGolden Sacrificial Bowl&r.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 简单来说，&b五芒星&r是围绕&a黄金献祭之碗&r摆放的一系列图案、碗和蜡烛等物品的集合，用于稳定仪式的运行。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[4].en_us: A &bRitual&r is the act of offering items to summon a &bSpirit&r from &9The Otherworld&r.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 而&b仪式&r是指供奉物品来从&9异界&r召唤&b魔灵&r的行为。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[6].en_us: There are 4 different types of &bPentacles&r, and each can be upgraded as you progress.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 总共有4种类型的&b五芒星&r，随着神秘学的推进，每一种都可以进一步升级。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[8].en_us: This means that you only need four 19x19 areas to set up all 4 types of &bPentacles&r!
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 这意味着你只需要4个19x19的空间就可以摆下所有四种&b五芒星&r！

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[10].en_us: Rituals are mainly split into four categories: &aBinding&r, &aPossession&r, &aFamiliar&r, and &aSummoning&r.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 仪式主要分为四个类别：&a束缚仪式&r、&a附身仪式&r、&a使魔仪式&r以及&a召唤仪式&r。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[12].en_us: Your &aAviar's Circle&r &bPentacle&r is considered a &aSummoning Pentacle&r.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 你的&a阿维亚之环&r&b五芒星&r就属于一种&a召唤五芒星&r。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[14].en_us: The next upgrade for it is &cOphyx's Calling&r, which allows you to summon &cDjinni&r.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 它的下一级称为&c欧菲克斯的呼唤&r，能够让你召唤&c巨灵&r。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[16].en_us: Your next step will be to acquire new colors of &aChalk&r, as higher tier pentacles require them.
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 接下来，你需要新颜色的&a粉笔&r为高阶五芒星做准备。

quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[18].en_us: With this knowledge, you should be ready to conquer the Occultism mod!
quest.42CE9840EED6B540.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: 有了这些知识，你应该准备好征服神秘学模组了！

quest.42F76C9425677DB3.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bDrives&r are the storage medium for &dQIO systems&r, with up to ten fitting in each &2Drive Array&r. There is no limit on the number of drives or arrays per frequency.
quest.42F76C9425677DB3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b硬盘&r是&dQIO系统&r的存储介质，每个&2驱动器阵列&r最多可容纳十个硬盘。每个频率的硬盘或阵列数量没有限制。

quest.42F76C9425677DB3.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each tier increases both the variety of items that can be stored and the total amount of items it can store.
quest.42F76C9425677DB3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个等级的提升都会增加可存储物品的种类和总存储量。

quest.4348C9D795E92FCE.quest_desc[0].en_us: This &aPortable Energy Storage&r can hold up to 1M RF and will retain energy when broken.
quest.4348C9D795E92FCE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a便携能量存储&r最高可储存1M RF，破坏后不会损失能量。

quest.4348C9D795E92FCE.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aPortable Energy Storage&r accepts energy from all sides through a green port and can only output through the single red port. A redstone signal will disable all energy output.
quest.4348C9D795E92FCE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a便携能量存储&r的任意有绿色端口的面都可以输入能量，但仅有一个红色端口可以输出能量。有红石信号时，它不会输出能量。

quest.437F2C378CD6FE51.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aInfuser&r can also be used to convert iron into &2Steel&r using &aCarbon&r for the infusion!
quest.437F2C378CD6FE51.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a灌注机&r可以用&a碳&r把铁灌注为&2钢&r！

quest.437F2C378CD6FE51.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can place Coal or Charcoal in the infusion slot to convert it into Carbon, with Charcoal giving double the amount. Once you have some in the machine, you can run Iron through once to get &aEnriched Iron&r. Infusing this again with carbon will give you &2Steel Dust&r which you can smelt into &2Steel Ingots&r!
quest.437F2C378CD6FE51.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以把煤炭或木炭放入灌注槽内，将其转化为碳（木炭可以转化为两倍的碳）。等机器里有两倍原材料的碳后，就把可以铁放进去灌注，得到&a富集铁&r。再用碳灌注一次就能得到&2钢粉&r，烧炼之后就是&2钢锭&r了！

quest.437F2C378CD6FE51.quest_desc[4].en_us: &2Steel&r is a great material to make tools out of due to its high durability, and is also needed to make the basic pipes from the mod.
quest.437F2C378CD6FE51.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &2钢&r是一种极佳的工具制作材料，因其高耐久性而备受青睐，同时，制作这个模组中的基础管道也需要用钢。

quest.43919D8A9EB5C627.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Hydroponic Bed&r from &bIndustrial Foregoing&r works as an accelerated soil for crops to grow on.
quest.43919D8A9EB5C627.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b工业先锋&r的&2水培床&r就像一种加速土壤，供农作物生长。

quest.43919D8A9EB5C627.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can automatically harvest crops for you, and can also be upgraded in speed using upgrades and by using &bEther Gas&r from Withers.
quest.43919D8A9EB5C627.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它可以自动收获作物，并可以使用插件或使用来自凋灵的&b以太气体&r来提速。

quest.43919D8A9EB5C627.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also use the &dSimulated Hydroponic Bed&r to simulate the growth from a single crop into multiple beds!
quest.43919D8A9EB5C627.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你也可以使用&d模拟水培床&r来将单一作物的生长模拟到多个水培床上！

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dCrafting CPU Multiblock&r is the heart of autocrafting within &eAE2&r.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d多方块合成CPU&r是&eAE2&r的自动合成核心。

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[2].en_us: These multiblocks must be built as rectangular prisms in shape with no empty blocks, and contain at least 1 or more &aCrafting Storages&r. While optional, &aCrafting Co-Processors&r are recommended to use as well.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个多方块必须按照立方体搭建，不允许有任何空缺方块，其中至少要有一个&a合成存储器&r。&a并行处理单元&r也推荐放几个进去。

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aCrafting Storage&r blocks are used to store the ingredients of a craft. The storage amount will determine how many items you can request to be autocrafted at once.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a合成存储器&r是用来存储合成原材料的，其存储容量决定了一次请求可以合成的物品量。

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[6].en_us: For example, if you want to craft 1k Crafting Tables, you will need to have enough crafting storage to store the ingredients of all 1k of them.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 比如，如果你想做1000个工作台，那你就需要足够的空间，至少能装下1000个工作台的全部原材料。（译注：实际上会受合成轮次的影响，需要的更多一点）

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[8].en_us: The &dCrafting Co-Processor&r is an optional block but is recommended as each additional Co-Processor allows for more sub tasks to be queued at once, and somewhat speeds up complex autocrafting operations.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &d并行处理单元&r是个可选组件，不过我推荐你还是放几个比较好。并行处理单元越多，意味着一次可以执行的分支请求就越多，对于那种合成树很复杂的请求很有效。

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[10].en_us: For example, crafting 1k Crafting Tables might require turning logs into planks, then planks into tables. With multiple Co-Processors, your multiblock can craft the logs into planks at the same time as it crafts planks into tables. Otherwise, it would craft all of the logs into planks until finished, then craft the planks into the tables all at once.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 比如，合成1000个工作台首先需要把木头变成木板，木板再做成工作台。如果你安装了多个并行处理单元的话，你的多方块合成器就可以同时处理木头变木板，还有木板变工作台。不然的话它就会先完成木头合成木板，再一次性把木板变成工作台。

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[12].en_us: One important thing to note is that each &dCrafting CPU Multiblock&r can only handle one type of task at a time. For example, if you wanted to craft both 1k Crafting Tables and autosmelt 1k Iron Ingots at the same time, you would need 2 separate CPU Multiblocks to achieve this.
quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 有一个非常重要的事：一个&d多方块合成CPU&r一次只能处理一种合成任务，如果你想合成1000个工作台的同时烧1000个铁锭，那你就需要两个合成CPU才能处理两个任务。

quest.43949500F6A0B46A.quest_desc[14].en_us: For more info, you can always refer to the AE2 Guide.

quest.4402F6855A75B7F6.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon spawns in the lower parts of the &2Twilight Forest&r ring.
quest.4402F6855A75B7F6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此地牢会生成在&2暮色森林&r环的下层。

quest.4445906BD04FC37D.quest_desc[0].en_us: With your new &3Unearthing&r skill, you should easily be able to find better materials in the different blocks that you can brush.
quest.4445906BD04FC37D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你的&3发掘&r水平更加精进了，应该能轻松从方块中刷出更好的材料了吧。

quest.4445906BD04FC37D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Try brushing &aDust&r to see what you can &3Unearth&r.
quest.4445906BD04FC37D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 刷一刷&a尘土&r，看看你能&3发掘&r出什么。

quest.44599533471DFDCB.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dStasis Chamber&r is an advanced machine used to keep mobs above it incapacitated, but also tries to keep them healed and alive.
quest.44599533471DFDCB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d冷凝室&r是一种高级机器，用于使上方生物丧失行动能力，同时会持续治疗并维持其生命状态。

quest.44599533471DFDCB.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is mostly used to trap &dWithers&r to extract &bEther Gas&r from them, or &3Wardens&r for their &3Souls&r.
quest.44599533471DFDCB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这台机器一般用来困住&d凋灵&r或&3监守者&r以提取&b以太气体&r或&3灵魂&r。

quest.4468BC270F100F27.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eEnderIO&r is a tech-mod with machines, inventory and automation tools, and many more features!
quest.4468BC270F100F27.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e末影接口&r是个科技模组，它带来了许多机器，物流和自动化工具，以及许多新机制！

quest.4468BC270F100F27.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started, you'll need to obtain some &aGrains of Infinity&r.
quest.4468BC270F100F27.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 想要开始游玩本模组，你需要先获取一些&a无限粉&r。

quest.4468BC270F100F27.quest_desc[4].en_us: In this pack, you can obtain some &aGrains of Infinity&r by throwing &aGravel&r into fire.
quest.4468BC270F100F27.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在这个整合包中，你只需将&a沙砾&r丢入火中便可获取&a无限粉&r！

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[0].en_us: To get started on getting your ultimate &eApotheosis&r gear, you'll need to fight monsters and explore the world for &bGems&r!
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想制作出终极的&e神化&r装备，那就准备好周游世界大战怪物寻找&b宝石&r吧！

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bGems&r are crystals that provide powerful bonuses when applied to &bAffix&r items.
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b宝石&r是一种水晶，将宝石镶嵌在带有&b词缀&r的物品上，就能为其带来强大加成。

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[4].en_us: To apply a &bGem&r to an item, you must combine it with the item in a &aSmithing Table&r. The item must have an open &aGem Socket&r for this to work.
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要用&a锻造台&r将&b宝石&r装到物品上。物品必须要有&a镶孔&r才能安装宝石。

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[6].en_us: Gems give different bonuses when slotted in different item types, and can be upgraded in the &aGem Cutting Table&r.
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 安装宝石的物品种类不同，宝石带来的加成也不同。&a宝石切割台&r可以升级宝石。

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[8].en_us: &cUnique Gems&r can only be socketed once per item, while most other gems can be socketed multiple times for stacking bonuses.
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 一件物品只能镶嵌一颗&c唯一宝石&r，其他的宝石则可以安装多个来叠加效果。

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[10].en_us: There are a variety of &eApotheosis&r &bGems&r, which you can get by killing mobs and bosses.
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &e神化&r模组的&b宝石&r种类繁多，击杀怪物或boss就能掉落。

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[12].en_us: &bGems&r can also be crushed by an anvil to create &aGem Dust&r.
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 用下落的铁砧砸碎&b宝石&r可获得&a宝石粉&r。

quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[14].en_us: You can use &aGem Dust&r for a variety of things, but the first thing you'll want to make is a &aSalvaging Table&r!
quest.4498E3F4B2DC24FC.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: &a宝石粉&r可以做很多东西，不过，你得先做一个&a回收台&r！

quest.44C341DE3BCD64CC.quest_desc[0].en_us: This upgraded version of the &dEnchantment Library&r can store enchantments values up to level 31.
quest.44C341DE3BCD64CC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这是升级版的&d魔咒图书馆&r，可以存储最高31级的附魔等级。

quest.44C341DE3BCD64CC.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oPlease note that the actual enchanted books are still capped at normal pack limits.&r
quest.44C341DE3BCD64CC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o请注意，实际能够取出的附魔书仍然受到正常的等级限制。&r

quest.450A1BAD728F594B.quest_desc[0].en_us: After you have formed the &dQuantum Bridge&r multiblock for your base, you can craft and link the &6Quantum Bridge Card&r to install in your Wireless Terminal! This card allows you to access your network from any dimension wirelessly.
quest.450A1BAD728F594B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 等你成功连通了两个&d量子桥&r后，就可以合成并链接&6量子桥卡&r，然后把它装入你的无线终端里！这张卡可以让你无视维度限制访问AE网络。

quest.450A1BAD728F594B.quest_desc[2].en_us: To link the two, you'll need to create a pair of &dQuantum Entangled Singularities&r, and place one into a &6Quantum Network Bridge&r and the other into your &dWireless Terminal&r, along with the card itself.
quest.450A1BAD728F594B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果想把终端和网络链接在一起的话，首先做一对&d量子纠缠奇点&r，然后一个放在接入基地的&6量子桥&r内，另一个和量子桥卡一起装入你的&d无线终端&r即可。

quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eClavis&r mod adds special interaction with locked chests.
quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eClavis&r模组给上锁的箱子添加了一些互动。

quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[2].en_us: Chests are now locked behind a lockpicking minigame! Line up the needle with the locks and left click to unlock them.
quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 现在你得先完成一个开锁小游戏，才能打开箱子！当指针与锁对齐时，按下鼠标左键，即可解开锁。

quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[4].en_us: The less you miss and the faster you complete the challenge, the better the loot!
quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你失误的次数越少，完成得越快，箱子里的战利品就越好！

quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: The chest will still unlock with reduced rewards if you fail. You can also use &aLock Picks&r to completely skip the minigame.
quest.455930CEC0C90C0C.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：如果你失败了，箱子还是会解锁，只是里面的战利品会减少。使用&a开锁器&r可以跳过这个小游戏。

quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bReactor Heat Absorbers&r remove a fixed amount of heat from all neighboring components making it more efficient when surrounded by components that need to be cooled.
