quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b反应堆热量吸收器&r能从所有相邻的组件上吸收固定量的热量，因此当它被需要散热的组件包围时，其冷却效率是最高的。

quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[2].en_us: It requires a constant supply of coolant in the form of ice (or blue/packed ice), which can be inserted via the &bCoolant Port&r above the &bAbsorber&r stack.
quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它需要持续供应冷却剂（冰、蓝冰或浮冰），冷却剂可以通过其上方的&b冷却剂口&r输入。

quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[4].en_us: The amount of coolant used is fixed, and does not increase with more sides being cooled. Each tick, 16 units of heat are removed from each neighbor.
quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 冷却剂的消耗量是固定的，不会随被冷却组件数量的增多而增加。每Tick，它都会从每个相邻的组件上吸收16单位的热量。

quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[6].en_us: A &bReactor Coolant Port&r must be placed on the outer ceiling of the &dReactor&r, with &bHeat Absorbers&r beneath it.
quest.456030ECDFA9CE3B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &b反应堆冷却剂吸收器口&r需要放置在&d反应堆&r外壳的顶面上，其下方需要放上&b热量吸收器&r。

quest.456904808D93A9E3.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.456904808D93A9E3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.456904808D93A9E3.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.456904808D93A9E3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.456B067C9CC123AD.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've crafted a &cHeater&r, you should return to the &dFabricator&r to learn how to use it with the &6World Engine&r.
quest.456B067C9CC123AD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作出一台&c加热器&r后，你需要回到&d构件师&r处，学习如何将其与&6世界引擎&r协同使用。

quest.45A3E686E32AB95D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Found within the &bTwilight Forest&r ring, the vault of the &aLich&r is the first of five Twilight bosses you need to find.
quest.45A3E686E32AB95D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a暮光巫妖&r宝库位于&b暮色森林&r环，它将是与你交手的第一个暮色Boss。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dReactor&r needs to be made of rectangular walls, where the frame is made of &aReactor Wall&r blocks. The max size of a Reactor is 64 blocks per direction. Its interior needs to be identical in the vertical (y) axis.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d反应堆&r必须是一个长方体结构，其框架必须由&a反应堆墙&r方块构成。反应堆的最大尺寸为64x64x64。其内部每一层（Y轴方向）的布局都必须完全相同。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Somewhere on the walls, you'll need the &6Nuclear Reactor Control Panel&r, as well as any &cEnergy Ports&r that you wish to use.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要在外壳的某处安装一个&6核反应堆控制面板&r，以及那些你要用的&c能量端口&r。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[4].en_us: While it's possible to make a small 3x3x3 Reactor, it's best to start with a 5x5x5 to properly cool it down.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 虽然3x3x3的小型反应堆也是能造出来的，但为了保证良好的散热，推荐你从5x5x5的尺寸开始。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[6].en_us: Even though the &dReactor&r allows for some heat build-up, a properly cooled design should not produce any leaking heat.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 尽管&d反应堆&r允许一定程度的热量积聚，但一个散热良好的反应堆应该不会发生热泄露。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[8].en_us: You can design your &dReactors&r as you wish. In general, &aDual/Quad Rods&r use fuel more efficiently, generating more total RF per pellet, but are also much harder to cool.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你可以随心所欲地设计你的&d反应堆&r。总的来说，&a双联或四联反应堆棒&r的燃料效率更高，每个燃料球能产生的RF更多，但是也更难冷却。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[10].en_us: You can use active cooling with the &bHeat Absorbers&r, or passive cooling with just &cHeat Vents&r.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 你可以使用&b热量吸收器&r主动散热，或是仅使用&c散热口&r被动散热。

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[12].en_us: If a &aFuel Rod&r contains a temperature of over 2000°C for a long period of time, it will overheat and trigger a &cNUCLEAR MELTDOWN&r!
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 如果一根&a燃料棒&r的温度长时间超过2000°C，它就会过热，然后引发&c堆 芯 熔 毁&r！

quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[14].en_us: Warning sirens will engage before it reaches those temperatures. Depending on the size of the &dReactor&r and the number of &aFuel Rods&r, the meltdown will result in a bigger or smaller explosion.
quest.45B2C8BD2ACBA46D.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 在温度达到临界点前，警报器会响起。根据&d反应堆&r的尺寸和&a燃料棒&r的数量，堆芯熔毁将导致不同规模的爆炸。

quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[0].en_us: Found within lower deepslate, the &3Ancient City&r holds a giant portal that can finally be activated, allowing you to defeat the boss within.
quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3远古城市&r坐落于深板岩环的下层，其中有一个巨大的传送门，现在你终于可以激活它，并击杀其中的boss了。

quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[2].en_us: Upon entering the portal you will receive a blindness effect that can only be cured by filling your &dSoul Cage&r with mob souls dropped from killing strengthened enemies inside the &3Vault&r.
quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 进入传送门后，你将获得一个失明效果。击杀&3宝库&r中被强化的怪物，你的&d灵魂之笼&r便能吸收它们的灵魂并治愈你的失明。

quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[4].en_us: &cYou must hold the &dSoul Cage &cin your offhand to charge it!
quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &c你必须在副手持有&d灵魂之笼&c才能为其充能！

quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[6].en_us: Once you have filled your &dSoul Cage&r, you may start the boss fight by taking the elevator in the starting room.
quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 当你充满&d灵魂之笼&r后，你就能乘坐初始房间的电梯与boss对战了。

quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eNote&r: Killing mobs with the &6Reaper&r enchantment will fill your Cage quicker (+1 per Level)
quest.45BA73F16B7AE681.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e注意&r：使用附魔了&6收割者&r的武器击杀怪物能更快地填充灵魂之笼（每级+1）

quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[0].en_us: Need a place to store all of your experience so you don't lose it when you die?
quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 需要一个存储你经验的地方吗？这样你死了也不会失去经验。

quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aExperience Holder&r from &6Just Dire Things&r is easy to use, and can also be used to collect experience around it in a configurable range.
quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 来自&6Just Dire Things&r的&a经验存储器&r使用简单，还可以在可配置的范围内收集经验。

quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aExperience Obelisk&r from &6Cognition&r works the same way!
quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 来自&6认知&r模组的&a经验方尖碑&r，工作原理相同！

quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7Even if you think you aren't going to die when going to the Arcane Grove, you probably should be safe and store your experience anyway.&r
quest.45CB3F325010A5AD.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &7即使你认为自己去奥术林地时不会死，你最好还是安全起见，把你的经验存起来。

quest.45CB4500F3CEF539.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMaterial Stonework Factory&r from &bIndustrial Foregoing&r can infinitely generate different types of stone blocks over time.
quest.45CB4500F3CEF539.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b工业先锋&r的&a造石加工机&r可以无限的生成不同种类的石类方块。

quest.45CB4500F3CEF539.quest_desc[2].en_us: To see the many different items the Factory can make, hit &bU&r on it while in JEI.
quest.45CB4500F3CEF539.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在JEI内按下&bU&r来查询造石机可以制造多少不同的物品。

quest.45E7D62C229F898C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCrafting Grid&r allows you to access all connected inventories and craft with them at one central location.
quest.45E7D62C229F898C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 通过&a合成终端&r，你可以集中访问所有已连接的存储，并直接使用其中的物品进行合成。

quest.45E7D62C229F898C.quest_desc[2].en_us: Just like other Panels, these cannot connect to &3Dense Cables&r. Glass, Covered, or Smart Cables will work!
quest.45E7D62C229F898C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 合成终端和别的面板一样，无法连接到&3致密线缆&r上；但是玻璃线缆、包层线缆和智能线缆可以！

quest.45E7D62C229F898C.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &bStorage Bus&r allows you to connect your existing storages to your network.
quest.45E7D62C229F898C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b存储总线&r可以把连接的所有的存储方块并入AE网络。

quest.461A01BDC4D4B1BD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aConstructors&r can place blocks or items in the world from your storage network.
quest.461A01BDC4D4B1BD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a成型器&r可以将网络中的方块或物品放置到世界中。

quest.461A01BDC4D4B1BD.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aDestructors&r can break blocks or items in the world and place them into your storage network.
quest.461A01BDC4D4B1BD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a破坏器&r可破坏世界中的方块或物品，并收集到你的存储网络中。

quest.461A01BDC4D4B1BD.quest_desc[4].en_us: Each &eCable Tiers&r upgrade works faster than its previous tier and has more filter slots.
quest.461A01BDC4D4B1BD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e多级线缆&r模组提供了许多升级版本的输入器，越高级的工作速度越快，过滤槽位越多。

quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[0].en_us: Before we dive into &eApotheosis&r, we need to cover what an &bAffix&r is!
quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在深入游玩&e神化&r模组前，我们得先弄明白&b词缀&r究竟是什么！

quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[2].en_us: An &bAffix&r is the driving force behind all &eApotheosis&r gear. Each &bAffix&r is very similar to an enchantment, providing a bonus to the item it is attached to.
quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b词缀&r是&e神化&r装备的力量来源。&b词缀&r的作用与附魔非常相似，可以给附有该词缀的物品提供增益效果。

quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[4].en_us: &bAffix&r items can be found when exploring the world and their effects vary based on the item's rarity. They are more commonly dropped from &eApotheosis&r boss monsters which can be found in underground caves or have a chance to randomly appear during the night.
quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以在探索世界的时候找到带有&b词缀&r的物品，它们的增益效果大小由稀有度决定。这些物品通常由&e神化&rboss掉落，它们会出现在地底的洞穴，偶尔也会在晚上随机刷新出来。

quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[6].en_us: There are a few different types of &bAffixes&r, each affecting a specific part of the item such as: Stats, Effects, Durability, and &bGem Sockets&r, which will be covered in the &bGems&r section.
quest.464AED8311A32476.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &b词缀&r有不同的种类，一种词缀只会影响物品的一个特定部分如：属性、药水效果、耐久和&b宝石镶孔&r，这在后面的&b宝石&r部分中会介绍到。

quest.466E449BFD87E62F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cAncient Battleground&r can be found within the upper part of the &cNether&r ring.
quest.466E449BFD87E62F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c远古战场&r会生成在&c下界&r环的上层。

quest.469C88B6CEC1F9E7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Cognition&r is a mod that expands on the use, storage, and production of &2experience&r.
quest.469C88B6CEC1F9E7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2认知&r模组扩展了&2经验&r的用途、存储手段和生产方式。

quest.469C88B6CEC1F9E7.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started in the mod, there will be a few entry-level materials that will be easier to make once a few of the devices are set up. We'll provide some extras.
quest.469C88B6CEC1F9E7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要发展本模组，你需要弄一些初期材料，之后这些材料就可以通过本模组的机器更轻松地制作了。任务将提供一些额外的指导。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[0].en_us: Before you start building out your &bAE Network&r, it's time to talk about &2Channels&r. Don't worry, the pack's default is set to &b4x by default&r with the intention of having an easier time for players who might be new to &eAE2&r.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 搭建属于你的&bAE网络&r前，首先了解一下有关&2频道&r的知识吧。也不必过分担心，这个包的AE频道数量&b翻了四倍&r，对&eAE2&r新手极其友好。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[2].en_us: &2Channels&r are essentially the limit of the total number of devices that your Network can interact with at one time. This can be increased with some clever mechanics and the use of multiblock &3Controllers&r, which will be discussed in a different quest.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &2频道&r的本质，就是你的网络在同一时间内能够交互的设备数量上限。这个上限可以通过一些巧妙的机制，或是搭建多方块结构的&3控制器&r来提升，相关内容我们会在另一个任务中讨论。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[4].en_us: With the increased settings, you have &232 Channels&r per network before needing to add more channels.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在当前整合包的设定下，你的每个网络在需要扩容前，最多可以拥有&232个频道&r。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[6].en_us: To connect different parts of your networks, you can do this by using 3 different types of ME Cables: &bGlass Cables&r, &3Dense Cables&r, and &dSmart Cables&r.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你可以用三种不同的ME线缆连通网络，这三种线缆分别为&b玻璃线缆&r，&3致密线缆&r，以及&d智能线缆&r。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[8].en_us: Each of these cables carry a different number of &2Channels&r. This means you might run into issues if you run &bGlass Cables&r to every single part of your network when you get towards the end game.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 每种线缆能够承载的&2频道&r数量各不相同。这意味着，当游戏进入后期，如果你只用&b玻璃线缆&r来连接网络的每个角落，就可能会遇到问题。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[10].en_us: &bGlass Cables&r transfer power, but can also transfer up to &232 Channels&r with the pack's settings.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &b玻璃线缆&r可以传输能量，在该整合包设定下可以传递&232个频道&r。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[12].en_us: &dSmart Cables&r don't add more channels, but give you a visual of how many channels are being used with lines on the cable itself.
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: &d智能线缆&r传递频道数和玻璃线缆一样，但是它可视化了线缆的频道负载。

quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[14].en_us: &3Dense Cables&r can transfer up to &2128 Channels&r, but does not support connecting to Buses or Panels. You can also make &dDense Smart Cables&r!
quest.46A1341E5E97ABDC.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: &3致密线缆&r最多可以传递&2128个频道&r，但不能连接总线和面板。如果你想的话可以制作&d智能致密线缆&r！

quest.47547FC5591CE0D3.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eActually Additions&r mainly revolves around creating and empowering crystals by zapping them with LASERS!
quest.47547FC5591CE0D3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e实用拓展&r的主要内容就是用激光制造水晶，然后用激光给水晶充能！

quest.47547FC5591CE0D3.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started, you'll need to level a &2Geologist&r to at least level 2 and have them brush &3Soul Sand&r for you.
quest.47547FC5591CE0D3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 想开始玩本模组，你需要一个至少2级的&2地质学家&r，让他帮你刷&3灵魂沙&r。

quest.4784FDEE62A479D0.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aDemon's Dream Seeds&r can be rarely gotten from breaking grass or by using a &aCrook&r on &eSand&r.
quest.4784FDEE62A479D0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 破坏草丛或用&a石钩子&r挖掘&e沙子&r，有小概率获得&a魔鬼之梦种子&r。

quest.4784FDEE62A479D0.quest_desc[2].en_us: Should you choose the path of the Occult, this seed may prove useful in opening your &bThird Eye&r.
quest.4784FDEE62A479D0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你选择走上神秘学的探究道路，这个种子可能会帮助你开启&b第三只眼&r。

quest.4784FDEE62A479D0.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &6Dictionary of Spirits&r is the guidebook for the mod, but it's also needed for certain recipes, and can be used to create &bholograms&r to help you build out &dRituals&r!
quest.4784FDEE62A479D0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &6魔灵全典&r提供此模组的全部入门指导。同时它也作为某些物品的合成材料之一，还能用于展示&b全息图&r来辅助你搭建&d仪式&r！

quest.47C1E9F93CEF25D3.quest_desc[0].en_us: Increasing your &3Unearther Level&r will also increase the types of drops you get from brushing blocks.
quest.47C1E9F93CEF25D3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提升&3发掘等级&r也可以丰富你刷方块得到的物品的种类。

quest.47D745A94C534B48.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of the Magician&r.
quest.47D745A94C534B48.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多的&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，去寻找&d魔法师的回响&r了。

quest.47D745A94C534B48.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock the &3Source Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.47D745A94C534B48.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&3魔源升级&r。

quest.47D745A94C534B48.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo magician&7.
quest.47D745A94C534B48.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo magician&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.48005B47655AD525.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the power of &dSource Gems&r, you can harness the flow of &dSource&r by making a &2Source Relay&r.
quest.48005B47655AD525.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 借助&d魔源宝石&r的力量，你可以制造出&2魔源中转器&r，掌控&d魔源&r的流动。

quest.48005B47655AD525.quest_desc[2].en_us: Using a &aDominion Wand&r, you can direct the flow of &dSource&r between jars.
quest.48005B47655AD525.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以使用&a支配之杖&r引导&d魔源&r在魔源罐之间流动。

quest.48005B47655AD525.quest_desc[4].en_us: By installing the &dSource&r &3World Engine Upgrade&r, you can direct &dSource&r into the engine to craft more magical items.
quest.48005B47655AD525.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 安装&d魔源&r&3世界引擎&r升级后，你就可以将&d魔源&r注入引擎，合成更多的魔法物品了。

quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aDiesel Generator&r generates &dHV&r power by consuming fuels like &2Diesel&r.
quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a柴油发电机&r可以燃烧&2柴油&r等燃料，产生&d高压&r能量。

quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[2].en_us: Depending on the fuel used, certain fuels will burn for longer inside the generator, creating more power.
quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 不同燃料的发电量也有所不同，有些燃料在发电机内可以燃烧更长时间，产生更多的能量。

quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[4].en_us: For a full list of fuels check the &bEngineer's Manual&r or JEI.
quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以在&b工程师手册&r或JEI中查看完整的燃料表。

quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[6].en_us: To learn more about building and using them, refer to the &aElectrical Grids&r section of the &bEngineer's Manual&r.
quest.4843F5564CA5810C.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 要了解更多有关发电机的搭建与使用的信息，请参阅&b工程师手册&r的&a电网&r部分。

quest.4882D3E03CC01268.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bStorage Buses&r allow your network to see and interact with items inside an external storage block/network, such as a chest, or &eStorage Controller&r (from &6Functional Storage&r mod).
quest.4882D3E03CC01268.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &bME存储总线&r能让你的ME网络读取并操作外部容器或存储网络里的物品，比如一个普通的箱子，或是来自&6功能性存储&r模组的&e存储控制器&r。

quest.4882D3E03CC01268.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bStorage Buses&r come in different types, and can also be filtered to only allow certain items to be stored and interacted with.
quest.4882D3E03CC01268.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &bME存储总线&r有多种不同类型，并且可以配置过滤器，从而只允许特定的物品存入或进行交互。

quest.4882D3E03CC01268.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oIt is possible to create an essentially infinite storage network that only takes up one channel.
quest.4882D3E03CC01268.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o利用这个特性，你可以搭建一个仅占用单一频道，但容量近乎无限的存储网络。

quest.4887C8EA4441F62B.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cFuel Generator&r is a 3x3x2 multiblock generator that consumes oil-like fluids to generate power.
quest.4887C8EA4441F62B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c燃料发电机&r是一个3x3x2的多方块发电机，它可以消耗油类流体发电。

quest.4887C8EA4441F62B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Higher tier fuels provide the same RF/t, but lasts a lot longer!
quest.4887C8EA4441F62B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 不同燃料的产能速率（RF/t）相同，但高级的燃料可以燃烧更久！

quest.4887C8EA4441F62B.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Hitting &aU&r on the Fuel Generator will show a full list of fuels that can be used.
quest.4887C8EA4441F62B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：将鼠标放在燃料发电机上，按&aU&r键，即可查看可用燃料列表。

quest.48935E2DFCA1E835.quest_desc[0].en_us: By milking the &zMighty Ender Chicken&r, you can acquire &zMolten Chaos&r that can be solidified into &zChaos Shards&r used to upgrade your infusion setup and craft the most advanced &eDE&r items.
quest.48935E2DFCA1E835.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 通过榨取&z威猛末影鸡&r，你能从它身上获得&z熔融混沌&r并制成&z混沌碎片&r，这能用于升级你的融合注入装置，并制作最高级的&e龙之进化&r物品。

quest.48935E2DFCA1E835.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can now upgrade your &6Draconic Gear&r to &zChaotic Tier&r.
quest.48935E2DFCA1E835.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你现在能将你的&6神龙装备&r升级到&z混沌等级&r了。

quest.48B3D104BEFE1959.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using a &aMechanical Saw&r from &6Create&r, you can create a contraption that can automatically harvest grown trees for you!
quest.48B3D104BEFE1959.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用&6机械动力&r的&a动力锯&r，你可以制作一个自动收获树木的动态结构

quest.48B3D104BEFE1959.quest_desc[2].en_us: Couple this with a &aDeployer&r to plant the saplings back, and you'll have a cool looking tree farm.
quest.48B3D104BEFE1959.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 再配上一个&a机械手&r来把树苗种回去，你就能建成一个很酷的树场了。

quest.48C1A1BB346B7D07.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using &6Time Crystals&r, you can make the &6Time Wand&r.
quest.48C1A1BB346B7D07.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用&6时间水晶&r可以制作&6时间手杖&r。

quest.48C1A1BB346B7D07.quest_desc[2].en_us: This uses &6Time Fluid&r to speed up any block it's used on, similar to the Time in a Bottle or Temporal Pouch.
quest.48C1A1BB346B7D07.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它消耗&6时间流体&r来加速所接触的方块，和时间之瓶或时间之袋之类的差不多。

quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eIron's Gems \&\ Jewelry&r is a mod that focus on combining materials and &bJewels&r to provide the player with special effects or stat increases.
quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eIron的宝石与饰品&r模组可以将各种材料与&b宝石&r组合在一起制成饰品，为玩家提供增益效果或属性加成。

quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[2].en_us: You will need to craft a &aJewelcrafting Station&r to begin making some basic &bJewelry&r.
quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在开始制作&b饰品&r之前，你需要先制作一个&a珠宝饰品工作台&r。

quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[4].en_us: To learn more advanced &bJewelry&r, you will need to find their blueprints by trading with villagers, or making a purchase from the &6Shop&r.
quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 要想制作更高级的&b饰品&r，你需要从村民或&6商店&r处购买工匠卷轴。

quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[6].en_us: Most &bJewelry&r consists of a &aBand Metal&r and a &aGem&r.
quest.496903AB7E8A0A92.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 大多数的&b饰品&r由&a环带金属&r与&a宝石&r组成。

quest.49835EC10C5AE8D8.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Quantum Crafter&r acts like a &3Molecular Assembler&r, &aPattern Provider&r, AND an &2ME Requester&r all in one.
quest.49835EC10C5AE8D8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6量子合成器&r是&3分子装配室&r、&a样板供应器&r和&2ME请求器&r的三合一设备。

quest.49835EC10C5AE8D8.quest_desc[2].en_us: It also crafts blazingly fast, can be configured to keep stock on multiple items at once, and can even be upgraded with &bAcceleration Cards&r.
quest.49835EC10C5AE8D8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 而且这玩意制造速度超级快，设置好了的话可以用来维持多个物品的库存，如果嫌慢可以用&b加速卡&r升级。

quest.49835EC10C5AE8D8.quest_desc[4].en_us: The only limit it has is that it can only store 9 &2Patterns&r total.
quest.49835EC10C5AE8D8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 唯一问题就是它里面只能放9个&2编码样板&r。

quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &3Fissile Fuel&r needed to run &dFission Reactors&r is made by processing &eSulfur&r, &7Fluoride&r, and &2Uranium&r with some water products. It seems complicated but, unlike in real life, it is easier than it seems.
quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d裂变反应堆&r所需的&3裂变燃料&r可以通过处理&e硫&r、&7氟石&r和&2铀&r和一些水一起混合制成。虽然看起来很复杂，但这是游戏，实际上要比看起来要简单。

quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[2].en_us: First, use &eSulfuric Acid&r to break down &7Fluorite&r into &9Hydrofluoric Acid&r in a &2Chemical Dissolution Chamber&r.
quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先，在&2化学溶解室&r中使用&e硫酸&r将&7氟石&r分解成&9氢氟酸&r。

quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[4].en_us: Second, enrich &aUranium&r ingots into &6Yellow Cake Uranium&r, before oxidizing it into &6Uranium Oxide&r.
quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 其次，将&a铀锭&r富集成&6铀黄饼&r，再将其氧化成&6氧化铀&r。

quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[6].en_us: Finally, combine the &9Hydrofluoric Acid&r and &6Uranium Oxide&r in a &aChemical Infuser&r before piping it into an &2Isotopic Centrifuge&r to produce &3Fissile Fuel&r.
quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 最后，在&a化学灌注机&r中混合&9氢氟酸&r和&6氧化铀&r，然后将其输送到&2同位素离心机&r中以生产&3裂变燃料&r。

quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eTip&r: &7Fluorite&r blocks take about as much &eSulfuric Acid&r to break down as a single &7Fluorite Crystal&r, but produce as much &9Hydrofluoric Acid&r as nine &7Crystals&r, saving on &eSulfur&r!
quest.49B8310D0C7A6C55.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e提示&r：&7氟石&r分解所需的&e硫酸&r量与单个&7氟石晶体l&r大致相同，但产生的&9氢氟酸&r量是九个&7氟石晶体&r的量，从而节省&e硫&r！

quest.49DD167D6323406B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Functional Storage can also handle fluid storage using &aFluid Drawers&r!
quest.49DD167D6323406B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以用功能性存储模组的&a流体抽屉&r来存储流体！

quest.49DD167D6323406B.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can either pump fluids directly into the drawer or just use a fluid bucket on it to set its fluid.
quest.49DD167D6323406B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以直接把要存储的流体输入至抽屉，或者手持一桶流体右击直接设置存储类别。

quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eDraconic Evolution&r (&eDE&r)is a mid-game to late-game mod focused around dragons, energy, and very overpowered equipment.
quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e龙之进化&r是围绕龙、能量与极强装备的游戏中后期模组。

quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started with &eDE&r, you'll first need to gather some &aDraconium Dust.
quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要开始发展&e龙之进化&r，你需要获取一些&a龙尘&r。

quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["The main way to acquire this dust is to level up your ", {"text": "Dimensionalist Unearther", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "6F91297C4FAA43FE"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Dimensionalist Quest"}}, " at least tier 4, but you may also acquire it through other methods (check JEI)."]
quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["获取这种粉尘的主要方式是将你的", {"text": "维度学家发掘室", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "6F91297C4FAA43FE"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "跳转到维度学家章节"}}, "至少升级到4阶，但你也能通过其他方法获得（查阅JEI）。"]

quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[6].en_us: You can also just manually brush &eEnd Stone&r once your &aUnearther Level&r is high enough.
quest.4A1DBDE0963407E7.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果你的&a发掘等级&r足够高，你也可以选择手动刷扫&e末地石&r。

quest.4A2EB77748103124.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon can be found in the &3Stone&r and &7Deepslate&r rings.
quest.4A2EB77748103124.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此地牢会生成在&3石头&r与&7深板岩&r环中。

quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Reactor Energy Port&r is used to output the energy generated by the &dReactor&r, and it needs to be placed on one of its outer walls.
quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2反应堆能量端口&r用于输出&d反应堆&r生成的能量，需要放置在反应堆的外壳上。

quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each port may output up to 25,000 RF/t.
quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个端口最高输出速率为25000RF/t。

quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &cReactor Redstone Port&r can disable the intake of new fuels, but will finish burning any pellet that has already started burning before the reactor is fully shut off.
quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &c反应堆红石端口&r可以禁止输入新燃料，但已开始燃烧的燃料会继续燃烧，燃尽后反应堆才会停机。

quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[6].en_us: It can also be used with a comparator to output data. It has 3 modes which can be cycled by right-clicking the port: Energy, Active Rod Count, and Temperature.
quest.4A5FD3641E0A566E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 它也可以与比较器一同使用以输出数据。它有3种模式：能量总量、非空棒数和温度，可通过右击端口来切换。

quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eFunctional Drawers&r is a storage mod that aims to provide an easy solution to storing tons of items in a single block!
quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e功能性存储&r旨在提供大宗物品的储存方式。

quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aDrawers&r come in three varieties: Single Drawers, 1x2 Drawers, and 2x2 Drawers.

quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[4].en_us: While a 2x2 drawer can store 4 separate items, the total base storage amount is also divided by 4.
quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 虽然一个2×2的抽屉能存四种不同类型的物品，但其基础物品存储量也要除以四。

quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[6].en_us: To place an item in, simply right click on the &aDrawer&r with the item. Double Right-clicking will deposit multiple stacks at a time.
quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果要把东西放进去，手持物品右击&a抽屉&r即可，右击两次抽屉会将多组物品一块存进去。

quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[8].en_us: To remove items from a &aDrawer&r, Left-clicking it will remove 1 item at a time, while Sneak + Left-clicking will pull out a full stack.
quest.4A707D443EC2DE33.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 如果要从&a抽屉&r里面取出物品，左击抽屉一次可取出一个物品，潜行左击可取出一组。

quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[0].en_us: To get more advanced types of &bFluid Cows&r, you'll need to breed specific cows together to get &cMolten Alloy&r &bFluid Cows&r.
quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了得到更多高级种类的&b流体牛&r，你需要将特定的牛繁殖来得到&c熔融合金&r&b流体牛&r。

quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[2].en_us: For example, you can breed an &aIron&r cow with a &eNickel&r cow to make an &7Invar&r &bFluid Cow&r.
quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 举例，你可以将&a铁&r牛和&e镍&r牛繁育来得到&7殷钢&r&b流体牛&r。

quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[4].en_us: To help navigate JEI better, the &aAlchemy Glass&r from the quest reward will show you the different breeding combos.
quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 为了帮助你更好地浏览JEI，作为任务奖励的&a炼金玻璃瓶&r将会向你展示不同的繁殖组合。

quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[6].en_us: You can also search up specific molten metals in JEI to see what you need to breed.
quest.4A8581D52BD1922B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你也可以在JEI中搜索特定的熔融金属，以查看你需要繁殖哪些牛才能得到。

quest.4A871B8D8648F305.quest_desc[0].en_us: Smelted from its dust form or alloyed

quest.4A871B8D8648F305.quest_desc[2].en_us: Dust from Metallurgic Infusing Nickel with Diamond

quest.4A87B0D25DE57F3F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Before you can complete the &dEnchanter's&r first task, you'll need to find a tougher version of stone.
quest.4A87B0D25DE57F3F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在完成&d附魔师&r的第一个任务之前，你需要先找到一种更坚硬的石头。

quest.4A87B0D25DE57F3F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Dig out further into the world until you find some &7Deepslate&r.
quest.4A87B0D25DE57F3F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 向世界更深处挖掘，直至找到&7深板岩&r。

quest.4A87B0D25DE57F3F.quest_desc[4].en_us: While it might not look magical, the remnants of ancient magic can be tapped into for their enchanting powers.
quest.4A87B0D25DE57F3F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 虽然它看起来没什么魔力，但其中残留的远古魔法仍然可以被利用，发挥它附魔的潜力。

quest.4AC8D1AEFCED24FD.quest_desc[0].en_us: This section refers to the different ways to transmit power &aWirelessly&r.
quest.4AC8D1AEFCED24FD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这部分介绍了&a无线&r输送能量的不同方式。

quest.4B463FDAEAC42511.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &3Matter Condenser&r will destroy any item inserted into it like a trashcan. If you provide it a Cell to act as a buffer, it can instead convert the items into &aMatter Balls&r(1-16k) or &dSingularities&r (64k+).
quest.4B463FDAEAC42511.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3物质聚合器&r会把输入的物品像垃圾一样销毁，但如果你给它插入一个1-16k的存储元件的话，则它会把输入物品转化为&a物质球&r。你也可以给它插入一个64k或以上的存储元件，此时它能够把输入的物品转化为&d奇点&r。

quest.4B463FDAEAC42511.quest_desc[2].en_us: These &dSingularities&r are critical for creating massive storages and inter-dimensional links.
quest.4B463FDAEAC42511.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d奇点&r要用来制作大规模存储设备，以及跨维度链接装置。

quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[0].en_us: Remember that these quests said you need a lot of &6Awakened Draconium&r? You need &a378&r &6Awakened Draconium Blocks&r.
quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 还记得任务里说，你将需要大量&6觉醒龙锭&r吗？时候到了，你需要&a378&r个&6觉醒龙锭块&r。

quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[2].en_us: To upgrade the &6World Engine&r, you will need to create a &aTier 8 Energy Core&r which also requires &a786&r &dDraconium Blocks&r as well.
quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要升级&6世界引擎&r，你需要制造一个&a8阶能量核心&r，这需要&a786&r个&d龙块&r。

quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 对那只鸡咯咯咯地呼唤吧。

quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&f: Recipes requiring this &3Upgrade&r will only work with an active &aEnergy Core&r.
quest.4B576E9FFA5D79CF.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&f：此&3升级&r解锁的配方只能在&a能量核心&r激活时生效。

quest.4B6154D6F9B7C7BF.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aCrafting Stations&r can pick up items stored in adjacent inventories and will also hold items in their crafting grids.
quest.4B6154D6F9B7C7BF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以从&a合成站&r中取出与其相邻容器中的物品，而且它的合成格中也可以存储物品。

quest.4B6154D6F9B7C7BF.quest_desc[2].en_us: They function like their &eTinker's Construct&r version, for those who remember that.
quest.4B6154D6F9B7C7BF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它就跟&e匠魂&r里那个一样，如果你玩过的话。

quest.4B7A9469150AF3A1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6The Psimetal Tools&r are a set of tools, comparable to &bDiamond-tier in quality&r, each of which can cast a &bSpell&r each time it performs its intended action.
quest.4B7A9469150AF3A1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Psi金属工具&r的质量相当于&b钻石级&r，每次执行其预期动作时，都可以施展一个&b术式&r。

quest.4B8E75ACE0AA6FA0.quest_desc[0].en_us: Can be acquired from Geologist in an Unearther from Crushed Kivi.

quest.4B92EBBA1F2BBFEA.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.4B92EBBA1F2BBFEA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.4BA8E435EDA995AC.quest_desc[0].en_us: You are probably tired of picking up SO MUCH COBBLE. Why not make a &aVoid Upgrade&r to help get rid of them?
quest.4BA8E435EDA995AC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可能已经厌倦了拾取 成 吨 的 圆 石 。为何不做个&a虚空升级&r把它们处理掉呢？

quest.4BA8E435EDA995AC.quest_desc[2].en_us: By itself, this upgrade can be set up to automatically void specific items that you set inside of its filter. Upgrading to the Advanced version allows for more filtering options!
quest.4BA8E435EDA995AC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个升级可以自动销毁白名单内的物品，升级后还有更多过滤选项！

quest.4BAD7359CF074014.quest_desc[0].en_us: Before you can harness the power of the void, you'll need to create a machine to craft on an atomic level.
quest.4BAD7359CF074014.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了掌控虚空的力量，你需要先制作一台机器，用于原子级的配方合成。

quest.4BAD7359CF074014.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dAtomic Forge&r is perfect for this, and can craft an ingot strong enough to hold in the void.
quest.4BAD7359CF074014.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d原子锻造器&r是最合适的选择，它能制造出强大到足以控制虚空的金属。

quest.4BAD7359CF074014.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: The &dAtomic Forge&r must be powered by the &dEnderic Laser&r.
quest.4BAD7359CF074014.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&d原子锻造器&r需要由&d末影激光器&r充能。

quest.4BB5ADD98F958712.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon spawns in the &7Stone&r and &7Deepslate&r rings.
quest.4BB5ADD98F958712.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此地牢会生成在&7石头&r与&7深板岩&r环中。

quest.4BB6832FE4685131.quest_desc[0].en_us: To use your &3Souls&r, point the &aSoul Surge&r at the block you want to accelerate and connect it to the &dSoul Laser Base&r using &aSoul Pipes&r.
quest.4BB6832FE4685131.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要使用&3灵魂&r，请将&a灵魂促速器&r指向你想要加速的方块，并使用&a灵魂管道&r将其连接到&d灵魂镭射钻&r。

quest.4BCA8A5C3F80D375.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSigil of Unnaming&r removes the Affix name of an item, reverting it to its normal item name.
quest.4BCA8A5C3F80D375.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a除名符石&r可以移除物品名称中的词缀文本，将其变回正常的物品名称。

quest.4BCA8A5C3F80D375.quest_desc[2].en_us: For example: &dEndawn the Ogre Slayer's Windswept Burnt Shoes of the Spellwarden&r will be renamed to &dBurnt Shoes&r.
quest.4BCA8A5C3F80D375.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 例如：一个&d充能的破损的时运的急迫的人的钻石镐&r除名后，就会变成&d钻石镐&r。

quest.4BEBF37F66E48801.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you feed a &bFluid Cow&r a bucket of milk, they will revert back to a regular cow.
quest.4BEBF37F66E48801.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你喂给&b流体牛&r牛奶，它们会变成普通牛。

quest.4BFF8EE3F588E006.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Enchanter&r.
quest.4BFF8EE3F588E006.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，寻找&d附魔师的回响&r了。

quest.4BFF8EE3F588E006.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock the &3Enchanting Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.4BFF8EE3F588E006.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&3附魔升级&r。

quest.4BFF8EE3F588E006.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo enchanter&7.
quest.4BFF8EE3F588E006.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo enchanter&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.4C549866DEB8DB61.quest_desc[0].en_us: To craft the &aMechanical Parts&r needed for the &3Machine Block Upgrade&r, you'll need some basic machines to make alloy wires and metal plates.
quest.4C549866DEB8DB61.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了合成&3机器方块升级&r所需的&a机械部件&r，你需要一些能制造合金线和金属板的基础机器。

quest.4C549866DEB8DB61.quest_desc[2].en_us: These plates are much easier to work with, and will reinforce the &2Machine Blocks&r to withstand &6World Engine&r crafts.
quest.4C549866DEB8DB61.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种金属板制造起来十分方便，它可以强化&2机器方块&r，使其能够胜任&6世界引擎&r的合成工作。

quest.4C549866DEB8DB61.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: These can be acquired using Productive Metalworks, Create, or Immersive Engineering.
quest.4C549866DEB8DB61.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：你可以通过Productive Metalworks模组、机械动力模组或沉浸工程模组来获取此材料。

quest.4C78823B3EFA3105.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dEnchanting Apparatus&r is basically the crafting table of Ars. It uses nearby items placed on &aArcane Pedestals&r to create new items, make enchantments, or upgrade Mage Armor later on.
quest.4C78823B3EFA3105.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d附魔装置&r是新生魔艺最基础的合成台。附魔装置所需物品要放在边上的&a奥术基座&r上，这样才能制造新物品、附魔和升级法师盔甲。

quest.4C78823B3EFA3105.quest_desc[2].en_us: To function, the Apparatus needs an &3Arcane Core&r placed underneath it. It also needs several &aArcane Pedestals&r placed within 3 blocks from the Apparatus. The number of pedestals needed depends on the recipe!
quest.4C78823B3EFA3105.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要使用附魔装置的话，首先在附魔装置底下放置一个&3奥术核心&r。在附魔装置边上需要放置多个&a奥术基座&r，且只能放置在附魔装置的三格半径内。配方要求物品越多，要放置的奥术基座就越多！

quest.4C78823B3EFA3105.quest_desc[4].en_us: Some recipes also require &dSource&r, which means you'll need &aSource Jars&r placed within 3 blocks as well.
quest.4C78823B3EFA3105.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 有些配方需要&d魔源&r，所以处理这类配方时你需要在三格内放置一个装有魔源的&a魔源罐&r。

quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aReplicators&r can be sped up using &dReplicator Enclosures&r, which can be Sneak+Right-clicked onto the &aReplicator&r to install it.
quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a复制器&r可以使用&d复制器外罩&r潜行+右击安装到其上来加速。

quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also configure speeds by installing a &aReplicator Motor&r. To craft the motor, you'll need to first craft the &dMatter Blueprint&r for the motor.
quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你也可以安装&a复制器马达&r来调速。为了制造马达，你首先需要制造马达的&d物质蓝图&r。

quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[4].en_us: Place this into an &aIdentification Chamber&r with a &dMemory Chip&r to teach your system how to replicate it, then craft it from the &aReplication Terminal&r.
quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将物质蓝图放入带有&d存储芯片&r的&a鉴定室&r中，来使你的系统了解如何复制出马达，然后在&a复制终端&r里合成它。

quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[6].en_us: Once installed into a &aReplicator&r, you can configure its speed. The fastest it can go is 20%, but increases the chance for the replication to fail.
quest.4CE414ADD47790B2.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 一旦将其安装到&a复制器&r上，你就可以调节它的速度。你最快可以调至加速20％，但是会增加复制失败的概率。

quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[0].en_us: Applying five arcane spirits at the totem pole and activating it will invoke &bThe Unchained Rite&r.
quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 用5个奥术精魂做一个图腾柱并激活它，它会展开&b释缚仪式&r。

quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[2].en_us: Pure archaic potential bursts through a wide local area, focusing through the organic totem to &ccorrupt&r all sorts of natural material into blighted forms, including the totem pole itself as the original form cannot handle the raw energies.
quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 纯粹的远古能量将在附近爆发开来，它会通过这根活体图腾将各种自然材料&c腐蚀&r成腐枯形态，就连图腾柱本身也无法驾驭这种原始的能量。

quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[4].en_us: The process becomes stable afterwards, an activated &aSoulwood Totem&r now more steadily channeling the energy to transmute materials placed on &aBlighted Earth&r in an extremely useful process.
quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 随后，转化进程就会稳定下来，留下一根&a灵魂木图腾&r。这根图腾柱可以更加稳定地引导能量，从而十分高效地转化&a腐枯土&r上的材料。

quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[6].en_us: The same cannot be said of resulting &aSoulwood Saplings&r however, which reproduces this rush of blight whenever they mature. Controlled cultivation is advised, if any.
quest.4D1EBD92C674531E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 不过，对于转化出的&a灵魂树苗&r来说，事情就没这么简单了。无论种在哪里，这种树苗都会传播腐枯。如果要种的话，最好是有所控制地种。

quest.4D55D9FBE06DAA46.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you want to infuse your weapons, armor, and spell books with even more power, one of the best options is crafting some &3Upgrade Orbs&r.
quest.4D55D9FBE06DAA46.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 假如你想为你的武器或法术书灌注更多力量，那做一个&3升级法球&r是最佳选择。

quest.4D55D9FBE06DAA46.quest_desc[2].en_us: These Orbs are created by combining an &aEmpty Upgrade Orb&r with 8 &3Runes&r.
quest.4D55D9FBE06DAA46.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 把&a空白升级法球&r和8个&3符文&r一起合成即可。

quest.4D55D9FBE06DAA46.quest_desc[4].en_us: To add the Upgrade Orb to your equipment, use the &dArcane Anvil&r. Up to 3 Orbs can be applied per equipment piece.
quest.4D55D9FBE06DAA46.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 使用&d奥术铁砧&r可以将升级法球加到装备上。一件装备最多只能安装3个升级法球。

quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6B.E.E.R. (Bookshelf Extended Enchanting Reach)&r allows you to modify the range that enchanting tables scan for bookshelves!
quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6B.E.E.R.（书架附魔范围扩展）&r能让你自定义附魔台扫描书架的有效范围！

quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[2].en_us: Normally, enchanting tables only look for bookshelves in a 5x5x3 area around them. With &6B.E.E.R.&r, you can extend this out further!
quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 原版中，附魔台只会在其周围5x5x3的区域内寻找书架。有了&6B.E.E.R.&r，你就可以扩大这个检索范围了！

quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[4].en_us: To modify an enchanting table's range, you just need to hold a &amodifier block&r in your main hand and Sneak + Right-click it on the table.
quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 主手持&a修改方块&r，潜行右击附魔台，即可增加附魔台的检索范围。

quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[6].en_us: Holding a piece of &anether quartz&r in your offhand will decrease the range instead.
quest.4D64F277A4330749.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果同时副手持有&a下界石英&r，则会减少检索范围。

quest.4D6D066B0855586D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Within the Ocean ring, there is a creature that has been touched by the void.
quest.4D6D066B0855586D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在海洋环中，有一种被虚空侵染的生物。

quest.4D6D066B0855586D.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: You will need an &dAbyssal Sacrifice&r to activate the altar. The items required to craft it can be acquired from the &9Coralssus&r &aGateway of Eternity&r.
quest.4D6D066B0855586D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：你需要一个&d深渊祭品&r来激活祭坛。制作祭品所需的材料可以从&a永恒之门模组&r添加的&9珊瑚巨像传送门&r中获得。

quest.4D754E91D203A89A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that you've unlocked a few &6World Engine&r upgrades, you should head back to the &dEcho of Guidance&r.
quest.4D754E91D203A89A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 既然你已经解锁了一些&6世界引擎&r的升级项目，就请回去找&d指引者的回响&r吧。

quest.4D754E91D203A89A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Make sure you've claimed any outstanding rewards from the other &dEchoes&r.
quest.4D754E91D203A89A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 请确保你已经领取了其他&d回响&r提供的所有奖励。

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[0].en_us: When you fought the &zMighty Ender Chicken&r, you might have noticed a &aDislocator Receptacle&r in the arena. It's time to use that, because you have to milk the chicken.
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你与&z威猛末影鸡&r战斗时，也许注意到了竞技场中有个&a传送符咒收纳器&r。现在，你该用它帮你榨鸡了。

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[2].en_us: Start by setting up a &aStasis Chamber&r setup for the boss. This might be worth doing somewhere like a &dCompact Machine&r.
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先为boss准备一个&a冷凝室&r装置。也许&d压缩空间&r是个好地方。

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[4].en_us: The goal will be to teleport the &zMighty Ender Chicken&r onto a &aStasis Chamber&r so that you can use a &6Fluid Laser Drill&r to milk it.
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你的目标是将&z威猛末影鸡&r传送到&a冷凝室&r上方，这样你就能使用&6流体镭射钻&r从它身上获取资源了。

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: The chicken will teleport back if it is in the same dimension. You should set this up in a &aCompact Machine&r!
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：如果鸡与传送点在同一维度，则会被自动拉回。你需要在&a压缩机器&r中为其设置陷阱！

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[8].en_us: The &aLaser Base&r needs to be placed depending on the size of the chicken that you warp over.
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你需要根据鸡的大小来放置&a镭射站基座&r。

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[10].en_us: The goal should be to place the Base directly above the chicken's head, which if tiny, will be one block above it.
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 基座需要放置在鸡的头部正上方，如果鸡的尺寸很小，那么只需向上一格高度放置。

quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[12].en_us: To achieve a tiny chicken, as soon as you summon it, place in the &dDislocator&r to immediately open the portal.
quest.4D7C7DE95E56C7B3.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 如果要获得一只迷你体型的鸡，当你召唤它时，应立即放置&d传送符咒&r来打开传送门。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dArc Furnace&r is a massive machine used to quickly alloy metals and smelt ores.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d电弧炉&r是台用于快速冶炼矿石和制作合金的大家伙。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dArc Furnace&r can smelt batches of many items at once at the cost of larger amounts of power.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d电弧炉&r能一次熔炼大批量的不同物品，但是需要消耗大量电力。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[4].en_us: The next pages break down the &dArc Furnace's&r interface and automation.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 下面两页将详细介绍&d电弧炉&r的界面与自动化。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[6].en_us: Make sure to check out the &bEngineer's Manual&r to help you build the multiblock!
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 务必查看&b工程师手册&r来辅助搭建多方块结构！

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[10].en_us: The top three slots are for &dGraphite Electrodes&r, which will degrade with use.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 顶部的三个槽位用于安放&d石墨电极&r，石墨电极会随着使用而老化。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[12].en_us: The twelve left slots are for item inputs, with the temperature bars representing the smelting progress of each individual item.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 左侧的12个槽位用于物品输入，温度条表示各个物品的冶炼进度。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[14].en_us: The button in the top left changes whether items are spread across the twelve slots or not.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 左上角的按钮能将物品均分至12个槽位。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[16].en_us: The four right slots are for additive materials that can be used for certain recipes.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 右侧的四个槽位用于加入某些特殊配方的附加材料。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[20].en_us: Input and additives are inserted through the left and right hatches at the top of the structure.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[20].zh_cn: 结构顶部的两个接口用于物品输入和附加材料输入。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[22].en_us: The bottom slot in the back will output slag, and the front one will output the main process.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[22].zh_cn: 机器正面底部的接口用于输出产物，背面底部的接口输出矿渣。

quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[24].en_us: Energy can be inserted through the three connectors at the back.
quest.4DABDC2484C732AC.quest_desc[24].zh_cn: 背面的三个接口用于输入能量。

quest.4DE483256F9E1D4F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSigil of Withdrawal&r will remove all socketed &bGems&r on an item without damaging your item.
quest.4DE483256F9E1D4F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a摘除符石&r可以将物品上镶嵌的&b宝石&r全部移除，且不会对物品造成任何损害。

quest.4DE483256F9E1D4F.quest_desc[2].en_us: These can also be bought from the &zShop&r!
quest.4DE483256F9E1D4F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在&z商店&r里购买这些符石！

quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Cores&r are an &aessential part of your CAD&r, always try to make the best one you can, &athey're basically the CPU of your CAD&r.
quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6核心&r是&aCAD中的关键部分&r，尽可能制作最好的吧——&a它们本质上是CAD的CPU&r。

quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[2].en_us: Every &6CAD Core&r has a &d&lComplexity Value&r&r, which means &dhow many computations it is able to do&r.
quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个&6CAD核心&r都有一个&d&l复杂度&r&r，这代表&d它能够执行多少计算&r。

quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[3].en_us: &8&o(Selectors, Operators e etc can increase the Complexity of a Spell)&r&r
quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: &8&o（选择符、运算符等会增加术式的复杂度）&r&r

quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[5].en_us: Also, Every &6CAD Core&r has a &3&lProjection Value&r&r, which is simply the &3total number of non-debug tricks it can perform at once&r.
quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: 此外，每个&6CAD核心&r都有一个&3&l映射值&r&r，这就是&3它能一次执行的非调试启动式的总数&r。

quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[7].en_us: These &6Cores&r in particular can provide you with either:
quest.4E4434B6CE1F2560.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: 这些&6核心&r可以为你提供：

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Draconic Reactor&r is the ultimate energy generator, capable of producing hundreds of millions of RF/t with the correct setup. &cThis Reactor can explode!&r
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6神龙反应堆&r是终极产能装置，正确搭建后，便能实现数以百万计的产能速率。&c这种反应堆会爆炸！&r

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[2].en_us: To start setting one, place the &6Reactor Core&r in the center with the &aStabilizers&r up to 5 blocks away from it each in a separate direction, and the &2Injector&r above or below it.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 若要开始搭建，首先需要在其中心位置放置&6反应堆核心&r，并在核心的四周放置&a稳定器&r，至多距离5格方块，然后在核心上方或下方放置&2反应堆能量注入器&r。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[4].en_us: To fuel the Reactor, you must provide it with &6Awakened Draconium&r (max 8 blocks at a time) and a massive amount of energy: the more energy you provide, the more energy it'll produce.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要为反应堆提供&6觉醒龙锭&r（一次最多8个块）和大量能量以激活它：你提供的能量越多，产出的能量就越多。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[9].en_us: Before you can power on your reactor, you'll be met with this interface, and you'll need to know what's what to avoid a Reactor meltdown that will nuke everything within 500 blocks.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[9].zh_cn: 在开启反应堆前，你将先看到这个界面，你需要了解界面各部分的含义，以防止反应堆熔毁，那会摧毁500格范围内的所有东西。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[11].en_us: We'll go over the interface, from left to right, on the next page ->
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[11].zh_cn: 在下一页，我们将从左到右依次介绍此界面->

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[13].en_us: - Core Temperature: Requires at least 2000°C to Activate the Reactor. A temperature of 8000°C or higher will begin heating up the core exponentially, increasing the chance of a meltdown occurring.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[13].zh_cn: —核心温度：激活反应堆需要至少2000°C。温度超过8000°C时，核心温度将指数级增长，提高其熔毁概率。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[15].en_us: - Containment Field Strength: Controls the protection around the core. If this reaches 0 the Reactor will explode. The lower this value the more power you can make.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[15].zh_cn: —控制场强度：控制着核心周围的防护场。如果降至0，反应堆就会爆炸。但其值越低，产出的能量就越高。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[17].en_us: - Energy Saturation: Increases as it absorbs more energy and reduces when you pull out energy. The higher the saturation the lower the generation rate. Higher Saturation also increases temperature
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[17].zh_cn: —能量储量：吸收能量时会增加其值，输出能量时就会降低。储量越多，产能速率就越低，温度就越高。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[19].en_us: - Fuel Conversion: How much fuel you have left and how much has been converted into energy (how much fuel is spent per tick to keep the reactor going). A perfectly balanced reactor burns nothing per tick. The Longer it stays balanced the longer it'll maintain its temperature.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[19].zh_cn: —燃料消耗进度：表示剩余燃料量和已转化为能量的燃料量（即维持反应堆运行时，每tick的燃料消耗）。每tick消耗0燃料时达到完美平衡，保持平衡的时间越久，控温时间就越久。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[23].en_us: Once everything is in place and you've provided fuel to your Reactor, you can safely hit "Charge" to start the Reactor.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[23].zh_cn: 准备好后，你就能为反应堆提供燃料，并安全地按下“充能”按钮开启反应堆。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[25].en_us: First, it'll change the Containment Field and Energy Saturation to 50%, then start heating up to 2kC. At this point it'll give you the option to Activate the reactor. If all goes well, nothing blows up.
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[25].zh_cn: 首先，它会将控制场强度和能量储量设置到50%，并升温至2000°C。此时，它会为你提供激活反应堆的选项。如果一切顺利，就不会发生爆炸。

quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[27].en_us: Your "Active" interface should look something like this:
quest.4E474C940C683371.quest_desc[27].zh_cn: 你的“激活”界面应该与下图类似：

quest.4E623BAFD92591EE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aStaff of Travelling&r is a powerful tool that allows you to teleport forward a short distance by Sneak + Right-clicking.
quest.4E623BAFD92591EE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a旅行权杖&r是一件非常有用的工具，手持时，潜行+右击能向前传送一小段距离。

quest.4E623BAFD92591EE.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aTravel Anchors&r allow you to set a waypoint that can be teleported to when holding the &aStaff of Travelling&r, so long as that block waypoint is within visible range.
quest.4E623BAFD92591EE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a旅行锚&r可作为一个传送点，当你手持&a旅行权杖&r时，可以在各个传送点之间传送，只要目标传送点在可视范围内即可。

quest.4E623BAFD92591EE.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: &aTravel Anchors&r require the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.4E623BAFD92591EE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&a旅行锚&r，需要先用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.4E6EC6E1A507A52B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dEnder Gates&r can be placed down on any machine to transfer power wirelessly.
quest.4E6EC6E1A507A52B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d末影道门&r可以放置在任何机器上，无线传输能量。

quest.4E6EC6E1A507A52B.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["These will only work if you have enough power in your ", {"text": "Ender Cell", "color": "dark_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "1CFBFD1CE648772F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Ender Cells Quest"}}, " network." ]
quest.4E6EC6E1A507A52B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["只有当你的", {"text": "末影单元", "color": "dark_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "1CFBFD1CE648772F"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往末影单元任务"}}, "网络中存有足够的能量时，这些设备才能正常工作。"]

quest.4E9EBB1268DEF8A6.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oWhen working, this block generates explosions that deal significant player damage, but has no effect on terrain.
quest.4E9EBB1268DEF8A6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o工作时，发电机产生的爆炸会对玩家造成高额伤害，但不会破坏地形。

quest.4F27342D2DA7C605.quest_desc[0].en_us: Smashing &7Gravel&r down further turns it into &aDirt&r!
quest.4F27342D2DA7C605.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 进一步粉碎&7沙砾&r即可获得&a泥土&r！

quest.4F27342D2DA7C605.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aDirt&r is always filled with some kind of seed or sapling.
quest.4F27342D2DA7C605.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a泥土&r里往往藏着种子或树苗。

quest.4F27342D2DA7C605.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 用&a石钩子&r挖掘&a泥土&r试试吧。

quest.4F2B35E4E3729560.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the final upgrade in place, the &6World Engine&r has been completely restored to its full functionality.
quest.4F2B35E4E3729560.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 正确安装最终升级之后，&6世界引擎&r的功能完全复原了。

quest.4F3CA2DCE719D18A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Quantum Multithreader&r will effectively multiply all &bCo-Processors&r in the multiblock by 4.
quest.4F3CA2DCE719D18A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 安装&6量子多线程模块&r后，多方块结构内的所有&b并行处理单元&r计入数量乘四。

quest.4F3CA2DCE719D18A.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can only use 1 per multiblock structure.
quest.4F3CA2DCE719D18A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个多方块合成器只允许放一个量子计算机。

quest.4F72252AD2DCAECC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAutocrafting Upgrade&r will start an automatic crafting request for the missing resource when it is trying to export it from your network.
quest.4F72252AD2DCAECC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 设备安装了&a自动合成升级&r后，当它需要输出特定资源而网络中的储量不足时，它会自动发起合成请求以补充该物品。

quest.4FA08F4A78785162.quest_desc[0].en_us: Whether you need to break, place, or even swap out blocks in the world, &6Just Dire Things&r has a machine for it.
quest.4FA08F4A78785162.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 无论你需要破坏、放置、还是交换世界中的方块，&6Just Dire Things&r的机器都能满足你的需要。

quest.4FA08F4A78785162.quest_desc[2].en_us: These machines are easy to use and configure within their interfaces.
quest.4FA08F4A78785162.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些机器的用法简单，你还可以在机器的GUI里轻松配置机器。

quest.4FE01499D831CACC.quest_desc[0].en_us: As you unlock more &6World Engine&r recipes, you will notice that some of them will require fluids.
quest.4FE01499D831CACC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6世界引擎&r配方的解锁，你会发现部分配方需消耗流体。

quest.4FE01499D831CACC.quest_desc[2].en_us: Make sure the fluid inside the &6World Engine&r is placed in the correct tank shown in JEI, otherwise the recipe will not function properly.
quest.4FE01499D831CACC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 请务必参考JEI，将流体注入&6世界引擎&r中对应的储罐，否则配方将无法运作。

quest.4FE945C26EDB2A53.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Souls&r allow you to speed up almost any machine by accelerating its tickrate for 15 seconds per &3Soul&r.
quest.4FE945C26EDB2A53.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以使用&3灵魂&r加速几乎所有机器，每个&3灵魂&r可加速15秒。

quest.4FE945C26EDB2A53.quest_desc[2].en_us: These &3Souls&r can be extracted from a &dWarden&r by setting up a &bSoul Laser Base&r above it, and powering it with &aLaser Drills&r. Then, place your &bBlue Laser Lens&r inside it to begin extraction.
quest.4FE945C26EDB2A53.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些&3灵魂&r可以通过在&d监守者&r上方搭建&b灵魂镭射钻基座&r，并用&a镭射钻&r供能来提取。在基座内放入&b蓝色镭射透镜&r即可开始抽取。

quest.4FE945C26EDB2A53.quest_desc[4].en_us: A &dStasis Chamber&r underneath the &dWarden&r will not only freeze it in place, but will also heal it over time (improved with addons).
quest.4FE945C26EDB2A53.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d冷凝室&r可以让在它上方的&d监守者&r无法移动，且会治疗怪物让其随时间的推移而不会挂掉（插件有效）。

quest.500074C1D4EC9591.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of the Catalyst&r.
quest.500074C1D4EC9591.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，寻找&d精械师的回响&r了。

quest.500074C1D4EC9591.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock several &3Upgrades&r, including the &cAdvanced Machine Block&r upgrade for your &bWorld Engine&r!
quest.500074C1D4EC9591.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&b世界引擎&r解锁多个&3升级&r，包括&c高级机器方块&r升级！

quest.500074C1D4EC9591.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo catalyst&7.
quest.500074C1D4EC9591.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo catalyst&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.50B0E45705EDB5F2.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.50B0E45705EDB5F2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.50B0E45705EDB5F2.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.50B0E45705EDB5F2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.50B7A38F7E66139C.quest_desc[0].en_us: Heat is easy to generate, but very easy to lose when transferring between machines.
quest.50B7A38F7E66139C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 热量很容易产生，但在机器间传递时也很容易散失。

quest.50B7A38F7E66139C.quest_desc[2].en_us: To reduce the loss of heat, there are special cables for this specific use.
quest.50B7A38F7E66139C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 使用为此特制的线缆可以减少热量的损失。

quest.50B7A38F7E66139C.quest_desc[4].en_us: Craft a few of the &dUltimate Thermodynamic Conductors&r. These should do the trick.
quest.50B7A38F7E66139C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 合成一些&d终极热导线缆&r。它们应该能派上用场。

quest.50B7CA94F8BB6F58.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCentrifuge&r is a simple machine that separates and transforms specific items, most notably &3Carbon Fibre Strands&r.
quest.50B7CA94F8BB6F58.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a离心机&r是一个可以分离转化一些特定物品的机器，常用于产出&3碳纤维&r。

quest.50B7CA94F8BB6F58.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine can be upgraded to separate fluids with the &bMachine Fluid Addon&r to make items like &bPlastic&r, or can be used to automate ore processing when using a &6Fragment Forge&r later down the road.
quest.50B7CA94F8BB6F58.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这台机器后续可以安装&b流体处理插件&r来分离流体，从而制作例如&b塑料片&r等物品，或者配合后期的&6粉碎工厂&r来自动化处理矿物。

quest.50BB7069AC5A1A14.quest_desc[0].en_us: You can find &zTyros&r in the &cCitadel&r that spawns in the &dVoid Chasms&r ring.
quest.50BB7069AC5A1A14.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z泰罗斯&r可在&c废弃堡垒&r中找到，而该堡垒会生成在&d虚空裂隙&r环中。

quest.50BB7069AC5A1A14.quest_desc[2].en_us: You will need a &cCinderous Soulcaller&r to summon the boss.
quest.50BB7069AC5A1A14.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 召唤此boss需要用到&c寻魂烬铃&r。

quest.50E133C3E351255E.quest_desc[0].en_us: Why use machines to create resources when you can grow some chickens from the mod &eRoost Ultimate&r!
quest.50E133C3E351255E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 既然你可以培育&eRoost Ultimate&r的小鸡，为啥要做机器去生产资源呢？

quest.50E133C3E351255E.quest_desc[2].en_us: This mod contains a chicken type for most resources in the pack, with the only exception being alloys. You can make Fluid Cows for those!
quest.50E133C3E351255E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个模组的鸡包括了该整合包里大多数资源，唯一的例外是合金。不过你可以用流体牛来得到这些！

quest.50E133C3E351255E.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once you've gotten your hands on an egg and a feather, you should make the &aChicken Stick&r. This serves as the wrench for the mod, and allows you to pick up chickens from the world.
quest.50E133C3E351255E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 当你获得了鸡蛋和羽毛后，你就可以制作&a鸡调试棒&r了。它是这个模组的扳手，可以让你从世界中拾取鸡。

quest.50EFBD8BDE0C88AF.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aRange Upgrade&r increases the range of the &3Wireless Transmitter&r, from 16 up to 48 blocks.

quest.5119EFBB9FB39CDE.quest_desc[0].en_us: You might find one of these in the &dArcane Grove&r structure, or from the &dTale of a Priest who knew too much!&r Gateway.
quest.5119EFBB9FB39CDE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可能会在&d奥术林地&r结构中找到其中之一，也可从&d一则传说——一位知道了太多的牧师&r传送门中找到。

quest.511B01F40006FC4B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &zInfinity Tools&r are unbreakable tools that can instantly break blocks.
quest.511B01F40006FC4B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z无尽工具&r可以立刻破坏方块，而且不会损坏。

quest.511B01F40006FC4B.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &zPickaxe&r and &zShovel&r can be 'Shift + Right-Clicked' to toggle modes, instantly vaporizing large areas of your world.
quest.511B01F40006FC4B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &z世界崩解之镐&r和&z星球吞噬之铲&r可以通过“Shift+右击”切换模式，在第二形态下可以瞬间清除一大片区域的方块。

quest.5151A30EB06C1122.quest_desc[0].en_us: Passively spawned chickens can drop eggs randomly, but you can also get the eggs before the chickens.
quest.5151A30EB06C1122.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 鸡会下蛋，但是没有鸡刷新出来的时候，你也可以弄到鸡蛋。

quest.5151A30EB06C1122.quest_desc[2].en_us: They may randomly drop from the &bLoot Bee&r event, or, if you're very lucky, the &bChicken Jockey&r event may also lay an egg.
quest.5151A30EB06C1122.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 比如说&b战利品蜜蜂&r事件中，蜜蜂可能会下蛋，或者，如果你很欧，&b鸡骑士&r事件中的那只鸡也有可能下个蛋给你。

quest.5151A30EB06C1122.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["With access to eggs and feathers, you can get started on the ", { "text": "Roost Ultimate", "color": "yellow", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "50E133C3E351255E"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Roost Starting Quest"} }, " mod, allowing your chickens to produce other resources than just plain old eggs."]
quest.5151A30EB06C1122.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["有了鸡蛋和羽毛，你就可以开始玩", { "text": "Roost Ultimate", "color": "yellow", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": {"action": "change_page", "value": "50E133C3E351255E"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往养鸡的任务"} }, "模组了，在那里鸡可不只是会下那几个破鸡蛋，它们还能给你生产别的资源。"]

quest.517AAA103D89A14F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Chicken Trainer&r is a gym for your chickens to level up.
quest.517AAA103D89A14F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6训练鸡器&r是为你的鸡升级的健身房。

quest.517AAA103D89A14F.quest_desc[2].en_us: If you want to beef up your chickens fast, you place them in the trainer and feed them tiered seeds.
quest.517AAA103D89A14F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你想要快速强化你的鸡，只需把它们放到训练鸡器并喂给它们对应等级的鸡饲料。

quest.517AAA103D89A14F.quest_desc[4].en_us: Instead of producing materials, the seeds will be consumed and give full experience to the chickens.
quest.517AAA103D89A14F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这不会产出材料，而是会消耗饲料，并给予鸡完整的经验值。

quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aTrash Slot&r mod allows you to open a slot in any inventory to delete unwanted items.
quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &aTrash Slot&r模组在你的物品栏界面中添加了一个能丢掉无用物品的槽位。

quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["The slot in the inventory can be toggled with the keybind ", { "keybind": "key.trashslot.toggle", "color": "green" }, "."]
quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ["该槽位可以通过快捷键", { "keybind": "key.trashslot.toggle", "color": "green" }, "来开关。"]

quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["You can also quickly delete items once the slot is open by using the keybind ", { "keybind": "key.trashslot.delete", "color": "green" }, "."]
quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["你也可以在槽位开启时，使用快捷键", { "keybind": "key.trashslot.delete", "color": "green" }, "快速清理物品。"]

quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[6].en_us: There is also the &aTrash Bin&r icon in the top left of your inventory that you can use as well. This can also be accessed by using the &a/trashcan&r command.
quest.51804232265672A9.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 同时，在你的物品栏左上方有一个&a垃圾桶&r图标，你能使用它进行相同操作，并可以通过&a/trashcan&r指令打开。

quest.51B3EF0BCEB804A4.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.51B3EF0BCEB804A4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.51B3EF0BCEB804A4.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.51B3EF0BCEB804A4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.51EBCDC63A047562.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are 3 sets of armor available through &eMalum&r.
quest.51EBCDC63A047562.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e灵灾&r模组提供了3套不同的盔甲。

quest.51EBCDC63A047562.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aSoulhunter Armor&r provides slightly more than leather-tier protection.
quest.51EBCDC63A047562.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a灵魂猎手套装&r的防御力比皮革套装稍高。

quest.51EBCDC63A047562.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b魂染钢套装&r的防御力与钻石套装相当。

quest.51EBCDC63A047562.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &d恶念要塞套装&r的防御力与下界合金套装相当。

quest.527A754FEFC95F4C.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now that you've literally milked some &zChaos&r, it's time for you to return to the &dChaos&r &6Echoborne&r.
quest.527A754FEFC95F4C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 现在你应该挤出了一些&z混沌&r，是时候返回&d混沌&r&6至高者&r身边了。

quest.52ADC3D46CCB2659.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aApotheosis&r provides the ability to relocate and upgrade &dMob Spawners&r that can be great for making your own mob farms. To move a spawner, break it with a pickaxe that has &bsilk touch&r on it.
quest.52ADC3D46CCB2659.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a神化&r模组可以转移并升级&d刷怪笼&r，以搭建属于你的刷怪场。要移动刷怪笼，用附魔&b精准采集&r的镐子挖掉即可。

quest.52ADC3D46CCB2659.quest_desc[2].en_us: Mob spawners can be changed by using a &aMob Egg&r on them, allowing you to create your own custom spawners. Using specific items on the spawners will also upgrade them to be faster, ignore spawning rules, and more!
quest.52ADC3D46CCB2659.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 对刷怪笼使用&a刷怪蛋&r可以改变刷怪类型，你可以以此创建自己的自定义刷怪笼。对其使用某些特定物品可以让刷怪速度更快、无视刷怪限制等等！

quest.52ADC3D46CCB2659.quest_desc[4].en_us: To learn more about which items to use, check the recipes in JEI for a spawner.
quest.52ADC3D46CCB2659.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在JEI中查看刷怪笼的配方来查看可使用的物品。

quest.52B46D49B5C4A7F2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dGas-Burning Generator&r can burn &dEthene&r to produce power at a very high rate! You can expect each full generator to produce ~8k RF/t.
quest.52B46D49B5C4A7F2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d燃气发电机&r可以燃烧&d乙烯&r，发电速率极高！每台满功率运行的燃气发电机产能速率约为8000RF/t。

quest.52C305EDBE2CCC55.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aGrids&r allow you to interact with and view parts of your network in different ways.
quest.52C305EDBE2CCC55.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a终端&r是你访问和管理网络的窗口，不同类型的终端提供了不同的交互方式。

quest.52C305EDBE2CCC55.quest_desc[2].en_us: The standard &aGrid&r allows you to view, remove, and insert resources into your storage network, send recipe requests, and many more things.
quest.52C305EDBE2CCC55.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 标准的&a终端&r能让你查看、存入或是从存储网络中取出资源、发送配方请求以及执行许多其他操作。

quest.52C305EDBE2CCC55.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &3Crafting Grid&r provides you with all the functionality of the regular &aGrid&r, but also provides you with an integrated crafting table.
quest.52C305EDBE2CCC55.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &3合成终端&r在常规&a终端&r的基础上集成了一个工作台。

quest.53060D307C063C25.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aWyvern Core&r is an upgraded crafting component used for most &eDE&r recipes and items.
quest.53060D307C063C25.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a龙芯&r是大多数&e龙之进化&r配方和物品的更高级合成材料。

quest.534F1C46873C1358.quest_desc[0].en_us: The generators in this row are considered &aMid Game Generators&r!
quest.534F1C46873C1358.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这一排的发电机属于&a游戏中期发电机&r！

quest.534F1C46873C1358.quest_desc[2].en_us: These generators start to become available once you have some progress and unlock several of the &6World Engine Upgrades&r.
quest.534F1C46873C1358.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些发电机需要你达到一定的游戏进度，解锁几个&6世界引擎升级&r后，才能制造出来。

quest.534F1C46873C1358.quest_desc[4].en_us: Some of them can also be upgraded or scaled up well into the late game, like the &6Powah&r &dReactors&r.
quest.534F1C46873C1358.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 其中部分也可以升级或者扩大规模，到游戏后期仍然适用，比如&6Powah&r模组的&d反应堆&r。

quest.537DE7A354AF8E9E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bMob Grinding Utils&r provides easy to use blocks to move mobs around in your mob farms.
quest.537DE7A354AF8E9E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b刷怪塔实用设备&r提供了些简单的方块，用于在刷怪塔里移动生物。

quest.537DE7A354AF8E9E.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aMob Fan&r can push mobs away from it, and can be upgraded to increase its work area.
quest.537DE7A354AF8E9E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a怪物风扇&r可以推离生物，并可以升级以提升其工作范围。

quest.537DE7A354AF8E9E.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aEntity Conveyor&r is a floor block that pushes mobs in the direction of its arrow. The player can sneak while on top to negate the effect.
quest.537DE7A354AF8E9E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a实体传送带&r可以朝其箭头方向推动生物。玩家可以在其上方潜行以免疫其效果。

quest.5388B67410670702.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["", {"text": "Draconic", "color": "gold"}, " weapons are upgraded versions of ", {"text": "Wyvern", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2C141655079AC173" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Wyvern Weapons Quest"}}, " weapons, with room for more ", {"text": "Upgrade Modules", "color": "green"}, " and better customizability."]
quest.5388B67410670702.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "神龙", "color": "gold"}, "武器是", {"text": "双足飞龙", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "2C141655079AC173" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往双足飞龙武器任务"}}, "武器的升级版，可安装更多的", {"text": "升级模块", "color": "green"}, "，具有更强的可定制性。"]

quest.5388B67410670702.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also craft the &6Draconic Staff of Power&r, an All-In-One tool and weapon.
quest.5388B67410670702.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你还可以打造一把集所有工具与武器于一体的终极装备：&6神龙之力权杖&r。

quest.5388B67410670702.quest_desc[4].en_us: Their module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.
quest.5388B67410670702.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.53C947D1E96420A1.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using an &aAtomic Reconstructor&r, you can install a &dLens of the Miner&r to zap certain stone blocks into ores using power.
quest.53C947D1E96420A1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用&a原子再构机&r，你可以为其安装&d矿工透镜&r，来消耗能量将石类方块转化为矿物。

quest.53C947D1E96420A1.quest_desc[2].en_us: This Lens can convert Stone, Deepslate, and Netherrack into ores.
quest.53C947D1E96420A1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该透镜可以将石头，深板岩和下界岩转换为矿物。

quest.53C947D1E96420A1.quest_desc[4].en_us: When automated, this can be really strong for ore generation!
quest.53C947D1E96420A1.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 一旦实现了自动化，这在矿物生成方面十分强力！

quest.53E949B1A0D04290.quest_desc[0].en_us: You'll need at least 21 &cFire Bricks&r to set up the outer walls of the smallest sized &6Foundry&r.
quest.53E949B1A0D04290.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你需要至少21个&c耐火砖块&r才能搭建最小尺寸的&6熔铸炉&r外墙。

quest.53E949B1A0D04290.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThese can be dyed to match your base aesthetics.
quest.53E949B1A0D04290.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o你可以根据你的喜好进行染色。

quest.5417C0BED57AE8DA.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Nether Fauna.

quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the &zNeutron Activator&r, you have the power of the sun now to convert &aNuclear Waste&r.
quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&z中子活化器&r，你就能使用太阳之力转化&a核废料&r了。

quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[2].en_us: This will give you the ability to create &zAntimatter&r using the &6Supercritical Phase Shifter&r.
quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这样你就能使用&6超临界移相器&r制造&z反物质&r了。

quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["", {"text": "Note", "color": "yellow"},  ": Take a look at the ", {"text": "Mekanism Reactor", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "49B8310D0C7A6C55"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Reactor Quest"}}, " quest if you want to learn more about creating Reactors and converting Nuclear Waste."]
quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "注意", "color": "yellow"},  "：如果你想了解更多关于搭建反应堆和转化核废料的信息，请查阅", {"text": "通用机械反应堆", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "49B8310D0C7A6C55"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往反应堆任务"}}, "任务。"]

quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[6].en_us: Also, you will only need half the normal amount of &aNuclear Waste&r compared to other packs.
quest.543C6917A16F266C.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 此外，你所需的&a核废料&r数量仅为其他包的一半。

quest.5455CF5D3C37ECA9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cNetherite Monstrosity&r can be found in the &3Soul Blacksmith&r.
quest.5455CF5D3C37ECA9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c下界合金巨兽&r可以在&3灵魂锻造厂&r中找到。

quest.5455CF5D3C37ECA9.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is located in the upper parts of the &cNether&r ring.
quest.5455CF5D3C37ECA9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该结构位于&c下界&r环的上部。

quest.54A1D7A1D89C1A04.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &bFrosted Prison&r dungeon can be found in the upper parts of the &bOcean&r ring.
quest.54A1D7A1D89C1A04.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b苦寒监牢&r会生成在&b海洋&r环的上层。

quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've cured a &aVillager&r, the &dEcho of Guidance&r knows of a tool you can craft that can harness their skills for future use. To make this tool, you must use the &6World Engine&r.
quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 治愈一名&a村民&r后，&d指引者的回响&r告诉你，你可以制造一种能掌握他们的技能的工具，以供未来使用。制造这个工具需要用到&6世界引擎&r。

quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6World Engine&r can harness the power of ancient crafts to create advanced items beyond your current knowledge.
quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&r能够操纵远古的合成之力，制造出超出你知识范围的先进物品。

quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[4].en_us: To reach the &6World Engine&r, a portal must be activated by Sneak + Right-clicking a &aChronon Cell&r once it contains some &bChronon&r.
quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 手持含有&b时元&r的&a时元电芯&r，潜行右击，即可激活前往&6世界引擎&r的传送门。

quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[6].en_us: Your goal will be to craft an &aEcho Encoder&r using the latent magical powers stored within amethyst.
quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你的目标是利用紫水晶中蕴藏的魔力，合成一个&a回响编码器&r。

quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[8].en_us: ["There are 2 main ways to get ", {"text": "Leather", "color": "green"}, " early on: ", {"text": "Killing a Cow", "color": "dark_green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Grass Quest"}}, ", or by using ", {"text": "Rotten Flesh", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "277181E358575312"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Rotten Flesh Quest"}}, "."]
quest.54A433FAF8A65CC0.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: ["获取", {"text": "皮革", "color": "green"}, "的方式主要有两种：", {"text": "杀牛", "color": "dark_green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "0ACCAD3AEF57F2E2"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往草的任务"}}, "，或者用", {"text": "腐肉", "color": "red", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "277181E358575312"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往腐肉的任务"}}, "转化而来。"]

quest.54B7D149B45635F4.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dChronometer&r is a better version of the &aChronon Generator&r, passively producing more &bChronon&r than before.
quest.54B7D149B45635F4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d时律计&r是&a时元发生器&r的改良版本，它可以比之前自动生成更多的&b时元&r。

quest.551964C1A41FA3D0.quest_desc[0].en_us: To get chickens for the higher tier materials, you'll need to breed specific chickens together in a &aBreeder&r.
quest.551964C1A41FA3D0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了得到高阶材料鸡，你需要将一些鸡在&a繁殖箱&r中繁育。

quest.551964C1A41FA3D0.quest_desc[2].en_us: For breeding to be successful, you'll need to provide 2 chickens and a specific tier of seed for the chicken you are trying to breed for. JEI will be your best friend when finding breeding recipes!
quest.551964C1A41FA3D0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 为确保繁育成功，你需要提供两只鸡和对应你想要繁育出鸡的等级的饲料。在找寻繁育配方时，JEI将会是你最好的朋友！

quest.551964C1A41FA3D0.quest_desc[4].en_us: To see which tier of seed that you need, make sure to hover over the seed in the recipe while in JEI. This will show you a tooltip with the required seed tier.
quest.551964C1A41FA3D0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 要查看你需要哪个等级的饲料，请务必在JEI中将鼠标悬停在配方里的饲料上。这会显示一个带有所需饲料等级的提示。

quest.5535D64E2B05005E.quest_subtitle.en_us: Increases working area size of Destroyer Blocks and Enderic Lasers
quest.5535D64E2B05005E.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 增加方块破坏器和末影激光器的工作范围

quest.558A4BBC3BDB853D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Kill &6Malkuth&r located in the &6Malkuth Arena&r in the &dVoid&r ring and &csubmit its trophy&r to claim your bounty.
quest.558A4BBC3BDB853D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 击杀&6王国&r，它位于&d虚空&r环中的&6王国竞技场&r，然后&c提交它的战利品&r来领取赏金。

quest.55D17BDE3E9C81CC.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.55D17BDE3E9C81CC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.55D17BDE3E9C81CC.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.55D17BDE3E9C81CC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.562156281B8D0843.quest_desc[0].en_us: This machine is used to break down specific liquids, like &bWater&r, into 2 separate &agases&r.
quest.562156281B8D0843.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 该机器可以将某些流体（比如&b水&r）电解成两种不同的&a气体&r。

quest.562156281B8D0843.quest_desc[2].en_us: The first use you'll have is separating &bWater&r into &eOxygen&r and &eHydrogen&r. &aOxygen&r is needed for several machines, including the &aPurification Chamber&r.
quest.562156281B8D0843.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 其中的一个用法就是把&b水&r电解成&e氧气&r和&e氢气&r。有许多机器都要使用&a氧气&r，例如&a提纯仓&r。

quest.5624865A6F796087.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aReplicator&r is the core working machine of your matter network.
quest.5624865A6F796087.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a复制器&r是你物质网络的核心工作机器。

quest.5624865A6F796087.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once an item is set in a &dMemory Chip&r and requested from a &aReplication Terminal&r, the job is sent to available &aReplicators&r to be crafted using stored matter.
quest.5624865A6F796087.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 一旦存储在&d存储芯片&r中的物品被&a复制终端&r请求，该任务将会派送给可用的&a复制器&r，来使用存储的物质进行复制。

quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[0].en_us: Via the &dField Projector's&r matrix slots, additional tweaks can be applied to the field's area. You can insert more than one of each, but most will not stack.
quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在&d力场投影仪&r的矩阵槽安装模块，可以对力场区域进行调整。每个模块都可以安装多个，但大多数模块无法堆叠生效。

quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[2].en_us: One &bSilence Module&r will silence the &dField Projector&r while it's running.
quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b静音模块&r会使&d力场投影仪&r无声运行。

quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &bDome Module&r tweaks the projected mode to only generate at and above the &dField Projector&r.
quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b圆顶模块&r将投影模式调整为只在&d力场投影仪&r及以上的高度生成投影。

quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[6].en_us: A &bCamouflage Module&r will cause the projected field to copy the appearance of a block left of it in the Matrix slots. &oNote: some non-standard blocks don't appreciate being copied. Mimic other modded machines at your own risk.&r
quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &b伪装模块&r使投影的力场应用伪装模块左侧方块的外观。&o注意：一些非标准方块不支持应用，模仿其他模组机器产生的风险自负。

quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[8].en_us: Adding &bShock Modules&r to your &dField Projector&r will cause the shield to deal damage to entities that contact it at 1 damage/module.
quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 在你的&d力场投影仪&r安装&b电击模块&r会使力场对接触到的实体造成伤害，每个模块增加一点造成的伤害。

quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[10].en_us: &bGlow Modules&r will cause the field blocks to emit light, brightness increasing by 1 every 4 modules up to the level of glowstone.
quest.56519A6A39FA9430.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &b发光模块&r使力场方块能够发光，每四个模块增加一点亮度，最高不超过荧石的亮度（15）。

quest.5672B339AE16EE6C.quest_desc[0].en_us: This is one of the essential upgrades for your chests!
quest.5672B339AE16EE6C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个升级对你的箱子来说非常重要！

quest.5672B339AE16EE6C.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aStack Upgrade&r increases the stack limit for each slot inside of the chest. These upgrades are also much cheaper than the &aSophisticated Backpack&r upgrades.
quest.5672B339AE16EE6C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a堆叠升级&r能使单个槽位的物品堆叠数量翻倍。这比&a精妙背包&r升级便宜多了。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eInterdiction Matrix&r has 8 slots available for &bModules&r that work off the registration and rights defined in a system's &aBiometric Identifier&r.
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e结界矩阵&r基于系统中&a生物识别器&r注册的身份卡和定义的权限运行，拥有八个可供安装&b模块&r的槽位。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bWarning Modules&r will increase the additional warning range of the &eMatrix&r by 1 block/module.
