By default, there is a 3 block radius beyond the range of other &bmodules&r that alerts unregistered players that they may be affected by the &eMatrix's&r actions. This is the only module that has a stacking effect.
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个&b警告模块&r额外增加一格&e矩阵&r的警告范围。默认情况下，其他&b模块&r作用半径以外三格将作为警告区域，警告未注册的玩家他们将受到&e矩阵&r影响。这是唯一一个可以堆叠生效的模块。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[4].en_us: &bBlock Access Modules&r prevent interaction with levers, machines, and the like for players without the right to bypass it.
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b访问拦截模块&r会阻止没有对应权限的玩家与拉杆、机器等方块互动。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[6].en_us: &bBlock Alter Modules&r act similarly to the above module, but disallow the breaking and placement of blocks altogether.
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &b修改拦截模块&r与上述模块作用相似，并且还会禁止没有对应权限的玩家破坏或放置方块。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[9].en_us: &bConfiscation Modules&r can be &4very nasty&r in multiplayer. Using the other 9 slots in the &eMatrix&r, up to 9 items can be selected to take from or leave in the inventory of unregistered players, with anything taken being dropped at the &ematrix&r or placed in adjacent inventories. This applies to armor as well. &4Be mindful&r when using this on normally &afriendly&r servers...
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[9].zh_cn: &b收缴模块&r在多人模式下可能&4非常令人讨厌&r。通过&e矩阵&r内的另外九个槽位，你可以设置最多九个物品，用来决定其在未注册玩家的物品栏内，是被自动取走或保留，被取走的物品会掉落在&e矩阵&r附近或被放进相邻的容器内。该机制对盔甲同样奏效。在&a氛围友好&r的服务器使用时要&4三思而行&r。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[11].en_us: &bAnti-Friendly&r, &b-Hostile&r, and &b-Personnel Modules&r will cause the matrix to kill animals, hostile creatures, and unregistered players respectively with extremely high damage.
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[11].zh_cn: &b反友好模块&r，&b反敌对模块&r和&b反玩家模块&r各自使矩阵能够以极高的伤害击杀动物、敌对生物和未注册的玩家。

quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[13].en_us: An &bAnti-Spawn Module&r will prevent any and all mobs from spawning in the working radius of the &ematrix&r.
quest.56E9C123DD727E46.quest_desc[13].zh_cn: &b反生成模块&r将阻止所有生物在&e矩阵&r的覆盖范围内生成。

quest.56FB1BC5711CC4F9.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.56FB1BC5711CC4F9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.56FB1BC5711CC4F9.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.56FB1BC5711CC4F9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Metronome&r is the ultimate &bChronon&r generation tool.
quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6时元节律器&r是&b时元&r的终极生产设备。

quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[2].en_us: You must provide it with about &b2000 Chronon&r to kickstart its production.
quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你必须先提供&b2000时元&r才可以将它启动。

quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &6Metronome&r has input and output slots that make it function as a &dChronon Battery&r, and it can link to other &6Metronomes&r on an internal network, which can also be set to private.
quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &6节律器&r有数个输入和输出槽位，可以当作&d时元电池&r来使用，并且它可以与其相连的其他&6节律器&r一起组成一个内部网络，还可以将一个节律器网络设置为私有。

quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&f: The &6Metronome&r is &cNOT&f a reliable chronon storage for teleporting via the &aAction Pad&r.
quest.575A111D4418BFB6.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&f：使用&a操作板&r传送时，&6时元节律器&r&c不是&f可靠的时元存储装置。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eLaserIO&r allows you to transfer pretty much everything using LASERS!
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以用&eLaserIO&r的激光传输万物！

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started, you'll need some &aLaser Nodes&r and a &cLaser Wrench&r to connect them. These are the main blocks of the mod, which allows lasers to directly interact with blocks they are attached to.
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要一些&a激光节点&r，还需要一把&c激光扳手&r链接它们。激光节点是这个模组的重要方块，激光需要通过它才能和方块交互。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[4].en_us: To learn how to set them up, check the next page!
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 下一页将会介绍设置节点的方法！

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: &aLogic Chips&r require the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to be crafted.
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&a逻辑芯片&r需要&b力场子灌注块&r&6世界引擎升级&r才能制作。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[8].en_us: To set up how Lasers will interact with the block, you'll need to install &aCards&r to specify what you'd like them to do.
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你需要给节点加装&a功能卡&r，才能设定节点的工作模式。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[10].en_us: These cards are highly configurable. For example, &aItem Cards&r can be used to pull or push items from separate inventories, and can be filtered for precise automation.
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 这些卡都可以随心所欲地配置。比如&a物品卡&r可以从不同的地方提取或输入物品，还可以写入过滤条件，实现精准自动化。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[12].en_us: When opening up the interface for a &aLaser Node&r, you'll have a tab for every face of the node. This determines the side that the Card works on. Think of the Card as essentially the "settings file" for that face.
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 打开&a激光节点&r的GUI后，可以在里面查看激光节点的各个面信息。你可以在这里决定功能卡的作用面，功能卡本质上可以理解为对应面的“设置文件”。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[14].en_us: The cards can also be upgraded to increase the speed at which it interacts with other blocks, allowing for extremely fast speeds for automation. They can also be filtered and set to specific channels.
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 你还可以给功能卡升级，提升节点和对应方块交互的速度，甚至可以实现极快速的自动化。功能卡还可以设定过滤和频道。

quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[16].en_us: You're not always going to have straight lasers from each &aLaser Node&r. That's where &aLaser Connectors&r come in!
quest.5778BAEC8F095B3D.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 你其实没必要让每个&a激光节点&r的激光都直来直去，用&a激光连接器&r就可以中继激光！

quest.57CBEE2A35F98614.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAssembler Matrix Frame&r must form the outer edges of the &dMatrix Assembler&r multiblock.
quest.57CBEE2A35F98614.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d矩阵装配器&r这个多方块结构需要用&a装配矩阵框架&r来搭建外框。

quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Industrial Foregoing&r has several machines that can help you when dealing with enchantments.
quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6工业先锋&r模组提供了一些处理魔咒相关事务的机器。

quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dEnchantment Applicator&r works like a mechanical anvil. Instead of using experience to enchant items, it will use &aEssence&r instead.
quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d魔咒施加机&r的功能与铁砧类似，不过使用时并不消耗经验，而是消耗&a精华液&r。

quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dEnchantment Sorter&r will filter enchanted items from non-enchanted items, placing anything that's enchanted in the top output. You can send these to different sides for extraction via pipes.
quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d附魔物品分拣机&r可以分离附魔物品与未附魔物品，附魔物品会被放入上方的输出槽（译注：其实是下方的）。你可以使用管道将物品提取出来。

quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &dEnchantment Extractor&r will strip down enchanted books from enchanted items when provided with books, effectively harvesting enchants off unused gear.
quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &d魔咒提取机&r可将物品上的魔咒提取到书中，从而更好地利用无用装备上的魔咒。

quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[8].en_us: The &dEnchantment Factory&r will automatically enchant books with enchantment level of 30 using a good amount of &aEssence&r.
quest.57DF1A1F0556B970.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &d魔咒工厂&r可以自动以30级的经验等级给书附魔，代价是需要消耗大量的&a精华液&r。

quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dEnergized Induction Matrix&r from &eMekanism&r is the ultimate way to store tons of power!
quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e通用机械&r的&d感应矩阵&r是最强大的能源存储方案！

quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is a custom multiblock structure that can be built up to 18x18x18 for all of your power storage needs. It only requires 1 &aInduction Cell&r, 1 &aInduction Provider&r, and &aInduction Ports&r to pull and push power out.
quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是一个自定义多方块结构，最大体积可达18x18x18，可以满足你的一切能量存储需要！想要存取能量的话，只需要1个&a感应元件&r，1个&a感应供应器&r和1个&a感应端口&r即可。

quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[4].en_us: To build this, the smallest structure that can be made is a 3x4x3 multiblock. The frame must be made up of &aInduction Casings&r, and the faces can be &aStructural Glass&r or &aInduction Ports&r.
quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这个多方块结构的最小规模是3x4x3。它的框架必须由&a感应外壳&r构成，六个面可以用&a结构玻璃&r和&a感应端口&r替代。

quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[6].en_us: Inside of the structure, you'll place down your &aInduction Cells&r and &aProviders&r. Providers determine how fast the Matrix can push or pull power, whereas the Cells determine the maximum amount of power that can be stored. You can mix and match however many you want of each, as long as it is placed inside of the structure.
quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 结构内部可以放置&a感应元件&r和&a感应供应器&r。感应矩阵的能量输入输出速度取决于供应器，能量存储上限取决于元件。你可以随意混搭这两个部件，只要保证它们都放在矩阵内部就好。

quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[8].en_us: &aInduction Ports&r can be configured to input or output power by sneak-using a &aConfigurator&r on them. I suggest using at least 2 for your first Matrix!
quest.57ED7DBAC5E8C5BE.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 手持&a配置工具&r，潜行右击&a感应端口&r即可调整该端口的输入输出状态。建议你至少要给你的矩阵装上两个端口！

quest.5804356B2AFCF14A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.5804356B2AFCF14A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.5804356B2AFCF14A.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.5804356B2AFCF14A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.580866E99C53DB3E.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are different upgrades that you can use to allow your chests to pick up nearby items.
quest.580866E99C53DB3E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想让箱子自动拾取周边物品的话，有一些升级可以帮到你。

quest.580866E99C53DB3E.quest_desc[2].en_us: The base level is just a &aPickup Upgrade&r, but upgrading to the &aMagnet Upgrade&r allows for more options and a wider range!
quest.580866E99C53DB3E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a拾取升级&r是最基础的，但升级到&a磁铁升级&r后就有更多设置，以及更大的拾取范围！

quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[0].en_us: To craft items in &6Draconic Evolution&r, you will need a special crafting setup called &dFusion Crafting&r.
quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 要制作&6龙之进化&r的物品，你需要一种被称作&d聚合注入&r的特殊合成装置。

quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dFusion Crafting Core&r must be the middle of the setup, with &dDraconium Fusion Crafting Ejectors&r placed facing towards the Core 2 blocks apart.
quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d聚合核心&r必须位于装置中央，并在间隔2个方块处，面向核心放置&d聚合注入器&r。

quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[4].en_us: The Core will also need a redstone signal to start.
quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要用红石信号启动核心。

quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[6].en_us: To upgrade to the &dWyvern Fusion Injectors&r, you will need at least 8 &dDraconium Injectors&r placed around the Core.
quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 要升级到&d飞龙聚合注入器&r，你需要在核心周围放置至少8个&d聚合注入器&r。

quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[8].en_us: You can right-click each item the injectors need to craft the upgrade. Each injector will also need power.
quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你可以手持所需物品右击注入器，来制作此升级。每个注入器都需要能量。

quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[10].en_us: With all items placed in the injectors, you can place the main item in the Core, and the craft should start once it has a redstone signal.
quest.580CDFD2B7675485.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 将物品全部放置到注入器上后，你就可以把主要物品放入核心，并用红石信号启动合成。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[0].en_us: You can access the Network UI from any block within the mod, like a &aFlux Plug&r or &aPoint&r.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本模组的所有方块都可以打开网络UI，例如&a通量网络输入点&r、&a通量网络接入点&r等。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[2].en_us: From there, you can create your first network! On the far-right tab of the UI, you can click the &a+&r to create a new network.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在那里你可以创建你的第一个网络！点击UI最右端的&a+&r即可创建一个新网络。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[4].en_us: On this screen, you can change the network's name and switch configuration options to public, private, or encrypted, making it a great power transfer mod for server use.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在这个界面中，你可以修改网络名称和网络权限（可设为公开、私人或加密），因此这个模组很适合在服务器中使用。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[8].en_us: When you're finished configuring the options, you can hit &bCreate&r at the bottom!
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 设置完成后，点击底部的&b创建&r按钮即可！

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[10].en_us: This will bring you to the &aNetwork List&r. In this list, you can see all networks that are available to you, including the one you just created!
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 然后你就会自动切换到&a网络列表&r界面，这里显示了所有可用的网络，包括你刚刚创建的那个！

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[12].en_us: For every device that needs to connect to the network, this is the first thing you'll do whenever you place it down.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 所有需要接入网络的设备，放下来之后，都需要先做这件事。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[16].en_us: Once you've selected a network, you can head over to the Home page to configure the settings of the device.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 选定网络后，你就可以前往主页，调试设备的设定了。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[18].en_us: The &bHome&r page allows you to configure several parts of the device, including the &aName&r, &dPriority&r, and &cTransfer Limit&r.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: 在&b主页&r中，你可以调整设备的各个参数，比如&a名称&r、&d优先级&r以及&c传输上限&r。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[22].en_us: The higher the &dPriority&r number, the more priority it gets for the power in your network.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[22].zh_cn: &d优先级&r数字越大，它就越优先获得能量。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[24].en_us: The &cTransfer Limit&r allows you to control how much the device can pull from the network.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[24].zh_cn: &c传输上限&r可以控制该设备从网络中抽取多少能量。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[26].en_us: You also have toggles on the bottom to override these settings if you wish!
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[26].zh_cn: 另外，打开下面的这几个开关，可以选择性地忽略这些设定！

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[28].en_us: &aPower Surge&r will ignore all priority settings and force the device to be the highest priority in the network.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[28].zh_cn: &a电涌模式&r会无视优先级设定，强行将此设备在网络中的优先级升到最高。

quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[30].en_us: &aBypass Limit&r just ignores the device's Transfer Limit settings and sets it to max.
quest.583FFE29C881EE8C.quest_desc[30].zh_cn: &a绕过上限&r就是会无视传输上限设定，把它直接拉满。

quest.584B4C34CBF0E028.quest_desc[0].en_us: While the &aImbuement Chamber&r can slowly draw in the magical essence from the world, it cannot create the &dSource&r that you need to upgrade the &6World Engine&r.
quest.584B4C34CBF0E028.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然&a灌注室&r可以缓慢吸取世间的魔法精华，但它无法制造出升级&6世界引擎&r所需的&d魔源&r。

quest.584B4C34CBF0E028.quest_desc[2].en_us: &dSource&r can be drawn from many different sources by using a &aSourcelink&r. There are many different options, but the &2Agronomic Sourcelink&r is a great starting point.
quest.584B4C34CBF0E028.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 借助&a魔源通道&r，你可以从许多东西中提取&d魔源&r。通道有很多种，但&2农艺魔源通道&r是最适合入门的。

quest.584B4C34CBF0E028.quest_desc[4].en_us: You'll also need a way to store the &dSource&r the link collects, which can easily be done by placing a &aSource Jar&r near the link.
quest.584B4C34CBF0E028.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还需要将通道收集到的&d魔源&r存储起来，这很简单，只需要在通道附近放上一个&a魔源罐&r即可。

quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[0].en_us: So far you have made good use of your fists, but now it's time to step it up a notch.
quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你对你拳头的开发已经很深入了，是时候更上一层楼了。

quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[2].en_us: Those &2Leaves&r have some life in them. You just need to crush them to find it.
quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些&2树叶&r中似乎蕴含着某些生命，你需要粉碎它，然后一探究竟。

quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[4].en_us: Place down the &aBasin&r, then place some &2Leaves&r on top of it. Jump on them until you've squeezed out every last drop from them.
quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将&a盆&r放下来，再将&2树叶&r放在盆上，然后踩在上面跳，直到把它彻底榨干为止。

quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[6].en_us: This will create &bWater&r, but you'll need a way to scoop it out...
quest.5868F616B3756FF3.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 这样就可以获得&b水&r，但你还需要找个东西把它舀出来……

quest.586C935010D2FE74.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.586C935010D2FE74.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.58982359699AFB7F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aConfiguration Card&r is a very useful tool that allows you to copy and paste a network device's settings and upgrades.
quest.58982359699AFB7F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a配置卡&r是一个很好用的工具，它可以复制粘贴网络设备的配置和升级。

quest.58982359699AFB7F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Shift + Right-click a network device to copy and paste its settings onto another device. Shift + Right-click the air to clear stored settings.
quest.58982359699AFB7F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持配置卡，Shift右击一个网络设备即可复制其配置，然后Shift右击另一个设备即可粘贴配置。Shift右击空气以清除配置。

quest.58DDBF43D54AF67F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eMalum&r weapons often have special abilities that synergize very well with other features of the mod, dealing significant amounts of damage.
quest.58DDBF43D54AF67F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e灵灾&r武器通常具有特殊的能力，与此模组的其他特性或机制协同可造成大量伤害。

quest.592A206B63BF556E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Batteries&r are an &dOptional Attachment&r to have in a &bCAD&r; they allow you to have a &bspare amount of Psi Energy ready&r to be discharged when your basic Psi Energy runs dry.
quest.592A206B63BF556E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6电池&r是&bCAD&r中的&d可选附件&r，可以在基础Psi能量耗尽时，提供&b额外的Psi能量&r。

quest.594911C1304689E9.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aExporters&r are used to move resources out of your network.

quest.594911C1304689E9.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each &eCable Tiers&r upgrade works faster than its previous tier and has more filter slots.

quest.594911C1304689E9.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oCheck each item's tooltip for exact speeds.

quest.59497745146C1EFD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aSoulstained tools&r and weapons can be used to collect &bSpirit&r in the same manner as a &eScythe&r while having all the same traits as their mundane counterparts, though an upgrade from the Crude version is available as is an improved sword with &dTyrving&r.
quest.59497745146C1EFD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a魂染工具&r包含了一系列可以用来收集&b精魂&r的武器，就和&e粗制镰刀&r一样，但同时也保留了它们对应工具的用途。不过你既可以把粗制镰刀升级成魂染钢镰刀，也可以使用由魂染剑改进而来的&d提尔锋&r。

quest.59497745146C1EFD.quest_desc[2].en_us: Splitting a metal across both spirit and physical however means that this damage is &esimilarly split&r, about half of it being converted into magic damage for better or worse.
quest.59497745146C1EFD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 不过，将金属拆分并把精魂融入实体，意味着武器造成的伤害也会&e以相似的形式分开计算&r，其中一半的伤害会被转化为魔法伤害。这既有可能是个好处，也有可能是个坏处。

quest.5964573222E4FA19.quest_desc[0].en_us: This questline shows general tech mods.
quest.5964573222E4FA19.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本任务线包含大部分科技模组。

quest.59A6D7B544F1AE06.quest_desc[0].en_us: Want an easy way to travel to different levels of your base? Make an &dElevator&r!
quest.59A6D7B544F1AE06.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 想要轻松地在基地不同楼层之间穿梭？做个&d电梯&r吧！

quest.59A6D7B544F1AE06.quest_desc[2].en_us: These can also copy the texture of another block by using that block directly on the &dElevator&r.
quest.59A6D7B544F1AE06.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持其他方块右击&d电梯&r，可以将&d电梯&r改为该方块的纹理。

quest.59CBFA5583139A3B.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dReforging Table&r is an improved version of the &aSimple Reforging Table&r, allowing you to reforge items of all rarities, including &zMythic&r items.
quest.59CBFA5583139A3B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d重铸台&r是&a简易重铸台&r的升级版，可以重铸所有稀有度的物品，包括&z神话&r物品。

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[0].en_us: According to the &dEchoes&r, recently cured Villagers are unskilled. You must train them to increase their Unearthing Levels!
quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 听&d回响&r说，新治愈的这些村民技术太烂了，所以你需要先训练训练他们，提升他们的发掘等级！

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once they are placed into an &aUnearther&r, they will slowly gain levels over time.
quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 将他们放入&a发掘室&r，他们的发掘等级就会缓慢增长。

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can place them back into the world using the Token, but will need to pick them back up with the &aEcho Encoder&r.
quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 用令牌可以直接把他们放回到世界中，但你需要用&a回响编码器&r才能再把他们收起来。

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[6].en_us: &cWarning&r: Placing the Villager back into the world as a Token will cause the Villager to lose their job and levels!
quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &c警告&r：用令牌将村民放回世界中会导致村民失去他的工作和等级！

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[8].en_us: While they can work without food, feeding them is probably a good idea.
quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 虽然这帮村民不用吃饭也能干活，但还是建议你给他们喂点食物。

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[10].en_us: The food you feed them will give them special bonuses depending on what you feed them!
quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 食物会给他们特殊的加成效果！不同的食物提供的效果也不同。

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: - 饱食度越多 = 工作速度越快。

quest.59E8FEC3758635DF.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: - 饱和度越多 = 食物持续时间越长。

quest.5A04F7A95366D15F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Reconstructing diamonds into &bDiamatine&r is only the first step into creating the core for the &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r.
quest.5A04F7A95366D15F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 将钻石再构为&b钻石水晶&r只是制作&c高级机器方块&r核心的第一步。

quest.5A04F7A95366D15F.quest_desc[2].en_us: This core needs to allow power to flow through it properly. Using an &bEmpowering Setup&r, you should be able to empower diamonds for this exact purpose.
quest.5A04F7A95366D15F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 为了让能量在核心内部能够正常流通，你需要使用&b充能台装置&r给钻石水晶充能。

quest.5A04F7A95366D15F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: The setup requires an &aEmpowerer&r connected to power as the center of the setup, with 4 &2Display Stands&r two blocks away from each side of the &aEmpowerer&r.
quest.5A04F7A95366D15F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要搭建此装置，你需要在中心处放一个&a充能台&r，并给它供能，然后在它每侧的两格远处，放上一个&2物品展示台&r（一共4个）。

quest.5A7056F1FB256B5F.quest_desc[0].en_us: This chapter outlines most of the different ways to automate generating resources!
quest.5A7056F1FB256B5F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本章概述了自动化生成资源的绝大多数方法！

quest.5A793B307C82AB91.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Geologist&r is a master of hard materials, and can work through &2Cobblestone&r, &7Gravel&r, &aSoul Sand&r, and &aCrushed Kivi&r. They require a &aSalvaging Table&r as a workstation.
quest.5A793B307C82AB91.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2地质学家&r是硬质材料的大师，可以处理&2圆石&r，&7沙砾&r，&a灵魂沙&r和&a磊岩&r。他们需要&a回收台&r作为工作站。

quest.5A793B307C82AB91.quest_desc[2].en_us: This worker can be a great source for generating most ore chunks and gems depending on their level.
quest.5A793B307C82AB91.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 根据他们的等级，这位工人可以成为大多数矿石和宝石的重要来源。

quest.5A793B307C82AB91.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &2Geologist&r is one of the only sources for generating items like &aXychorium Gems&r and &aBlack Quartz&r.
quest.5A793B307C82AB91.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &2地质学家&r是&aXy晶宝石&r和&a焦黑石英&r这类物品的唯一来源。

quest.5A8CEB600CAADCD2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &bCryomancer&r can be found by using the &aPearl of the Frozen Oath&r Gateway.
quest.5A8CEB600CAADCD2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b冰霜术士&r可通过使用&a冰霜誓约之珍珠&r传送门找到。

quest.5AC7EEC3D69AF032.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bCelestigem&r tools are the next tier of tools from &6Just Dire Things&r.
quest.5AC7EEC3D69AF032.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b苍穹晶&r工具是&6Just Dire Things&r模组下一等阶的工具。

quest.5AC7EEC3D69AF032.quest_desc[2].en_us: Instead of using durability, these tools use &cenergy&r instead, and can have even more upgrades that can be installed.
quest.5AC7EEC3D69AF032.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 苍穹晶工具不再消耗耐久，而是使用&c能量&r，并且可以加装更多的升级。

quest.5AC7EEC3D69AF032.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be made once you've made a trip out to the &dAncient City&r and made &dVoidshimmer Goo&r.
quest.5AC7EEC3D69AF032.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 等你探索过&d远古城市&r，制作出&d虚空辉凝胶&r之后，就可以制作苍穹晶了。

quest.5B23C2EB38DCEE6E.quest_desc[2].en_us: Atomic Forging Platinum + 2 Reinforced Carbon Sheets

quest.5B512AED08EC1899.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aThermo Generators&r generate power using &cheat&r from the block placed underneath it, and a &bcoolant&r being pumped in from any side.
quest.5B512AED08EC1899.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a热力发电机&r在下方有&c热源&r方块，且有&b冷却剂&r供应时，即可产生能量。&b冷却剂&r可以从任意面输入机器。

quest.5B512AED08EC1899.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can use JEI to see all valid &cheat sources&r and &bcoolants&r.
quest.5B512AED08EC1899.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在JEI中查看可用的&c热源&r和&b冷却剂&r。

quest.5B512AED08EC1899.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Water is not a good enough coolant. You can see which coolants and heat blocks you can use by hitting &aU&r on the Thermo Generator in JEI.
quest.5B512AED08EC1899.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：水并不适合用作冷却剂。你可以对JEI中的热力发电机按&aU&r查看可用的冷却剂。

quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCooking Table&r is the first big craft you'll want to make to get started making your kitchen!
quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 搭建厨房的第一步就是制造一个&a烹饪桌&r！

quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[2].en_us: This block acts as the main crafting table for foods, and is the centerpiece of your &aKitchen Multiblock&r. When opened, it will show you every food you can make based on what you have stored in the multiblock and what appliances you have connected.
quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 烹饪桌是制作食物的主要区域，也是你&a多方块厨房&r的核心部分。基于你已储存的食物和多方块厨房中已连接的设备，你可以直接在烹饪桌的界面中看到所有你可以制作的食物。

quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can expand your kitchen by adding &aCabinets&r or &aCounters&r.
quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以增加&a厨柜&r或&a厨房橱柜&r来扩展你的厨房。

quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: Certain mods won't connect with it, like the &bFarmer's Delight Cooking Pot&r. Make sure to always check JEI for specific recipes!
quest.5B7448EEC26FF0E3.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：部分模组的方块无法与烹饪桌接入交互，如&b农夫乐事的厨锅&r。烹饪前请在JEI里看清配方的合成站！

quest.5BBA51F8FE4D6C3B.quest_desc[0].en_us: A solid block that you can choose whether you want to walk through it or not! Right-click it to toggle its current state
quest.5BBA51F8FE4D6C3B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这是一种可以切换固体状态的方块，你可以自由决定它是否能够通行！右击即可轻松切换。

quest.5BBA51F8FE4D6C3B.quest_desc[2].en_us: While mobs don't know how to walk through this in its non-solid state, they can still be pushed or fall through.
quest.5BBA51F8FE4D6C3B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 当它处于非固体状态时，虽然生物不会主动穿行通过，但仍可以被推挤穿过或坠落穿过。

quest.5BE257CE3FD1FDAC.quest_desc[0].en_us: With &6Awakened Draconium&r, you can now upgrade your Infusion setup to craft more advanced items.
quest.5BE257CE3FD1FDAC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&6觉醒龙锭&r，你就能升级你的聚合注入装置，并制作更高级的物品了。

quest.5BE257CE3FD1FDAC.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can now upgrade your &dWyvern Gear&r to &6Draconic Tier&r.
quest.5BE257CE3FD1FDAC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你现在能将你的&d双足飞龙装备&r升级到&6神龙等级&r了。

quest.5BF72200F151FF24.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Psi&r has a fairly simple progression of materials, allowing you to unlock better components for your &bCADs&r thus allowing you to cast more &dcomplex&r and &3cool&r spells.
quest.5BF72200F151FF24.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Psi&r的材质升级过程相对简单，可以解锁更好的&bCAD&r组件，从而让你能够施展更多&d复杂&r和&3酷炫&r的术式。

quest.5BF72200F151FF24.quest_desc[2].en_us: ► But it all has to start somewhere. By simply &6Shooting&r a piece of &cRedstone Dust&r in the ground you should be able to convert it into &6Psi Dust&r!
quest.5BF72200F151FF24.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: ► 但千里之行始于足下。只需在地上&6扔下&r任意数量的&c红石粉&r，你应该就能将其转化成&6Psi粉&r！

quest.5BF72200F151FF24.quest_desc[4].en_us: &8&o● If you haven't made yourself an &lActual CAD&r&8&o, simply &nplace it inside the CAD Assembler&r.
quest.5BF72200F151FF24.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &8&o● 如果你还没有制作自己的&lCAD&r&8&o，只需&n将其放置在CAD装配器内即可&r。

quest.5C2C0986D6014ADD.quest_desc[0].en_us: For centuries, the &aWandering Trader&r has set out to personally annoy as many players as it possibly can.
quest.5C2C0986D6014ADD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 几百年以来，&a流浪商人&r始终致力于刻意招惹尽可能多的玩家。

quest.5C2C0986D6014ADD.quest_desc[4].en_us: Kill the &aWandering Trader&r in the name of &6AlfredGG&r.

quest.5C8773D5561D7245.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.5C8773D5561D7245.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.5C8773D5561D7245.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.5C8773D5561D7245.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.5CD461E6C3E8E7D1.quest_desc[0].en_us: Found within the &3Deepslate&r ring, this vault is easy to get lost in.
quest.5CD461E6C3E8E7D1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这座宝库位于&3深板岩&r环中，人们很容易在里面迷路。

quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aWorker Token&r that the villager converted into was just an example of what the &aEcho Encoder&r can do.
quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 把村民变成&a劳工令牌&r只是&a回响编码器&r的一个小功能。

quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[2].en_us: If you encode villagers with specific jobs, you can put them to work for you in an &2Unearther&r.
quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你将有职业的村民编码，你就可以把他们放进&2发掘室&r中，让他们给你打工。

quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[4].en_us: This is a 3x3x3 block that allows you to automate block brushing. All it requires is a little Villager labor!
quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 发掘室是一个3x3x3的结构，可以自动刷洗方块，你只需要往里面放一个可爱的村民当劳工就行了。

quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[6].en_us: &o&7The Unearther supports automatic item input and output via hoppers and pipes.
quest.5CD7299E8709E7F6.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &o&7发掘室可以通过漏斗和管道自动输入/输出物品。

quest.5CDE33FC6A041416.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &3Autocrafter Manager&r allows you to configure all your &3Autocrafters&r from this single block.
quest.5CDE33FC6A041416.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3自动合成仓管理器&r可配置网络中所有的&3自动合成仓&r。

quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Oritech&r comes with several basic &bPipes&r just for this! And of course, you'll need some way to configure the pipes, which is where the &aWrench&r comes in.
quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Oritech&r为此添加了一些基础&b管道&r，完全可以胜任你的物流需求！当然了，你还需要对管道进行配置，&a扳手&r就是用来办这事的。

quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Right-clicking on a &bPipe&r with an empty hand will set the pipe to extract!
quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 空手右击&b管道&r，可以将其设定为提取模式！

quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[4].en_us: Using the &aWrench&r on the end of a &bPipes&r will disconnect the &bPipe&r from whatever it is attached to. To reconnect it, use the &aWrench&r on the middle of the &bPipe&r.
quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 对着&b管道&r的末端使用&a扳手&r会让它断开和该面的链接，如果想重新连接则需要对着&b管道&r中心使用&a扳手&r。

quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[6].en_us: Sneak+using the &aWrench&r on a &bPipe&r will insta-break it.
quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 手持&a扳手&r潜行右击&b管道&r即可立刻破坏它。

quest.5CFC04F4F9A4B01D.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: - 物品管道：每5tick传输8个物品

quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dEnderic Railgun&r from &6Oritech&r is a powerful ranged weapon that fires a high-speed projectile, dealing significant damage to enemies and breaking blocks at a distance.
quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6Oritech&r模组的&d末影电磁炮&r是一个强力的远程武器，它可以发射高速弹射物，对敌人造成大量伤害，且可以远程破坏方块。

quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[2].en_us: Left mouse button can fire a continuous beam that damages any entities in its path and can also mine the first block in line. Energy will be transferred to an energy containing block instead of breaking it. It can also transform mined blocks, similar to the &aEnderic Laser&r.
quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 按住鼠标左键可发射连续光束，对路径上的实体造成伤害，并破坏命中的方块。若命中的方块为能量容器，则不会破坏它，而是会将能量传输进去。它还能像&a末影激光器&r一样转换被挖掘的方块。

quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[4].en_us: Mining-Mode can be toggled by Sneak + Right-Clicking with the item in hand.
quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 手持此物时潜行右击可以切换挖掘模式。

quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[6].en_us: Using the right mouse button fires a powerful projectile that explodes at the target location, destroying nearby blocks and entities.
quest.5D20790BCDE45CF9.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 右击可发射一枚威力巨大的弹丸，在命中位置爆炸，破坏附近的方块并伤害实体。

quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[0].en_us: Where &eMalignant Weapons&r &oseemed&r to have some will, weapons made with Fused Consciousness leave no room for doubt.
quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你的&e恶念武器&r&o看起来&r有了一些自己的想法，用融合意识将它们升级成新武器将是你的不二之选。

quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Sundering Anchor&r continues to attack after you swing, not yet finished with your foe.
quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6裂展锚刃&r会在你的挥击后持续攻击敌人，这还没完。

quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[3].en_us: Using the blade unleashes it, sending it out to gleefully attack anything it can in a large area repeatedly before returning, striking deep into their souls.
quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: 你可以右击扔出刀刃。直到返回前，它都会愉快地对附近大范围内的一切活物进行反复攻击，每一击都刺向它们的灵魂深处。

quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7Aside from you, of course. Who else would wield it?&r
quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7当然了，除了你，还有谁能支配这把武器？&r

quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &6Unwinding Chaos&r sears every foe it affects with magical fervor, the staff sapping energy from the flames it caused to regain the hexing charges used to create them.
quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &6混沌四侵&r会用它的魔法热忱地灼烧一切敌人。这把法杖能从被自己引燃的敌人身上汲取咒术能量，从而补充法术弹。

quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[7].en_us: &7You don't want it to be over after all do you? Not yet, at least.&r
quest.5D7BABE1A37EC6D3.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: &7你还不想终结这一切，不是吗？至少目前不想。&r

quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eCreate&r is a mod that offers a variety of tools and blocks for building, decorating, and aesthetic automation with cool-looking steampunky contraptions.
quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e机械动力&r是一款提供了多种工具和方块，用于建筑、装饰，还可以借助其中外观酷炫的蒸汽朋克风格机械装置，来实现富有美感的自动化。

quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eCreate&r's visual in-game documentation, called &bPonder&r, will teach you how most blocks work. Hover over an item in JEI or in your inventory to see if it has a &bPonder&r.
quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e机械动力&r的内置的视觉化文档名为&b思索&r，它将教你大多数方块的工作原理。在JEI或你的物品栏中将鼠标指针悬停在一个物品上可以查看它们是否有&b思索&r。

quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[4].en_us: To get started, craft some &aAndesite Alloys&r. You'll need a lot of these.
quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 首先，制作一些&a安山合金&r，你需要很多这种合金。

quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &aWrench&r is a multipurpose tool for working with &eCreate&r contraptions.
quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a扳手&r是一种多功能工具，用于操作&e机械动力&r的结构。

quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[8].en_us: It can rotate, configure, and dismantle blocks, contraptions, and more!
quest.5D96F0CE1154B9B8.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 它可以旋转、配置和拆卸方块、结构等等！

quest.5D9EAE2A6D2B6646.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Fragment Forge&r is an advanced multiblock machine that is mostly used to &bFragment&r and process ores, increasing the overall yield of ingot production.
quest.5D9EAE2A6D2B6646.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6粉碎工厂&r是个高级多方块结构，其可以&b将矿物粉碎&r并处理，极大地提升单个矿物产出。

quest.5D9EAE2A6D2B6646.quest_desc[2].en_us: Most &bAddons&r affect the operation of the &6Fragment Forge&r. The &bMachine Yield Addon&r will produce additional byproducts when installed in the &6Fragment Forge&r.
quest.5D9EAE2A6D2B6646.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 后续可以安装&b流体处理插件&r来分离流体，或与&6粉碎工厂&r搭配， 进行自动化矿物处理。

quest.5DF92F096DB91299.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dMeka-Tool&r is a power-consuming tool that can be upgraded and customized in a &aModification Station&r with a variety of &bModules&r to improve its performance.&r
quest.5DF92F096DB91299.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &dMeka工具&r由能量驱动，可在&a改造站&r中安装各种&b模块&r进行升级。

quest.5E1FD04538F89292.quest_desc[0].en_us: You can connect a second network to your main &eRS2&r network wirelessly by binding a &aNetwork Card&r to the secondary network's &dNetwork Receiver&r, then placing that same &aNetwork Card&r into a &dNetwork Transmitter&r connected to your main network.
quest.5E1FD04538F89292.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以将&a网络卡&r绑定到子网络的&d网络接收器&r，然后将其放入主网络中的&d网络发送器&r，来实现子网络与主网络间的无线连接。

quest.5E1FD04538F89292.quest_desc[2].en_us: This even works across dimensions as long as your main system is chunkloaded.
quest.5E1FD04538F89292.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这甚至能实现跨维度连接，只需要加载主网络所在区块。

quest.5E1FFB29D89798F5.quest_desc[0].en_us: While simply placing a &aQIO Dashboard&r down whenever you need to access your storage is powerful, what if you didn't need to place it down at all?
quest.5E1FFB29D89798F5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然随时放置一个&aQIO仪表板&r来访问存储已足够便捷，但如果你根本不需要放置它呢？

quest.5E2F4A6147694D5C.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["", {"text": "Chaotic", "color": "rainbow"}, " tools are the final upgrades to ", {"text": "Draconic", "color": "gold", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "11A35E8F97ACA240" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Draconic Tools Quest"}}, " tools, with the most room for ", {"text": "Upgrade Modules", "color": "green"}, " and maximum customizability."]
quest.5E2F4A6147694D5C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "混沌", "color": "rainbow"}, "工具是", {"text": "神龙", "color": "gold", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "11A35E8F97ACA240" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往神龙工具任务"}}, "工具的最终升级版，可安装", {"text": "升级模块", "color": "green"}, "的数量最多，拥有最强的可定制性。"]

quest.5E2F4A6147694D5C.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also upgrade into or craft the &zChaotic Staff of Power&r, an All-In-One tool and weapon.
quest.5E2F4A6147694D5C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你还可以通过升级或直接合成的方式打造一根&z混沌之力权杖&r，它不仅是一把全能工具，还是一把武器。

quest.5E2F4A6147694D5C.quest_desc[4].en_us: Their module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.
quest.5E2F4A6147694D5C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.5E3A4A3F00FDDEC0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aArcane Anvil&r will quickly become your best friend when using this mod.
quest.5E3A4A3F00FDDEC0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 游玩这个模组的时候，&a奥术铁砧&r将很快成为你最好的搭档。

quest.5E3A4A3F00FDDEC0.quest_desc[2].en_us: This anvil can be used to &bupgrade spells, equipment,&r and even &bimbue spells onto your gear!&r
quest.5E3A4A3F00FDDEC0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个铁砧可以拿来&b升级法术、装备&r，甚至还可以&b为装备灌注法术！&r

quest.5E3A4A3F00FDDEC0.quest_desc[4].en_us: Have a favorite spell but it's rather weak? Upgrade it using higher tier inks using the &aArcane Anvil&r!
quest.5E3A4A3F00FDDEC0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 喜欢用某个法术，但是这个法术有点太弱了？在&a奥术铁砧&r上用高阶墨水升级它！

quest.5E5BDCBF185E48E3.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEngineer's Workbench&r is the main crafting table for all of your engineering needs!
quest.5E5BDCBF185E48E3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a工程师装配台&r是用来制作沉浸工程耗材的最主要的工作站！

quest.5E5BDCBF185E48E3.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make items using the &aEngineer's Workbench&r, you will need different types of &bBlueprints&r to craft different types of items.
quest.5E5BDCBF185E48E3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要想使用&a工程师装配台&r制作物品，你需要提供&b工程师蓝图&r，不同的蓝图能够制作的东西也不同。

quest.5E5BDCBF185E48E3.quest_desc[4].en_us: When you place a &bBlueprint&r on the top-left slot, it will show what recipes are available to craft on the right side of the workbench. You can then place in the items for the recipe, then pull the crafted item out.
quest.5E5BDCBF185E48E3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 将&b工程师蓝图&r放置在左上方的槽位后，装配台的界面右侧将会显示可制作的物品。你需要将配方所需的原材料丢进装配台，然后直接取出你想制作的物品。

quest.5E74E0339A6F5314.quest_desc[0].en_us: Kill the &dChesed&r located in the &dChesed Arena&r in the &eEnd&r ring and &cSubmit its trophy&r to claim your bounty.
quest.5E74E0339A6F5314.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 击杀&d慈悲&r，它位于&e末地&r环中的&d慈悲竞技场&r，然后&c提交它的战利品&r来领取赏金。

quest.5E90192C6F3011B7.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the power of the &6World Engine&r and an &aEcho Encoder&r, you can manufacture more villagers using food once you have at least 1 &2Worker Token&r.
quest.5E90192C6F3011B7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 借助&6世界引擎&r和&a回响编码器&r的力量，你现在可以用食物生产村民了。不过在此之前，你还需要先获得至少一个&2劳工令牌&r才行。

quest.5E90192C6F3011B7.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oGone are the days of manually making more villagers.
quest.5E90192C6F3011B7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o跟手动繁殖村民的日子说再见吧。

quest.5ED10C54AE06DB40.quest_desc[0].en_us: &zInfinity Armor&r negates all damage to the player and provides jump boost and movement speed.
quest.5ED10C54AE06DB40.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z无尽套装&r可减免一切伤害，还可提升跳跃高度和移动速度。

quest.5ED10C54AE06DB40.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: You will need the entire set to prevent damage.
quest.5ED10C54AE06DB40.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：需要装备全套无尽套装才能免受伤害。

quest.5FBD41923B66C239.quest_desc[0].en_us: By default, drawers can only hold a base number of items depending on their size. You can upgrade this with these upgrades!
quest.5FBD41923B66C239.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 默认状态下，抽屉的存储上限由其种类决定，但是你可以升级它的存储上限！

quest.5FBD41923B66C239.quest_desc[2].en_us: For example, a standard Drawer that holds one type of item can hold up to around &a2,000 items&r for the base amount. Each upgrade multiplies the total storage amount, meaning the upgrades stack. Most drawers can hold 4 &aInventory Size Upgrades&r of any tier.
quest.5FBD41923B66C239.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 举个例子：基础抽屉只能储存一个物品，基础储存量为&a2,000&r个物品。你加装的每个升级都会翻倍储存量，而且升级可以累加。大部分抽屉都可以加装4个任何等级的&a存储容量升级&r。

quest.5FBD41923B66C239.quest_desc[4].en_us: Pro Tip: You can also place these inside of a &3Storage Controller&r to increase the linking range.
quest.5FBD41923B66C239.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 专业提示：你可以把存储升级加装到&3存储控制器&r中，可以提升存储控制器的链接范围。

quest.5FD42392FCECCB47.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the power of &dEnderic Lasers&r, you can focus the laser to mine Amethyst Clusters to get &dFluxite&r.
quest.5FD42392FCECCB47.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&d末影激光器&r，你就可以让激光挖掘紫水晶簇，从而得到&d辐水晶&r

quest.5FD42392FCECCB47.quest_desc[2].en_us: Using the laser on a Budding Amethyst will energize it and increase its growth rate.
quest.5FD42392FCECCB47.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果把激光射到紫水晶母岩上，则该母岩会被充能，以提升水晶生长速率。

quest.5FDB9EC42FE936C6.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.5FDB9EC42FE936C6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.5FDB9EC42FE936C6.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.5FDB9EC42FE936C6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.5FFC80176D33E4E1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6ProjectE&r gear negates a percentage of damage when equipped, with &cRed Matter&r gear having the strongest reduction of damage overall.
quest.5FFC80176D33E4E1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6等价交换&r模组的盔甲能够减免一定百分比的伤害，&c红物质&r盔甲减免得最多。

quest.5FFC80176D33E4E1.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, you must have the &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.5FFC80176D33E4E1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，你需要先进行&a机器方块&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.60633295CFD82152.quest_desc[0].en_us: Digging with a pickaxe will take forever since it only mines one block at a time.
quest.60633295CFD82152.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 用镐子挖东西实在太慢了，毕竟它们一次只能挖一格方块。

quest.60633295CFD82152.quest_desc[2].en_us: Upgrade to a &bHammer&r from the &bJustHammers&r mod! The basic &aStone Hammer&r can dig in a 3x3x1 area per swing, with the better Hammers digging out even bigger areas.
quest.60633295CFD82152.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 把你的工具升级成&bJust Hammers&r模组中的&b锤子&r吧！最基本的&a石锤&r可以挖掘3x3x1的空间，越高级的锤子挖掘范围也就越大。

quest.606BDEB81F65A79F.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are different upgrades that you can use to allow your chests to pick up nearby items.
quest.606BDEB81F65A79F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想让箱子自动拾取周边物品的话，有一些升级可以帮到你。

quest.606BDEB81F65A79F.quest_desc[2].en_us: The base level is just a &aPickup Upgrade&r, but upgrading to the &aMagnet Upgrade&r allows for more options and a wider range!
quest.606BDEB81F65A79F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a拾取升级&r是最基础的，但升级到&a磁铁升级&r后就有更多设置，以及更大的拾取范围！

quest.60871670B71C711F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Budding Crystals&r can take some time to grow and when you're trying to get your system up and running.
quest.60871670B71C711F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2水晶母岩&r的生长速度很缓慢，尤其是急着搭建AE系统的时候。

quest.60871670B71C711F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bGrowth Accelerators&r can be crafted and placed under the budding block to speed up the rate they grow substantially. These do require power to work.
quest.60871670B71C711F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 做个&b催生器&r，把它放在母岩下方就可以加快生长速度，不过要消耗能量。

quest.6089F3DC28FB69C0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aDirt&r seems to have plenty of &2Saplings&r that you can use! You can get these saplings by mining &aDirt&r with the &2Crook&r.
quest.6089F3DC28FB69C0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 看样子&a泥土&r里有大量的&2树苗&r可以利用！用&2钩子&r挖掘&a泥土&r，就能拿到这些树苗。

quest.6089F3DC28FB69C0.quest_desc[2].en_us: While you can wait for a tree to grow, you can force it to grow by using &eSquat Grow&r.
quest.6089F3DC28FB69C0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以慢慢等树长大，也可以通过&eSquat Grow&r模组来加速它们的生长。

quest.6089F3DC28FB69C0.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["This can be toggled with the keybind ", { "keybind": "key.squatgrow.toggle", "color": "green" }, "."]

quest.609DF15D870AE2C0.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eSoulplied Energistics&r is an addon mod for &eIF Souls&r that allows the transferring of souls using &eAE2&r.
quest.609DF15D870AE2C0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eSoulplied Energistics&r是&eIndustrial Foregoing: Souls&r和&6AE2&r的附属模组。它实现了通过&eAE2&r网络自动化传输灵魂的功能。

quest.609DF15D870AE2C0.quest_desc[2].en_us: Attaching a &aStorage Bus&r to the &dSoul Laser Base&r will allow your network to access the &3Warden Souls&r inside it. Then, Right-click any &eIF Souls&r item on an &aInterface Filter&r to request &3Souls&r stored in your system.
quest.609DF15D870AE2C0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 将&aME存储总线&r连接到&d灵魂镭射钻基座&r上方，你的ME网络便能访问其中的&3监守者灵魂&r。用任意&eIF Souls&r的物品右击&aME接口的过滤槽&r，即可通过网络请求系统中存储的&3灵魂&r。

quest.609DF15D870AE2C0.quest_desc[4].en_us: Finally, attach a &bSoul Pipe&r to the &aInterface&r and it will use its &3Warden Souls&r to power &bSoul Surges&r.
quest.609DF15D870AE2C0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 最后，将&b灵魂管道&r连接到该&a接口&r，接口便会消耗其中的&3监守者灵魂&r来驱动&b灵魂促速器&r。

quest.60B8D5DAA4BA7DC4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eReplication: Matter Overflow&f allows you to craft &aOverflow Tanks&r that will automatically void excess matter of its set type.
quest.60B8D5DAA4BA7DC4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &eReplication: Matter Overflow&f模组的&a物质储罐&r能自动销毁特定种类的过量物质。

quest.60B8D5DAA4BA7DC4.quest_desc[2].en_us: You should make one for each matter type and lock them so that excess matter always has somewhere to go and won't overflow into other tanks in your network.
quest.60B8D5DAA4BA7DC4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要为每种物质都制作一个储罐并将其锁定，这样过量的物质就不会造成堵塞，也不会流入网络中的其他储罐。

quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have a Data Model for a mob, you'll need to level it up to at least the &aBasic&r tier by killing that type of mob.
quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 一旦你获得了某个生物的数据模型，你就需要通过击杀该类型的生物，来将其至少提升到&a基础&r等级。

quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[2].en_us: When provided with a &2Prediction Matrix&r and power, the &aSimulation Chamber&r will run simulations as if you were killing that specific mob.
quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 提供&2预测矩阵&r和能源后，&a模拟室&r将模拟你对该生物的击杀过程。

quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[4].en_us: If the simulation fails, you'll get a &bGeneralized Prediction&r. If it succeeds, you'll get that mob's &6Prediction&r.
quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果模拟失败，你就会获得&b通用预测产物&r；而模拟成功时，就能获得对应生物的&6预测产物&r。

quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[6].en_us: This &6Prediction&r can be run through a &dLoot Fabricator&r to create loot!
quest.60BBE214131DF6EB.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &6预测产物&r可以在&d战利品制造器&r内运行以获取掉落物。

quest.60C650264AA5525D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aController&r is the main device that provides energy to your &eRS2&r network.
quest.60C650264AA5525D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a控制器&r是为你的&eRS2&r网络提供能源的主要设备。

quest.60C650264AA5525D.quest_desc[2].en_us: More than one controller can be present on a network if more power is needed. Controllers can also be placed anywhere across your network, unlike &eAE2&r Controllers.
quest.60C650264AA5525D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果网络需要更多能量，你可以在其内部放置多个控制器。控制器可以放置在网络中的任意位置，这与&eAE2&r的控制器不同。

quest.60FDF616DEDE5E73.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eApotheosis&r overhauls exploration and combat by creating a more RPG-like experience.
quest.60FDF616DEDE5E73.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e神化&r模组大改了原版的探索与战斗，打造了更类似于RPG游戏的游戏体验。

quest.60FDF616DEDE5E73.quest_desc[2].en_us: Items and mobs you can find in the world can have special &bAffixes&r on them, making them much stronger, and sometimes giving them special abilities to make things even more fun!
quest.60FDF616DEDE5E73.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 无论是你在世界中探索获得的物品，还是偶然遭遇的怪物，都有可能带有一个特殊的&b词缀&r。词缀会让物品/生物大大增强，有时甚至还能带来特殊的能力，为你的探索旅程增添乐趣！

quest.60FDF616DEDE5E73.quest_desc[4].en_us: If you feel lost, you can always refer to the &aChronicle of Shadows&r, which is the guidebook for the mod.
quest.60FDF616DEDE5E73.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果你感到不知所措的话，可以去看看本模组的教程书——&a阴影编年史&r。

quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the &aStraw&r that you've made, you are finally able to make a basic version of the most important tool on your journey: &3The Crude Brush&r.
quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&a草秆&r，你就可以做出游戏中最重要的工具的基础版本了：&3粗制刷子&r。

quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[2].en_us: With a gentle hand and a stroke of the &3Brush&r, you'll be able to find the minerals hidden inside the broken stones.
quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 挥动&3刷子&r，在碎石中小心地搜寻，你就可以找到其中埋藏的矿物了。

quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[4].en_us: You should return to the &dEcho of Guidance&r to show him your progress.
quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 现在回去找&d指引者的回响&r，向他展示你的成果吧。

quest.6120A9478D66C2F9.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: You can use /spawn to return to the lobby.

quest.612340743D7C7536.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &3Wireless Transmitter&r allows &dWireless Grids&r to access your network when within its set range, which can be extended with up to 4 &aRange Upgrades&r.
quest.612340743D7C7536.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3无线发送器&r可提供覆盖一定范围的信号，使&d无线终端&r能够连接到你的网络。可安装至多4个&a范围升级&r来扩大信号的覆盖范围。

quest.612340743D7C7536.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe default range is 16 blocks, which can be extended up to 48.
quest.612340743D7C7536.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o默认范围为16格，最多可扩展至48格。

quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the &2Worker Token&r, the &dEcho of Guidance&r has unlocked more &6Archives&r for you to visit.
quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&2劳工令牌&r，你便可在&d指引者的回响&r处解锁更多的&6档案&r。

quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[2].en_us: Within them are new &dEchoes&r whose tasks will allow you to upgrade the &6World Engine&r! Make sure to go meet each one, as they might have a gift for you.
quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 档案中有一些新的&d回响&r，他们的任务会指引你完成&6世界引擎&r的升级！请务必每一个都去见一见，他们可能有些礼物要送给你。

quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &6World Engine&r has plenty of upgrades, with only a few being required to advance. Each tier requires at least 2 Upgrades to be completed by working with the &dEchoes&r.
quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&r有诸多的升级项目，不过推进进程仅需完成少数特定的升级。每个阶段都需要你与&d回响&r合作，完成至少2项升级。

quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: &dMajor Upgrades&r will be required, while &aMinor Upgrades&r are optional.
quest.615D1A52ED3A9C78.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&d主要升级&r是必须要完成的，而&a次要升级&r不强制要求完成。

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6通用机械&r是这个整合包中最强的科技模组！

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &2Metallurgic Infuser&r is the core machine used in &6Mekanism&r.
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &2冶金灌注机&r是通用机械中的核心机器。

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[4].en_us: With this machine, you'll infuse metals with specific materials to create &aAlloys&r and &2Circuits&r used for more advanced machinery.
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以用这个机器向各类金属中灌注特定材料，用来制造更高级设备需要的&a合金&r与&2电路板&r。

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[6].en_us: For a complete description of the interface, check the next page!
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 关于有关界面的说明，请查看下一页！

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[8].en_us: Inside of the &2Infuser's&r interface, we have multiple slots that we can interact with to create new items.
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 在&2灌注机&r的界面中，分布着多个可交互的槽位，通过放置不同物品来合成其他物品。

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[10].en_us: The slot on the far left is the &aExtra Slot&r, which is where you place infusion items like &cRedstone&r or &aCoal&r.
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 最左边的叫&a灌注槽&r，你可以在这个槽位中放入灌注材料，比如说&c红石&r和&a煤炭&r。

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[12].en_us: The middle-left slot is for the item you wish to infuse, like Iron or Osmium!
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 中间靠左的槽位用于放置被灌注的原材料，比如说铁和锇！

quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[14].en_us: On the right, we have the output slot as well as an energy slot. This slot can use items that store energy like batteries. If you see an energy slot in a &eMekanism&r machine, chances are you can put these items in it!
quest.616E3CE38F1D73AE.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 右侧是输出槽和能源槽，能源槽可放入电池等储能工具。如果你在&e通用机械&r模组中的机器看到能源槽，可以试试放入储能工具！

quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Classic Pipes&r brings back that original &aBuildcraft&r feel with their easy to craft and use pipes.
quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6经典管道&r带来了简单易用的管道，来自&aBuildcraft&r模组的经典味道。

quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[2].en_us: The basic wooden pipes can be used to transport items and fluids.
quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 基础的木质管道可以用来传输物品和流体。

quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aIron&r versions are used to extract items or fluids when given redstone power.
quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a铁质&r版本则可以在通入红石信号后提取物品或流体。

quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[6].en_us: There are also several different tiers of pipes that do different things, so check them out!
quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 还有好几个不同等级的管道，各有各的用处，都去看看吧！

quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eNote&r: When these pipes overflow, they will lag the world. Make sure to create an overflow system!
quest.61B830759B316300.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e注意&r：当这些管道溢出时，它们会导致世界延迟。请确保创建一个溢出系统！

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the right combination of ingredients placed into a &aSoulbinding Brazier&r, semi-permanent &bOaths&r (also known as Geasa, singular: Geas) can be sworn on one's soul that change your experience in ways from minor to drastic.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 只要把正确的材料放进&a魂缚火盆&r，你就能为自己的灵魂签下一个半永久的&b条约&r，这会在各种大大小小的方面改变你的游戏体验。

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[2].en_us: Some examples are providing &2innate armor&r at the cost of &onever&r wearing any, or making you a &3titan of the sea&r, but &oonly&r when in water...
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 举个例子，一种条约会让你&2天生自带护甲值&r，但你将&o不能&r穿盔甲；另一种能让你成为&3海中霸主&r，但也&o只有&r在海里才是霸主……

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[4].en_us: Check &eMalum's Encyclopedia&r to see the conditions of these various Oaths.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你可以通过&e奥术全典&r来查阅签署这些条约的条件。

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[5].en_us: Check the next page for details on the Oath-making process.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: 签下条约的完整过程在下一页。

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[7].en_us: To use the &aBrazier&r, the central item outlined in the &eEncyclopedia&r must be inserted first. From there, the spirits and additional materials can be applied. Once the &bOath&r is prepared, use &eEther&r on the brazier to light it and begin the Oath.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: 要想使用这个&a火盆&r，你需要先把&e奥术全典&r里提到的核心物品放进去。随后，你就可以加入精魂及其他材料。&b条约&r准备完成后，用&e灵火&r即可点燃火盆，开始签订条约。

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[9].en_us: The Oath process will take a few dozen seconds, and any willing player may interact with the Brazier to accept the Oath at this time at the cost of a little damage, with each player able to take on two Oaths at once.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[9].zh_cn: 条约的签订会持续数十秒的时间，想签订条约的玩家只需要右击火盆即可进行签订，但需要受到一定伤害作为代价。每个玩家都只能同时拥有两个条约。

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[11].en_us: &o&7Unwilling, or unwitting, players and creatures can be included into Oaths by applying weakness to them before lighting the Brazier.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[11].zh_cn: &o&7身上具有虚弱效果的玩家或生物会在火盆开始燃烧后自动签下条约，无论他们自己意愿如何。

quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[13].en_us: To end the effects of an Oath, this process can be repeated with a &eParacasual Flame&r lighting the &aBrazier&r instead.
quest.61B948F3E526ADF9.quest_desc[13].zh_cn: 要想解除条约，只需要再放入同样的仪式材料，但是改用&e违因火焰&r来引燃&a火盆&r即可。

quest.61D55FA7CEA6F414.quest_desc[0].en_us: This dungeon can be found in the &dVoid Chasm&r ring.
quest.61D55FA7CEA6F414.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此地牢会生成在&d虚空裂隙&r环中。

quest.61D79267453CA30C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aFlux Plug&r is the device you place on your generators or power storage. It acts as a &cPower Tap&r and tells your network where to get the power from.
quest.61D79267453CA30C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a通量网络输入点&r是放在发电机或能量存储器上的，它就像一个&c能量阀门&r，告诉你的网络从哪里能提取能量。

quest.61D79267453CA30C.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aFlux Point&r is the device you place on the blocks or pipes you need powered. You'll want a lot of these!
quest.61D79267453CA30C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a通量网络接入点&r是放在需要供能的机器或管道上的。这个东西的用量会很大哦！

quest.61D79267453CA30C.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can craft any of the &aFlux Storage&r blocks to create a buffer of power for your network as well.
quest.61D79267453CA30C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还可以制造各种各样的&a能量存储器&r，增加你的网络能量缓存。

quest.620F29613800DC94.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aRune Inscribed Ring&r pattern allows you to inscribe &dRunes&r from the &6Iron's Spells&r mod.
quest.620F29613800DC94.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a铭刻符文之戒&r可以镶嵌&6Iron的法术与魔法书&r模组中的&d符文&r。

quest.620F29613800DC94.quest_desc[2].en_us: These &dRunes&r will empower the ring with different powers. Make sure to experiment!
quest.620F29613800DC94.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些&d符文&r会赋予戒指不同的力量，试试看吧！

quest.620F29613800DC94.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: This can only be bought from the &dEnchanter's&r &zShop&r.
quest.620F29613800DC94.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：此工匠卷轴只能在&d附魔师的&r&z商店&r中购买。

quest.62531896A7E58F55.quest_desc[0].en_us: The alloys within the &3Vault&r are exactly what the &dMachinist&r talked about needing for the &6World Engine&r upgrade.
quest.62531896A7E58F55.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3宝库&r中的合金正是&d机械师&r口中升级&6世界引擎&r所需的那种。

quest.62531896A7E58F55.quest_desc[2].en_us: Make those upgrade materials and head back to the &dEcho&r.
quest.62531896A7E58F55.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作好升级材料，然后回去找那个&d回响&r吧。

quest.62531896A7E58F55.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: You'll need to provide Rotational Power to the &6World Engine&r through the &aEncased Chain Drive&r below it.
quest.62531896A7E58F55.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：你需要通过&6世界引擎&r底部的&a链式传动箱&r来向其提供旋转力。

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[0].en_us: A &6CAD's Socket&r is basically its &abullet clip&r.

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[1].en_us: It's what &aSpell Bullets&r are loaded into, and it's responsible for transferring the compiled &bSpells&r contained within the Bullets to the &dCore&r for processing.
quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[1].zh_cn: 它是装填&a术式子弹&r的地方，并且也负责将子弹中已编译的&b术式&r转移到&d核心&r进行处理。

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[3].en_us: A &6Socket&r has a &eBandwidth&r, which is the maximum size &8&o(in grid spaces)&r&r of a &bSpell&r that it can transfer to a &dCore&r, all at once.
quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: 一个&6弹夹&r有自己的&e带宽&r，这是它一次可以将&b术式&r传输到&d核心&r的最大值&8&o（在网格中）&r&r。

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[4].en_us: &8&o(for example, a Socket with bandwidth 5 could transfer a Spell up to 5x5 in dimension)&r&r
quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &8&o（例如，一个带宽为5的弹夹最多可以传输尺寸为5x5的术式）&r&r

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[6].en_us: Also, another non-trivial attribute of &6Sockets&r is to provide a way to store &3persistent information&r, the more &bMemory&r a &6Socket&r provides, more &bVectors&r can be stored for later &bSpell&r executions.
quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 此外，&6CAD弹夹&r的另一个特有的属性是提供一种存储&3连续信息&r的方法，一个&6弹夹&r提供的&b内存&r越多，可以存储的&b向量&r就越多，以便之后的&b术式&r执行。

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[8].en_us: &8&o(&lTrick: Save Vector&r&8&o saves a vector to a designated Memory Slot, whereas &lSelector: Saved Vector&r&8&o retrieves the vector saved in the designated Memory Slot)&r&r
quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &8&o（&l启动式：储存向量&r&8&o可以将向量保存到指定的内存槽中，而&l选择符：储存向量&r&8&o可以检索保存在指定内存槽中的向量）&r&r

quest.62802965CA91E8C9.quest_desc[10].en_us: &6These ones&r in particular can provide you with either:

quest.62C92C8960875611.quest_desc[0].en_us: Metalworking is just as important in magic as it is with the mundane, even if the methods are far different. Ingots that have been infused with spiritual properties will be instrumental in progressing deeper into this craft.
quest.62C92C8960875611.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 无论是在物理领域还是在魔法领域，金属加工都是非常重要的，不过两个领域的加工方式大相径庭。注入了精魂的金属锭非常有利于更加深远的发展。

quest.6323068C93CF7DCE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWand of Symmetry&r can set up layouts that will automatically place blocks mirroring the blocks you place.
quest.6323068C93CF7DCE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d对称之杖&r可以设置布局，自动镜像你放置的方块。

quest.634884134E2786B2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dMalkuth Arena&r is a massive structure found within the &dVoid Chasms&r ring.
quest.634884134E2786B2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d王国竞技场&r是生成于&d虚空裂隙&r环中的大型结构。

quest.634884134E2786B2.quest_desc[2].en_us: This arena comes with its own boss fight!

quest.637CDD290456F2B2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aDissolution Chamber&r is the main crafting machine in the mod. This machine combines fluids like &2Latex&r with items to create new items.
quest.637CDD290456F2B2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a化学溶解室&r是工业先锋的主要合成机器，它可以将&2胶乳&r等流体与物品组合，从而制作新的物品。

quest.637CDD290456F2B2.quest_desc[2].en_us: While you'll be getting into some more advanced liquids later on, &2Latex&r will be used for most recipes for now!
quest.637CDD290456F2B2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你后续会接触到更高级的流体，但当前阶段&2胶乳&r仍是配方核心！

quest.63ACBB448387B83C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zCreative Memory Chip&r can be installed to unlock all items that can be replicated within your replication system.
quest.63ACBB448387B83C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 安装&z创造模式存储芯片&r就可以解锁复制网络中所有可被复制的物品。

quest.63B7AC676FC1EE7F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using &3Creosote Oil&r, you can combine it with planks to create &aTreated Wood&r.
quest.63B7AC676FC1EE7F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了&3杂酚油&r之后，你就可以用它与木板合成&a防腐木板&r了。

quest.63B7AC676FC1EE7F.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aTreated Wood&r is used to craft various &6I.E&r workstations, such as the &aEngineer's Workbench&r.
quest.63B7AC676FC1EE7F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a防腐木板&r能用来制作各种&6沉浸工程&r的工作站，例如&a工程师装配台&r。

quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are more types of Relays to transfer &dSource&r between jars and blocks!
quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有更多种类的中转器可以用来在罐子和方块之间传输&d魔源&r！

quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dSplitter&r is used to split the Source that is directed towards it into multiple Source Jars at once!
quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d魔源中转器：分流型&r可以将魔源分散成多股，从而同时填充多个魔源罐！

quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aDepositor Relay&r will deposit Source into Source Jars that are not linked to anything within 5 blocks. Great for creating Source storage rooms!
quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a魔源中转器：存放型&r会把收到的魔源传输到周边五格内未用支配之杖建立连接的魔源罐中，可以用来搭建大型魔源存储室！

quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &dWarper Relay&r is used to teleport Source to other &dWarper Relays&r, no matter how far away.
quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &d魔源中转器：折越型&r可以将魔源传输至另一个&d折越型中转器&r，无视距离。

quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eNote&r: Distances beyond 30 blocks will have a chance to lose some Source when warping.
quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e注意&r：如果折越距离大于30格，则在传送时有概率损耗一些魔源。

quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[10].en_us: The &aCollector Relay&r will automatically take Source from any Source Jar it is not connected to within 5 blocks of it.
quest.63BED4D08224B3EF.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &a魔源中转器：收集型&r会自动从未用支配之杖建立连接的魔源罐中提取魔源，提取范围为五格。

quest.63E9BE547681EB33.quest_desc[0].en_us: Babysitting a &dFission Reactor&r setup is important when it first comes online, but there are other things to do once it starts running fine on its own. This doesn't need to come at a cost to safety!
quest.63E9BE547681EB33.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 当&d裂变反应堆&r刚启动时，值守看管非常重要，但待其运行稳定后，你就可以去做其他事情了。这并不意味着你要为了生产效率而牺牲安全！

quest.63E9BE547681EB33.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is where the &aFission Reactor Logic Adapter&r comes in. When a &dReactor&r is built with one or more adapter(s), they can be configured to emit a redstone signal under &chazardous conditions&r, or to automatically activate the &dReactor&r.
quest.63E9BE547681EB33.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这时就需要用到&a裂变反应堆逻辑适配器&r了。当&d反应堆&r安装了一个或多个反应堆逻辑适配器时，其就可以被配置为在&c危险情况&r下发出红石信号，或者自动激活&d反应堆&r。

quest.63E9BE547681EB33.quest_desc[4].en_us: For example, using a comparator reading a &aRadioactive Waste Barrel&r to tell your &dReactor&r to turn off when the barrel is too full, or to toggle an emergency coolant supply if the reactor starts to &coverheat&r.
quest.63E9BE547681EB33.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 例如，先使用比较器读取&a放射性废料桶&r，在废料桶过满时让&d反应堆&r关闭，或在反应堆即将&c过热&r时切换紧急冷却剂的供应。

quest.64123F6FE4DEB4EF.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.64123F6FE4DEB4EF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.6461D19F839957B6.quest_desc[0].en_us: The heat from the &cIgnitium Ingot&r will give the spirits infused in the &bSoulstained Steel Ingots&r the feeling of home...
quest.6461D19F839957B6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c腾炎锭&r的热量足以让&b魂染钢锭&r中的精魂感受到家的温暖……

quest.6461D19F839957B6.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6World Engine&r should be able to encase the spirits properly into a block that you can use for the &3Spirit World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.6461D19F839957B6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&r可以将这些精魂封入方块中，制成&3世界引擎精魂升级&r所需的材料。

quest.648083DCC5BDF216.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aKinetic Dynamo&r uses forces generated by &aWaterwheels&r to generate power.
quest.648083DCC5BDF216.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a动能发电机&r利用&a水车&r产生的动能发电。

quest.648083DCC5BDF216.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aWaterwheels&r provide constant power based on the amount of water flowing around the wheel. Up to three &aWaterwheels&r can be attached to the same shaft.
quest.648083DCC5BDF216.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a水车&r可根据周围水流量的大小产生能量，同轴最多可放置3个&a水车&r。

quest.64B237B611F88036.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dEclipse Alloy&r is the final tier from &6Just Dire Things&r.
quest.64B237B611F88036.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d蚀空合金&r是&6Just Dire Things&r模组最高等阶的材料。

quest.64B237B611F88036.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are powered armors that can use the best upgrades from the mod.
quest.64B237B611F88036.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些能量驱动的盔甲可以安装本模组中最强力的升级。

quest.64B237B611F88036.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be made once you've defeated the &dChicken Jockey&r and made &dShadowpulse Goo&r.
quest.64B237B611F88036.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 等你击败&d威猛鸡骑士&r，制作出&d暗影脉凝胶&r之后，就可以制作蚀空合金了。

quest.652650C157E16712.quest_desc[0].en_us: One obvious use of &bSpirit&r is to make equipment from it. Infusing it into cloth provides a fine base to use the Spirit's properties.
quest.652650C157E16712.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b精魂&r的作用之一是制作装备。将精魂注入布料，你就能得到包含精魂力量的优秀装备材料。

quest.652650C157E16712.quest_desc[2].en_us: A &aSoulwoven Pouch&r can help you when gathering Spirits by funneling Spirits and certain other drops into itself before they'd touch its holder’s inventory, up to 8 stacks worth. The pouch can be used to dump its contents into the world, or used in the inventory to pull out sets of items at a time.
quest.652650C157E16712.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在收集精魂时，&a魂织布袋&r可以帮你在精魂以及其他物品进入你的物品栏前自动把它们吸入自己体内，最多可以装八组精魂。你可以通过手持这个布袋右击来直接倒出里面的全部物品，也可以在物品栏里一组一组地取出物品。

quest.65B10C46C1AE5026.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.65B10C46C1AE5026.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.65B10C46C1AE5026.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.65B10C46C1AE5026.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.6600E26635FD3D0E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Speed Modules&r can be used to upgrade many &eMFFS&r machines, generally speeding up their performance.
quest.6600E26635FD3D0E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 许多&e模块化力场系统&r的机器都可以安装&2速度模块&r，通常会加快他们的性能。

quest.6600E26635FD3D0E.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can also increase the generation rate of the &aCoercion Deriver&r and the &3Fortron&r transfer limit of the &aFortron Capacitor&r.
quest.6600E26635FD3D0E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 同样还会增加&a能源转换器&r的生成速率以及&a力场子电容器&r的传输速率。

quest.6600E26635FD3D0E.quest_desc[4].en_us: &2Capacity Modules&r increase the amount of &3Fortron&r a machine can hold at once.
quest.6600E26635FD3D0E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &2电容模块&r可以增加机器容纳&3力场子&r的量。

quest.663460DE8AF7E464.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCircuit Fabricator&r is a multiblock that creates processors for both &6AE2&r and &6RS2&r. These do require power but can accept regular FE power from other modded sources.
quest.663460DE8AF7E464.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a电路加工机&r是一种可以制作&6AE2&r和&6RS2&r所需的所有处理器的多方块机器。机器运作需要消耗能源，但可以接受其他模组的FE能量。

quest.663460DE8AF7E464.quest_desc[2].en_us: To create the multiblock, you will need some &dBlue Sheetmetal&r and &dVibrant Quartz Glass&r, and a &dMysterious Cube&r, which can be purchased from the &6Machinist&r, or traded from a &dWandering Trader&r or &aFluix Researcher&r.
quest.663460DE8AF7E464.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 搭建这种多方块结构，你需要一些&d蓝色板金属&r和&d聚能石英玻璃&r，还有能从&6机械师&r处购买的&d神秘方块&r，也可以通过与&d流浪商人&r或&a福鲁伊克斯水晶研究员&r交易获得。

quest.663460DE8AF7E464.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aCircuit Fabricator&r utilizes the same dimensional parallaxing as the &6World Engine&r and is able to process up to 16 recipes at once! You can overclock the fabricator by placing up to 10 &dAcceleration Cards&r into its upgrade slot. Fully upgraded this machine has the potential to consume A LOT of power!
quest.663460DE8AF7E464.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a电路加工机&r采用与&6世界引擎&r相同的维度视差技术，并能同时处理16个配方！你可以在它的升级栏中放置至多10个&d加速卡&r来为其超频。完整升级此机器将会使其消耗巨量能量！

quest.664F7957756D84FF.quest_desc[0].en_us: No matter what kind of spell school you choose to use, there is an armor set just for you.
quest.664F7957756D84FF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 不管你准备走哪个流派的法术，总有一套盔甲合你心意。

quest.664F7957756D84FF.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make these, you'll need to make &dArcane Cloth&r first. Combine several pieces of the cloth with a &aRune&r, and you can make some of the strongest mage armor!
quest.664F7957756D84FF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 先做出&d奥术布匹&r，再把它们和&a符文&r组合在一起，你就能造出一些最强的法师盔甲了！

quest.66545AFE0DEA820F.quest_desc[0].en_us: A darker set of items for a darker sort of craft.
quest.66545AFE0DEA820F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 更加黑暗的物品，致更加黑暗的工艺。

quest.665C261B98E4D20B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Speak to &dTwilight&r once you have returned triumphantly from your adventure so they can show you how to install the &3Twilight World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.665C261B98E4D20B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 从旅行中凯旋后，请与&d暮光族裔&r交谈，他会教你如何安装&3暮色世界引擎升级&r。

quest.6697F832067F1A9C.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eOritech's &3Enderic Railgun&r can shoot out both a concentrated laser beam and an explosive damaging beam depending on its mode. You can Shift + Right-click to toggle &bMining Mode&r on/off.

quest.6697F832067F1A9C.quest_desc[2].en_us: In &bMining Mode&r this All-In-One tool mines blocks directly into your inventory with infinite block interaction range.

quest.66BC4434409F959B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Plutonium&r can be reclaimed into &7Fissile Fuel&r with a bit of brine or salt processing.
quest.66BC4434409F959B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3钚&r可以通过少量的盐水或盐处理后，重新成为为&7裂变燃料&r。

quest.66BC4434409F959B.quest_desc[2].en_us: If you're using your &dReactor&r for power and hurting for &aUranium&r, &eSulfur&r, or even &7Fluorite&r, this process can be looped to make your initial fuel last up to five times as long over time with up to less than a tenth of the waste. That's the magic of recycling at work!
quest.66BC4434409F959B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你正在用&d反应堆&r发电，但又苦于缺乏&a铀&r、&e硫&r甚至&7氟石&r，不要担心，这个过程可以循环，让你的初始燃料使用的时间延长最多五倍，同时废料产出只减少不到10%。这就是循环利用的魅力！

quest.66E73F99D943365C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The first task from the &dFabricator&r is to create an element that can withstand very high temperatures.
quest.66E73F99D943365C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d构件师&r的第一个任务是制造一种能够承受极高温度的元件。

quest.66E73F99D943365C.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6World Engine&r should be able to forge these elements, as long as you have the &3Machine Block Upgrade&r.
quest.66E73F99D943365C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 完成&3机器方块升级&r后，&6世界引擎&r就能锻造出这种元件。

quest.66FF7D88B712C969.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.66FF7D88B712C969.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[0].en_us: A &aMolecular Metamorpher&r is a device that uses experience from a bound &eObelisk&r to infuse materials. This can make certain recipes for the mod cheaper, but is also a required method of crafting for some of &2Cognition's&r resources.
quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a分子重组仪&r是一种能将&e方尖碑&r的经验注入材料，然后制作出产物的设备。它不仅能使某些配方的造价降低，而且还是制作某些&2认知&r模组中的资源的必要途径。

quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is further expanded on with a &aTransforming Focus&r, converting various vanilla items into niche variants.
quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 有了&a转化之心&r的扩展，各种原版物品可以转换为其他变体。

quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7All xp levels listed in crafting use point values, and will not take any more experience levels than needed.
quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7制作中列出的所有经验等级都使用经验点数，不会消耗超过需求的经验等级。

quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7Item slots can also be locked to enable external automation.
quest.67396087E1916115.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &7物品槽可以锁定，从而实现外部自动化。

quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aCoercion Driver&r will convert energy to generate &bFortron&r over time.
quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a能源转换器&r能随时间将能量转变为&b力场子&r。

quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bFortron&r is mainly used to power your &eMFFS&r machines, but it can also be used to make more &#41AA71Fortron Infused Ingots&r in the &6World Engine&r once you have upgraded it.
quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b力场子&r主要用于为你的&eMFFS&r机器供能。升级&6世界引擎&r后，你也可以用它制作更多的&#41AA71力场子灌注锭&r。

quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oMFFS machines require a redstone signal to run by default, most of which can be inverted in the upper left corner of the interface.
quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o模块化力场系统的机器默认需要红石信号才会运行，你可以在大部分机器的界面左上角切换为需要红石信号关停机器。

quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eDerive Mode&r converts energy from other mods or dischargeable items in its inventory to generate &3Fortron&r.
quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e输入模式&r转换其他模组的能量或使用机器内物品中的能量来生成&3力场子&r。

quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[10].en_us: &eIntegrate Mode&r converts &3Fortron&r into energy at a slight loss.
quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &e输出模式&r以微小损耗将&3力场子&r转换为其他能量。

quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[12].en_us: Placing &2Lapis&r or &2Nether Quartz&r inside will triple the &aCoercion Deriver's&r conversion rate when consumed.
quest.6739E7A96309D0A8.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 你可以在机器内放入&2青金石&r或&2下界石英&r，&a能源转换器&r会消耗他们，并将转换速率提升至三倍。

quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Cores&r are an &aessential part of your CAD&r, always try to make the best one you can, &athey're basically the CPU of your CAD&r.
quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6核心&r是&aCAD中的关键部分&r，尽可能制作最好的吧——&a它们本质上是CAD的CPU&r。

quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[2].en_us: Every &6CAD Core&r has a &d&lComplexity Value&r&r, which means &dhow many computations it is able to do&r.
quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个&6CAD核心&r都有一个&d&l复杂度&r&r，这代表&d它能够执行多少计算&r。

quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[3].en_us: &8&o(Selectors, Operators e etc can increase the Complexity of a Spell)&r&r
quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: &8&o（选择符、运算符等会增加术式的复杂度）&r&r

quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[5].en_us: Also, Every &6CAD Core&r has a &3&lProjection Value&r&r, which is simply the &3total number of non-debug tricks it can perform at once&r.
quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: 此外，每个&6CAD核心&r都有一个&3&l映射值&r&r，这就是&3它能一次执行的非调试启动式的总数&r。

quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[7].en_us: This &6Core&r in particular provides you with:
quest.6755CACD4957A4CB.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: 这个&6核心&r可以为你提供：

quest.6781D1A7A53A5F1D.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.6781D1A7A53A5F1D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.6781D1A7A53A5F1D.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.6781D1A7A53A5F1D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[0].en_us: Not every &bFluid Cow&r can be made by breeding or using the &aClapple&r.
quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 并不是所有&b流体牛&r都可以由繁育或者&a粘土苹果&r得到。

quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[2].en_us: There are a few other items that you can feed to a cow to create specific types of &bFluid Cows&r, like an &dEye of Ender&r that creates a &cMolten Ender&r cow, a &dBlaze Rod&r creates a &cLava&r cow...
quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 还有一些其他的物品也可以喂给牛，用来创造特定类型的&b流体牛&r，比如&d末影之眼&r就可以创造出一只&c熔融末影珍珠&r牛，&d烈焰棒&r创造出一只&c熔岩&r牛……

quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &bLatex&r cow is also pretty nice.

quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[6].en_us: Feeding a fluid cow a &bBucket of Milk&r will reset them to a normal cow.
quest.67AD604F2C4E5CC9.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 给流体牛喂&b奶桶&r就会将它重置为普通牛。

quest.67D1E0D81B2C5D8D.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dLeviathan&r can be found within the &bWater Orb&r structure.
quest.67D1E0D81B2C5D8D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d利维坦&r可在&b水渊之珠&r结构中找到。

quest.67D1E0D81B2C5D8D.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is found scattered throughout the &bOcean&r ring.
quest.67D1E0D81B2C5D8D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该结构散布在&b海洋&r环周围。

quest.67D1E0D81B2C5D8D.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: You will need an &dAbyssal Sacrifice&r to activate the altar. The items required to craft it can be acquired from the &9Coralssus&r &aGateway of Eternity&r.
quest.67D1E0D81B2C5D8D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：你需要一个&d深渊祭品&r来激活祭坛。制作祭品所需的材料可以从&a永恒之门模组&r添加的&9珊瑚巨像传送门&r中获得。

quest.67DE9E103F50E3F1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aAndesite Casings&r are used to craft most early-game blocks and machines.
quest.67DE9E103F50E3F1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a安山机壳&r用于制作大多数早期游戏方块和机器。

quest.67DE9E103F50E3F1.quest_desc[2].en_us: They can also be used to cover up several &eCreate&r components to make your decoration prettier.
quest.67DE9E103F50E3F1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它还可以用来遮盖一些&e机械动力&r部件，让你的装饰更加美观。

quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &bFortron Capacitor&r is required in every &eMFFS&r system to act as a &3Fortron&r buffer and transfers it throughout the registered &bFrequency&r. The large button in the middle of the UI adjusts how the &bCapacitor&r distributes &3Fortron&r throughout a system.
quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 每个&e模块化力场系统&r的系统都需要&b力场子电容器&r作为缓存并在注册的&b频率&r内传输。界面中间的大按钮可以调整&b电容器&r在系统内分配&3力场子&r的方式。

quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each &2Speed Module&r increases its transfer rate.
quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个&2速度模块&r都会增加传输速率。

quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[4].en_us: Each &2Scale Module&r increases the base working range from a 15 block radius by 1 per module.
quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 每个&2尺寸模块&r都会增加1格工作范围半径，基础工作范围半径为15格。

quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[6].en_us: Each &2Capacity Modules&r increases the storage capacity.
quest.68258EA281734B4A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 每个&2电容模块&r都会增加最大存储量。
