quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[0].en_us: &7&oMoving chests has always been a pain. But not anymore!
quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &7&o移动箱子一般都是个劳苦活儿，但现在不会了！

quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aPacking Tape&r allows you to pack up &eSophisticated chests&r for you to easily move them.
quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a包装带&r可以打包&e精妙存储箱子&r，这样你就能轻松移动它们了。

quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[4].en_us: Use the packing tape on it first, then break it to get the chest as a single item. Once you've placed it down, the tape will disappear!
quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 首先把包装胶带用在箱子上，然后弄断胶带后你能把它当成一个普通物品拿着它，你一把它放地上，胶带就会消失！

quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: Chests with &aStack Upgrades&r will need to be packed up first before moving.
quest.68583162106594A8.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：装有&a堆叠升级&r的箱子最好先打包再移动。

quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Foundry &aDrain&r with a &aFoundry Tap&r on it can extract the molten metals you create onto a &2Casting Table&r.
quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 装有&a熔铸炉浇注口&r的&6熔铸炉&a排液孔&r可以将熔融金属排出到&2铸件台&r上。

quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[2].en_us: The molten metals will need some type of &bCast&r before they can be poured out onto the table.
quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在排出熔融金属前，铸件台上需要放好&b铸模&r。

quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &2Casting Basin&r can be used to store and create metal blocks.
quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &2铸造盆&r可以直接冷却和存储一整个金属块。

quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[6].en_us: &7&oThese can be dyed to match your base aesthetics.
quest.68668718B414B6E4.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &7&o你可以根据你的喜好进行染色。

quest.68778308CBAB4AE3.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aExternal Storages&r can access inventories outside of your storage network like Chests, Drawers, Tanks, and many others.
quest.68778308CBAB4AE3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a外部存储&r可直接访问网络外部的存储容器，如箱子、抽屉、储罐等。

quest.695B2CCD18E5DDFE.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of The Infernal&r.
quest.695B2CCD18E5DDFE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，寻找&d炼狱使者的回响&r了。

quest.695B2CCD18E5DDFE.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock the &bSpirit&r upgrade for your &6World Engine&r!
quest.695B2CCD18E5DDFE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&b精魂&r升级！

quest.695B2CCD18E5DDFE.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo infernal&7.
quest.695B2CCD18E5DDFE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo infernal&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.69997DAB93184551.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWyvern Chestpiece&r provides an energy shield when powered that nullifies damage taken by the player when worn in a Curios Slot. This can be upgraded via &aUpgrade Modules&r.

quest.69997DAB93184551.quest_desc[2].en_us: Its module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.

quest.69E90341CD1AD494.quest_desc[0].en_us: ► By &dRight Clicking&r a &6Spell Programmer&r you'll be able to access its GUI, it's a 9x9 &8&o(Direwolf Approved)&r Grid that allows you to place and connect &b"blocks of code"&r together.
quest.69E90341CD1AD494.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ► &d右击&r&6术式编写台&r，你就可以打开它的界面。你可以在它9x9&8&o（Direwolf赞同了）&r的网格上放置并连接&b“代码方块”&r。

quest.69E90341CD1AD494.quest_desc[2].en_us: Don't forget to make &6Spell Bullets&r too as they'll be used to hold your Spells, and let's move to the next quest where you'll be making your &bFirst Spell&r!
quest.69E90341CD1AD494.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 别忘了做&6术式子弹&r，它们可是用来存放你的术式的。那就让我们开始下一项任务，制作你的&b第一个术式&r吧！

quest.69E90341CD1AD494.quest_subtitle.en_us: Time to start Coding your own Spells!
quest.69E90341CD1AD494.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 是时候编写你自己的术式了！

quest.69F87073390131D5.quest_desc[0].en_us: To teach your system how to craft items, you'll need to provide it with &aCrafting Patterns&r. These are created inside of a &dPattern Encoding Terminal&r.
quest.69F87073390131D5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你需要给你的网络塞&a合成样板&r，才能教会它怎么合成某样东西。请在&dME样板终端&r中编写样板。

quest.69F87073390131D5.quest_desc[2].en_us: By providing the terminal with &aBlank Patterns&r, you can use &eJEI&r to search for an item you want to make a pattern for, then clicking the &b+&r to add the recipe onto the terminal.
quest.69F87073390131D5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 给终端里放上&a空白样板&r后，在&eJEI&r中搜索某样你想写样板的东西，之后按&b+&r按钮将合成表移动到终端里。

quest.69F87073390131D5.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once the pattern is on the table, you can click the button below the &aBlank Pattern&r to encode the recipe onto the pattern to be used in autocrafting!
quest.69F87073390131D5.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 样板放入正确槽位后，点击&a空白样板&r下方的按钮就能编写样板，日后自动合成就能用了！

quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e通用机械&r的&a粉碎机&r一共有3个用途。

quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[2].en_us: 1. It is used to break down ingots directly into &bDusts&r, which can be useful for creating dusts needed for certain machines or upgrades.
quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 1. 该设备可直接将金属锭分解为&b粉&r，便于获取制造特定机器或升级部件所需的材料。

quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[4].en_us: 2. In the Tier 2 Ore Processing Chain, the &aCrusher&r takes &eore clumps&r made from the &aPurification Chamber&r and breaks them down into &aDirty Dusts&r.
quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 2. 在二阶矿物处理产线中，&a粉碎机&r会将来自&a提纯仓&r产出的&e矿石碎块&r粉碎成&a污浊矿粉&r。

quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[6].en_us: 3. It can create &aBiofuel&r from organic materials, which is used to create new machines and byproducts that we'll need later down the road!
quest.6A3BFD63419A15CE.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 3. 可以用生物质制造&a生物燃油&r，后续需要它制作新的机器，同时它的副产物也有用途！

quest.6A4A2A2EFD552316.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you're looking to store your power, &aEnergy Cells&r from &ePowah&r will do the trick.
quest.6A4A2A2EFD552316.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想要些存储能量的东西，那你可以试试看&ePowah&r模组的&a能量单元&r。

quest.6A4A2A2EFD552316.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also craft &aBatteries&r and charge them up using the Cells. The Batteries can then be used to charge items in your inventory in the early game!
quest.6A4A2A2EFD552316.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你还可以做点&a电池&r，然后用能量单元给电池充能，再用电池给物品栏中的物品充能。这在游戏前期就可以实现！

quest.6A67A14C8770B8C5.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cLava&r and &bWater&r chickens are craftable Tier 2 chickens!
quest.6A67A14C8770B8C5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c熔岩&r和&b水&r鸡是可制造的2级鸡！

quest.6A67A14C8770B8C5.quest_desc[2].en_us: These chickens can be used to get some &aTier 2 Souls&r, which means &2Tier 2 Seeds&r.
quest.6A67A14C8770B8C5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些鸡可以用来获取一些&a2级灵魂&r，这意味着你就可以得到&22级饲料&r。

quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aDisk Drives&r accept &bStorage Disks&r capable of holding different resources and have several configuration options such as storage priority, insert/extract mode, void mode, and more.
quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a磁盘驱动器&r是装载&b存储磁盘&r的设备，这些磁盘可以存储不同类型的资源。驱动器本身有多种配置选项，如存储优先级、传输模式、销毁过量模式等等。

quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can also filter what items can be stored within a &aDisk Drive&r by placing that item on one of the top 9 slots inside its interface.
quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 其界面内最上方的9个槽位是过滤槽位，将物品放入其中即可限定&a磁盘驱动器&r只存储这些物品。

quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[4].en_us: &bStorage Disks&r can be upgraded directly into the next tier by crafting the upgraded part with the existing &bStorage Disk&r, returning your old one in the process while keeping all of your items stored.
quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &b存储磁盘&r可以通过将升级后的部件与现有的&b存储磁盘&r合成来直接升级到下一级，在此过程中会返还旧存储组件，同时保留所有存储的物品。

quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[6].en_us: &bStorage Disks&r can be separated from their housing by Shift + Right-clicking when it has no items stored inside it.
quest.6AA51581B0CA5271.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 当&b存储磁盘&r内没有存储物品时，可以通过Shift右击将存储组件与其外壳分离。

quest.6B2F4AA722DAC535.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Nether Stars.

quest.6B387999FBEE2E9E.quest_desc[0].en_us: This pack comes with random events that are disabled by default. To enable them, complete this quest!
quest.6B387999FBEE2E9E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个整合包里有各种各样的随机事件，但它们在默认情况下是不会发生的。完成这个任务，就可以启用它们！

quest.6B387999FBEE2E9E.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: Some events might contain jump scares. You can toggle each event using the command &b/events toggle <event>&r.
quest.6B387999FBEE2E9E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：有些随机事件包含跳杀元素。你可以通过&b/events toggle <事件名>&r这个指令来启用或禁用各种事件。

quest.6B387999FBEE2E9E.quest_desc[4].en_us: For example, if you want to disable the jump scare event, you can use the command &a/events toggle ftb:creeper&r.
quest.6B387999FBEE2E9E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 例如，你可以使用命令&a/events toggle ftb:creeper&r来禁用跳杀事件。

quest.6B391D0B32AF8529.quest_desc[0].en_us: After you've crafted enough &2Shadow Steel&r, you should return to the &dMachinist&r to learn where to place it in the &6World Engine&r.
quest.6B391D0B32AF8529.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作出足够的&2暗影钢&r后，请回到&d机械师&r处，他会告诉你这些东西需要装在&6世界引擎&r的什么位置上。

quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dArcane Essence&r can be useful in making your first magic armor set from &6Iron's Spells&r.
quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作&6Iron的法术&r模组中的早期法师盔甲的时候，&d奥术源质&r非常有用。

quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[2].en_us: When combined with a piece of leather armor, it creates a piece of the &aWandering Magician Set&r.
quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 把它和皮革盔甲合成后，就会产出属于&a流浪法师套装&r的盔甲。

quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once you have a good bit of essence, you can create the &dWizard&r set using &dArcane Cloth&r.
quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 当你的奥术源质够多之后，你就可以使用&d奥术布匹&r来制作&d巫师套装&r了。

quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[6].en_us: These are both great starting sets for slinging spells.
quest.6B584FB6F2EEBCD0.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 这两套盔甲都很适合施展法术的人穿戴。

quest.6B6C60BFE1D378D0.quest_desc[0].en_us: These are all of the blocks you'll need to complete a typical high-end &dAssembler Matrix &rsetup focusing on pattern storage, speed, and processing power.
quest.6B6C60BFE1D378D0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想搭建一个兼顾样板容量、合成速度和并发处理能力的顶配&d装配矩阵&r，这里列出的就是你所需要的全部方块。

quest.6B6C60BFE1D378D0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o这将搭建一个尺寸为7x7x7的多方块结构

quest.6B971FA156A96BD5.quest_desc[0].en_us: A &aSpirit Catalyzer&r consumes inserted furnace fuels to accelerate the processing speed of a nearby &eCrucible&r, up to eight are able to function on a single Crucible.
quest.6B971FA156A96BD5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a精魂催化器&r会消耗熔炉可用的燃料来给附近的&e坩埚&r加速。1个坩埚最多可以被8个催化器加速。

quest.6B971FA156A96BD5.quest_desc[2].en_us: This speed can sometimes cause more damage to the focal &eImpetus&r than usual, decreasing the total amount of material it can create before needing to be fixed or replaced.
quest.6B971FA156A96BD5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种加速可能会导致作为核心材料的&e促符&r损坏得更快，从而减少它能够合成的物品数量，而后你就必须修复或替换它了。

quest.6BB9FD515DFD8FF1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &bAE2&r comes with a built-in guide that you can access at any time within JEI.
quest.6BB9FD515DFD8FF1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &bAE2&r有内置教程，在JEI里就可以随时查看。

quest.6BB9FD515DFD8FF1.quest_desc[2].en_us: When hovering an item from the mod, you'll be prompted to hold the keybind to open up the guide.
quest.6BB9FD515DFD8FF1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 拿到不熟悉的AE2物品后，按住教程快捷键可以打开教程。

quest.6BB9FD515DFD8FF1.quest_desc[4].en_us: This guide is incredibly detailed and can be super helpful if you need help along the way!
quest.6BB9FD515DFD8FF1.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这个教程面面俱到，如果需要帮助的话它绝对能帮到你！

quest.6BCA2ED05C7D9D4E.quest_desc[0].en_us: The rejection of magic, when properly isolated from the mage wearing it, provides a powerful defense.
quest.6BCA2ED05C7D9D4E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 只要靠这套盔甲来隔开朝你进攻的施法者，它那对魔法的排斥能力就会给予你强大的防御。

quest.6BCA2ED05C7D9D4E.quest_desc[2].en_us: Magic attacks and boons alike are partially absorbed by the &5Malignant Stronghold&r, used to further fuel the armor's integrity and warding capabilities.
quest.6BCA2ED05C7D9D4E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &5恶念要塞&r会吸收你的一部分法术强度及其他属性，用作这套盔甲的食粮，从而进一步将其补完，并增强其防御能力。

quest.6BCA2ED05C7D9D4E.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7The more they fight, the closer their end approaches.
quest.6BCA2ED05C7D9D4E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7他们越是挣扎，死亡越是逼近。

quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aPrecision Dispeller&r allows the selective stripping of unwanted enchantments from items and can remove curses at the cost of 30 levels.
quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a精密祛魔台&r可以选择性地祛除不需要的附魔，还可以花费30级来移除诅咒。

quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7Binding this device to an Obelisk allows the XP gains and costs to use the Obelisk's storage instead of the player's when able to.
quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7将此设备绑定到经验方尖碑上，它就会从方尖碑内提取所需的经验，或是存入收获的经验，而不会使用玩家的经验等级。

quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[4].en_us: Once bound to an &eExperience Obelisk&r, an &aExperience Fountain&r can be activated with redstone to spill XP from the Obelisk into the world at certain rates. This also happens whenever a player stands on top.
quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 绑定到&e经验方尖碑&r后，你就可以用红石激活&a经验泉&r，以一定速度将经验从方尖碑输出到外界。当玩家站在上面时，它也会自动激活。

quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[6].en_us: Right clicking a bound Fountain with certain items can infuse them with XP.
quest.6C25708068B5197C.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 手持某些物品右击经验泉可以为它们注入经验。

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &cThermal Evaporation Tower&r is a multiblock that heats up the liquid inside of it to create a new liquid. For this, we'll be making &eBrine&r from &9Water&r.
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &c热力蒸馏塔&r可以加热内部的流体，以此来制造出新的流体。你可以利用这个机制来将&9水&r制作成&e盐水&r。

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make this, you'll need a minimum of 53 Thermal Evaporation Blocks, 3 Valves, and 1 Controller. Once you have those, let's learn how to build it!
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 搭建这个多方块结构至少需要53个热力蒸馏方块，3个热力蒸馏阀门和1个热力蒸馏控制器。材料准备齐全后，咱们就来学习一下如何搭建它！

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &cThermal Evaporation Tower&r multiblock is built 4 blocks wide and 4 blocks long, with a minimum height of 3 blocks and a maximum height of 18 blocks. Aside from the first layer, the center is hollow, no matter the height. Think of it like a giant bucket! The frame must also be Thermal Evaporation Blocks, with the Controller and Valves placed on the faces.
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &c热力蒸馏塔&r多方块结构底部的长宽均为4格，高度至少3格，最多18格。除底层面外，无论高度多少，中间空心，可以想象成一个巨大的水塔！框架必须是热力蒸馏方块构成，控制器和阀门需要安装在水塔的侧面。

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[6].en_us: Here is an example of how it might look:

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[10].en_us: To interact with the block, you'll need to place the &aController&r on one of the faces.
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 需要在任意一个面上放上&a热力蒸馏控制器&r，这个多方块结构才可以被交互。

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[12].en_us: Each &cValve&r is used to pump liquids in and out of the Tower. To make &eBrine&r, you'll need to give it water which can be done by pumping water into the Valve using Mechanical Pipes from a water source.
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 每个&c阀门&r均用于向塔内输入或从中输出液体。若需生产&e盐水&r，则需向其供水，这可以通过机械管道从水源将水泵入阀门来实现。

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[14].en_us: You'll need another Valve to output the Brine you create, and the 3rd Valve is used to heat up the multiblock. You can make either a &aFuelwood Heater&r or a &cResistive Heater&r to achieve this. Fuelwood burns items like coal, while Resistive Heaters use power instead. 2k is the perfect number for a max size Tower!
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 第二个阀门是用来输出盐水的，第三个阀门则是用来给蒸馏塔供热的。可以做个&a固体燃料加热器&r或&c电阻型加热器&r来给它供热，固体燃料加热器需要消耗煤炭之类的燃料才能发热，而电阻型加热器则消耗的是能量。顶配蒸馏塔则要2k的温度！

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[16].en_us: Once built, you'll see red sparkles indicating that it formed!
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 结构搭建完成时会出现红石的激活粒子！

quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[18].en_us: Pro Tip: You can place the Heater directly on the Valve, so no pipes needed!
quest.6C4441CC63BC7603.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: 专业提示：你可以直接把加热器贴在阀门上，这样就不需要管道了！

quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dSchrödinger's Safe&r is an energy storage multiblock that can store billions of RF when properly set up.
quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d薛定谔保险柜&r是一个多方块储能装置，配置得当时，其储电量可达数十亿RF。

quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[2].en_us: This multiblock requires a &bCapacity Block&r which changes the base storage multiplier of &dSchrödinger's Safe&r.
quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该多方块结构中有一个&b容量方块&r，它决定了&d薛定谔保险柜&r的基础容量倍率。

quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[4].en_us: Low, Medium, and High Capacity Blocks multiply the base storage by 0.3x, 1x, and 5x respectively. Check the item tooltip for a full list of available capacity blocks.
quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 低、中、高三种等级的容量方块分别对应0.3倍、1倍和5倍的容量倍率。将鼠标悬停在物品上，查看其工具提示，那里列出了所有可用的容量方块。

quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[6].en_us: You can also exponentially increase the capacity of &dSchrödinger's Safe&r by powering its sides with &aEnderic Lasers&r, up to 5000x
quest.6C4783132CC50BF0.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 此外，你还可以用&a末影激光器&r向&d薛定谔保险柜&r的侧面输入能量，使其容量指数级增长，最高可达5000倍。

quest.6C7F31673B12795D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dEclipse Alloy&r is the final tier from &6Just Dire Things&r.
quest.6C7F31673B12795D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d蚀空合金&r是&6Just Dire Things&r模组最高等阶的材料。

quest.6C7F31673B12795D.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are powered weapons that can use the best upgrades from the mod.
quest.6C7F31673B12795D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些能量驱动的武器可以安装本模组中最强力的升级。

quest.6C7F31673B12795D.quest_desc[4].en_us: These can be made once you've defeated the &dChicken Jockey&r and made &dShadowpulse Goo&r.
quest.6C7F31673B12795D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 等你击败&d威猛鸡骑士&r，制作出&d暗影脉凝胶&r之后，就可以制作蚀空合金了。

quest.6C974CC33C5BADD8.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Liquid Meat and any ingot.
quest.6C974CC33C5BADD8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 消耗肉汤与任意锭发电。

quest.6D06EDA1F34FA4E9.quest_desc[0].en_us: With infinite power for your storage system and access to &zcreative spells&r from &6Ars&r, that only leaves one more thing to take care of before you can shape the world around you.
quest.6D06EDA1F34FA4E9.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你已经拥有了无限能量的存储系统和来自&6Ars&r模组的&z创造法术书&r，在改写这个世界之前只剩下最后一步没有处理。

quest.6D06EDA1F34FA4E9.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 让&z创造能量立方&r供能一切。

quest.6D06EDA1F34FA4E9.title.zh_cn: 飞升阶段3 - 无所不知

quest.6D0C1811DA909BBD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAncient City Vault&r is filled with loot, but the most important item comes from the boss.
quest.6D0C1811DA909BBD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d远古城市宝库&r中充满了各种各样的战利品，但最重要的东西还是来源于那里的Boss。

quest.6D0C1811DA909BBD.quest_desc[2].en_us: 3-4 &bCursium Ingots&r will drop on each kill. These ingots can be transformed into a usable upgrade in the &6World Engine&r.
quest.6D0C1811DA909BBD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每次击杀boss将掉落3-4个&b咒魂锭&r。这些锭可以在&6世界引擎&r中转化为可用的升级材料。

quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eTime Steel&r is used to craft better versions of your existing devices, and a few new gadgets as well.
quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e时钢&r可用于升级你的现存设备，也可以合成一些有用的东西。

quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dChronon Battery&r is the first upgrade you should craft.
quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d时元电池&r是你应当合成的第一个升级。

quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[4].en_us: It can store much more &bChronon&r than the simple &aChronon Cell&r, and is also a crafting ingredient used in some of the more advanced &eTempad&r recipes.
quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 与普通的&a时元电芯&r相比，它可以存储更多的&b时元&r，而且它还是参与更高级&e时域仪&r合成的原材料。

quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: You must have the &eChroniton Glass&r and &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrades&r to craft this.
quest.6D28E1AFBB33C43E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，需要先用&e时空粒子玻璃&r与&a机器方块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.6D2B6421B1115667.quest_desc[0].en_us: Instead of storing Iron Nuggets, Ingots, and Blocks in 3 separate drawers, you can store them all in a &aCompacting Drawer&r.
quest.6D2B6421B1115667.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你没必要再把铁粒、铁锭、铁块分开装三个抽屉了，都丢进&a压缩抽屉&r就行。

quest.6D2B6421B1115667.quest_desc[2].en_us: These are special drawers that store and convert items directly into their compressed versions. This is useful for items like Iron or Gold to easily convert back and forth!
quest.6D2B6421B1115667.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这种特殊抽屉可以把物品变为它的压缩形态！你可以用它轻松转化像是铁和金的形态！

quest.6D2B6421B1115667.quest_desc[4].en_us: With &aSimple Compacting Drawers&r, you can store items that only use a base and block recipe. This is great for items like Redstone, Diamonds, and Emeralds!
quest.6D2B6421B1115667.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a简易压缩抽屉&r可以处理只有原物品和方块物品的储存，比如放红石钻石和绿宝石！

quest.6D5905345348ABEF.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dFlux Controller&r enables wireless charging for items you have equipped or in your hotbar.
quest.6D5905345348ABEF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d通量网络控制器&r可为你的装备栏或快捷栏中的物品无线充能。

quest.6D5905345348ABEF.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once placed down and connected to a network, you can open up the &dWireless Charging&r tab to select which slots you want to be charged wirelessly.
quest.6D5905345348ABEF.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 把它放下并连接到网络后，打开&d无线充能&r标签页，然后选择你想充能的槽位。

quest.6D5905345348ABEF.quest_desc[4].en_us: Make sure to toggle it on at the bottom and click apply!
quest.6D5905345348ABEF.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 记得把底部的开关打开，然后点击应用！

quest.6D5A9E9E8B0D8AC2.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the materials you've gathered, you should be able to craft the &3Chronon Generator&r like the &dEcho&r wanted!
quest.6D5A9E9E8B0D8AC2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 现在，你手上的材料应该已经能合成出那个&d回响&r想要的&3时元发生器&r了！

quest.6D5A9E9E8B0D8AC2.quest_desc[2].en_us: It's time to submit the &aChronon Generator&r and return to the &dEcho of Guidance&r. Doing this will award all players on your team a &aCell&r and a &2Generator&r.
quest.6D5A9E9E8B0D8AC2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 请在这里提交&a时元发生器&r，然后回去找&d指引者的回响&r。完成此任务会奖励你队伍中的每个玩家一个&a电芯&r和一个&2发生器&r。

quest.6D5A9E9E8B0D8AC2.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&f: You must submit the &aChronon Generator&r to complete this quest and update the &dEcho of Guidance&r.
quest.6D5A9E9E8B0D8AC2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&f：你必须提交&a时元发生器&r，才能完成这个任务并更新&d指引者的回响&r。

quest.6DB6B40C3E07E389.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you manage to find your way through the puzzles of this vault, the &2Chroniton Star&r should be yours for the taking.

quest.6DB6B40C3E07E389.quest_desc[2].en_us: Just remember, the cake is a lie.

quest.6E149F8E8B3F150B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've crafted the &2Echoing Deepshelves&r, head back to the &dEcho of the Enchanter&r to learn how to install it into the &6World Engine&r as an upgrade.
quest.6E149F8E8B3F150B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作出&2回响深暗书架&r后，请回到&d附魔师的回响&r处，学习如何为&6世界引擎&r安装该升级。

quest.6E24701C49A6114D.quest_desc[0].en_us: With the &6World Engine&r upgraded with the power of the &zVoid&r, you can create the &dNeutronium Compressor&r to compact items down into &zSingularities&r.
quest.6E24701C49A6114D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 以&z虚空&r之力升级&6世界引擎&r后，你就能制作&d中子态素压缩机&r来将物品压缩成&z奇点&r。

quest.6E24701C49A6114D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Use these to create the &zInfinity Singularity&r.
quest.6E24701C49A6114D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用这些奇点制作&z无尽奇点&r。

quest.6EE1C1B7FFB86C6C.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aSigils of Socketing&r are used to increase the number of &bGem Sockets&r of an &bAffix&r item.
quest.6EE1C1B7FFB86C6C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a镶孔符石&r可增加&b词缀&r物品的&b宝石镶孔&r数量。

quest.6EE1C1B7FFB86C6C.quest_desc[2].en_us: These can also be bought from the &zShop&r!
quest.6EE1C1B7FFB86C6C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在&z商店&r里购买这些符石！

quest.6F258F4C7BE2EE44.quest_desc[0].en_us: This compass points to the location of a &3Vault.
quest.6F258F4C7BE2EE44.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这个指南针指向了一座&3宝库&r。

quest.6F258F4C7BE2EE44.quest_desc[2].en_us: &7&oThe Compass can be Sneak + Right-clicked when within 256 blocks from the vault to instantly teleport to the entrance!&r
quest.6F258F4C7BE2EE44.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &7&o在你位于宝库256格范围内时，潜行右击指南针便能立即传送到入口处！&r

quest.6F4A4B4C261FF84B.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Furnace Fuels.

quest.6F53C65C3131B68A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &2Archaeologist&r is a master of soft materials, and can work through &2Dirt&r, &eSand&r, &eDust&r, and &7Mud&r. They require a &aDecorated Pot&r as a workstation.
quest.6F53C65C3131B68A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2考古学家&r是软质材料的大师，可以处理&2泥土&r、&e沙子&r、&e灰尘&r和&7泥巴&r。他们需要一个&a饰纹陶罐&r作为工作站。

quest.6F53C65C3131B68A.quest_desc[2].en_us: This worker can be a great source for generating seeds, clay, and more unique ore chunks like &2Uranium&r.
quest.6F53C65C3131B68A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 根据他们的等级，这位工人可以成为种子，粘土和更多稀有矿物碎块如&2铀矿&r的重要来源。

quest.6F53C65C3131B68A.quest_desc[4].en_us: A level 4 &2Archaeologist&r is a great way to get &dArchwood Saplings&r!
quest.6F53C65C3131B68A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 四级&2考古学家&r是得到&d至高树苗&r的好办法！

quest.6F91297C4FAA43FE.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dDimensionalist&r is a master of other-worldy materials, and can brush through &cNetherrack&r, &eEnd Stone&r, and &7Otherrock&r. They require a &aResonanz Engineering Block&r as a workstation.
quest.6F91297C4FAA43FE.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d维度学家&r是异界材料的大师，可以刷&c下界岩&r、&e末地石&r和&7异界岩&r，需要一个&a共振工程块&r作为工作站。

quest.6F91297C4FAA43FE.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is an advanced worker that allows you to acquire some of the rarer materials like &aPlatinum&r and &bDimensional Shards&r.
quest.6F91297C4FAA43FE.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是高级工人，允许你获得一些稀有材料，如&a铂&r和&b维度碎片&r。

quest.6F91297C4FAA43FE.quest_desc[4].en_us: A level 4 &dDimensionalist&r is required to get &aReplica Ore&r and &aDraconium Dust&r.
quest.6F91297C4FAA43FE.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 四级&d维度学家&r是得到&a复制物质矿石&r和&a龙尘&r的必要条件。

quest.6FB2393F2348D59E.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aMob Imprisonment Tool&r is a simple reusable device that snatches up mobs so you can place them down anywhere you want.
quest.6FB2393F2348D59E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a生物捕捉工具&r是一种可重复使用的简易装置，它能捕捉生物，以便你将它们放置在任意地点。

quest.6FB2393F2348D59E.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aCreature Catcher&r works the same way, but requires you to throw the item at the mob... like a certain other game that shall not be named.
quest.6FB2393F2348D59E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a生物捕捉器&r的工作方式相同，但你需要将它扔到生物身上……就像一款不可言说的游戏。

quest.6FF752712E99A936.quest_desc[0].en_us: To craft any of the upgrades, you'll need to make an &aUpgrade Base&r.
quest.6FF752712E99A936.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果想要合成升级，你得先做&a升级基板&r。

quest.700716B4ACCBD4F4.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["The ", {"text": "Draconic Chestpiece", "color": "gold"}, " is an upgraded versions of the ", {"text": "Wyvern Chestpiece", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "69997DAB93184551" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Wyvern Chestpiece Quest"}}, ", with room for more ", {"text": "Upgrade Modules", "color": "green"}, "."]
quest.700716B4ACCBD4F4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "神龙护胸", "color": "gold"}, "是", {"text": "双足飞龙护胸", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "69997DAB93184551" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往双足飞龙护胸任务"}}, "的升级版，可安装更多的", {"text": "升级模块", "color": "green"}, "。"]

quest.700716B4ACCBD4F4.quest_desc[2].en_us: Its module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't bound by default.
quest.700716B4ACCBD4F4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.705E4FFB4FCADFD1.quest_desc[0].en_us: You can extract matter from items using the &aDisintegrator&r.
quest.705E4FFB4FCADFD1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以使用&a分解器&r从物品中提取物品。

quest.705E4FFB4FCADFD1.quest_desc[2].en_us: This matter will need to be stored into &aMatter Tanks&r for later use, and can be piped between machines and tanks using &eMatter Network Pipes&r.
quest.705E4FFB4FCADFD1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 物质需要储存在&a物质储罐&r中以备后用，其可被&e物质网络管道&r在机器和储罐传输。

quest.706E469302F9F383.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSource Condenser&r can be used to turn regular source into fluid.
quest.706E469302F9F383.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a魔源凝聚器&r能将魔源转变为流体。

quest.70753CD7045AE9E1.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dMalignant Pewter&r is a material made of magic that is inherently counter to the world of magic and creation.
quest.70753CD7045AE9E1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d恶念白镴&r是一种魔法材料，这种材料天生就对这充满了魔法和创造的世界抱有恶意。

quest.70753CD7045AE9E1.quest_desc[1].en_us: Weapons and armor made from the stuff seem to seek to undo, to end, if not outright destroy.
quest.70753CD7045AE9E1.quest_desc[1].zh_cn: 这种材料制成的武器和盔甲不是为了彻底的毁灭，就是为了打破禁忌和寻求终结。

quest.70753CD7045AE9E1.quest_desc[3].en_us: &7The greatest tales all told, end with silence.
quest.70753CD7045AE9E1.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: &7一切伟大传说，终将归于死寂。

quest.708CFC310C5408B6.quest_desc[0].en_us: Lenses are placed on an &eAtomic Reconstructor&r to change its functionality.
quest.708CFC310C5408B6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 将透镜放在&e原子再构机&r上能够更改它的功能。

quest.708CFC310C5408B6.quest_desc[2].en_us: The basic &aLens&r is only used as a crafting material for other lenses.
quest.708CFC310C5408B6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 基础&a透镜&r仅作为其他透镜的制作材料。

quest.70A9E1AC900A77B4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aPlayer Transmitters&r are used to power items in your inventory.
quest.70A9E1AC900A77B4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a玩家供电仪&r可以给你物品栏中的物品充能。

quest.70A9E1AC900A77B4.quest_desc[2].en_us: To do this, you'll need to first make a &aBinding Card&r, then use it in your hand to claim it. Placing the card in the Transmitter will tell it to power your inventory.
quest.70A9E1AC900A77B4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在此之前，你需要先做一张&a绑定卡&r。手持绑定卡右击即可将卡绑定到自己，然后把卡插入供电仪就可以给物品栏供能了。

quest.70A9E1AC900A77B4.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also use the &aBinding Card&r on an Enderman to convert it into a &dDimensional Binding Card&r, which allows the Transmitter to work across dimensions.
quest.70A9E1AC900A77B4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果对末影人使用&a绑定卡&r，绑定卡就会变成&d跨维度绑定卡&r，这样玩家供电仪就可以跨维度工作了。

quest.70BB982228095E51.quest_desc[0].en_us: To make the &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r for the &6World Engine&r, you'll need a sturdy frame to start with.
quest.70BB982228095E51.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了制作用于&6世界引擎&r的&c高级机器方块&r，你需要先制造一种坚固的框架。

quest.70BB982228095E51.quest_desc[2].en_us: Processing the frame requires creating &aPlastic&r. This can be used to make a machine capable of extracting a specific fluid from monsters.
quest.70BB982228095E51.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作这种框架需要用到&a塑料片&r。&a塑料片&r可用于制造一种机器，这种机器可以从怪物身上提取特定的流体。

quest.70BB982228095E51.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["", {"text": "Note", "color": "yellow"}, ": ", {"text": "Latex", "color": "green"}, " can also be acquired by making a ", { "text": "Fluid Cow", "color": "dark_green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "150BB4679DD2B4B5" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Fluid Cows Quest"}}, "!" ]
quest.70BB982228095E51.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "注意", "color": "yellow"}, ": ", {"text": "胶乳", "color": "green"}, "也可以通过", { "text": "流体牛", "color": "dark_green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "150BB4679DD2B4B5" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往流体牛任务"}}, "获得！" ]

quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[0].en_us: Chickens have &bTiers&r depending on the resource they can create. This &bTier&r determines what tier of seed that they will need to eat. These seeds require &dSouls&r to make.
quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 鸡拥有&b级别&r，这取决于它们可以制造的资源。&b级别&r决定了它们需要吃什么级别的饲料。这些饲料需要&d灵魂&r来制作。

quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[2].en_us: You'll need to make a &dSoul Extractor&r to extract &btiered souls&r from chickens to make the seeds.
quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要&d灵魂提取器&r来从鸡中提取&b各级别的灵魂&r来制造这些饲料。

quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[4].en_us: Thankfully, you will only need one seed of each tier, then you can plant them and squat-grow them!
quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 幸运的是，你每个阶段只需要一份饲料。之后你可以种植它们并蹲起来催熟。

quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: The &6World Engine&r can also craft soul upgrades.
quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&6世界引擎&r也可以制作灵魂升级。

quest.70C02FCA0C7B8777.quest_subtitle.en_us: Use the Chickens to Breed the Chickens

quest.70D5BEA5CC437AB6.quest_desc[0].en_us: Got a lot of random enchanted gear? Using a &dTome of Scrapping&r, you can break it down and extract some of the enchantments from it.
quest.70D5BEA5CC437AB6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 带乱七八糟附魔的装备太多了？&d拆解宝典&r可以帮你拆解装备，把一部分魔咒提取出来。

quest.70D5BEA5CC437AB6.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dTome of Extraction&r will also remove all enchants, but will keep the item from being destroyed, allowing you to remove and replace any number of enchantments on an item at will.
quest.70D5BEA5CC437AB6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d提取宝典&r也会移除所有的附魔，但是不会摧毁物品，你可以用它随意移除或更换物品的魔咒。

quest.70D5BEA5CC437AB6.quest_desc[4].en_us: If you're looking for a specific enchantment for a specific tool, you can use &dTomes&r which can be crafted to only support a certain class of enchantments.
quest.70D5BEA5CC437AB6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果你在为某种工具寻找特定的魔咒，可以试试用&d宝典&r，特定种类的宝典只能附魔出特定种类的魔咒。

quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you're looking to store your items &bDigitally&r, you'll want to make the &aME Drive&r and some &2Storage Cells&r.
quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想&b数字化&r地存储物品，那就做个&aME驱动器&r和&2存储元件&r吧。

quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aME Drive&r can house up to &b10 AE Disks&r. When connected to your network, items can automatically be stored as digital media and accessed via interfaces, I/O Buses and Terminals.
quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &aME驱动器&r可以最多插入&b10个AE存储元件&r，装进AE网络后就可以以数字媒介存储物品，还可以和各种接口、输入/输出总线和终端交互。

quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[4].en_us: There are 2 types of item storage drives. &aItem Storage Cells&r can store 63 different types of items, while &aME DISK Drives&r can store an infinite number of item types, with a higher crafting cost.
quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 有两种类型的物品存储驱动器。&a物品存储元件&r可以存储63种不同的物品类型，而&aME磁盘驱动器&r没有物品类型限制，但制作成本更高。

quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &aCell Workbench&r allows you to configure what types of items you want to allow onto an &2AE Storage Cell&r.
quest.71024D8DC19834AC.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 你可以用&a元件工作台&r给&2AE存储元件&r进行设定，例如你想让它可以存储什么物品。

quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAssembler Matrix&r is a multiblock structure that combines the functionality of &aMolecular Assemblers&r and &2Pattern Providers&r, and it can run many crafting jobs simultaneously.
quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d装配矩阵&r是一种多方块结构，它集成了&a分子装配室&r和&2样板供应器&r的功能，能同时执行大量的合成任务。

quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aAssembler Matrix&r can be between 3x3x4 and 7x7x7, must contain at least 1 Matrix Pattern Core and 1 Matrix Craft Core, and it must also not contain any hollow spaces.
quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a装配矩阵&r的尺寸最小为3x3x4，最大为7x7x7。其内部必须填满，不能空心，并且至少要包含1个矩阵样板核心和1个矩阵合成核心。

quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[4].en_us: - The edges must be composed of &bAssembler Matrix Frames&r,
quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: - 结构的边框必须使用&b装配矩阵框架&r；

quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[5].en_us: - The faces can be composed of &aAssembler Matrix Wall&r/&2Glass&r,
quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: - 结构的“墙面”可以用&a装配矩阵墙壁&r或&2玻璃&r；

quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[6].en_us: - The interior must be composed of &dMatrix Cores&r.
quest.711D381A7974F88A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: - 结构内部则必须用各类&d矩阵核心&r填满。

quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dForce Field Projectors&r consume &3Fortron&r to create a procedurally regenerating area of blocks. It doesn't do much without a &2Mode&r to work from, but it's what makes all the &mmagic&r technology happen!
quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d力场投影仪&r通过消耗&3力场子&r投射立场。不安装&2模块&r也能发挥作用，但模块才是引发&m魔法&r般质变的关键！

quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each change in the interface will cause the &dProjector&r to delete the current projection and rebuild the new one, so be mindful of how often you make changes.
quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 对&d力场投影仪&r界面的更改会移除当前的投影并重构，因此不建议频繁更改。

quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oLarger Force Fields will negatively affect performance.
quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o更大的力场需要更高的性能。

quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eMatrix Slots&r accept various &2Modules&r that add to/tweak how the &dProjector&r and shield blocks function, such as making them silent, filling the affected area, or destroying terrain.
quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e矩阵槽&r可以放入各种&2模块&r来增加/调整&d力场投影仪&r和力场的功能，例如让装置静音、填充区域、破坏地形等。

quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[8].en_us: The red &eMode Slot&r in the center defines the basic shape of the projected area.
quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 中间的红色&e模式槽&r决定了投影区域的基本形状。

quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[10].en_us: The 12 &eField Slots&r are for &2Scale&r, &2Translation&r, and &2Rotation Modules&r, which help define the area your &dProjector&r will build on each of the three axis: N/S, E/W, Up/Down.
quest.711E7B6204708BD7.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 周围的12个&e力场槽&r可以安装&2尺寸模块&r，&2移动模块&r，和&2旋转模块&r，以定义&d力场投影仪&r在三个坐标轴方向（南北、东西、上下）生成的区域。

quest.71205F3FE5AD49B3.quest_desc[0].en_us: To show the &dEcho&r that you've learned how to &3Unearth&r resources from this world, you should make an &aIron Hammer&r from the materials you can brush from &7Gravel&r.
quest.71205F3FE5AD49B3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 为了向&d回响&r证明你已经学会了如何&3发掘&r资源，你可以刷一刷&7沙砾&r，用其中获得的材料做一把&a铁锤&r。

quest.71205F3FE5AD49B3.quest_desc[2].en_us: This will speed up gathering cobblestone greatly.
quest.71205F3FE5AD49B3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它可以大大加快你收集圆石的速度。

quest.71205F3FE5AD49B3.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Completing this quest will upgrade your &3Unearther Level&r, which increases the types of items that you receive when &3Brushing&r.
quest.71205F3FE5AD49B3.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：此任务的奖励会提升你的&3发掘等级&r，使你&3刷&r东西的时候获得的物品种类增多。

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[0].en_us: A &6CAD's Socket&r is basically its &abullet clip&r.

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[1].en_us: It's what &aSpell Bullets&r are loaded into, and it's responsible for transferring the compiled &bSpells&r contained within the Bullets to the &dCore&r for processing.
quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[1].zh_cn: 它是装填&a术式子弹&r的地方，并且也负责将子弹中已编译的&b术式&r转移到&d核心&r进行处理。

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[3].en_us: A &6Socket&r has a &eBandwidth&r, which is the maximum size &8&o(in grid spaces)&r&r of a &bSpell&r that it can transfer to a &dCore&r, all at once.
quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: 一个&6弹夹&r有自己的&e带宽&r，这是它一次可以将&b术式&r传输到&d核心&r的最大值&8&o（在网格中）&r&r。

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[4].en_us: &8&o(for example, a Socket with bandwidth 5 could transfer a Spell up to 5x5 in dimension)&r&r
quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &8&o（例如，一个带宽为5的弹夹最多可以传输尺寸为5x5的术式）&r&r

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[6].en_us: Also, another non-trivial attribute of &6Sockets&r is to provide a way to store &3persistent information&r, the more &bMemory&r a &6Socket&r provides, more &bVectors&r can be stored for later &bSpell&r executions.
quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 此外，&6CAD弹夹&r的另一个特有的属性是提供一种存储&3连续信息&r的方法，一个&6弹夹&r提供的&b内存&r越多，可以存储的&b向量&r就越多，以便之后的&b术式&r执行。

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[8].en_us: &8&o(&lTrick: Save Vector&r&8&o saves a vector to a designated Memory Slot, whereas &lSelector: Saved Vector&r&8&o retrieves the vector saved in the designated Memory Slot)&r&r
quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &8&o（&l启动式：储存向量&r&8&o可以将向量保存到指定的内存槽中，而&l选择符：储存向量&r&8&o可以检索保存在指定内存槽中的向量）&r&r

quest.7131F9C883EE955E.quest_desc[10].en_us: &6These ones&r in particular can provide you with either:

quest.715F30D0A9B79DD7.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6World Engine's &3Machine Block Upgrade&r unlocks several new crafts, including one of the best tools you can make for getting around.
quest.715F30D0A9B79DD7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6世界引擎&3机器方块升级&r解锁了许多新的合成配方，包括这个，探险旅途中最好用的工具之一。

quest.715F30D0A9B79DD7.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aExplorer's Compass&r can help you locate any structure in the pack, including mysterious &3Vaults&r!
quest.715F30D0A9B79DD7.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a探险家指南针&r可以定位整合包中的任何结构，包括神秘的&3宝库&r！

quest.7169587C7DC4C8C0.quest_desc[0].en_us: &5Umbral Spirits&r are used to craft the most powerful and mysterious equipment from the &eMalum&r and &eGaze&r mods.
quest.7169587C7DC4C8C0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 若想获得&5幽影精魂&r，需以生命的灵魂作为祭品。

quest.7169587C7DC4C8C0.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can only be bought from the &dEcho of The Infernal&r.
quest.7169587C7DC4C8C0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以将自己投入&5哭泣之井&r来完成献祭；此外，在使用&6帷幔之锋&r杀死村民时，也有小概率获得此物。

quest.7169587C7DC4C8C0.quest_desc[4].en_us: It is recommended to craft the &5Encyclopedia Unveiled&r, as it shows you new &eGaze&r mechanics.

quest.718C72A43E57B75A.quest_desc[0].en_us: In this &bChapter&r, you'll find most of the ways to handle transferring items, energy, fluids, and more!
quest.718C72A43E57B75A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本&b章节&r将会介绍如何传输物品、能量、流体和其他东西！

quest.7191726ECAAFE40F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you've crafted enough &2Chroniton Glass&r, head back to the &dEcho of the Wayfinder&r to learn how to install it into the &6World Engine&r as an upgrade.
quest.7191726ECAAFE40F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作出足够的&2时空粒子玻璃&r后，请回到&d寻路者的回响&r处，学习如何为&6世界引擎&r安装该升级。

quest.71BDC5B453B8CAB4.quest_desc[0].en_us: You find yourself at the event horizon of a gigantic black hole. Explore the area and find &6Radiance&r.
quest.71BDC5B453B8CAB4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你发现自己正处在一个巨型黑洞的事件视界。探索这片区域并找到&6辐光&r。

quest.71BDC5B453B8CAB4.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with them to create and encase your very own &dBlack Hole&r and acquire the &3Dark Void Upgrade&r for your &6World Engine&r.
quest.71BDC5B453B8CAB4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与他合作，制造并封存专属于你的&d黑洞&r，并为你的&6世界引擎&r安装&3黑暗虚空升级&r。

quest.71F17C85D540C559.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aCables&r are used to connect network devices with each other.

quest.71F17C85D540C559.quest_desc[2].en_us: Full blocks will connect to any adjacent block regardless of their color, while &aCable&r blocks will only connect to those of the same color.
quest.71F17C85D540C559.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 完整方块会连接到所有与之相邻的方块，无论颜色，而&a线缆&r只会连接到与之颜色相同的方块。

quest.71F25B7D688EE182.quest_desc[0].en_us: Completing the &bMaze Vault&r will reward you with at least 4 &bFortron Infused Blocks&r.
quest.71F25B7D688EE182.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 通关&b迷宫宝库&r可获得至少4个&b力场子灌注块&r。

quest.71F25B7D688EE182.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is a &bMinor&r &6World Engine&r &bUpgrade&r that unlocks things like autocrafting or generating resources with an &aExtractor&r.
quest.71F25B7D688EE182.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是一个&b次要&r&6世界引擎&r&b升级&r，升级后可解锁自动合成、用&a提取机&r生产资源等操作。

quest.71F25B7D688EE182.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dEcho of The Light Bender&r should show you how to install this &3Upgrade&r.
quest.71F25B7D688EE182.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 回到&d折光师的回响&r处，他会教你如何安装该&3升级&r。

quest.722901B4259D8AEC.quest_desc[0].en_us: The next goal will be to hit &a60&r &6Eterna&r, &a40&r &cQuanta&r, and &a40&r &dArcana&r.
quest.722901B4259D8AEC.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 下一个目标是达到&a60&r&6位阶&r、 &a40&r&c量子化&r以及&a40&r&d阿卡那&r。

quest.722901B4259D8AEC.quest_desc[2].en_us: This will require upgrading the &dInfused Bookshelves&r.
quest.722901B4259D8AEC.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你得继续升级&d灌注书架&r才能达到这个目标。

quest.7244348CAB8356E0.quest_desc[0].en_us: ["The ", {"text": "Chaotic Chestpiece", "color": "rainbow"}, " is the final upgrade to the ", {"text": "Draconic Chestpiece", "color": "gold", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "5388B67410670702" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Draconic Chestpiece Quest"}}, ", with the most room for ", {"text": "Upgrade Modules", "color": "green"}, " and maximum customizability."]
quest.7244348CAB8356E0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ["", {"text": "混沌护胸", "color": "rainbow"}, "是", {"text": "神龙护胸", "color": "gold", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "5388B67410670702" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往神龙护胸任务"}}, "的最终升级版，可安装", {"text": "升级模块", "color": "green"}, "的数量最多，拥有最强的可定制性。"]

quest.7244348CAB8356E0.quest_desc[2].en_us: Its module inventory can be accessed via the keybind &eTool Modules&r, which isn't set by default.
quest.7244348CAB8356E0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 模块安装界面可通过&e工具模块&r键位（默认情况下未绑定按键）打开。

quest.7244D5DADCF0D7A2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &bSeashelf of Aquatic Filtration&r can be loaded with up to six enchanted books, and will block those enchantments from showing up again.
quest.7244D5DADCF0D7A2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &b水之过滤海洋书架&r最多可以放六本附魔书，附魔书中的附魔不会再在附魔台中出现。

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[0].en_us: To upgrade to the final tier of machine frames, we'll need to extract &bEther Gas&r from the &dWither&r.
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你需要从&d凋灵&r身上提取出来的&b以太气体&r，才能做出最高级的机器框架。

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[2].en_us: To do this, you'll need the &dFluid Laser Base&r and some &aLaser Drills&r. You might also want to look into making the &dStasis Chamber&r to keep it from exploding!
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 准备好&d流体镭射钻基座&r和&a镭射钻&r，最好再做个&d冷凝室&r，不然凋灵会把你的设备全部炸掉！

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[4].en_us: The Laser Base is placed in the center above the Wither and needs the &aLaser Drills&r and &5Purple Laser Lens&r to work.
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 流体镭射钻基座要放在凋灵正上方，放入&5紫色镭射聚焦透镜&r并在周围放置&a镭射钻&r，这样才能开始提取以太气体。

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &aLaser Drills&r are the main "work" machines in this setup. The Drills are placed connecting to either the Laser Base or another Laser Drill.
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a镭射钻&r是建立矿物镭射钻系统时的核心“工作”机器。镭射钻需要连接至镭射钻基座或另一台镭射钻。

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[8].en_us: The easiest way to place this is by looking directly at the side of the Laser Base, then sneak-right click to place the Drill. The animated face should be pointing to you in placed properly.
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 最简单的办法就是你把光标移到镭射钻基座边上，然后潜行右击放下镭射钻，这样的话正面就会直接朝向你了。

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[10].en_us: You can open up the interface of one of the Laser Drills to see if it is connected to the base!
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 打开镭射钻的GUI，确认一下它是否正确连接！

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[12].en_us: Inside of the &dFluid Laser Base&r, make sure to place in the &5Purple Laser Lens&r to tell it what type of fluid to extract.
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 在&d流体镭射钻&r的UI界面里放入&5紫色镭射聚焦透镜&r以设定镭射钻的提取目标。

quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[14].en_us: You'll also need to adjust the &bY Level&r to match up with the Wither. If done properly, you'll start extracting &dEther Gas&r!
quest.726891EAC51F5F70.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: 你还需要把机器的&bY轴&r和凋灵的位置匹配上，万事俱备后你就可以开始提取&d以太气体&r了！

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aRituals&r will require more than just some symbols drawn on the ground!
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 举行&a仪式&r可不是在地上随便画两笔那么简单！

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each ritual will need several &aSacrificial Bowls&r, which are used to place items that will be sacrificed to perform the ritual. For the first ritual, you will only need four of these.
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每个仪式都需要一些&a献祭之碗&r，用于摆放献祭于仪式的所需物品。你的第一次仪式只需要四个碗就可以了。

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aGolden Sacrificial Bowl&r is the centerpiece of the ritual &bPentacle&r. This bowl will hold the key item used in the ritual, which is usually a &dBound Book&r.
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a黄金献祭之碗&r需要放置于仪式&b五芒星&r的正中间。这个碗用于承载举行仪式的关键物品，通常而言是&d绑定之书&r。

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[6].en_us: For the regular &aSacrificial Bowls&r, the exact placement does not matter as long as they are within 8 blocks of the &aGolden Sacrificial Bowl&r.
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 普通的&a献祭之碗&r只需要放在&a黄金献祭之碗&r为中心的八个方块以内就能被识别到，没有特定的摆放位置。

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[8].en_us: What type of ritual is it if it doesn't require some &eCandles&r! Any vanilla candle will do.
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 无论什么仪式都少不了&e蜡烛&r！准备一些原版蜡烛就可以了。

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[10].en_us: If you want to get special with it, you can also make &aLarge Candles&r using Tallow.
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: 但如果你想来点特别的，你也可以用动物油脂制作神秘学的&a大蜡烛&r。

quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[12].en_us: To get &aTallow&r, you will need to kill large animals with a &aButcher's Knife&r. Large animals include:
quest.726B56E54CAC971B.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 使用&a屠刀&r杀死大型动物来获得&a动物油脂&r，大型动物包括：

quest.727070B13B966DE1.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.727070B13B966DE1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.727070B13B966DE1.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.727070B13B966DE1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.7279FFED00B223D7.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aDraconium Core&r is one of the main crafting components in &eDE&r and can be used in some basic recipes for items and &bModules&r used in Draconic Armor and Tools.
quest.7279FFED00B223D7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a龙芯&r是&e龙之进化&r的重要合成材料之一，它能用来制作基础物品和用于此模组护甲和工具的&b模块&r。

quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dVoid Upgrade&r - Automatically voids items above the current stack limit.
quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d虚空升级&r - 自动销毁超过数量上限的物品。

quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aCollector Upgrade&r - Adds an internal magnet to pick items up off the ground around it.
quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a收集升级&r - 给抽屉内置一个“磁铁”，可以拾取周边的东西。

quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aPuller Upgrade&r - Allows the drawer to pull from adjacent inventories.
quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a抽入升级&r - 抽屉可以从周边存储方块中自动抽取物品。

quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[6].en_us: &aPusher Upgrade&r - Allows the drawer to push to adjacent inventories.
quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a推出升级&r - 抽屉可以向周边存储方块自动输出物品。

quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[8].en_us: These can be configured by right clicking the upgrade while inside of the drawer.
quest.7312FFEDAD1A6F75.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 安装在抽屉里后，右击升级就可以配置它们。

quest.73268E8255CBB44A.quest_desc[0].en_us: By making a &aSoul Vial&r, you can Sneak+Right-click on a mob to capture its soul.
quest.73268E8255CBB44A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 制作&a灵魂瓶&r后，你可以对着生物潜行+右击来提取它的灵魂

quest.73268E8255CBB44A.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can combine this soul with a &aBroken Spawner&r inside of a &dSoul Binder&r to infuse the spawner with that mob's soul.
quest.73268E8255CBB44A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以将这个灵魂与&a破损的刷怪笼&r在&d灵魂绑定器&r内结合，来将这个生物的灵魂灌注到刷怪笼里面。

quest.73268E8255CBB44A.quest_desc[4].en_us: Crafting a &2Powered Spawner&r using that infused spawner will create your own powered version of a spawner!
quest.73268E8255CBB44A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 使用注入灵魂的刷怪笼制作&2电动刷怪笼&r，会得到属于你自己的，需要能量的刷怪笼。

quest.7379486ABDDE4430.quest_desc[0].en_us: This quest will set up a waypoint to &dThe Light Bender's &6Archive&r.

quest.73871351B8E5775B.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you are more of a spellcaster and want to power up your spells, &6Iron's Spells&r has plenty of options for gearing up.
quest.73871351B8E5775B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你准备精研法师之道并且想增强你的法术效果，&6Iron的法术&r模组也有一些进阶套装可选。

quest.73871351B8E5775B.quest_desc[2].en_us: There are many different armor sets that provide powerful buffs to different spell schools.
quest.73871351B8E5775B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 一种盔甲套装会给特定属性的法术带来增强效果。

quest.73EC5E7F2300B99D.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aBudding Certus Quartz&r works similarly to amethyst and will bud crystals over time.
quest.73EC5E7F2300B99D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a赛特斯石英母岩&r的机制与紫水晶类似，会随着时间的推移长出水晶。

quest.73EC5E7F2300B99D.quest_desc[2].en_us: These will decay into &7Flawed Budding Certus Quartz&r if mined, but can be moved safely using things like a &2Cardboard Box&r.
quest.73EC5E7F2300B99D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果你直接挖掉它的话，它就会变成&7有瑕的赛特斯石英母岩&r。如果使用&2纸箱&r之类的手段则可以无损移动它。

quest.73EC5E7F2300B99D.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: Squat grow does work on the budding blocks.

quest.73FD015A3696ABFB.quest_desc[0].en_us: By infusing a &aDragon's Heart&r into your &dDraconium&r, you can acquire &6Awakened Draconium&r which you'll need if you wish to upgrade your existing &eDE&r setups.
quest.73FD015A3696ABFB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 通过将&a龙之心&r注入到&d龙锭&r中，你就能获得&6觉醒龙锭&r了，这是你升级已有&e龙之进化&r装置的必需材料。

quest.744120E37CD03AE0.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aAtomic Disassembler&r from &6Mekanism&r is an unbreakable tool that consumes power to break blocks.
quest.744120E37CD03AE0.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6通用机械&r模组的&a原子分解机&r破坏方块时不会消耗耐久，而是消耗能量。

quest.744120E37CD03AE0.quest_desc[2].en_us: It functions as a pickaxe, axe, and shovel simultaneously.
quest.744120E37CD03AE0.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它可以同时充当镐、斧、锹三种工具。

quest.749634B68269401A.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6ProjectE&r has several very strong weapons that can be made once you have your hands on enough EMC and a &cNetherite Smithing Template&r.
quest.749634B68269401A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6等价交换&r模组有一些非常强大的武器，只要你有足够的EMC和一个&c下界合金锻造模板&r就能制作。

quest.749634B68269401A.quest_desc[2].en_us: These weapons have different modes that can be used to empower them to do even more damage or increase the AoE range.
quest.749634B68269401A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这些武器拥有不同的模式，可以提升攻击伤害或增加AOE攻击范围。

quest.749634B68269401A.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, you must have the &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.749634B68269401A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，你需要先进行&a机器方块&r&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.74AD70F5C648DBDF.quest_desc[0].en_us: This section refers to most of the ways to store power!
quest.74AD70F5C648DBDF.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这部分介绍了存储能量的大多数方式！

quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Hostile Neural Networks&r (or &6HNN&r for short) allows you to collect data from a mob to harvest its drops in the form of &bPredictions&r.
quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6敌对神经网络（Hostile Neural Networks, &6HNN&r）&r允许你从生物中收集数据，以&b预测产物&r的形式获取掉落物。

quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started with the mod, start off by creating a &aModel Framework&r and right-clicking it on a mob to gather its &cData Model&r.
quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该模组从制造&a空白数据模型&r开始，用其右击生物以收集&c数据模型&r。

quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[4].en_us: Next, you'll want to craft a &2Deep Learner&r and place the &cData Model&r inside of it. Once inside, every kill for that mob will allow you to improve the &bData Model&r.
quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 接下来，你需要制作&2深度学习器&r并放入&c数据模型&r，数据模型放入后，击杀对应生物将优化&b数据模型&r。

quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: You will need the &bChroniton Glass&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to use this mod.
quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要使用该mod，你需要先用&b时空粒子玻璃&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.74CC5FF2097C0839.title.zh_cn: 对服务器友好的刷怪塔

quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you're looking for an early game option for transferring power wirelessly, &6Irregular Implements&r has a simple solution!
quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你需要一种适合游戏前期的无线能量传输方案，那不妨看看&6Irregular Implements&r模组吧！

quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[2].en_us: The first step is to get your hands on &bEctoplasm&r from killing a &bVex&r. Once you have one, you can make a &bSpectre Sapling&r for a renewable resource of them.
quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 首先你需要击杀&b恼鬼&r，获取&b灵质&r。有了灵质，你就可以制造一棵&b幽灵树苗&r，可持续地获取这种资源。

quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[4].en_us: The next step will be making the &aSpectre Energy Injector&r and placing it down and pipe power into it.
quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 接下来你需要制造一个&a幽灵能量注入器&r，然后把它放下来，用管道将能量输入其中。

quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[6].en_us: Anywhere you need to use that power, simply place down a &eSpectre Coil&r to transfer energy out!
quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 然后，你只需要在要用能量的地方放一个&e幽灵线圈&r，将能量提取出来就可以了！

quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[8].en_us: &eNote&r: &aSpectre Energy Injectors&r are considered power networks and work based on the player who placed it down.
quest.74E9653C810F045B.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&a通灵能量注入器（Spectre Energy Injector）&r被视作能量网络，并以放置它的玩家为准。

quest.74EA9D857CB71A91.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using a &aDissolution Chamber&r, you can infuse a Simple Machine Frame with &cNetherite&r and &#ffa5fcPink Slime&r.
quest.74EA9D857CB71A91.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 使用&a化学溶解室&r，你就可以将&c下界合金锭&r和&#ffa5fc粉红黏液&r灌注到简易机器框架中。

quest.74EA9D857CB71A91.quest_desc[2].en_us: This should create a frame strong enough to create the &cAdvanced Machine Blocks&r you need for the &6World Engine&r upgrade.
quest.74EA9D857CB71A91.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这样制得的框架应该足够坚固，可用于制作&6世界引擎&r升级所需的&c高级机器方块&r了。

quest.754048401D3A6A7B.quest_desc[0].en_us: This chapter covers most of the different ways to generate power.
quest.754048401D3A6A7B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 本章涵盖了大部分发电方法。

quest.754ADB22C6B8041F.quest_desc[0].en_us: This structure spawns in the lower &7Deepslate&r ring.
quest.754ADB22C6B8041F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此结构会生成在&7深板岩&r环的下层。

quest.754ADB22C6B8041F.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aWeeping Well&r will be needed to progress in &6Malum&r!
quest.754ADB22C6B8041F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要推进&6灵灾&r模组的进度，就要用到&a哭泣之井&r！

quest.754ADB22C6B8041F.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: You can also find the &aWeeping Well&r in the &dArcane Grove&r.
quest.754ADB22C6B8041F.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：在&d奥术林地&r中也存在&a哭泣之井&r。

quest.7552BF792403EF44.quest_desc[0].en_us: &3Enchanting Clues&r give you more text on the enchanting table, letting you see more of what's going to be put onto your books and items before you click the button.
quest.7552BF792403EF44.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &3魔咒线索&r可以增加附魔时的描述，让你能更清楚地知道将要附到书或物品上的是什么魔咒。

quest.75A7DDE0D617B5E6.quest_desc[0].en_us: These are all of the blocks you'll need to complete the most optimal &6Quantum Computer&r setup.
quest.75A7DDE0D617B5E6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这里列出的就是你搭建一台性能最顶尖的&6量子计算机&r所需要的全部方块。

quest.75A7DDE0D617B5E6.quest_desc[2].en_us: Though you can have more &6256M&r storage units within, 1 unit should be more than enough to handle all your crafting needs in this pack.
quest.75A7DDE0D617B5E6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 虽然理论上你可以往里面放更多的&6256M&r存储单元，但其实只要1个就完全足够应对这个整合包里所有的合成了。

quest.75A7DDE0D617B5E6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o这将搭建一个尺寸为7x7x7的多方块结构

quest.75D124AF83D637A8.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eIndustrial Foregoing&r (&eI.F&r) is all about using machines to do your work for you.
quest.75D124AF83D637A8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e工业先锋&r（&eIF&r）的核心理念就是运用机器解放双手。

quest.75D124AF83D637A8.quest_desc[2].en_us: To get started, you'll need to make a &aPity Machine Frame&r. This machine frame is used for all early game machines, and some cheaper machines like the Block Breaker and Block Placer.
quest.75D124AF83D637A8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要先制作&a缺陷机器框架&r。该机器框架用于制作游戏早期的机器，以及像方块破坏器和方块放置器这样的廉价机器。

quest.75D124AF83D637A8.quest_desc[4].en_us: Let's use the &aPity Machine Frame&r to get into creating &7Plastic&r next!
quest.75D124AF83D637A8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 用&a缺陷机器框架&r制作机器，开始生产&7塑料片&r吧！

quest.75D3AC9CCA5A82E4.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dMechanical Crafters&r are gigantic crafting tables that can be automated in several different ways.
quest.75D3AC9CCA5A82E4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d动力合成器&r是一个巨大的可自动化工作台。

quest.75D3AC9CCA5A82E4.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aCrafter Slot Covers&r can be used to cover up any slots that are not used in autocrafting. However, you can also use a redstone signal to force-start a crafting recipe.
quest.75D3AC9CCA5A82E4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a合成槽盖板&r可用于覆盖自动合成中未使用的槽位。当然，你也可以使用红石信号来强制启动合成配方。

quest.75D3AC9CCA5A82E4.quest_desc[5].en_us: &c&lFTB Notice&r: Due to impact on load times, general crafting is currently disabled. We apologize for the inconvenience.
quest.75D3AC9CCA5A82E4.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: &c&l注&r：由于对加载时间的影响，目前普通的合成功能已禁用。对于给你带来的不便，我们深表歉意。

quest.75D7595FD90E77E5.quest_desc[0].en_us: Each &dAssembler Matrix Pattern Core&r provides 36 pattern slots to the &6Assembler Matrix&r.
quest.75D7595FD90E77E5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 每装一个&d装配矩阵样板核心&r，就能给&6装配矩阵&r增加36个样板槽位。

quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are several appliances you can connect to your &aKitchen Multiblock&r!
quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这里还有一些可以添加到你的&a多方块厨房&r中的设备！

quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aSink&r will provide access to recipes that require Water. You will need to provide water to the Sink; it is not infinite.
quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a水槽&r可为需要水的烹饪配方供水。水槽里的水并不是取之不尽的，你需要给它加水。

quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &aFridge&r is the perfect place to store cold items, and can be upgraded to provide more recipes for your &bKitchen Multiblock&r!
quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a冰箱&r是冷藏食物的绝佳设备，升级后可为&b多方块厨房&r提供更多烹饪配方！

quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[6].en_us: The &aOven&r will provide access to recipes that require the use of a furnace or smoker as long as it has fuel.
quest.75DB0E723089281E.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a烤箱&r可以给厨房添加需要熔炉或烟熏炉的配方。当然，它需要燃料才能运作。

quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[0].en_us: You may be surrounded by stone, but that doesn't help you for automation.
quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然你周围到处都是石头，但那些石头不方便自动化用。

quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aCobble Generators&r will generate cobblestone over time, with higher tiers generating more per tick.
quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a造石机&r会持续生产圆石，越高级的造石机每tick造的石越多。

quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also create an &aAuto Hammer&r to break the cobble down into the different blocks needed for the &aUnearther&r!
quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你还可以做一个&a自动锤&r，帮你自动粉碎圆石，生产&a发掘室&r所需的各种方块！

quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: &cLava&r can easily be acquired by using the gift you get from meeting the &dEcho of the Machinist&r. You can also get it from the &cNether&r ring.
quest.75F6827C1FB52C91.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：&d机械师的回响&r给你的礼物可以帮你轻松获取&c熔岩&r。&c下界&r环中也有熔岩。

quest.76482BDD2CD6CB8E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Occultism&r has a &aLumberjack Foliot&r that you can summon to cut down trees for you.
quest.76482BDD2CD6CB8E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6神秘学&r可以生成为你砍树的&a魔精伐木工&r。

quest.76482BDD2CD6CB8E.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be a very magical way of creating a simple tree farm!
quest.76482BDD2CD6CB8E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这是创造一个简易树场的魔幻方法。

quest.765E218999FC00BD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Batteries&r are an &dOptional Attachment&r to have in a &bCAD&r; they allow you to have a &bspare amount of Psi Energy ready&r to be discharged when your basic Psi Energy runs dry.
quest.765E218999FC00BD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6电池&r是&bCAD&r中的&d可选附件&r，可以在基础Psi能量耗尽时，提供&b额外的Psi能量&r。

quest.76673B8374630924.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.76673B8374630924.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.76673B8374630924.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.76673B8374630924.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.7675666E156F0A94.quest_desc[0].en_us: Each &dAssembler Matrix Speed Core&r counts as an &aAcceleration Card&r for the overall structure.
quest.7675666E156F0A94.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 每个&d装配矩阵速度核心&r的效果都等同于一张&a加速卡&r。

quest.7675666E156F0A94.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &6Assembler Matrix&r will run at full speed with 5 &dSpeed Cores&r. Any more will have no extra effect on its processing speeds.
quest.7675666E156F0A94.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 装配5个&d速度核心&r后，&6装配矩阵&r的运行速度即可达到上限。再多装也没有用了，不会变得更快。

quest.76D5941D76026588.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Food Items.

quest.77074CE5719763BB.quest_desc[0].en_us: This &aHex Staff&r holds formidable power in melee combat and is capable of collecting Spirit, but what makes it stand out is its ability to fire off potent charges of &bspirit energy&r from your soul.
quest.77074CE5719763BB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这把&a忆念咒术法杖&r有着强劲的近战能力，并且可以收集精魂。不过它真正优秀的点在于它能利用你的灵魂来充能，并释放出&b精魂能量&r攻击。

quest.77074CE5719763BB.quest_desc[2].en_us: These charges replenish over time (seen on the hotbar), and can be increased or regained through various enchantments or trinkets.
quest.77074CE5719763BB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 充能会随时间自动恢复（详见饱食度上的状态条），还可以被附魔和饰品强化充能上限或加快恢复速度。

quest.7713D75A36D0A23D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Setting up a &aQuantum Link&r in its designated spot and linking it to the main &6World Engine&r machine block using a pattern provider, your ME System will have a direct link to the &6World Engine&r, allowing you to directly request crafting recipes and processes from the &6World Engine&r.
quest.7713D75A36D0A23D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在指定的位置设立&a量子链接&r，并通过样板供应器将其连接到&6世界引擎&r的主体机器方块，你的ME系统即可直接与&6世界引擎&r建立连接，这样你就能直接向&6世界引擎&r发送配方制作请求了。

quest.7713D75A36D0A23D.quest_desc[2].en_us: &dThe Light Bender&r seems convinced that this relatively simple upgrade will change the way you interface with the &6World Engine&r.
quest.7713D75A36D0A23D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d折光师&r似乎十分确信，这个相对简单的升级能改变你与&6世界引擎&r交互的方式。

quest.7713D75A36D0A23D.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&f: Each side of the &6World Engine&r must be configured individually for input and output.
quest.7713D75A36D0A23D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&f：&6世界引擎&r的每一个面都需要单独配置输入和输出。

quest.775BE99DF402AF0D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Speak to &dThe Ancient&r once you have returned from the &3Vault&r.
quest.775BE99DF402AF0D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 从&3宝库&r回来后，请与&d远古族裔&r交谈。

quest.775BE99DF402AF0D.quest_desc[2].en_us: They'll be able to show you how to install the &3Euphonium World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.775BE99DF402AF0D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 他会告诉你如何安装&3低吟金属世界引擎升级&r。

quest.777F76601D213DF2.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &eSimply Swords&r mod adds a wide range of weapons that you can choose to craft.
quest.777F76601D213DF2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e简易刀剑&r模组添加了种类繁多的武器供你选择。

quest.777F76601D213DF2.quest_desc[2].en_us: &dRunic Weapons&r require &dRunic Tablets&r found by exploring the world.
quest.777F76601D213DF2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 制作&d符文武器&r需要探索世界，寻找&d符文石板&r。

quest.777F76601D213DF2.quest_desc[4].en_us: &6Unique Weapons&r can also be rarely found during your explorations, though some may also be crafted.
quest.777F76601D213DF2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在探险途中你也许能找到一些&6独特武器&r，不过有些独特武器也可以直接合成出来。

quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[0].en_us: When a redstone signal is applied to a non-straight &aGuide Ring&r, it becomes a switch block. When powered on, it leads particles straight; when powered off, it guides them into the original curved direction. A particle can also enter from the 'other' direction, visualized by the smaller red glass tube, following the path of the white tube, and entering from both the red and white tubes.
quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 当给非直线状态下的&a导向环&r通入红石信号后，它就会按照信号指示粒子运动轨迹。充能时粒子会直线发射，未充能则会按照导向环自有的弧度加速粒子。另一边也可以输入粒子，这里将输入方向可视化为小一点的红色玻璃管，粒子运动轨迹为白色管道，最终进入红色/白色管道。

quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[2].en_us: At higher speeds, the particle can't take tight turns. If the last full 90-degree turn is too close, it exits the guided path and shoots out into the world. If the distance between &aGuide Rings&r is too big, or no next &aGuide Ring&r is found, it will also shoot out.
quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 请注意，在较高速度下，粒子无法通过较短的距离转弯。如果两个弯道相距过近，或者&a导向环&r之间的间距过大（或前方找不到下一个环），粒子就会脱离引导路径飞出。

quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[5].en_us: A particle's speed can be measured with a &aParticle Accelerator Sensor&r. A comparator can then provide a redstone signal based on the particle's speed.
quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[5].zh_cn: 粒子的速度可以用&a粒子加速器速度传感器&r来测量。连接红石比较器后，就能根据粒子速度输出对应强度的红石信号。

quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[7].en_us: The following shows the required speed for each redstone level:
quest.778A876616D4638E.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: 下方列出了各个红石信号所对应的速度：

quest.7791DA964DA2A80D.quest_desc[0].en_us: When particles of different items collide, they can create new items. The particle starts from the &aParticle Accelerator Block&r, where you can insert any item to be used as a particle. A straight &aGuide Ring&r needs to be placed right behind the &aController&r, facing to the side, with visuals aligning correctly.
quest.7791DA964DA2A80D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 不同物品的粒子碰撞就会产生新的物品，粒子起始处是&a粒子加速器方块&r，你可以放入任何想作为粒子发射的物品。在&a粒子加速器&r后面放一个朝向加速器侧面的直向&a导向环&r，如果它们看上去浑然一体，就说明你搭建对了。

quest.7791DA964DA2A80D.quest_desc[2].en_us: Once inserted, the particle travels along a route defined by the &aGuide Rings&r. They can be right-clicked to add a 45-degree turn on one side. Another &aGuide Ring&r needs to be in the particle's path as defined by the &aGuide Rings&r. Depending on the speed, the allowed distance between &aGuide Rings&r increases
quest.7791DA964DA2A80D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 粒子进入后就会沿 &a导向环&r 的方向前进。右击导向环，就可以更改它的角度（每次右击增加45°）。如果需要继续引导，就要在它的前进方向上再放一个 &a导向环&r。粒子的速度越快，两个 &a导向环&r 的间隔就可以越大。

quest.7791DA964DA2A80D.quest_desc[4].en_us: This means that, at higher speeds, the distance between &aGuide Rings&r can be larger.
quest.7791DA964DA2A80D.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这就意味着如果粒子速度很快，那么两个&a导向环&r之间的间距就可以非常大。

quest.77DE3D57E5B58948.quest_desc[2].en_us: Head out to the Ocean Ring and use your &bExplorer's Compass&r to find the Water Orb arena where you can summon the &dLeviathan&r!
quest.77DE3D57E5B58948.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 前往海洋环，使用&b探险家指南针&r找到水渊之珠，你能在那召唤&d利维坦&r！

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eOccultism's&r upgradeable storage system allows you to store your items in a separate dimension of &9The Otherworld&r.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e神秘学的&r可升级的存储系统能让你在单独的&9异界&r维度储存物品。

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &aStorage Actuator Base&r is the first of two parts needed to access your storage dimension.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a存储促动器基座&r是访问您的存储维度所需的两个部件中的第一个部件。

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[4].en_us: This block functions very much like a big shulker box. This means that when breaking the &aDimensional Storage Actuator&r, your items will stay safe inside the block.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 这个方块的功能特别像大号的潜影盒。这意味着当你破坏&a维度存储稳定器&r时，你的物品会被安全保留在其中。

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[6].en_us: &aStorage Stabilizers&r increase the storage space in the &aStorage Actuator&r.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &a存储稳定器&r会增加&a存储促动器&r的存储空间

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[8].en_us: Higher tier &aStorage Stabilizers&r provide a bigger storage increase for both items and item types.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 更高等级的&a存储稳定器&r提供更多的同类物品存储量和物品存储类别

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[10].en_us: &aStorage Stabilizers&r can be placed up to five blocks away, facing the &aDimensional Matrix&r texture. Check the &aDictionary of Spirits&r for the exact layout.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &a存储稳定器&r需要被放置在五格范围内，面向&a维度水晶矩阵&r的纹理。查看&a魔灵全典&r了解如何摆放

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[12].en_us: Each &aTier 1 Dimensional Storage Stabilizer&r adds 512000 items, and 64 item types, up to four &aStabilizers&r.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[12].zh_cn: 每个&a一阶维度存储稳定器&r能增加512000个物品和64个物品种类，最多支持四个&a稳定器&r。

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[14].en_us: The &aStable Wormhole&r allows access to a Dimensional Storage from a remote destination.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[14].zh_cn: &a稳定虫洞&r使得远程访问维度存储变得可能。

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[16].en_us: Shift-click the &aDimensional Storage Actuator&r to link it, then place the &aStable Wormhole&r in the world to use as a remote access point.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[16].zh_cn: 潜行右击&a维度存储促动器&r以连接它，然后把&a稳定虫洞&r放置在世界中的任意地点作为远程访问点

quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[18].en_us: Shift + right-click a &aDimensional Storage Actuator&r with a &cStorage Accessor&r to link them, allowing you to access your items from anywhere in the world, even across dimensions.
quest.77F8CCE971B9B186.quest_desc[18].zh_cn: 手持&c存储访问器&r潜行右击&a维度存储促动器&r以连接它，然后你就可以通过这个物品在世界的任何角落访问你的存储，甚至跨维度

quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[0].en_us: &a/home&r | This command unlocks during the main quest in the early game, and opens a portal to take you back to your base.
quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a/home&r | 该指令在游戏前期的主线任务中解锁，可以开启传送门送你回家。

quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[2].en_us: &a/back&r | Allows you to return to a previous point after you have died.
quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a/back&r | 可以让你在死亡后返回之前的位置。

quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[4].en_us: &a/spawn&r | Teleports the player back to the lobby. The lobby is very important in this pack!
quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a/spawn&r | 可将玩家传送回大厅。大厅在这个整合包中至关重要！

quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[7].en_us: &a/spark tps&r | Checks the server's TPS. Useful to see if your world is lagging
quest.77FC846DC0EF4ED2.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: &a/spark tps&r | 检查服务器TPS。用于判断你的世界是否存在卡顿。

quest.7804E97C7772403E.quest_desc[0].en_us: Want a portable crafting table? Make a &aCrafting Table on a Stick&r!
quest.7804E97C7772403E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 想要个随身的工作台？做一个&a便携式工作台&r吧！

quest.7804E97C7772403E.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can put this in a &bCurio Slot&r that you can even set a keybind for quick access.
quest.7804E97C7772403E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你也可以把它放进&b饰品栏&r里，然后设置一个快捷键来便捷地打开它。

quest.78115154B5DC07B3.quest_desc[0].en_us: This block generates &625 Million RF/t&r when all other &dMycelial Generators&r are active.
quest.78115154B5DC07B3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 此方块在所有种类的&d菌丝网络发电机&r同时工作时，发电速率最高可达&62500万RF/t&r。

quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWeeping Well&r can be found within the &7Deepslate&r or in the &dArcane Grove&r structure.
quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 可以在&7深板岩环&r或者&d奥术林地&r中找到&d哭泣之井&r。

quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[2].en_us: This structure leaks whispers and heartbeats and weeping and tugs on certain items with its dark pull. It ... wants something. Try offering it your &earcane knowledge&r, or raw resources, see what you might get in return.
quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个结构散发着低语、心跳和哭泣的声音，它那黑暗的引力正向外界索取着某些物品。它…有想要的东西。试着把你的&e奥术全典&r交给它，或者给它一些粗矿，看看你会得到什么回报。

quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["You can find ", {"text": "Runewood Trees", "color": "dark_green"}, " within the ", { "text": "Arcane Grove", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "066B47D2AB72355C" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Arcane Grove Quest"}}, " just be ready to put up a fight."]
quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["你可以在", { "text": "奥术林地", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "066B47D2AB72355C" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往奥术林地任务"}}, "中找到", {"text": "符文木树", "color": "dark_green"}, "，准备好战斗吧。"]

quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: Certain recipes are hidden until you jump in.
quest.781D7DA09E444B95.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：某些合成配方只有跳入哭泣之井后才会显示。

quest.787BD711CFF837C6.quest_desc[0].en_us: With more &6Archives&r unlocked, it is time to explore the lobby and find the &dEcho of the Lightbender&r.
quest.787BD711CFF837C6.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着更多&6档案&r被解锁，是时候探索大厅，寻找&d折光师的回响&r了。

quest.787BD711CFF837C6.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with this &dEcho&r to unlock the &bFortron Block&r upgrade for your &6World Engine&r!
quest.787BD711CFF837C6.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与此&d回响&r合作，为你的&6世界引擎&r解锁&b力场子方块&r升级！

quest.787BD711CFF837C6.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7&oYou may teleport directly to this Echo from anywhere in the lobby after meeting them using &e/echo light_bender&7.
quest.787BD711CFF837C6.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7&o与他见面后，你可以使用&e/echo light_bender&7命令从大厅的任何地方直接传送到这个回响处。

quest.789A4FE79256A4C6.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Enchanted Books.

quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Portal Gun&r is an incredibly fun gadget that can create portals for you to travel through. This does require power to function!
quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6传送枪&r是个很有趣的工具，它可以创造出能供你穿梭的传送门，不过需要消耗能量才能运作！

quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[2].en_us: Left clicking will create a blue portal, while right clicking will create an orange portal. Traveling through either will send you to the other.
quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 左击打开蓝色传送门，右击打开橙色传送门，从一个门进去会从另一个门出来。

quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[4].en_us: The &dAdvanced Portal Gun&r allows you to save locations to teleport to, provided it has power and &dPortal Fluid&r.
quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &d高级传送枪&r可以保存传送点，只要有足够的能量和&2传送流体&r，就可以传送到目标地点。

quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: To craft these, it requires the &bChroniton Glass&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.78A644464D4C506A.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成此物，需要先用&b时空粒子玻璃&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.78ADC11570C5561E.quest_desc[0].en_us: &dFluix&r is at the heart of all of technology in Applied Energistics.
quest.78ADC11570C5561E.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d福鲁伊克斯石英&r是应用能源科技的核心材料。

quest.78ADC11570C5561E.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make the &dFluix Crystal&r, you'll first need to charge &bCertus Quartz Crystal&r in the charger. Next, toss the crystal with a piece of redstone and nether quartz in a pool of water out in the world.
quest.78ADC11570C5561E.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 先把&b赛特斯石英水晶&r放在充能器中充能，然后将其与红石、下界石英一起丢进水里，就可以制造出&d福鲁伊克斯水晶&r。

quest.78ADC11570C5561E.quest_desc[4].en_us: The components will react and form a &dFluix Crystal&r that is ready for refinement! You can do many of these at once to speed up the process, as well as eventually making machines that can automate the creation process for you.
quest.78ADC11570C5561E.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 丢进去的原材料会发生反应，然后就会生成可以纯化的&d福鲁伊克斯水晶&r！你可以一次丢很多物品来加速合成过程，或者做个机器帮你完成这个过程。

quest.78C4840B377E14FD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEnchanter&r from &6EnderIO&r is an &dEnchantment Table&r that allows you to pick which enchantment you want to make.
quest.78C4840B377E14FD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6EnderIO&r模组的&a附魔器&r是一个可以自选魔咒的&d附魔台&r。

quest.78C4840B377E14FD.quest_desc[2].en_us: When provided with specific items and &2Experience&r, you can enchant &aBook \&\ Quills&r with an enchantment of your choice.
quest.78C4840B377E14FD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 使用特定的物品和一些&2经验值&r，你便可以按己所需给&a书与笔&r附上想要的魔咒。

quest.78C4840B377E14FD.quest_desc[4].en_us: To see which enchantments you can make, make sure to check out the uses in JEI!
quest.78C4840B377E14FD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 想知道能制作哪些魔咒？看看JEI吧！

quest.78F7CFEA0EB5024C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The generators in this row are considered &aStarter Generators&r to help you create your first bit of power!
quest.78F7CFEA0EB5024C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这一排的发电机属于&a入门发电机&r，为你提供最初的电力支持！

quest.7913B52AD9D28D2B.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Harbinger&r is a tough mob found within the &6Ancient Factory&r structure.
quest.7913B52AD9D28D2B.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6先驱者&r是个存在于&6古代工厂&r结构中的强悍生物。

quest.7913B52AD9D28D2B.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be found in the &dVoid Chasm&r ring.
quest.7913B52AD9D28D2B.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该结构可以在&d虚空裂隙&r环中找到。

quest.7913B52AD9D28D2B.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: You must activate the boss by using a &dNether Star&r on it first.
quest.7913B52AD9D28D2B.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：你必须先使用一个&d下界之星&r才能激活boss。

quest.795A3ABA29AC0E4F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Generates power by consuming Frozen/Snow Items.

quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eJust Dire Things&r (&eJDT&r) is a cool tech mod that despite the name, actually adds some &oimpressive&r and slightly overpowered &2Gadgets&r, &aTools&r and &9Armors&r!
quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然名字不咋样，但&eJust Dire Things&r（&eJDT&r）其实是一个很酷的科技模组，它加入了一些&o令人眼前一亮&r而且有一丢丢超模的&2小帮手&r、&a工具&r以及&9盔甲&r！

quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eJDT&r has a very unique mechanic for acquiring its materials.
quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &eJDT&r拥有一套独特的资源获取方式。

quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[4].en_us: It starts by making &bGoo&r which will spread onto other blocks to convert them over time.
quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 一般来说就是先制造&b凝胶&r，然后等凝胶慢慢蔓延到其他方块，将他们转化。

quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[6].en_us: The first &bGoo&r that you'll make is called &aPrimogel Goo&r, which takes only a few basic materials.
quest.7983727D0EE456FD.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 第一种&b凝胶&r叫做&a原初浆凝胶&r，只需要消耗一点点基础材料就能做出来。
