quest.79873815DEB7A086.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aImporters&r and &aExporters&r are able to wirelessly insert into and pull from a &dQIO system&r set to their frequency.
quest.79873815DEB7A086.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a输入端口&r和&a输出端口&r能从你的&dQIO网络&r输入和输出资源。

quest.79873815DEB7A086.quest_desc[2].en_us: With the ability to make multiple frequencies, this can be used to create isolated item systems, or just be used as a main storage network.
quest.79873815DEB7A086.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 因为可以创建多个频率，所以可以用来创建独立的物品系统，或者仅用作主存储网络。

quest.79873815DEB7A086.quest_desc[4].en_us: &bQIO Redstone Adapters&r can be configured to emit a redstone signal depending on the number of items in a set frequency, useful for automating systems without flooding your storage system with items.
quest.79873815DEB7A086.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &bQIO红石适配器&r可以根据物品数量在设定的频率下发出红石信号，非常适合用于自动化系统，同时避免存储系统被大量物品淹没。

quest.79E5C4E3958DA8DD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Entro Crystals&r are harvested from budding blocks, just like harvesting Certus!
quest.79E5C4E3958DA8DD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &2恩特罗水晶&r要从母岩上采集，就和赛特斯石英水晶一样！

quest.79E5C4E3958DA8DD.quest_desc[2].en_us: To create the budding block that grows Entro Crystals, you'll need to make an &aEntro Seed&r first and then right click them on a &dFluix Block&r in the world to convert it over.
quest.79E5C4E3958DA8DD.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 想要得到能生产恩特罗水晶的母岩方块的话，先制作一个&a恩特罗种子&r，然后对着&d福鲁伊克斯块&r使用就可以将其转化。

quest.79E5C4E3958DA8DD.quest_desc[4].en_us: It's a good idea to get these crystals growing early, especially if you plan on getting into &bExtended AE&r!
quest.79E5C4E3958DA8DD.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 最好尽早开始培育这些水晶，特别是如果你打算深入研究&bExtended AE&r模组的话！

quest.79EB0239FE299185.quest_desc[0].en_us: According to the &dQuartermaster&r, you now have everything you need to craft the &2World Engine Machine Frames&r in the &6World Engine&r.
quest.79EB0239FE299185.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 听&d军需官&r说，你已经备齐在&6世界引擎&r中制造&2世界引擎机器方块&r的全部材料了。

quest.79EB0239FE299185.quest_desc[2].en_us: You'll need a bunch of these to restore some of the &6World Engine's&r functions, allowing you to craft more complex items!
quest.79EB0239FE299185.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要很多机器方块才能恢复&6世界引擎&r的一部分功能，这样你就可以合成更复杂的物品了！

quest.7A0028FE5DF359E8.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEnergy Transmitter&r is a small machine that allows for wireless charging of blocks in a configurable radius.
quest.7A0028FE5DF359E8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a能量传输器&r可以给设定范围内的方块无线充能。

quest.7A0028FE5DF359E8.quest_desc[2].en_us: By default, this machine can transfer up to 1k RF/t. It also has a slight loss of transfer.
quest.7A0028FE5DF359E8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它的基础传输速率是1000RF/t，传输过程中也会有少量的能量损耗。

quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[0].en_us: Have some enchants you want, but they are stuck to items you don't want to use?
quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 是否心仪某些附魔，但它们却附着在你不愿使用的装备上？

quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[2].en_us: You can easily separate enchants using the &bAnvil&r method.
quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 用&b铁砧&r就可以轻松把附魔弄下来。

quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[4].en_us: First, place down a block of &dDraconium&r, then throw down an item with enchants on it. For every enchant you want to remove, you'll need to throw down an empty book as well.
quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 首先放一块&d龙块&r，把附魔的物品丢上去。再根据你想要分离的魔咒数量，丢相应数量的书（未附魔的）上去。

quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[6].en_us: To separate them, drop an &bAnvil&r onto the pile of items!
quest.7A06D08AC7C65D20.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 然后，用&b铁砧&r砸物品就好啦！

quest.7A1BCD0876713992.quest_desc[0].en_us: Flawed Budding Block is available to craft in the &bWorld Engine&r that has the basic &aMachine Block&r upgrade.

quest.7A26B0FFC0BCA275.quest_subtitle.en_us: Allows Enderic Lasers to targets living entities
quest.7A26B0FFC0BCA275.quest_subtitle.zh_cn: 允许末影激光器瞄准实体

quest.7A62B07AD0BCCCEA.quest_desc[0].en_us: While at first it seems that collecting &bSpirit&r can only be done manually, a closer inspection into &5Wicked-aligned&r runewood &espirit rites&r shows a special synergy.
quest.7A62B07AD0BCCCEA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 虽然一开始玩家只能手动收集&b精魂&r，但只要仔细观察这些&5被邪恶浸染的&r符文木，就会发现它们的&e精魂仪式&r与精魂之间有着一种奇特的共鸣。

quest.7A62B07AD0BCCCEA.quest_desc[2].en_us: The lesser rite will &dslowly damage&r nearby hostile mobs down to low health, and the greater rite will &dcull mobs&r in both body and soul when they are at low health, generating &bSpirit&r alongside their standard drops!
quest.7A62B07AD0BCCCEA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 衰朽仪式会&d缓慢地伤害&r附近的敌对生物，直到它们生命值见底，而它的升级版则会在它们生命值较低时&d收割它们&r的躯体和灵魂，并在产出普通掉落物时附上它们的&b精魂&r。

quest.7A62B07AD0BCCCEA.quest_desc[4].en_us: &7A similar synergy exists for passive animals among the various rites...
quest.7A62B07AD0BCCCEA.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &7这种共鸣同样存在于友好生物与某些仪式之间……

quest.7A6F14DB74189B67.quest_desc[0].en_us: Inside our &6Store&r you should be able to &bBuy Pre-Coded Spells&r. Some are more complex than others, you may use them for their basic purpose or to learn how to do new tricks :p
quest.7A6F14DB74189B67.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在我们的&6商店&r里，你可以&b购买预编程术式&r。其中有些术式更为复杂，你可以用它们实现基本功能，或者学习如何做新花样:p

quest.7A6F14DB74189B67.title.en_us: The Shop may offer you Great Deals!

quest.7A8669713BE28E8F.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dWarden&r lives in the &dAncient City&r, which you can find in the bottom layer of the &3Deepslate&r ring.
quest.7A8669713BE28E8F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d监守者&r生活在&3深板岩&r环底层的&d远古城市&r中。

quest.7A8D31482AB1FCAA.quest_desc[0].en_us: &6Compact Machines&r allow you to create your own room in a pocket dimension!
quest.7A8D31482AB1FCAA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6压缩空间&r能让你在压缩维度中创建自己的房间！

quest.7A8D31482AB1FCAA.quest_desc[2].en_us: This can be great for building farms that might cause FPS drops.
quest.7A8D31482AB1FCAA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这对于建造可能会导致FPS下降的农场非常有用。

quest.7A8D31482AB1FCAA.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：这些是&z仅限商店&r的物品！

quest.7AB7D06E0DD24F7A.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you're struggling with the &3Vault&r, or killing &cIgnis&r, you may use this music disc in your offhand to &6Light Your Inner Fire&r.
quest.7AB7D06E0DD24F7A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你在解锁&3宝库&r或挑战&c焰魔&r时感觉吃力，你可以副手手持这张唱片并使用它，以&6点燃你心中之火&r。

quest.7AB7D06E0DD24F7A.quest_desc[2].en_us: This will generate 10x more heat for killing blazes and doing the dance puzzle, while also eliminating any penalty for missing colors.
quest.7AB7D06E0DD24F7A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这会让你在击杀烈焰人和舞蹈时获得多于平时10倍的热量，同时免于踩到错误颜色时的惩罚。

quest.7AB7D06E0DD24F7A.quest_desc[4].en_us: It will also let you deal triple damage with all of your attacks against &cIgnis&r.
quest.7AB7D06E0DD24F7A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 在面对&c焰魔&r时，还会让你的所有攻击对其造成三倍伤害。

quest.7ACCC2EECD9883FD.quest_desc[0].en_us: &eCognition&r tools are as good as diamond gear with an extra block interaction range.
quest.7ACCC2EECD9883FD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e认知&r工具和钻石工具的属性相同，但交互距离更远。

quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[0].en_us: Other mods may add their own types, but &eSimple Magnets&r keeps it...simple. Just craft a &aMagnet&r, activate it with right click, and while it's on your person any items in range will be swiftly pulled to your person to get picked up!
quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 别的模组里也有类似的东西，但是&e简单磁铁&r里的……比较简单。你只需要合成一块&a磁铁&r，右击激活它，这样只要把它带在身上，就可以把一定范围内的掉落物吸过来了！

quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &dAdvanced Magnet&r has a larger range and a filter menu opened by sneak + right clicking.
quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &d高级磁铁&r的作用范围更广，而且还有过滤功能（潜行右击打开菜单）。

quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[4].en_us: Don't want your magnet to pull items in a particular area? Check out the &2Demagnetization Coils&r!
quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果你不希望磁铁乱吸某个区域中的掉落物，那你可以做个&2消磁线圈&r。

quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[6].en_us: Any items in their range will ignore &aSimple Magnets&r pulling on them.
quest.7B20023BE78887DA.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 其作用范围内的物品不受&a简单磁铁&r的吸引。

quest.7B2044D285C9F1E3.quest_desc[0].en_us: Most quests in the main chapters that are shaped like a &aGear&r are &dEcho&r related quests!
quest.7B2044D285C9F1E3.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 主线章节中&a齿轮&r形状的任务基本都是与&d回响&r有关的！

quest.7B2044D285C9F1E3.quest_desc[2].en_us: This means that you will most likely need to return to an &dEcho&r to complete their task, or see if they have something new for you.
quest.7B2044D285C9F1E3.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这意味着你需要回到&d回响&r处，完成他们的任务，或者看看他们有没有什么新东西要告诉你。

quest.7B496376BC7B399A.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aThe Ender&r is a diamond-tier sword that specializes in beheading your enemies.
quest.7B496376BC7B399A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a终结之剑&r的属性与钻石剑相当，但它擅长将敌人斩首。

quest.7B579D0762DB9F33.quest_desc[0].en_us: Once you have some &aOsmium&r, you can easily start generating some basic power using the &eHeat Generator&r from &6Mekanism&r.
quest.7B579D0762DB9F33.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 等你获得了&a锇&r，你就可以开始用&6通用机械&r的&e热力发电机&r产能了。

quest.7B579D0762DB9F33.quest_desc[2].en_us: This &aGenerator&r can be fed any burnable item like coal or wood to generate power, but can also harness heat from &cLava&r around it to generate power passively.
quest.7B579D0762DB9F33.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 这个&a发电机&r可以烧煤炭、木头之类的燃料产能，不过如果周围有&c熔岩&r的话，它也可以被动产能。

quest.7B579D0762DB9F33.quest_desc[4].en_us: To extract the power from the generator, you must connect a pipe or machine to the front face that has a square on it!
quest.7B579D0762DB9F33.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你需要将管道或机器连接到发电机带有方形标记的正面才能输出能量！

quest.7B5B32A08ADB5E76.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dPrecision Mechanism&r is an important crafting component used for some of the best tools and machines &eCreate&r has to offer.
quest.7B5B32A08ADB5E76.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d精密构件&r是&e机械动力&r模组中一些顶级工具和机器的重要合成部件。

quest.7B5B32A08ADB5E76.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&r: This recipe has a 20% chance to fail, so make sure to have a filter in place to account for this.
quest.7B5B32A08ADB5E76.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&r：本配方有20%的失败概率，因此请在产物输出设置过滤。

quest.7B5B32A08ADB5E76.quest_desc[4].en_us: You can also buy these from the &zShop&r!
quest.7B5B32A08ADB5E76.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 你也可以从&z商店&r直接购买！

quest.7B6A17901EC8180C.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &zRed Morningstar&r is the ultimate all-in-one tool from &6ProjectE&r.
quest.7B6A17901EC8180C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z红物质钉头锤&r是&6等价交换&r模组中最强的全能工具。

quest.7B772A85691C60F5.quest_desc[0].en_us: For each ring, there are 4 pre-built &dTelepads&r; one for each cardinal direction.
quest.7B772A85691C60F5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在每个环中都有4个预先生成的&d传送台房间&r；正东、正西、正南、正北方向各一个。

quest.7B772A85691C60F5.quest_desc[2].en_us: You might run into these as you dig out, but you can also buy &dEnder Shards&r that are linked to them from the &zShop&r!
quest.7B772A85691C60F5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 在你向外挖掘的过程中，你可能会遇到这些房间，不过你也可以在&z商店&r中购买特殊的&d末影碎片&r，这些碎片会直接链接到传送台房间！

quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[0].en_us: If you want to connect all of your storage into a single network, this can easily be done by making the &aStorage Controller&r.
quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 如果你想把你的所有存储方块都并入一个存储网络，做一个&a存储控制器&r就可以轻松解决。

quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[2].en_us: Any storage container that is placed next to the &aController&r will automatically link to it. This allows you to item dump by right clicking or sneak-right clicking on the Controller for easy inventory management!
quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 任何放在&a控制器&r边上的存储方块都会自动链接上，搭建完后右击潜行右击或就可以把东西都存进去，轻松管理所有物品！

quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[4].en_us: &eNote&r: The &aStorage Controller&r requires the &aMachine Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&a存储控制器&r，需要先用&a机器方块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[6].en_us: Placing storage next to anything that is linked to the Controller will also add it to the network as well, like a big multiblock chest!
quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 在并入网络的存储方块边上再放一个存储方块，则该存储方块也会被并入网络，就像一个巨大的多方块箱子！

quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[8].en_us: You can make &aStorage Links&r to connect any storage container that might be separate from your main storage hub, and can use the &aStorage Tool&r to link them up to the Controller!
quest.7B77544B48E690CB.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 你可以制作&a存储链接&r将那些分散的工具链接到主网，还可以用&a存储工具&r把它们都链接到控制器！

quest.7BA228FC749BF70A.quest_desc[0].en_us: Although the &eCatalyzer&r can increase the speed of the &eSpirit Crucible&r, many more aspects of its function can be tweaked with various &aAugments&r. Some of these affect different Crucible stats, while others will add entirely new mechanics to the system. Consult the &eMalum book&r for details!
quest.7BA228FC749BF70A.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &e精魂坩埚&r的合成速度可以被&e催化器&r提高，但其他的功能需要用到各种不同的&a增强件&r才能调整。其中一些增强件可以为坩埚属性带来不同的影响，另一些则会为坩埚的合成系统添加全新的机制。具体信息请看&e奥术全典&r！

quest.7BA228FC749BF70A.quest_desc[2].en_us: A &aTuning Fork&r will show these stats and features above the Crucible when held, and can tweak some minor aspects when used on it.
quest.7BA228FC749BF70A.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持&a调谐音叉&r时，你可以看见坩埚的属性等信息，还可以选择优先属性。

quest.7BA228FC749BF70A.quest_desc[4].en_us: Up to four can be applied to the Crucible itself, and linked Catalyzers can accept one augment each to apply to their Crucible.
quest.7BA228FC749BF70A.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 坩埚本体最多可以安置四个增强件，而附近的催化器则每个都可以安置一个增强件，从而给坩埚带来增益。

quest.7BF4EF06E2D0D763.quest_desc[0].en_us: Now with your Recently Obtained &bPsi Metal&r, you should be able to make a &6Psi Metal CAD&r.
quest.7BF4EF06E2D0D763.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 有了新获得的&bPsi金属&r后，你应该能够制作一个&6Psi金属CAD&r。

quest.7BF4EF06E2D0D763.quest_desc[2].en_us: It &dprovides much better stats&r, allowing you to &3cast more interesting spells!&r
quest.7BF4EF06E2D0D763.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 它&d能提供更高的属性&r，让你可以&3施放更有趣的术式&r！

quest.7C0FD2B2589BC66D.quest_desc[0].en_us: Build a 3x3x3 of &bFurnaces&r to create the &bJumbo Furnace&r.
quest.7C0FD2B2589BC66D.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 用&b熔炉&r堆一个3x3x3的立方体，就可以造出&b巨型熔炉&r。

quest.7C0FD2B2589BC66D.quest_desc[2].en_us: The &bJumbo Furnace&r allows multiple recipes to be processed at the same time, and it can be upgraded with more &bJumbo Furnaces&r in the bottom-right slot (up to 64), each one representing the number of items it can smelt at once.
quest.7C0FD2B2589BC66D.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &b巨型熔炉&r可以同时进行多个配方的熔炼。它还能继续升级，把更多的&b巨型熔炉&r（至多放64个）放进界面右下角的格子里即可，放入的熔炉数量等于它可一次性熔炼的物品数量。

quest.7C6BB27CCDA5E878.quest_desc[0].en_us: This quest will set up a waypoint to &dThe Infernal's &6Archive&r.

quest.7C72E7E48CCA7BB1.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dAdvanced Dislocator&r allows you to store multiple warp points at once. It has infinite uses, but needs to be fueled by &dEnder Pearls&r to work.
quest.7C72E7E48CCA7BB1.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d高级传送符咒&r能够存储多个传送点，且能无限使用。但它需要&d末影珍珠&r作为燃料才能工作。

quest.7C72E7E48CCA7BB1.quest_desc[2].en_us: To fuel it, open up the interface with Ender Pearls in your inventory, then click the + buttons at the bottom of the GUI to add them in as fuel.
quest.7C72E7E48CCA7BB1.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 要为其添加燃料，需要右击打开其界面（请确保物品栏中有末影珍珠），然后点击右下角的“+”按钮，即可将末影珍珠填入燃料槽。

quest.7C94432EFD49611F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &zInfinity&r is the sole being holding back the collapse of reality as you know it.
quest.7C94432EFD49611F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z无尽&r是你所知的阻止现实崩溃的唯一存在。

quest.7C94432EFD49611F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Work with them to unlock the &3Infinity World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.7C94432EFD49611F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与他合作以解锁&3世界引擎无尽升级&r。

quest.7C9B4CE2A2F62096.quest_desc[0].en_us: Using the &aPressurized Reaction Chamber&r, we can use Substrates to make &6HDPE Pellets&r. These advanced pellets are used to create many high tier items and machines!
quest.7C9B4CE2A2F62096.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你可以将基片放进&a加压反应室&r内，以制取&6高密度聚乙烯球&r。高密度聚乙烯球是用于制作高阶物品和机器的重要原材料！

quest.7C9B4CE2A2F62096.quest_desc[2].en_us: To make these, you'll need to combine &6Liquid Ethene&r, Oxygen, and Substrates. From here, you can run them through an Enrichment Chamber to create &6HDPE Sheets&r!
quest.7C9B4CE2A2F62096.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 如果想制作高密度聚乙烯板，你需要将基片、&6液态乙烯&r和氧气同时放入加压反应室进行混合得到高密度聚乙烯球，然后将三个高密度聚乙烯球放入富集仓内进行处理，最终就能得到&6高密度聚乙烯片&r！

quest.7C9B4CE2A2F62096.quest_desc[4].en_us: Note that it takes LIQUID Ethene, meaning you'll need to create a &aRotary Condensentrator&r to convert it from a gas to a liquid first. Did you pump in the gas already? Use a &aGauge Dropper&r to remove it!
quest.7C9B4CE2A2F62096.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 注意：合成用的是液态乙烯，你需要做个&a回旋式气液转换机&r才能将气态乙烯变成液态乙烯。反应仓内已注入气体？那就用&a滴管&r将它们排出！

quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[0].en_us: ► For &6Psi's Progression&r in particular we want a simple &b&lTrick: Infusion&r&r to get access to a Better Material for our CADs, &6Psimetal&r!
quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: ► 对于&6当前Psi模组的进程&r来说，我们需要使用一个简单的&b&l启动式：灌注&r&r，来获取升级CAD的材料——&6Psi金属&r！

quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[2].en_us: &61.&r &dRight Click&r in any spot of this grid then type -> &b"Trick: Infusion"&r and click on it to place it in the Grid.
quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &61.&r&d右击&r任意一个网格，然后输入->&b“启动式：灌注”&r并点击它，将其放置在网格上。

quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[4].en_us: &62.&r &oGive the Spell a name if you want to&r.

quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[6].en_us: &63.&r Get out of this GUI and then &dRight Click with a bullet&r into the table to &bcopy the spell over to it&r.
quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &63.&r退出界面，然后手持一枚子弹&d右击&r术式编写台，&b将该术式复制到子弹上&r。

quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[8].en_us: &64.&r &lProfit&r! you've just made your &bfirst Psi Spell&r!
quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &64.&r&l完工&r！你刚刚已经完成了你的&b第一个Psi术式&r！

quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[10].en_us: &8&o● And don't worry, no one is born with infinite knowledge, make sure to start small then over time increase the complexity of your Spells as you learn more about the mod =)&r&r
quest.7CA687749E953A19.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &8&o● 不必担心，人非生而知之者。你只需要从简单的术式入手，随着你对这个模组了解地更多，再逐步增加术式的复杂度=)&r&r

quest.7CC7824471E1B45F.quest_desc[0].en_us: &zCreative Goo&r will never die, and works as the highest tier goo.
quest.7CC7824471E1B45F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &z创造凝胶&r永远不会死亡，并且等级与最高级的凝胶一致。

quest.7D1FB9A40B5CAE97.quest_desc[2].en_us: &bUnlocks&f: Doors to T1 Echoes and Chapter 1
quest.7D1FB9A40B5CAE97.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &bUnlocks&f: Doors to T1 Echoes and Chapter 1

quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[0].en_us: A &6CAD's Socket&r is basically its &abullet clip&r.

quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[1].en_us: It's what &aSpell Bullets&r are loaded into, and it's responsible for transferring the compiled &bSpells&r contained within the Bullets to the &dCore&r for processing.
quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[1].zh_cn: 它是装填&a术式子弹&r的地方，并且也负责将子弹中已编译的&b术式&r转移到&d核心&r进行处理。

quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[3].en_us: A &6Socket&r has a &eBandwidth&r, which is the maximum size &8&o(in grid spaces)&r&r of a &bSpell&r that it can transfer to a &dCore&r, all at once.
quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[3].zh_cn: 一个&6弹夹&r有自己的&e带宽&r，这是它一次可以将&b术式&r传输到&d核心&r的最大值&8&o（在网格中）&r&r。

quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[4].en_us: &8&o(for example, a Socket with bandwidth 5 could transfer a Spell up to 5x5 in dimension)&r&r
quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &8&o（例如，一个带宽为5的弹夹最多可以传输尺寸为5x5的术式）&r&r

quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[6].en_us: Also, another non-trivial attribute of &6Sockets&r is to provide a way to store &3persistent information&r, the more &bMemory&r a &6Socket&r provides, more &bVectors&r can be stored for later &bSpell&r executions.
quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 此外，&6CAD弹夹&r的另一个特有的属性是提供一种存储&3连续信息&r的方法，一个&6弹夹&r提供的&b内存&r越多，可以存储的&b向量&r就越多，以便之后的&b术式&r执行。

quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[8].en_us: &8&o(&lTrick: Save Vector&r&8&o saves a vector to a designated Memory Slot, whereas &lSelector: Saved Vector&r&8&o retrieves the vector saved in the designated Memory Slot)&r&r
quest.7D2A583FBDCE4FC7.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: &8&o（&l启动式：储存向量&r&8&o可以将向量保存到指定的内存槽中，而&l选择符：储存向量&r&8&o可以检索保存在指定内存槽中的向量）&r&r

quest.7D3A5740B5857874.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dSecurity Manager&r allows you to control who has access to different network functions.
quest.7D3A5740B5857874.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d安全管理器&r可设置不同用户对各种网络功能的权限。

quest.7D3A5740B5857874.quest_desc[2].en_us: Right-click a &aSecurity Card&r to bind it to a player and configure it. Sneak + Right-click to clear the configuration.
quest.7D3A5740B5857874.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 手持&a安全卡&r右击即可绑定玩家并进行配置。潜行右击可清空配置。

quest.7D945B6D1311B741.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &dEcho&r mentioned a &2Healing Spring&r somewhere north of your base that can provide you with resources to make the &aChronon Cell&r.
quest.7D945B6D1311B741.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d回响&r提到过，在你基地的北方，有一个&2治愈之泉&r，它可以提供制造&a时元电芯&r所需的资源。

quest.7DE26DE10C64D2E7.quest_desc[0].en_us: Claiming this quest reward will set a waypoint at the &dEcho's &6Archive&r entrance.
quest.7DE26DE10C64D2E7.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 领取此任务奖励将在&d回响&6档案室&r入口处设置一个路径点。

quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &6Tempad&r allows you to open a door to any marked location.
quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &6时域仪&r可以开启一扇通往任意标记点的传送门。

quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[2].en_us: It also allows you to manually add new locations via current coordinates, and has several configuration options. Pinned locations can be teleported to via keybinds.
quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你也可以手动将当前坐标添加为新的标记点，添加时有多个选项可供配置。可以使用快捷键快速打开置顶标记点的传送门。

quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aLocation Cards&r can also be used in the Tempad interface to register or copy locations.
quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a定位卡&r也可以在时域仪的界面中用于注册和复制标记点。

quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&f: The &6Tempad&r does &cNOT&f function as a chronon storage for teleporting via the &aAction Pad&r.
quest.7DE9A4C7979AC1FA.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&f：使用&a操作板&r传送时，&6时域仪&r&c不会&f被视作时元存储装置。

quest.7E062B48AD37EAF1.quest_desc[0].en_us: Processors are used to craft most of the core components of your &eRS2&r network.

quest.7E062B48AD37EAF1.quest_desc[2].en_us: ["These can only be assembled inside a ", { "text": "Circuit Fabricator", "color": "light_purple", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "663460DE8AF7E464" }, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Circuit Fabricator Quest"} }, "."]

quest.7E0E4E6260C1D61E.quest_desc[0].en_us: With infinite power for your storage system and access to &zcreative spells&r from &6Ars&r, that only leaves one more thing to take care of before you can shape the world around you.

quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[0].en_us: One of the main uses of digital storage is the ability to &3Autocraft Items&r.
quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 数字化存储的主要用处就是&3自动制造物品&r。

quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[2].en_us: In &eAE2&r, this is done by creating custom multiblocks that make use of &aCrafting CPUs, Co-Processors&r, and more.
quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以在&eAE2&r中建造多方块结构，比如&a合成CPU和并行处理器&r之类的设备。

quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[4].en_us: To get started, you'll need to make the main crafting component: the &3Crafting Unit&r.
quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 如果想要搭建自动合成网络，你就得先做最基础的合成部件：&3合成单元&r。

quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[6].en_us: &eNote&r: &3Crafting Units&r require the &bFortron Infused Block&r &6World Engine Upgrade&r to craft.
quest.7E4FF5A454039E47.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: &e注意&r：要合成&3合成单元&r，需要先用&b力场子灌注块&r进行&6世界引擎升级&r。

quest.7E685EAD7FB60B45.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aSalvaging Table&r is used to break down affix items into their corresponding rarity materials:
quest.7E685EAD7FB60B45.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a回收台&r能将词缀物品分解为相应稀有度的材料：

quest.7E685EAD7FB60B45.quest_desc[7].en_us: The &aSalvaging Table&r can be automated by sending items in from the top or sides, and extracting them from the bottom of the table. Don't lose any items!
quest.7E685EAD7FB60B45.quest_desc[7].zh_cn: &a回收台&r可以从顶部和侧面自动输入物品并拆解，从底部输出。任何材料都不会被遗漏！

quest.7E685EAD7FB60B45.quest_desc[9].en_us: &eNote&f: &#EA6F14Godforged Pearls &cCANNOT&r be salvaged in this pack. You will have to craft them via the &6World Engine&r after unlocking the &3Draconic Upgrade&r.
quest.7E685EAD7FB60B45.quest_desc[9].zh_cn: &e注意&f：&#EA6F14神铸珍珠&r在这个整合包中&c无法&r被拆解。你需要在解锁&3神龙升级&r后，使用&6世界引擎&r制作。

quest.7E7745D3E460831F.quest_desc[0].en_us: Those &aQuantum Links&r will be a great help as you require more and more automation from the &6World Engine&r.
quest.7E7745D3E460831F.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 随着你对&6世界引擎&r的自动化需求越来越多，那些&a量子链接&r能为你提供很大帮助。

quest.7E7745D3E460831F.quest_desc[2].en_us: Speak to &dThe Light Bender&r so they can show you where to install this &3World Engine Upgrade&r.
quest.7E7745D3E460831F.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 与&d折光师&r交谈，他会教你如何安装&3世界引擎升级&r。

quest.7E88C7654F281E43.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &#EA6F14Augmenting Table&r is an end-game crafting station used to augment the individual affixes on an item.
quest.7E88C7654F281E43.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &#EA6F14强化台&r是游戏后期的设备，可以强化物品的词缀。

quest.7E88C7654F281E43.quest_desc[2].en_us: It can upgrade an existing Affix at the cost of two &#EA6F14Sigils of Enhancement&r, or can reroll affixes at the cost of 1 &#EA6F14Sigil of Enhancement&r.
quest.7E88C7654F281E43.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 消耗两个&#EA6F14强化符石&r可增强一个已有的词缀，消耗一个&#EA6F14强化符石&r可刷新词缀。

quest.7EA0870C93C7DBA5.quest_desc[0].en_us: &aPowercells&r are energy storage blocks that are capable of sharing their storage with each other adjacently as a single structure.
quest.7EA0870C93C7DBA5.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a能量单元&r是一种能量存储方块，它们可以彼此相连，成为一个整体结构。

quest.7EA0870C93C7DBA5.quest_desc[2].en_us: To insert or extract energy, configure a side of the cell using a &eSmart Wrench&r. Blue sides will allow energy into the powercell, yellow will allow energy to be pushed out.
quest.7EA0870C93C7DBA5.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以用&e智能扳手&r配置能量单元的侧面以输入或输出能量，蓝色端口为输入，黄色端口为输出。

quest.7EEBD17F0EA6EE0C.quest_desc[0].en_us: Submitting the blocks required for the &3Upgrade&f and claiming its rewards will automatically assemble your team's &6World Engine&r.
quest.7EEBD17F0EA6EE0C.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 提交&3升级&f所需的方块并领取奖励，即可自动为你团队的&6世界引擎&r组装该升级。

quest.7EEBD17F0EA6EE0C.quest_desc[2].en_us: &eNote&f: Any blocks placed where an upgrade should go will be voided.
quest.7EEBD17F0EA6EE0C.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &e注意&f：任何放置在升级组装处的方块将被替换。

quest.7EF7546FF007EF36.quest_desc[0].en_us: &2Bio Fuel&r is created by crushing down organic materials in a &aCrusher&r.
quest.7EF7546FF007EF36.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 在&a粉碎机&r中打碎生物质就可以得到&2生物燃料&r。

quest.7EF7546FF007EF36.quest_desc[2].en_us: This is used to craft and power a &aBio-Generator&r, which can be a useful power upgrade in the early game!
quest.7EF7546FF007EF36.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你可以用它制作&a生物能发电机&r，对于前期来说，它的能量非常可观！

quest.7EF7546FF007EF36.quest_desc[4].en_us: It's also used to create &6Ethene&r, which is an energy-dense gas used for both power and crafting &eHDPE Pellets&r.
quest.7EF7546FF007EF36.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 还可以用来制造&6乙烯&r，这是一种能量密度极高的气体，既可用于发电，也可以制作&e高密度聚乙烯丸&r。

quest.7F4E7C687E7D8707.quest_desc[0].en_us: There are several ways to keep items from piling up on the ground from your farms!
quest.7F4E7C687E7D8707.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 这里有几种方法可以防止你的农场物品堆积在地上！

quest.7F4E7C687E7D8707.quest_desc[2].en_us: Each of these are configurable, allowing you to set the range for item collection.
quest.7F4E7C687E7D8707.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 每一个都可以配置，允许你设置物品收集的范围。

quest.7F5729C2350E3087.quest_desc[0].en_us: You'll need items from the &9Otherworld&r to progress further, and &aSpirit Fire&r does just that.
quest.7F5729C2350E3087.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 你会需要更多来自&9异界&r的物品以推进神秘学研究，而&a灵火&r能够帮到你得到那些材料。

quest.7F5729C2350E3087.quest_desc[2].en_us: Throwing a &aDemon's Dream Fruit&r on the ground and setting it on fire will produce &dSpirit Fire&r, which never burns out and does not harm entities.
quest.7F5729C2350E3087.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 把&a魔鬼之梦果&r扔在地上并点燃就能产生&d灵火&r，这种火不会自然熄灭，也不会对实体造成伤害。

quest.7F5729C2350E3087.quest_desc[4].en_us: Throwing items into the &dSpirit Fire&r will convert them into their &9Otherworld&r equivalent.
quest.7F5729C2350E3087.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 把物品丢进&d灵火&r就能将其转化为&9异界&r版本的对应物品。

quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[0].en_us: The first task from the &dMagician&r is to unearth magical trees from the world.
quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &d魔法师&r给你的第一个任务是从世界中发掘出魔法树。

quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[2].en_us: You should work together with an Expert or Master &2Archaeologist&r in an &aUnearther&r to dig up these magical saplings up.
quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 你需要与专家或大师级的&2考古学家&r合作，在&a发掘室&r中挖出这种魔法树苗。

quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[4].en_us: ["If you're more of the explorer type, you may also find some magical resources in the ", {"text": "Arcane Grove", "color": "dark_green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "066B47D2AB72355C"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "Go to Arcane Grove Quest"}}, ". Use the compass provided by the ", {"text": "Magician", "color": "light_purple"}, " to guide you."]
quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: ["如果你更喜欢探险的话，或许还能在", {"text": "奥术林地", "color": "dark_green", "underlined": true, "clickEvent": { "action": "change_page", "value": "066B47D2AB72355C"}, "hoverEvent": {"action": "show_text", "contents": "前往奥术林地任务"}}, "中找到一些魔法资源。", {"text": "魔法师", "color": "light_purple"}, "给你的那个指南针会为你指路。"]

quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[6].en_us: If you're planning to engage the enemies within the &2Grove&r, make sure to equip at least &bDiamond-level&r gear. &cYou've been warned!&r
quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果你打算会一会&2林地&r中的那些敌人，你的装备至少得是&b钻石级别&r的才行。&c我警告过你了！&r

quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[8].en_us: You should return to the &dMagician&r once you have completed his task.
quest.7F7C0B1523AA28C4.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 完成&d魔法师&r给你的任务后，请回去找他。

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[0].en_us: Cognition has a unique method of XP generation by way of &aBibliophages&r: tiny constructs that steadily break down bookshelves into XP orbs until only &7Forgotten Dust&r is left behind.
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: 认知有一种依靠&a噬菌体&r生产经验的独特方法：这种微小的结构体能够不断地将书架分解成经验球，直到只剩下&7遗忘尘埃&r。

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[2].en_us: &aInfected Bookshelves&r can spread the phages onto other bookshelves, allowing for a single use of a Bibliophage to affect as many connected bookshelves as available. This process can be halted by using a &eStaff of Attunement&r on the infected shelf.
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: &a受侵染的书架&r会把噬菌体传播到其他书架上，这意味着使用一次噬菌体就能侵染所有相连接的书架。可以使用&e调试权杖&r来停止这一过程。

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[4].en_us: &aSpecial bookshelves&r made using written books and enchanted books can also be infected, producing more XP value over their decay than regular shelves.
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: &a用成书和附魔书制成的特殊书架&r也可以被侵染，并在过程中产出比普通书架更多的经验值。

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[6].en_us: A 'nest' for phages can be made if bookshelves are not in ready supply. &aFluorescent Agar&r is made using the dust left behind by decayed bookshelves, and then placed among infected bookshelves to allow phages to convert it into proper &aNutrient Agar&r, which can passively spread phage infection onto the 26 blocks surrounding it if able.
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果暂时没有书架，那么你可以为噬菌体制作一个“巢”。&a荧光琼脂&r是利用腐烂的书架留下的尘埃制成的。将它放置在受侵染的书架之间，它就会被噬菌体转化为可利用的&a营养琼脂&r， 它能被动地将噬菌体侵染到周围可传播的26个方块上。

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[8].en_us: This Agar can be broken and picked back up to further enhance it:
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[8].zh_cn: 这种琼脂可以被破坏并拾取，从而进一步增强它：

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[9].en_us: &6Insightful Agar&r will increase the rate of infection and decay.
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[9].zh_cn: &6洞察琼脂&r会加快侵染和腐烂的速度。

quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[10].en_us: &dExtravagant Agar&r will increase rate of infection and the XP value gained from decay.
quest.7FBA170218539BE8.quest_desc[10].zh_cn: &d奢华琼脂&r会增加感染率和腐烂时产出的经验值。

quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aEnrichment Chamber&r has several important uses!

quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[2].en_us: This machine can break down 3 raw ores into &e4 Dusts&r, essentially multiplying your ingot returns.
quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[2].zh_cn: 该机器可以将三个粗矿打碎成&e4个矿粉&r，从而提升矿物的收益。

quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[4].en_us: It's also used to create &cEnriched&r versions of items, like &cEnriched Redstone&r, &2Enriched Carbon&r, and more!
quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[4].zh_cn: 也可以用来制造&c富集材料&r，例如&c富集红石&r和&2富集碳&r之类的材料！

quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[6].en_us: These enriched items can be used in the &aMetallurgic Infuser&r for 8x the original value.
quest.7FCCB25011D69673.quest_desc[6].zh_cn: 如果将这些富集材料放入&a冶金灌注机&r时，则可以提供原物品8倍的材料值。

quest.7FEDD82D9B47EFCD.quest_desc[0].en_us: The &aBio Generator&r consumes biomass to generate energy, which can be increased with &bAddons&r.
quest.7FEDD82D9B47EFCD.quest_desc[0].zh_cn: &a生物质能发电机&r可消耗生物质产生能量，加装&b插件&r可提升发电效率。
